rows.original:
[flags.ARENED_VISIT
        |You head over to Arened's house, [dayNight
            |letting yourself in since he's left the door drawn open. The fox-folk man greets you with a friendly wave. "Just a moment, [pc.name]," he says, glancing back at his work. "I'm almost finished! Girls, grab something to drink, won't you?"
            
            One of the younger harpies roosting up in the rafters makes an over-dramatic sigh after some prodding from her sisters and hops down, going to fetch [party.yall] some snowberry juice. 
            
            Arened only leaves you waiting a few seconds, running gloved hands up and down to smooth the last rough edge of his work before finally easing off his peddling. He stands, stretches, and pulls off his gloves, laying them carefully out on his workbench. "So! What brings you?"
            |and rap your knuckles on the wall beside the door. "Arened, are you awake?"
            
            One of his older harpy daughters answers your call, a girl that looks around your own age with hair the same reddish-pink as her dad's. "Hiya! Dad's just putting one of my sisters back to bed. C'mon in!"
            
            You're ushered in, just in time to see Arened clambering down the ladder to the rafters. He greets you with a smile. "Ay-ah, [pc.name]! What brings you?"
        ]
        |[dayNight
            |Arened's sitting just inside the door to his house, both feet peddling to spin a potter's wheel while he works the clay with both hands.
            |You're able to pick Arened's abode out by bricks of spare clay stacked up under a tarp at his door, and as you draw near, you can hear a potter's wheel cranking away inside. When you pull the edge of the curtain door aside, you can see him sitting at work, peddling with his feet and working the clay with his hands.
        ] His great big paws are covered with leather gloves, keeping the wet clay from ruining his fur, and he's merrily singing a tune while he works, a jolly song the mountain-foxes' indecipherable native tongue.
        
        And his tune is being matched by several more voices inside, all better singers than he by far. 
        
        "Ah! [pc.name], please, come in and be welcome!" he says, noticing your arrival. When you step in, you're greeted by not just the potter, but a room full of young women ranging from barely more than toddlers to ladies you'd say are probably older than you are — if they weren't all harpies, anyway. There's got to be a dozen of them, maybe more, packed into the house, mostly sitting up in a set of open rafters that would be where the second floor of a normal house would be. A few of them have the same reddish-pink hair as Arened's fur, but others have feathers of every color of the rainbow and a few more besides, leaving a technicolor palette scattered across the house's stone floor from their shed. 
        
        The potter heaves himself up from his workbench and extends a hand, but before you can take it, several of the feathery ladies jump you instead, pulling you inside with giddy squeals and excited giggling. 
        
        "Ah, they don't see [pc.ra harpy
            |others of their own kind
            |lowlanders
        ] often," Arened laughs, removing his gloves and setting them aside. His Belharan is slow and measured, a clear effort on his part to enunciate these foreign words clearly. "And my girls are endlessly curious. Tell me, what brings you?"
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.ARENED_VISIT
        |你前往阿雷恩的家。 [dayNight
            |趁他没把门关上，你走了进去。那个狐狸族男子友好地向你挥了挥手：“稍等片刻…… [pc.name]差不多完成了！”他说着，回头看了看自己的工作。“姑娘们，去拿点喝的来吧，好吗？”

在屋檐下休息的那些年轻女妖中，有一个在姐妹们的催促下，夸张地叹了口气，然后跳下来去拿东西了。 [party.yall] 一些雪莓汁。

他只是让你们等待了几秒钟，然后戴上手部套，仔细地整理自己工作的最后细节，直到一切都完美无缺，才终于停止了忙碌。他站起身来，伸了伸腰，摘下了手部套，小心翼翼地将它们放在工作台上。“那么！是什么事让您来找我呢？
            |然后你用指关节敲了敲门旁的墙壁：“阿雷内德，你醒着吗？”

他的一个年纪稍大的女儿回应了你，那女孩看起来和你年纪相仿，头发也和她父亲一样，是那种红粉色的。“嗨！爸爸正在把我的一个妹妹送回床上呢，快进来吧！”

你被邀请进了屋，正好看到阿雷内德正沿着梯子爬向房梁。他微笑着向你打招呼：“哎呀…… [pc.name]! 你来找我有什么事吗？
        ]
        |[dayNight
            |阿伦德就坐在他家门口，双脚不停地转动着陶轮，同时用双手塑造黏土。
            |你可以从阿伦德家门处堆放的那些备用黏土块中找到他的工作室。当你靠近时，会听到里面传来陶艺轮转动的声音。当你拉开帘门的一角，就会看到他正坐在那里工作，双脚不停地踩动陶艺轮，双手熟练地操控着黏土。
        ] 它那巨大的爪子上套着皮手部套，这样湿黏的黏土就不会弄脏它的毛皮了。它一边干活，一边欢快地唱着歌——那是山狐们那种难以理解的母语。

而它的歌声，里面还有好几道其他的声音在回应着，这些声音的唱功显然都比它要好得多。

“啊！ [pc.name]请进来，欢迎您的到来！”他注意到你的到来后说道。当你走进房间时，迎接你的不仅仅是那位陶艺师，还有一个满是年轻女性的房间——这些女性有的还只是些刚学步的孩童，而有的则看起来显然比你年长……当然，如果她们不是那些女妖的话。 房子里肯定有十几只，甚至可能更多。它们大多栖息在那些敞开的屋梁上——在普通房子里，那些地方应该就是二楼的位置。其中有几只的毛发呈现出与阿雷内德相同的红粉色，但还有其他的则长着五颜六色的羽毛，除此之外，还有一些其他种类的羽毛，这些五彩斑斓的羽毛散落在房子的石地上。 
        
        陶艺师从工作台前站起身，伸出了手部，但还没等你握住他的手部，那些羽毛般轻盈的女子们却抢先跳到了你身上，伴随着兴奋的尖叫和欢笑声，将你拉了进去。

“啊，它们根本看不见…… [pc.ra harpy
            |同类中的其他个体
            |低地居民
        ] 通常都是这样，”阿伦德笑着摘下手部套，把它们放在一边。他的贝尔哈兰语说得很慢、很谨慎，显然是在努力把这些外来词汇发得清楚些。“而我的女儿们总是充满好奇心。告诉我，是什么事让你来的？
    ]

rows.original: Sit awhile by the fire and chat with the village's potter — and perhaps some of the colorful fowl he's got with him.
rows.translation: 在火堆旁坐一会儿，和村里的陶艺匠聊聊天吧——说不定他还会让你看看他养的那些五颜六色的家禽呢。
rows.raw: "Sit awhile by the fire and chat with the village's potter — and perhaps some of the colorful fowl he's got with him."

rows.original: Between Arened's pottery and all these harpy gals, surely he's got some goods he'd be willing to part with?
rows.translation: 有了阿雷内德的陶器，再加上这些漂亮的女子，他肯定有些宝贝愿意拿出来交换吧？
rows.raw: "Between Arened's pottery and all these harpy gals, surely he's got some goods he'd be willing to part with?"

rows.original: Rely on the family's hospitality for the evening, and get what rest you can.
rows.translation: 今晚就依靠家人的热情好客来休息吧，尽量多睡一会儿。
rows.raw: "Rely on the family's hospitality for the evening, and get what rest you can."

rows.original: Spend some %"quality time" with the mature vulperine.
rows.translation: 与这位成熟的女性角色共度一些“高质量”的时光吧。
rows.raw: 'Spend some %"quality time" with the mature vulperine.'

rows.translation: 和你的那些狡猾的小家伙们一起玩耍吧。

rows.original: [silly|Get that orb pondered|Get a nice massage].
rows.translation: [silly|拿去仔细思考那个球体吧|去享受一次舒适的按摩吧]。
rows.raw: "[silly|Get that orb pondered|Get a nice massage]."

rows.original:
"Have time for a chat?" you ask. 

    Arened gestures to the stone bench and perches himself down, sitting astride it. [dayNight
        |A few of the younger harpies flap down and take up roost in his lap, while an older girl about your age squishes her chest into his back and throws her arms around his shoulders. The rest of the flock gather 'round in short order, sitting above you in the rafters or huddling up by the hearthfire, well within arm's reach. 
        
        "Speak, my friend. The girls are eager to listen, as am I!"
        |"Speak, my friend, but quietly! The younger chicks are fast asleep!" he says, nodding towards the rafters. The youngest might be, but there's still half a dozen adult harpies wide awake to swarm over the pair of you, offering up hot tea and dinner's leftover bread before huddling up to listen in.
    ]
rows.translation:
有时间聊聊天吗？”你问道。

他指了指那条石凳，然后坐了下去，两腿分开跨坐在上面。 [dayNight
        |几只年纪较小的雌鹰飞下来，落在他的腿上栖息，而一只年龄与你相仿的雌鹰则把胸贴在他的背上，双臂环绕着他的肩膀。其余的雌鹰也很快聚集了过来，有的坐在你头顶的屋梁上，有的则挤在壁炉旁，都在他伸手可及的范围之内。

“说吧，我的朋友。这些女孩都很乐意听你说话，我也一样！
        |说话吧，我的朋友，但声音小一点！那些小家伙都已经睡熟了！”他一边说，一边指向屋梁。虽然最小的那些孩子确实已经睡着了，但还有半打成年女妖醒着呢，它们会围过来，给你们端上热茶和晚餐剩下的面包，然后聚在一起听你们说话。
    ]

rows.original:
"Ahah, yes, the girls always draw attention," Arened laughs, plucking up a small chick and putting her on his knee. "The story is really not so grand as all that, though. When I was a young man, I was a gatherer for the village, bringing berries and Belharan stone and discarded eggs back from the higher peaks. The harpies that roost in the ruins up-mountain have a habit of leaving their barren eggs all over, like decorations or territorial markers, but they are good eating for we vulperines! However, it so happened that on one of my treks up the mountain on a balmy summer day I found an abandoned nest. Within it was one egg standing among many shattered shells, possessed of a brilliant golden-black hue. A beauty unlike any I had ever seen before. It was never a question of if I would take it, I could not resist its luster. I was sure the village medicine-man would pay handsomely for it."

        A couple of the youngest harpies gasp in shock at the idea. Arened grins at them and pets their feathers. "Imagine my surprise, as I was climbing back down the cliff, when that egg began to rumble around in my arms! I just about fell off the side of the mountain I was so taken off guard. Years of bringing back eggs and never once had one been live! I will never know what caused her mother to abandon her child alone, but regardless, I had taken the egg from the nest, and was near enough to the village that I was able to reach it in a sprint before the egg hatched in earnest. I had barely gotten it wrapped up at home before out popped a beautiful black-feathered chick, squawling up a storm! I had no clue what to do!"
        
        While some of the littler harpies flap their wings sympathetically, you take the chance to ask: "And her mother never came looking for her?"
        
        "No, never," Arened says. "Nor did I ever find a reason for her to have abandoned her nest. Perhaps she thought the egg was stillborn, after all its sisters had hatched. And what was I to do with an abandoned chick? She would not survive the trip back up the mountain, she was so small and frail, even if I wanted to take her and search for her mother. And, so, I did what I felt was right: I built a nest beside my bed and, with a little help from a wetnurse and the village's Sorran priest of the time, took the little raven in as my own. My Vasha."
        
        [vasha.met
            |Vasha! The Sorran paladin you've encountered guarding the mountaintop.
        ]
        
        "That explains one harpy," you say. "But you seem to have a whole flock!"
        
        Arened nods. "Indeed. Vasha changed my life in more ways than I could have expected! When I carried her scent upon me, the harpies on the mountain went from indifferent to adoring — they knew I was safe. Not just for them, but for their children, too. I was able to get very close to the great matron's lands, far more so than any other forager, which brought me esteem from my peers. And the harpies began to give me gifts, too: shiny scraps they had found, flecks of gold, and the like... and eggs, too. Suddenly young harpies that weren't ready to be mothers were leaving live eggs out amidst duds where I would find them, and Vasha got her first sisters. And then, well..."
        
        The fox-man reaches behind him and ruffles the wing of a girl whose feathers are the same pale pink hue as his fur. "Some of those sisters began to carry my blood, too."
        
        The pink harpy grins proudly, puffing out her chest. 
        
        Another with green feathers chirps. "Daddy loves us all the same though."
        
        Several agreements are issued from young and old bird alike, and you could swear Arened's cheeks color through his fur. His tail wags off the back of his stool, dragging a particularly tiny harpy around with it. "And there you have it," he says. "The story of the flock. My beautiful girls are all gifts from their mothers, in one way or another. I would not trade even one of them for all the world."
        
        He really stepped up, huh?
rows.translation:
哈哈，没错，女孩子们总是容易吸引注意呢，”阿雷纳德笑着，抓起一只小鸡放在膝盖上。“不过，这个故事其实并没有那么夸张。我年轻的时候，是村里负责采集食物的成员，会从高山上去采撷浆果、贝拉兰石以及那些被遗弃的鸟蛋。那些栖息在山上废墟中的鹰身女妖，有把它们那些没有受精的鸟蛋扔得到处都是的习惯，就像是在点缀环境或者标记领地一样，不过对我们这些狐狸族来说，这些鸟蛋可是非常好的食物！然而，就在一个温暖的夏日，我在上山采集食物的时候，偶然发现了一个被遗弃的鸟巢。在那些破碎的鸟蛋壳中间，有一个颜色呈现出灿烂的金黑色的鸟蛋，它的美丽程度是我以前从未见过的。我根本没考虑过是否要拿它，我实在无法抗拒它那迷人的光泽。我敢肯定，村里的医者一定会出高价购买它的。

        几个年纪最小的女妖听到这个故事后，都震惊得倒抽了一口气。阿伦德对着她们笑了笑，还轻抚了她们的羽毛：“你们能想象我当时的惊讶吗？当我正从悬崖上往下爬的时候，那个蛋突然在我怀里开始动来动去！我差点从山上掉下去，简直完全没料到会发生这种事。这些年来，我带回来的蛋从来都没有一个是活的！我永远也不会知道，为什么那只鸟的母亲会把它独自留下……不过不管怎样，我当时把那个蛋带回了村子，距离村子很近，所以我能够在蛋真正孵化之前赶到那里。我刚把蛋拿回家包好，一只长着黑色羽毛的漂亮小鸟就破壳而出，吵吵闹闹地叫个不停！我完全不知道该该怎么办……
        
        当一些较小的乌鸦同情地拍打着翅膀时，你趁机问道：“那她的母亲从来没有来找过她吗？”

“没有，从来没有，”阿雷内德回答道，“我也没能找到她抛弃自己孩子的理由。也许她认为那个蛋已经死产了，因为它的其他兄弟姐妹都已经孵化出来了。而我，又能拿一个被抛弃的小鸟怎么办呢？它太弱小了，根本无法熬过返回山上的旅途，即使我想带着它去寻找它的母亲。所以，我就做了我认为正确的事情：我在自己的床边筑了一个巢，然后在一位保姆和当时村里的索兰牧师的帮助下，把这个小乌鸦当作自己的孩子来抚养。它就是我的瓦莎。
        
        [vasha.met
            |瓦莎！就是那个守在山顶上的索兰圣骑士吧。
        ]

“这就解释了为什么会有那只女妖，”你说，“但你们似乎有一整群这样的女妖啊！”

阿伦德点了点头。“确实如此。瓦莎改变了我的人生，其影响远超我的预期！当我身上带着她的气味时，山上的那些女妖从原本的漠不关心变成了崇拜我——它们知道我是安全的，不仅对它们自己来说，对它们的后代也是如此。因此，我能够比其他任何觅食者都更接近那位女妖首领的领地，这也让我在同伴中赢得了尊重。而这些女妖也开始给我送礼物：它们找到的闪亮碎片、金粒之类的东西……还有鸟蛋。突然间，那些还没到生育年龄的年轻女妖也会把未孵化的鸟蛋放在那些空蛋壳旁边，而我总能找到它们，于是瓦莎也拥有了自己的姐妹们。然后，嗯……
        
        狐狸人伸手到身后，拨动了那个女孩的羽毛——她的羽毛与他身上的毛色一样，都是淡粉色。“有些姐妹也开始继承了我的血脉了。”

那个粉红色的女妖骄傲地咧嘴一笑，挺起了胸膛。

另一个长着绿色羽毛的生物叽叽喳喳地说道：“不过爸爸还是爱我们所有人的。
        
        老老少少的鸟儿们纷纷发出了同意的声音，你甚至可以发誓，阿雷内德的脸颊因为激动而让它的羽毛都显得红了。它的尾巴在凳子后面摇来摇去，还拖着一只特别小的女妖一起摆动。“就是这样，”它说道，“这就是关于这个鸟群的故事。我那些漂亮的小鸟们，无一不是以这样或那样的方式，由它们的母亲送给我的。就算给我整个世界，我也不会放弃其中任何一只。
        
        他真的挺身而出啦，是吧？

I will never know what caused her mother to abandon her child alone, but regardless, I had taken the egg from the nest, and was near enough to the village that I was able to reach it in a sprint before the egg hatched in earnest. I had barely gotten it wrapped up at home before out popped a beautiful black-feathered chick, squawling up a storm! I had no clue what to do!"
        
        While some of the littler harpies flap their wings sympathetically, you take the chance to ask: "And her mother never came looking for her?"
        
        "No, never," Arened says. "Nor did I ever find a reason for her to have abandoned her nest. Perhaps she thought the egg was stillborn, after all its sisters had hatched. And what was I to do with an abandoned chick? She would not survive the trip back up the mountain, she was so small and frail, even if I wanted to take her and search for her mother. And, so, I did what I felt was right: I built a nest beside my bed and, with a little help from a wetnurse and the village's Sorran priest of the time, took the little raven in as my own. My Vasha."
        
        [vasha.met
            |Vasha! The Sorran paladin you've encountered guarding the mountaintop.
        ]
        
        "That explains one harpy," you say. "But you seem to have a whole flock!"
        
        Arened nods. "Indeed. Vasha changed my life in more ways than I could have expected! When I carried her scent upon me, the harpies on the mountain went from indifferent to adoring — they knew I was safe. Not just for them, but for their children, too. I was able to get very close to the great matron's lands, far more so than any other forager, which brought me esteem from my peers. And the harpies began to give me gifts, too: shiny scraps they had found, flecks of gold, and the like... and eggs, too. Suddenly young harpies that weren't ready to be mothers were leaving live eggs out amidst duds where I would find them, and Vasha got her first sisters. And then, well..."
        
        The fox-man reaches behind him and ruffles the wing of a girl whose feathers are the same pale pink hue as his fur. "Some of those sisters began to carry my blood, too."
        
        The pink harpy grins proudly, puffing out her chest. 
        
        Another with green feathers chirps. "Daddy loves us all the same though."
        
        Several agreements are issued from young and old bird alike, and you could swear Arened's cheeks color through his fur. His tail wags off the back of his stool, dragging a particularly tiny harpy around with it. "And there you have it," he says. "The story of the flock. My beautiful girls are all gifts from their mothers, in one way or another. I would not trade even one of them for all the world."
        
        He really stepped up, huh?'

rows.original: You can't help but notice there's a remarkable number of bird-girls crammed into his hovel...
rows.translation: 你不得不注意到，他的小屋里挤满了数量惊人的鸟女……
rows.raw: "You can't help but notice there's a remarkable number of bird-girls crammed into his hovel..."

rows.original: "I can tell you nothing that the mountain, Khor Lachista, cannot tell you itself, if you have the courage to look!" Arened laughs. "Though I confess, it takes more headstrong bravado than ever these days. I suppose I cannot recommend you wander the mountain paths when Vasha and her sisters are so zealously defending it from the demons burbling up from the understone." "Let's start with that, then," you say. "Tell me how the demons have affected you." He shrugs, and when he speaks, he enunciates even more carefully than usual. "Little, thankfully. As I say, Sorra's guardians are fighting them fiercely whenever they appear... though the girls cannot be everywhere at once. Widow Talana disappeared more than a week ago, and several of the young hunters have had brushes with the demons and come away with tails tucked. Young Branno claims to have felled a flying demon, but no one can vouch for the truth of it, and he is known to be a braggart. Our priestess prays tirelessly for Sorra's protection, and between her rites and the Matron's paladins, our village has been spared what ails Khor'minos below." "Tell me about the Matron, then?" "Ah. Matron Shaedra, blessed of Sorra. She has ruled the highest peaks longer than anyone in the village has been alive. Our elders suggest she has lived since the Godswar, even. She keeps court up in the ancient ruins near to the very top of the mountain. There was once a villa up there, belonging to some noble house before the war. There is a bath house, a tower, and a temple that I have seen, and I have heard that there is more buried in the snow. But the manticores and wyverns claim what Shaedra's flock does not, and the wyverns especially are quite violent in protecting their territory. Our winged neighbors make exploring beyond the river quite hazardous!" A pink-feathered harpy spreads her wings up and out, flexing her claws and mocking a little roar. Her younger sisters shriek, then giggle as she starts tickling their tummies. "Do the other folk on the mountains give you that much trouble?" Arened waves a hand. "Only when we stray into their lands. So, too, would we harry a wyvern that tried nesting near our village! That is the way of things here: establishing territory is vital when resources are so scarce." "What resources are even up here?" you ask, only half serious. "I just see stone and water." "Those're super important!" a harpy insists. "Our house is made of stone!" Her dad nods. "Those are the building blocks of life up here. But there are gems and gold to be found up here, and relics of the past if you are brave and quick. What we cannot produce ourselves up here, we can trade for with the minotaurs, and they are — or were, at least — happy to do business. And I am proud to say my pots decorate more than a few Minoan villas today!"
rows.translation: 关于这座山，我实在没有什么可以告诉你的。 科拉奇斯塔它自己也无法告诉你答案，只有你有勇气去探索的时候，才能找到答案！”阿雷内德里的众人笑了起来。“不过我得承认，如今要做出这样的决定，确实需要比以往更多的勇气和决心。我想，在瓦莎和她的姐妹们如此拼命地保护着这些山路，防止那些从地下涌出来的恶魔侵扰的时候，我确实不建议你去那些山路上冒险。 那就从这个开始吧，”你说，“告诉我那些恶魔对你产生了什么影响。” 他耸了耸肩，说话时比平时更加谨慎地吐字：“还好影响不大。正如我所说，每当那些恶魔出现时，索拉的守护者们都会与它们进行激烈的战斗。不过，这些女孩不可能同时出现在所有地方。泰拉娜寡妇在一周多前就消失了，还有几名年轻的猎人也与那些恶魔有过接触，但都侥幸逃生了。年轻的布兰诺声称自己击落了一只会飞的恶魔，但没人能证实他的说法是否属实——毕竟他以爱吹牛而出名。 我们的女祭司不懈地祈祷，为索拉祈求庇护。多亏了她的仪式以及女族长的骑士们，我们的村庄才免于遭受科尔米诺斯其他地区所遭遇的灾难。 那请告诉我关于女祭司的事吧。” “啊。女祭司莎德拉，受到索拉的庇佑。她统治这些高山的时间，比村里任何一个人的寿命都要长。我们的长者们甚至认为，她从神战时期就一直活到现在。 她在靠近山顶的古老废墟中建立了自己的居所。在那片地方，战争之前曾有一座属于某个贵族家族的别墅。我见过那里有浴室、塔楼和寺庙，而且听说在积雪之下还埋藏着更多的东西。 但是那些螳螂兽和翼龙所占据的区域，并不是莎德拉的鸟群能够进入的；尤其是那些翼龙，在保护自己的领地时表现得极为凶猛。因此，我们的这些有翼邻居使得在河流另一边进行探索变得相当危险！ 那只羽毛粉嫩的哈比展开双翼，炫耀着它的爪子，同时发出模仿咆哮的声音。它的妹妹们先是尖叫起来，然后在她开始挠她们的肚子时，又开始咯咯笑起来。 “山上的其他动物也会给你们带来这么多麻烦吗？ 阿伦德挥了挥手：“只有当我们闯入他们的领地时，才会遭到他们的攻击。同样，如果有巨龙试图在我们村庄附近筑巢，我们也会去驱赶它！在这里，划定领地是至关重要的——因为资源实在太稀缺了。” “可这里到底有什么资源呢？”你半开玩笑地问道，“我看到的只有石头和水而已。 那些东西非常重要！”一个女妖坚持说道，“我们的房子可是用石头建造的！” 她的父亲点了点头：“这些确实是这里生存的基本要素。不过，如果你足够勇敢且行动迅速，还能在这里找到宝石、黄金，以及过去的遗迹。那些我们自己无法生产的东西，可以和弥诺陶洛斯人进行交易，而他们——至少过去是这样——非常乐意与我们做生意。我很自豪地说，如今我的陶器装饰着不少米诺斯人的别墅！

rows.original: What can he tell you about the mountain?
rows.translation: 他能告诉你关于那座山的哪些事情呢？
rows.raw: "What can he tell you about the mountain?"

rows.original:
Arened makes a winged sign with his hands and bows his head. "Yes, you speak true. Our village reveres the Storm Maiden, for it she that curtains the winds that would otherwise blow us all straight off the mountainside." He laughs. "All we who dwell atop the peaks beg her for her protection, and cultivate her blessings that we might live in harmony with her chosen."

        "The priestess says our village is blessed cus of us!" one of his older harpies says, preening. 
        
        "Yes, she does, and we are," her dad says, rubbing her ear. "I know I certainly am."
        
        "What does your village's worship entail?" you ask.
        
        Arened gestures towards the middle of the village. "For that you should ask our priestess! But there is a great deal of singing, and the sacrifice of fresh game on her alter, for these are the things that Sorra loves most of all. When the winds howl fiercely, we throw spears into the gale to show our displeasure, and sure as sunset, the storms will quiet before long."
        
        "You throw spears at your goddess's winds?"
        
        The harpies titter. One of them, the largest and most well-built of the bunch, flexes. "Sorra teaches that you shouldn't hide your emotions. Show the world, even the gods, what you really think!"
        
        Another pokes one of her biceps. "You just like getting to throw things!"
        
        "Yeah, and? If Sorra's the wind, she must like being pelted with things, cuz she sure sends plenty of storms for us to complain to her about!"
rows.translation:
阿伦德用手部比划出一个象征翅膀的姿势，然后低下了头。“没错，你说得对。我们村庄一直敬仰风暴少女，正是她阻挡了那些会把我们从山崖上吹下去的狂风。”他笑着说，“所有居住在山顶上的人们都祈求她的庇护，也努力获得她的恩赐，这样我们才能与她所眷顾的生灵和谐共处。

        女祭司说，正是因为我们，我们的村庄才得到了神的庇佑！”其中一只年纪稍大的女妖得意地说道。

“没错，她确实是这么说的，我们也是这么认为的。”她的父亲一边揉着她的耳朵一边说，“我敢肯定，我自己也受到了神的恩赐。”

“那么，你们村庄的祭祀活动都是些什么内容呢？”你问道。
        
        他指向村庄的中央说道：“关于这件事，你应该去问我们的女祭司！不过，她总是会唱很多歌，还会在她的祭坛上献上新鲜的猎物，因为这些正是索拉最喜欢的。当狂风猛烈地呼啸时，我们会把长矛扔进风中，以此来表达我们的不满。而到了日落的时候，暴风雨肯定就会平息的。
        
        你竟然用长矛去攻击你的女神所创造的风吗？”

那些女妖们发出了咯咯的笑声。其中一只体型最大、体格最为魁梧的女妖挺了挺身子，说道：“Sorra教导我们，不应该隐藏自己的情感。要让全世界，甚至众神，都看到你真正的想法！
        
        另一个人戳了戳她的二头肌：“你就是喜欢扔东西吧！”

“是啊，那又怎样？如果索拉是风，那她肯定也喜欢被人用东西扔吧，因为她确实经常引发风暴，让我们有理由去抱怨她啊！

rows.raw: "The village seem strongly faithful to the Storm Maiden..."

rows.original: [flags.VASHA_ARENED_MEET |"Ah, my pride and joy. I'm glad you two have finally met!" |"Ah, I take it you've met!" ] Arened laughs. "Vasha received a holy vision from Sorra when all this demon business began, and she has taken it upon herself to protect both village and roost. I do hope she has not given you too much trouble..." "[vasha.isMom |I think I gave her more than she gave me," you say, thinking back to her giving birth to your child. "Congratulations, by the way." The elder fox nods. "You aren't the first to give me grandchildren, though you were Vasha's first. She was very excited." |She's certainly dedicated to her cause," you say. "She refused to back down." The elder fox nods. "That is her way. She was always headstrong." ] One of the pink-feathered harpies giggles. "Vasha's something else. I wish I could have Sorra's favor like she does! I've been going to the temple every day since she had her vision!" "Do you really believe she was touched by her goddess?" you ask. "Duh! Of course!" the harpy says. "Harpies are Sorra's chosen people. Everybody knows that!" Her father pats her head. "Not everybody, my dear. But it's true, Vasha, experienced a divine revelation from the goddess. She frightened us terrible with it, thrashing and screaming in her sleep so badly that I was afraid she would bite her tongue. But when she came out of it, she was full of righteous purpose, and her spear blazed with divine lightning when she took it up! I could not have been more proud in that moment, let me tell you!" "We all were!" another harpy says. You suppose if a seizure manifests magical powers, there might well be something to it... After a moment's consideration, you decide you might as well ask, "Do you think she'll ever ease up? She doesn't seem to care if who she attacks is a demon or not." Arened shrugs. "Her charge was to protect the mountaintop from all who would intrude upon it. Until Sorra herself should dismiss Vasha from her holy duty, I do not believe she will relent no matter what you do. I would suggest joining us all in prayer that soon the demons will be dealt with."

rows.translation: 让孩子们享受游戏的乐趣吧！

rows.original:
Seeing how happy the vulperine potter is surrounded by dozens of little chicks makes you wonder if he'd like to have a few more fuzzy kids to raise. Before you can say anything though, one of the juvenile harpies finds her way to your lap.
        
        "You're gonna be Dada's new mate?"
        
        Arened chuckles. "Easy there little [silly
            |scamp
            |tweet
        ], [pc.name]'s only been here a few times. I don't know if [pc.heShe] wants to be more involved in our relationship, not that it'd bother me that is," the pink-furred patriarch confesses. 
        
        So it's a yes? Isn't it too much to ask for him, he's got a lot of daughters to raise already?
        
        "I've raised and fathered a few kids already, but it'd be my first non-harpy infant to take care of. Don't worry about the logistics, we've got everything one needs to raise a few more toddlers, be it food, clothes, or knowledge. If you want, you can settle with us once you're done with your business, I'm sure my girls will love to have a doting [pc.daddyMommy] to hug and cuddle."
        
        Slowly, you pass your hand through the small harpy's feathers and set your [pc.eyes] on her, then back on the older vulperine. "I think I'm ready to mother a foxy child," you whisper, a revelation that makes all the young girls giggle with glee. Arened smiles from his bench, happy to see his [silly

        |Arened and you
        |[companion1.name], Arened, and you
        |[companion1.name], [companion2.name], Arened, and you
    ]. Since you don't risk a harpy raid, you can take the time to appreciate the refined treat. The cake is nothing fancy, except for the thin touch of snowberry perfuming the caramelized crust, maybe some leftovers of liquor that the baker glazed over them before putting them in the oven, making it a nice, sweet pastry with a fruity taste.
    
    "Soooo tasty!"
    
    "The matron puts clouds in them, that's why they are so soft."
    
    "I prefer Daddy's snowberry cupcakes."
    
    Once the kids are satiated, Vasha and you join them on the furs near the heat to play with them for a while, leaving Arened free to focus on his work for some time. Between [var0
        |your vulperine children[vasha.isMom
            |, Vasha's shy daughter,
        ] and the many toddlers tweeting around
        |[vasha.isMom
            |Vasha's shy daughter and the many toddlers tweeting around
            |the many toddlers tweeting around
        ]
    ] the warm, primitive rugs, there's not a second your attention isn't required by a babbling chick. Fortunately, none of them tries to paint [silly
        |the walls with their crayons
        |on the walls
    ], so maybe the presence of their big sister dampens their slyness. The little ones mostly stay calm as they play with stuffies, dolls, wooden toys, and dice in the oldests' case. 
    
    As soon as a couple of them start dosing out, Vasha gathers them all around in a circle for a story. This time, it's the tale of how the young Shaedra, a lean and athletic stormbreaker at the time, [rand
        |explored the ancient ruins south of the Foothills and recovered Sorra's latex nightgown from a wriggling abomination
        |won a cooking contest by creating the %"reverse cherry pie"
        |defeated the entire honor guard of a taeleer warlord alone, using but a regular sling against heavily-armored champions
    ]. The more tired chicks fall asleep on the cozy furs while their older or more endurant siblings dutifully listen to the tan stormcaller's tale. Halfway through the story, a green-feathered harpy on your lap taps on your shoulder.
    
    "[pc.name]? Do you believe it's true?"
    
    Behind you, Arened chuckle and places a finished pot away. "Not all things said about Shaedra are true, but in this case, my father knew people that saw it happen."
    
    "Woah! That's so cool! Do you have stories about her too?"
    
    "I've got a handful, but some of them aren't for your young ears. Now focus, this is the best part," he whispers as Vasha mentions the matron's lifelong rival: Nekino the Avanai Shaman. The juvenile harpies' attention redoubles as this turn of event raises the story's stakes to new highs, making it not only personal but a part of the centuries long feud between the Marches' avian races. The tension is high for a few minutes then goes down as the sinister sorcerer is defeated once more thanks to Shaedra's clever ruse.
    
    "Do you know if he's still alive?"
    
    "Last I heard of him, he retired to the Glacial Rift's highest aerie," Vasha softly replies. "Some people say he glides over the Frostwood on crescent moon nights. If you come across an avanai hunter far from the Rift, there's high chances they are one of his many grandchildren."

“就一点点吧，我可不想弄坏什么东西，”风暴召唤者回答道，然后伸手部去拿挂在包上的一个小袋子。她慢慢地从袋子里取出一把灰尘，撒在了自己的头上。 当这些粉末接触到她那把长剑的剑尖时，会迸发出微小的火花，那些灰色的颗粒立刻变成了五颜六色的轻型芒。看到这一幕，那些被聚集在一起的哈比们兴奋地欢呼起来，整个房间都被这些绚丽的色彩所笼罩，仿佛进入了一个梦幻般的时刻。 当所有被引导电流消耗掉的接地石块都被用完后，现场响起了一阵欢呼声、掌声，人们纷纷要求再来一轮。瓦莎摇了摇头，但脸上露出了微笑：“我没有足够的瘦石粉来继续进行了，而且，我还有东西要给你。”她说着，伸手部去拿包，“是莎德拉嬷嬷专门为你准备的东西。"
    
    那些充满好奇心的小鸡们，就在它们的大姐姐从那个不起眼的包装里拿出一块长条形的糕点那一刻，立刻变得一片混乱。转眼间，它们又围了上来，这次则是争先恐后地想要成为第一个被喂到糕点的人。 冷静点，每个人都会得到马德琳蛋糕的。如果你们表现得好，下次我可能会带更多的来哦，”她一边说，一边把一块点心递给那个新手部。被分到蛋糕的那些人越开心，其他人的嫉妒心就越强，这让瓦莎几乎没有喘息的机会——她不得不慢慢地把袋子里的东西全部拿出来。 它们的数量减少得如此之快，以至于你都会怀疑以这样的速度，是否还有机会品尝到它们中的任何一种。幸运的是，每当有一只小鸡拿到自己想要的食物时，它就会飞到屋檐下，或者坐在靠近壁炉的地方，在那里它可以安静地进食，远离那些嘈杂的声音。

“据我所知，他已经退隐到了冰川裂谷的最高处。”瓦莎轻声回答道，“有人说，在新月之夜，他会飞越霜冻森林。如果你在裂谷以外的地方遇到一位阿瓦奈猎人，那么他们很可能是他的孙子辈之一。"

"I don't have enough powdered leananstone to do more, and besides, I've got something for you," she replies, reaching for her bag, "something matron Shaedra made especially for you."
    
    The intrigued young chicks turn into a chaotic mess the moment their big sister recovers an oblong pastry from her unassuming package. In the blink of an eye, they swarm her again, this time begging to be the first to be served. "Calm down, there will be madeleines for everyone. If you behave well, I might bring more next time," she teases, handing a treat to a green-feathered gal. The more harpies are served, the more rabid the others become, not leaving Vasha any moment to breathe as she slowly empties her bag from its warm payload. It's diminishing so fast you doubt you'll get to taste any of them at this pace. Fortunately, as soon as a little chick gets her hands on her treat, she either flies to the rafters or sits near the hearth where she'll be free to eat in relative calm, away from the ruckus.
    
    As soon as the little ones are served, the ravenette fetches deeper in her sack, opening a hidden compartment full of cakes. "I knew I'd have a lot of success so I secured some away in case I lost control," she smiles before handing the leftover treats to [party.som
        |Arened and you
        |[companion1.name], Arened, and you
        |[companion1.name], [companion2.name], Arened, and you
    ]. Since you don't risk a harpy raid, you can take the time to appreciate the refined treat. The cake is nothing fancy, except for the thin touch of snowberry perfuming the caramelized crust, maybe some leftovers of liquor that the baker glazed over them before putting them in the oven, making it a nice, sweet pastry with a fruity taste.
    
    "Soooo tasty!"
    
    "The matron puts clouds in them, that's why they are so soft."
    
    "I prefer Daddy's snowberry cupcakes."
    
    Once the kids are satiated, Vasha and you join them on the furs near the heat to play with them for a while, leaving Arened free to focus on his work for some time. Between [var0
        |your vulperine children[vasha.isMom
            |, Vasha's shy daughter,
        ] and the many toddlers tweeting around
        |[vasha.isMom
            |Vasha's shy daughter and the many toddlers tweeting around
            |the many toddlers tweeting around
        ]
    ] the warm, primitive rugs, there's not a second your attention isn't required by a babbling chick. Fortunately, none of them tries to paint [silly
        |the walls with their crayons
        |on the walls
    ], so maybe the presence of their big sister dampens their slyness. The little ones mostly stay calm as they play with stuffies, dolls, wooden toys, and dice in the oldests' case. 
    
    As soon as a couple of them start dosing out, Vasha gathers them all around in a circle for a story. This time, it's the tale of how the young Shaedra, a lean and athletic stormbreaker at the time, [rand
        |explored the ancient ruins south of the Foothills and recovered Sorra's latex nightgown from a wriggling abomination
        |won a cooking contest by creating the %"reverse cherry pie"
        |defeated the entire honor guard of a taeleer warlord alone, using but a regular sling against heavily-armored champions
    ]. The more tired chicks fall asleep on the cozy furs while their older or more endurant siblings dutifully listen to the tan stormcaller's tale. Halfway through the story, a green-feathered harpy on your lap taps on your shoulder.
    
    "[pc.name]? Do you believe it's true?"
    
    Behind you, Arened chuckle and places a finished pot away. "Not all things said about Shaedra are true, but in this case, my father knew people that saw it happen."
    
    "Woah! That's so cool! Do you have stories about her too?"
    
    "I've got a handful, but some of them aren't for your young ears. Now focus, this is the best part," he whispers as Vasha mentions the matron's lifelong rival: Nekino the Avanai Shaman. The juvenile harpies' attention redoubles as this turn of event raises the story's stakes to new highs, making it not only personal but a part of the centuries long feud between the Marches' avian races. The tension is high for a few minutes then goes down as the sinister sorcerer is defeated once more thanks to Shaedra's clever ruse.
    
    "Do you know if he's still alive?"
    
    "Last I heard of him, he retired to the Glacial Rift's highest aerie," Vasha softly replies. "Some people say he glides over the Frostwood on crescent moon nights. If you come across an avanai hunter far from the Rift, there's high chances they are one of his many grandchildren."
    "

Deep down, she's still the little girl that asked me if she could be a vulperine too when she got older[vasha.isMom|, and now she's a mother too]," he mumbles. "Anyway, what can I offer you today, [pc.name]? Supplies, advice, a warm shelter?"

瓦莎随后缓缓讲完了她的故事，故事以一个幸福的结局结束，同时也为关于那些山峰地区的代理统治者的另一个故事留下了悬念，这个悬念让那些还在醒着的女妖们听得入迷。你小心翼翼地帮她用温暖的毯子盖住那些正在午睡的姐妹们，然后陪在她身边。[vasha.isMom| 还有你那个爱睡觉的孩子] 在房子外面。瓦莎先亲了在场的每个女孩一口，然后紧紧地拥抱了她们。 [party.som
            |你
            |[companion1.name]你，
            |[companion1.name], [companion2.name]你，
        ] 我会尽快回来的。爸爸，千万不要太劳累，有很多人都在依赖你呢。”她轻声说道，同时瞥了瞥自己的兄弟姐妹。

“只要是我不会做的事，你就别去做。”那位有着狐狸般眼神的女性回答道，然后递给她一个小小的铁盒。“我觉得这些应该能帮你撑过几天。”

“这就是我想象中的东西吗？”

“没错，这是我自制的纸杯蛋糕。在准备这些食物之前，我确实留了一些出来。 [silly
            |调皮鬼们
            |坏蛋们
        ] 它可以把它们全部吃掉，”他说着，轻轻拨弄着那只长着蓝色羽毛的哈比鸟那柔软的羽毛。

“爸爸？我们也能吃蛋糕吗？”

“明天午睡之后，如果你们表现好的话，就可以。但现在，是时候和瓦莎道别了。再见了，瓦莎！”他们齐声喊道。那只乌鸦女妖挥动翅膀，送上了最后的吻别，然后转身让强劲的风力托起她的翅膀，将她带回了浴场。你朝她挥了挥手，随后跟着阿雷纳德和他的孩子们回到了那温暖舒适的屋子里。 那只狡黠的陶艺师像往常一样坐在他的工作台前，而你则占据了那些椅子。几个疲惫的女孩爬到他的腿上，将她们重型的头靠在他宽阔而毛茸茸的胸膛上。

“无论她来了多少次，这么多年过去了，我仍然总是很难舍得让她离开。 在内心深处，她依然是一个小时候曾经问我长大后是否也想成为一只狐女的小女孩。[vasha.isMom|现在，她也成为了一位母亲。]嗯，”他喃喃道，“不管怎样，今天我能为您做些什么呢？ [pc.name]物资、建议，还有温暖的庇护所？

"Woaaah!!! Your egg must be huge!! Your legs and back must hurt like, a lot. Maybe Daddy can help you, he's a profy- profos- expert in cuddles and massages."
    
    The vulperine gives the cheerful [silly
        |scamp
        |kid
    ]'s feathers a good ruffle, making her laugh in a crystal-clear tone. "Easy there girls, if our guest wants to be pampered it's up to [pc.himHer] to decide. These paw[silly
        |b
    ]s aren't just for making voluptuous jugs and exquisite pots." 
    
    A little massage wouldn't hurt considering how cumbersome your swollen belly is to your poor bones and sore muscles. The moment the furry caretaker sees you nod, he makes some room around him, dusts his clothes, and taps his lap invitingly. "Go ahead [pc.name], I won't bite and I'm pretty sure my daughters won't either," he says, making a couple of them giggle. You barely have the time to stand before a small [silly
        |murder
        |assembly
    ] of excited chicks surrounds you, takes your hands, and pulls you closer to their father. In the blink of an eye, they sit you on his firm thighs, a cushiony setup that feels heavenly to your burdened back and [pc.ass]. Torrid breaths tickle your vulnerable neck in sultry caresses that make you shiver with delight. Speaking of nice touches, [pc.isBimbo
        |Daddy Neddy
        |Arened
    ]'s meaty knuckles gently sink into your shoulders and back, probing your sore spots and looking for vicious knots spread all over them.
    
    "Sorra's wings, everything's tensed up here! Don't worry, I'll help you relax," the caretaker whispers as his pleasant rubs become stronger and sink deeper into your strained muscles. While he's busy with your upper body, some of his oldest daughters take care of your [pc.feet], legs, and thighs. They brush, groom, and fondle your skin[pc.hasLegTags furred
        | and fur
    ], caressing and manicuring you in good, albeit less skillful, motions than their father's seasoned embrace.
    
    "I can't wait to be a mother as well," one of them says before dropping a peck on your [pc.belly]. "It must feel so good to sense yourself becoming plusher and rounder while a new life forms inside your womb.[pc.isMilky
        | I wonder if I'll be very milky, just like you," she mumbles, eyeing the sensitive peaks poking through your gear.
        |"
    ]
    
    The hunky fox chuckles softly behind you. "Easy there sweetie, first you'll need to meet a wonderful person that'll make you a happy parent. Since you brought up the subject, who wants to be a mother too?" He asks, carefully running his paw[silly
        |b
    ] over your tummy in very delicate circles. In a matter of seconds, dozens of hands rise up from all over the room in a whirlwind of colors. Almost all of the juvenile harpies desire to have [pc.bg noblescion
        |descendants
        |kids
    ] except a vibrant green-feathered one with a bright pink beret and a chubbier one with owl-like features and round, [silly
        |nerdy

    ] glasses.
    
    "[pc.dcb
        |I see we've got rebels among us. What's your goals, little ones?
        |We've got some ladies with more complex plans it seems. Would you kindly elaborate?
        |I didn't expect, like, so many of you to want to be mommies too! Now I'm even more eager to know why these adorable cuties don't want to be one.
    ]"
    
    The plump owl tilts her head and sets her large eyes on you. "I-I'd like to be a daddy instead," she confesses. "I want to be the one cuddling and kissing my pregnant friend surrounded by our cute hatchlings."
    
    The entire crowd gasps in surprise, that's a very unusual yet adorable future she wants for her and her family. A quick glance to her vulperine father confirms to you that he too was touched by his daughter's words. [agni.around
        |Agni pipes up at that, saying "I wish you good luck, young lady. It's possible for a harpy to grow the bits to sire a child[agni.hasCock
            |, I'm the living proof of it
        ], but I don't know if you'll be able to impregnate your partner. You'll have to try and find out by yourself if your body can accept to grow a new set of virile genitalia," 
        |"I've heard stories about harpies growing male genitalia but nothing about them fathering children thereafter. Maybe it's possible but I'm not sure about that at all, you'll have to try and find out by yourself," [pc.isBimbo
            |Daddy Neddy
            |Arened
        ] says,
    ] bringing a slight smile to the smaller gal's face.
    
    "I'll be the Marches' best alchemist and fertility expert then."
    
    The furry potter then turns his attention on the jade-feathered girl. "And you Gem, what's your plan?"
    
    "I'll be the greatest hero ever. People will write songs about my deeds and about my shiny armor and weapons as I take down monsters and save cities all by myself," she boasts, flexing her muscles and raising her chest high in a somewhat knightly pose. 
    
    Her sisters giggle, more amused by her proud demeanor rather than dismissing her [silly
        |shonen spirit
        |ambition
    ]. "I'd love to see my little Gem grow into a proud paladin or even into one of the gods' champions. I'm sure you'll be feared and revered across the seas," the mature vulperine says, massaging your rounded belly in smooth rubs.
    
    "Count on me! Once I'm strong and cool, I'll find a cute hubby to marry and cuddle. I'd love to be with a centaur that'll be both my lover and faithful steed," she adds, daydreaming about her future conquests and achievements.
    
    With their cute answers in mind, you let yourself melt in the vulperine's tender grasp. His paw[silly
        |b
    ]s and furred arms feel so good on your sore muscles and tensed middle, a perfect pampering for your burdened body. It's a wonder how he can find and untangle the knots spread across your back and how tender his warm embrace is. You feel incredibly lighter like this, hugged and snuggled against a loving man's broad, welcoming chest and well-defined biceps. It just feels right to lower your defenses and let him play you like an exquisite instrument that produces naught but sweet gasps and delighted shivers.
    
    "Are you relaxed enough or do you want another round?" he whispers before dropping a quick salvo of smooches all over your neck. Without uttering a word, you place your hands on his paw[silly
        |b
    ]s and lead them on your pregnant belly's warm flesh.
    
    "Yes, I'd like that."
    
    The potter nods as he resumes his movements on this beautiful, shapely jug, [silly
        |pondering your orb
        |brushing your bloated middle
    ] over and over. His meaty knuckles run on you the same way they did the smooth clay he was working on when you arrived. Strong yet considerate fondles ripple your burdened physique — a sweet massage that makes you feel light-headed and featherweight despite the chaotic rush of hormones conquering your veins and the heavy weight of your offspring's life resting on your shoulders, a weight his back rubs relieved a little. Taking advantage of your advanced state of relaxation, Arened's daughters line up to kiss and rub your large paunch, whispering sweet nothings to your growing infan[var0
        |s
    ] before hugging and kissing you, the luckiest [pc.mf
        |lad
        |gal
    ] in the room.
    
    As soon as the last of them is done with you, the furry caretaker slows his ministrations down and frees you from his intimate embrace. Reluctantly, you wiggle out of his grasp and leave his lap, but not without sharing a quick kiss with him in front of your feathery audience. Since my siblings won't be harpies this time, I thought it'd be nice to give you a little something to rock your vulperine kids to sleep, and also spare the villagers the effort of making a new one," the slender harpy confesses, gazing at your rounded belly. "I'll try to be here for the delivery. Father's blissful smile when he holds a newborn is a spectacle I wouldn't miss for all of the [silly
        |shinies
        |electrum
    ] in the Marches."
    
    [pc.dcb
        |You cough. "Thank you, I guess?
        |You nod. "I appreciate the gesture. Thanks for the gift Vasha.
        |"Daww, thank you so much Vasha! I'm sure the baby will love their cozy beddies[silly
            | :D
        ].
    ]"
    
    The raven harpy blushes again as her father rises from his seat and fumbles inside one of his cupboards in search of a sizable tin box. As soon as he unearths his treasure from his stock, all the other harpies surround him like hungry chicks. "I think you need a reward for your services, and your sisters too for being so calm until now," he mumbles before extracting a big cupcake from the metallic coffin's depths. "One per person only!"
    
    "YEAH! DADDYCAKES!"
    
    In a matter of seconds, the feathery [silly
        |scamps
        |scoundrels
    ] raid the poor container, looting everything their tiny claws can get before escaping to the rafters with their treats in hand. The little ones clearly didn't follow his rule and snatched a lot more than they should, leaving nothing for you,[party.som
        |
        | [companion1.name],
        | [companion1.name], [companion2.name],
    ] Vasha, or Arened. Despite this turn of events, the furry potter approaches you with his emptied box nonetheless, a wry grin on his face. "I might be a honest fox, but it doesn't stop me from being a little mischievous," he smirks, opening a small compartment on the bottom of the box and sharing the precious cakes with the [party.som
        |three
        |four
        |five
    ] of you. Without hesitating, you dig into the spongy dessert's sweet core and fill your mouth with a mix of walnuts, fox berries, and a touch of caramel. The delighted face Vasha and her sisters make as they gulp their respective cakes down confirms to you how balanced and flavorful the recipe is.
    
    "Dad's pastries are the bestest!" a green-freathered girl giggles.
    
    "It's because they are baked with love," another one tweets between bites.
    
    "Pine honey and cinnamon actually, but love is also an important ingredient," Arened mumbles, appreciating the sweet stuff with you. While you're busy devouring the small cake, one of his big, wonderful hands gently caresses your pregnant belly,holding you close against him as if you were the most precious thing in the world[pc.isBimbo
        | - because like, you are!
        |.
    ] Vasha's eyeing the two of you while she savors her cupcake with an eagerness matching her other sisters' intensity, albeit a more controlled one. They might be her favorite too. The more she looks at you, the more she relaxes and appreciates her father's serenity alongside you, a peacefulness she might not have seen in a long time. 
    
    "You are looking good together, I'm sure you'll make a perfect [pc.mf
        |father
        |mother
    ]."
    
    You nod. "Maybe I'll stay here once I'm done with the demons, to take care of the little ones with their super daddy," you reply, a smooth answer that makes the surrounding harpies giggle.
    
    "That's a very big commitment, [pc.name], considering how needy and possessive my daughters are, but I'm sure they'll love to have [pc.mf
        |another father figure
        |a mother figure
    ] to raise them. Some of them already adopted you," Arened remarks, glancing at a couple of toddlers trying to claim your lap for themselves. The vulperine's oldest daughter tilts her head, gauging your attitude, your poise, your presence for a few seconds before shaking her head.
    
    "I'm sure you'd fare well, just keep an eye on my sisters. Some of them like to spike the food with very spicy peppers when you aren't looking."
    
    "It was your favorite prank, wasn't it?" Arened retorts, turning Vasha's cheeks so bright they challenge the heart's radiance.
    
    "A-Anyways, it's getting late and I've got stuff to do with the others."
    
    The raven harpy rises from her seat and recovers her[flags.VASHA_FIGHT
        | new
    ] glaive then gives a big smooch to her father. "Goodbye Dad, I'll try to be here to celebrate my birthday with you," she says before dropping another smooch on your cheek. "Take care of yourself [pc.name], the peaks are dangerous but they are also full of nice surprises."
    
    Vasha blows a couple more kisses to her sisters before stepping outside the house and deploying her wings. A few seconds later, a powerful gust of air lifts her up and propels her far over the village and toward the ancient bathhouse north of here. The large building feels empty now that the stormy harpy is gone, a weird feeling considering it's full of excited young chicks begging for your attention.
    
    "Is there anything we can do for you [pc.name]? Maybe one of my own massages or a few treats for your exploration of our bellowing mountains?"
    "

rows.original:
A sudden belly cramp bends you in two. It's not the first one you experienced since your pregnancy started but this one is far stronger than the other. Taking a deep breath, you steady your posture before another contraction sears your mind again with a painful jolt. 

    Seeing that the muscle cramps don't stop, you grit your teeth and head toward the vulperine village with the hope to arrive before it's too late. Every ten seconds, a new cramp makes you hiss with their insidious ache, reminding you of how imminent your pregnancy is to end. It'll be hard to hold on and get to Arened, [party.som
        |especially since you are on your own
        |even with [companion1.name]'s support
        |even with your companions' help
    ], but that obvious consideration won't stop you from trying to reach your children's father.
rows.translation:
突然的腹痛让你弯下了腰。自从怀孕以来，这种疼痛你已经经历过很多次了，但这一次的疼痛程度远远超过了以往任何一次。你深吸一口气，努力稳住身体，然而紧接着，又一次剧烈的阵痛再次袭来，让你感到难以忍受。 

    看到肌肉痉挛始终没有停止，你咬紧牙关，朝着那个名叫“狐村”的地方奔去，希望能在为时已晚之前赶到。每隔十秒钟，新的痉挛就会袭来，那种隐秘的疼痛让你不断发出嘶嘶声，这些疼痛不断提醒着你：你的妊娠即将结束。 要坚持下去并到达阿雷内德，将会非常困难。 [party.som
        |尤其是你现在还是独自一人。
        |即使如此 [companion1.name]其支持系统
        |即使在你的同伴的帮助下也是如此。
    ]但是，这个显而易见的考虑因素并不会阻止你试图联系你孩子的父亲。

rows.original:
After a rather long and tedious trek, you finally step foot in the vulperine settlement[party.som
            |
            | thanks to [companion1.name]'s help
            | thanks to your friends' support
        ]. Your [pc.legs] finally collapse from exhaustion, too weak to hold you anymore in this state. Fortunately, a reddish-pink and an emerald one spot you from afar and drop their respective packages to help you.
        
        "[pc.name], are you alright?"
        
        "I-I think," you mumble before another cramp muffles you with a painful hiss. "The babies, they're coming."
        
        The furry potter nods. "Gem, I need you to fetch Natalia. Tell her to bring her wetnurse gear to our house as soon as possible, we'll be waiting for you there," he groans, lifting you in his strong arms. The young harpy [silly
            |salutes her caretaker
            |shakes her head
        ] and surges toward the Sorran shrine while your children's sire carries you to his home. A sudden heat wave caressing your [pc.skinFurScales] eases some of your pain as you penetrate inside the harpy daycare. The little chicks look at you, flabbergasted by your weak whimpers and heavy gasps while Arened places you on a smooth pelt near the heart.
        
        "I'll need your help, girls. Somebody fetch me waterproof linens and prepare me some hot water, [pc.name] is very close to delivery. Everyone else step back, things will be loud and messy."
        
        In a couple of seconds, the older harpies collect the younger ones and lead them away from you, leaving you some breathing room as the contractions reach a new high. The vulperine patriarch slowly removes your gear and checks on your vulva and vagina, measuring how dilated you are with his keen, artisan's eyes. Celestine barely has the time to put a clean blanket under you before your water breaks — there's no turning back now!
        
        "You are almost dilated enough to lay them, breathe deeply and relax the best you can [pc.name]."
        
        You'd if you could, but the increasingly quicker cramps make it hard for you to stay calm, your babies are just so eager to come out. After a particularly strong ache, a half-vulperine and a dark-feathered harpy enter the house with arms packed with supplies. "We came as soon as we could. Vasha, take some of the warm water and stir the medicinal herbs for two minutes. Arened, step aside please, I'll take care of our patient. Hold [pc.hisHer] head and hold [pc.himHer] up," the foxy priestess commands while she puts minoan latex gloves on.
        
        The elder harpy immediately prepares the soothing concoction, adding substances and dried herbs to the simmering pot while Natalia cleans you up and gently spreads your legs wide. The vulperine examines your snatch for a few seconds then puts her fingers on your middle for about three contractions. "Alright, I figured your rhythm. You are ready to deliver so there's no reason to wait anymore. Follow my lead and they'll be out in a moment."
        
        "You sure [pc.heShe]'ll be okay? I helped a lot of ladies in the village and a lot more of Shaendra's daughters but this time... things feel different," Arened confesses, holding you close against him.
        
        "It's because this time you are involved on a personal level. You are lucky I came for a visit, else you'd be even more of a mess," she teases. A second later, the stormcaller pours the greenish tea into a small bowl and presents it to you. "Here, drink it. This ancestral beverage will ease your pain and make the labor smoother for you." 
        
        Since you've got nothing left to lose, you reach for the small container and chug down the [silly
            |chartreuse
            |leaf green
        ] liquid. Without a surprise, it tastes like ass, a dirty mix between a bad gin and mate that flows down your gullet in raging rivers. Vasha didn't lie though, as soon as the hot liquid reaches your stomach, a smooth torpor caresses your neurons and quenches the inferno in your strained loins. Now that the cramps aren't as terrible as they were, you've got enough focus to listen to the vulperine sitting between your legs.
        
        "One, two, push!"
        
        Gritting your teeth, you clench your inner muscles with all you've got for a few seconds then relax, a tremendous effort in your state. It feels like you displaced an immovable object a few inches away before it returned back to its place. "You're doing great! Do this a little more and we'll have little ones in your arms in a minute!"
        
        Easier said than done. Two seconds later, another contraction forces you to push again, a new inhuman request that drives your mind insane with a debilitating mix of bliss and pain. Unable to do anything else, you concentrate yourself on Natalia and Vasha's voice and scream with a maddened fervor with each new aching thrust. Arened holds your hand tight and whispers unintelligible words to your [pc.ears], supporting you the best he can and massaging your temples with as much care as he'd a very fancy vase. Little by little, you feel something moving inside you, something big and warm that's impatient to move out.
        
        "Good, very good! I can see the head, just a little more!"
        
        The perspective of finishing this ordeal invigorates you as you push again, giving all you've got to birth your vulperine kid. A slick, wet mass slides out of you followed a moment later by an acute roar. The tiny fox in Natalia's hands screams as hot lumps of air inflate his small lungs for the first time. He's just so beautiful, even in this state your tired eyes find him absolutely adorable as Vasha delicately cuts the umbilical cord, cleans him a little, and wraps your son in a cozy blanket. She playfully rubs her nose against his muzzle before gently placing him in the cradle her father prepared for your offspring.
        
        "I see another one, keep at it [pc.name]!"
        
        Mustering your willpower, you reiterate your efforts all over again, albeit with looser muscles and a weakened stamina but with a steadfast willpower. A couple of minutes later, another wail fills the room and another kiddo lands in the priestess's hands. This boy is a little smaller than the former but he's far more vigorous. Last but not least, you lay a big girl with round cheeks a few contractions later. She doesn't whimper much, even when her big sister breaks the link between you and her, as if she were too tired to shadow the peaks' bellowing gales. Seeing that you've got nothing left to deliver, Natalia and Vasha slowly clean and heal you while Arened offers you some clear water.
        
        "Good job [pc.name], some harpy broodmothers would kill to have your stamina," the stormcaller teases as they lift you from the stained linens and place you on warm, dry furs near the heart. Arened drops a soft kiss on your forehead before finally letting your hands go and recovering your snoozing kids from the wooden bunk. You are still numbed by the painkiller concoction, and yet you feel so alive, so happy, so light all of a sudden, as if your mind was finally relieved of a titanic burden. A large smile breaks your features as the furry potter places your childrens on your [pc.chest], resting their peaceful bodies on top of you, just close enough for you to smooch them.
        
        "They are magnificent," you whisper, barely able to raise your voice. "Did you pick names for each of our treasures?"
        
        The caretaker nods. "I think that Inigo, Ugo, and Shelly would suit them well, if that's fine with you. We don't usually name them before they open their eyes, when we are sure they will survive, but their [pc.mf
            |father
            |mother
        ] is a tough one, so there's no fear to have for their sake."
        
        You barely have the time to rest a little before Arened's harpies swarm you, eager to see and meet their new siblings. Natalia and Vasha try their best to reduce the flow but there's nothing they can do to stop the multicolor flock from surrounding you with wide, curious eyes — even the toddlers waddle around toward you, intrigued by the little foxes peacefully napping against you. 
        
        "They are so tiny!"
        
        "Can I hold one?"
        
        "No! Me first!"
        
        Arened slowly tuts. "Easy there girls, [pc.name] and your siblings are very tired right now. Let them rest a few hours then we'll play with them. Give [pc.name] a smooch then we will make a big treat for our guest," the furry potter commands. The young chicks produce disappointed sighs but behave nonetheless. In the span of a minute, you get showered with kisses by the feathery sweethearts, leaving your face an even wetter mess than it already was. Feeling a deep torpor embracing you, your [pc.eyes] close and let a snug, dark warmth take you.
rows.translation:
经过一段漫长而艰辛的跋涉，你终于踏入了那只狐狸族人的聚居地。[party.som
            |
            | 多亏了 [companion1.name]的帮助
            | 多亏了朋友们的大力支持
        ]你的 [pc.legs] 最终，它们也因精疲力竭而崩溃，已经无力再支撑你处于这种状态了。幸运的是，有一只红粉色的和一只翠绿色的生物从远处发现了你，然后分别丢下了它们的包裹来帮助你。[pc.name]你没事吧？”

“我……应该没事吧，”你喃喃道，但紧接着又一阵剧痛袭来，让你发出痛苦的呻吟。“孩子们，他们要出生了……”

那只毛茸茸的波特点了点头。“杰姆，你需要去把娜塔莉亚叫来。告诉她尽快带着她的哺乳用品来到我们家，我们会在那里等你们，”它边说边用强有力的手部臂将你抱起来。年轻的哈皮…… [silly
            |向她的照顾者致以敬意
            |摇了摇头
        ] 而当你孩子的生父将你带往他的家中时，一股热浪突然袭来，抚触着你…… [pc.skinFurScales] 当你走进哈比人的托儿所时，这些声音确实能缓解你的一些痛苦。那些小家伙们看着你，对你那微弱的呜咽声和重型的喘息显得十分惊讶。而阿雷恩则把你放在靠近心脏部位的一块柔软皮毛上。

“姑娘们，我需要你们的帮助。有人去拿些防水布料来，再准备一些热水给我。 [pc.name] 已经快要分娩了。其他人都退后一点吧，否则会非常吵闹且场面混乱。”

几秒钟后，那些年长的雌鹰便把年幼的雌鹰们带走，让你暂时有了喘息的空间，因为此时的宫缩已经达到了新的强度。 那位经验丰富的医生缓缓地为你脱去衣物，仔细检查你的外阴和阴道，用他那敏锐而专业的眼轻型来判断你的宫颈开口程度。就在塞莱斯汀还没来得及为你铺上干净的毯子时，你的羊水就已经破了——此刻，一切都已经无法挽回了！
        
        你的血管已经扩张到足以放置这些装置的程度了，深呼吸，尽量放松吧。 [pc.name]如果你可以的话，你一定会这么做的，但是那些越来越频繁的阵痛让你很难保持冷静——你的宝宝们实在是太急于出生了。在一次特别剧烈的疼痛之后，半只狼人和一只羽毛呈黑色的女妖带着满满一手部的物资走进了屋子。“我们一得到消息就立刻赶来了。瓦莎，你去取一些温水，把那些药材搅拌两分钟。阿伦德，请你让开一下，让我来照顾我们的病人吧。 [pc.hisHer] 带头并坚持到底 [pc.himHer] 向上，”这位狡黠的女祭司一边说着，一边戴上米诺斯风格的乳胶手部套。

那位年长的女妖立刻开始准备这种具有舒缓效果的药液，她在沸腾的锅里加入各种成分和干草药，而娜塔莉亚则负责为你清理身体，并轻轻地将你的双腿分开。 那位女医生检查了你的阴道几秒钟，然后把手部指放在你的子宫颈上，等待着你子宫有三次收缩。“好了，我已经掌握了你的宫缩节奏。你已经准备好分娩了，所以没有必要再等待了。跟着我的节奏来，孩子很快就会出生了。你确定吗？ [pc.heShe]会没事的吧？我帮助过村里很多女性，也帮助过很多莎恩德拉的女儿们，但这一次……感觉不一样，”阿雷内德紧紧地将你搂在怀里，低声说道。

“因为这一次，你个人也牵涉其中了。 你真幸运，我正好来拜访你，否则你的情况会更糟的，”她开玩笑地说。一秒钟后，那位名叫“风暴召唤者”的女子将那杯略带绿色的茶倒入一个小碗中，递给了你：“来，喝吧。这种祖传的饮品能缓解你的疼痛，让你的分娩过程更加顺利。既然你已经没有什么可失去的了，你就拿起那个小容器，一饮而尽。 [silly
            |黄绿色
            |叶绿色
        ] 这种液体……毫不意外，它的味道糟透了，就像是劣质杜松子酒和马黛茶的混合体，那种味道会像汹涌的河流一样顺着你的喉咙流下去。不过瓦莎并没有说谎，当这种热液体进入你的胃部时，一种柔和的麻木感会蔓延到你的神经末梢，从而缓解你腰部那种剧烈的疼痛。 现在，那些痉挛已经没有那么厉害了，你应该有足够的注意力去聆听那些位于你双腿之间的“声音”了。

“一、二，用力推！”

你咬紧牙关，用尽全力收紧腹部的肌肉几秒钟，然后放松——在这种状态下，这确实需要付出巨大的努力。 感觉就像你把一个固定不动的物体挪开了几英寸，然后它又回到了原来的位置。“你做得非常棒！再坚持一会儿，很快你就能抱到小宝宝了！”

说起来容易做起来难啊。 两秒钟后，又一次宫缩迫使你再次用力推进，这种非人类的需求让你的头脑陷入疯狂——愉悦与痛苦交织在一起，令你难以承受。你无能为力，只能集中精力聆听娜塔莉亚和瓦莎的声音，在每一次剧烈的宫缩中，带着疯狂的激情发出尖叫。 阿伦德紧紧握住你的手部，低声说着一些你听不懂的话…… [pc.ears]他尽自己最大的能力支持你，用极其小心翼翼的方式轻抚你的太阳穴，就像在抚摸一个极其精美的花瓶一样。渐渐地，你感觉到自己体内有某种东西在动，那种东西庞大而温暖，迫不及待地想要冲出来。
        
        好，太好了！我已经能看到它的头了，再稍微用力一点就行了！”

当你终于即将结束这段艰难的过程时，这种成就感会让你重新充满力量，于是你再次使出全部力气，将那只小狐狸生了出来。一个轻型滑、湿润的小生命从你体内滑了出来，紧接着，它发出了一声尖锐的叫声。 纳塔莉亚手部中的那只小狐狸发出了尖叫声——因为炽热的空气首次涌入它那小小的肺部。它实在太可爱了，即便在这种状态下，当你疲惫的双眼注视着它时，也会觉得它无比惹人怜爱。瓦莎小心翼翼地剪断了它的脐带，稍微清理了一下它的身体，然后用一条柔软的毯子把它包裹起来。 她调皮地用鼻子蹭了蹭他的嘴部，然后轻轻地将它放在她父亲为你的后代准备好的托盘中。

“我又看到一只了，继续找吧。 [pc.name]你强忍住意志力，再次开始努力。虽然肌肉已经变得松弛，体力也有所减弱，但你的意志力依然坚定如初。几分钟后，房间里又传来一声哭喊，另一个孩子被送到了女祭司的手部中。 这个男孩虽然比前一个稍微矮一些，但体力却要强健得多。最后，过了几阵宫缩之后，你生下了一个面颊圆润的大女孩。即使她的姐姐切断了你与她之间的联系，她也不怎么哭闹，仿佛她已经太疲惫了，无暇去理会那些呼啸的风暴。 看到你已经没有任何东西可以交付了，娜塔莉亚和瓦莎便慢慢为你清理伤口、治疗你的伤势，而阿雷纳德则为你提供了一些清水。
    
“干得不错。 [pc.name]有些残忍的‘母后’们会不惜一切代价得到你的体力呢，”风暴召唤者在将你从那些沾满污迹的床单上抱起来，放在靠近中心位置、温暖而干燥的毛皮上时调侃道。阿伦德在你额头上轻轻一吻，然后终于松开了手部，从木制床上把正在熟睡的孩子们抱了下来。 你仍然被那种止痛药的效果所影响，但突然间，你感到自己如此充满活力、如此快乐、如此轻松，仿佛你的心灵终于摆脱了重型的负担。当那个毛茸茸的陶艺师把你的孩子们放在你身边时，你露出了灿烂的笑容。 [pc.chest]它们安静地躺在你身上，距离你如此之近，以至于你完全可以亲吻它们。

“它们真是太美妙了，”你轻声说道，几乎无法提高音量，“你为我们的每一个‘宝贝’都起了名字吗？”

看护人点了点头：“我觉得‘伊尼戈’、‘乌戈’和‘雪莉’这些名字很适合它们，如果你不介意的话。通常我们会在它们睁开眼睛、确定它们一定能活下来的时候才会给它们起名字的…… [pc.mf
            |父亲
            |母亲
        ] 这确实是个棘手部的问题，但为了他们，我们也不必担心。”

你几乎还没来得及稍作休息，阿雷内德的那些小妖精们就已经蜂拥而至，它们迫不及待地想要见到自己的新“兄弟姐妹”。Natalia和Vasha竭尽全力想要减缓这些小生物的攻势，但它们那充满好奇的、五颜六色的身影依然将你团团围住——就连那些年幼的小生物也摇摇晃晃地朝你走来，被那些安静地依偎在你身边的小狐狸们吸引住了。 
        
        它们太小了！”
“我能拿一个吗？”
“不行！让我先来！”
阿伦德慢慢地叹了口气：“好了，姑娘们，别急…… [pc.name] 你的兄弟姐妹现在都非常累了。让他们休息几个小时，等他们恢复了精力，我们再一起玩吧。 [pc.name] 先来一个吻，然后我们就为我们的客人准备一份特别的礼物吧，”这位毛茸茸的波特说道。那些小鸡们发出了失望的叹息，但还是乖乖地照做了。在短短的一分钟内，这些羽毛柔软的“甜心”们给了你无数个吻，让你的脸变得更加湿漉漉了。一种深深的倦意笼罩了你…… [pc.eyes] 闭上双眼，让那种温暖而宁静的暗影包围你。

        After a rather long and tedious trek, you finally step foot in the vulperine settlement[party.som
            |
            | thanks to [companion1.name]'s help
            | thanks to your friends' support
        ]. Your [pc.legs] finally collapse from exhaustion, too weak to hold you anymore in this state. Fortunately, a reddish-pink and an emerald one spot you from afar and drop their respective packages to help you.
        
        "[pc.name], are you alright?"
        
        "I-I think," you mumble before another cramp muffles you with a painful hiss. "The babies, they're coming."
        
        The furry potter nods. "Gem, I need you to fetch Natalia. Tell her to bring her wetnurse gear to our house as soon as possible, we'll be waiting for you there," he groans, lifting you in his strong arms. The young harpy [silly
            |salutes her caretaker
            |shakes her head
        ] and surges toward the Sorran shrine while your children's sire carries you to his home. A sudden heat wave caressing your [pc.skinFurScales] eases some of your pain as you penetrate inside the harpy daycare. The little chicks look at you, flabbergasted by your weak whimpers and heavy gasps while Arened places you on a smooth pelt near the heart.
        
        "I'll need your help, girls. Somebody fetch me waterproof linens and prepare me some hot water, [pc.name] is very close to delivery. Everyone else step back, things will be loud and messy."
        
        In a couple of seconds, the older harpies collect the younger ones and lead them away from you, leaving you some breathing room as the contractions reach a new high. The vulperine patriarch slowly removes your gear and checks on your vulva and vagina, measuring how dilated you are with his keen, artisan's eyes. Celestine barely has the time to put a clean blanket under you before your water breaks — there's no turning back now!
        
        "You are almost dilated enough to lay them, breathe deeply and relax the best you can [pc.name]."
        
        You'd if you could, but the increasingly quicker cramps make it hard for you to stay calm, your babies are just so eager to come out. After a particularly strong ache, a half-vulperine and a dark-feathered harpy enter the house with arms packed with supplies. "We came as soon as we could. Vasha, take some of the warm water and stir the medicinal herbs for two minutes. Arened, step aside please, I'll take care of our patient. Hold [pc.hisHer] head and hold [pc.himHer] up," the foxy priestess commands while she puts minoan latex gloves on.
        
        The elder harpy immediately prepares the soothing concoction, adding substances and dried herbs to the simmering pot while Natalia cleans you up and gently spreads your legs wide. The vulperine examines your snatch for a few seconds then puts her fingers on your middle for about three contractions. "Alright, I figured your rhythm. You are ready to deliver so there's no reason to wait anymore. Follow my lead and they'll be out in a moment."
        
        "You sure [pc.heShe]'ll be okay? I helped a lot of ladies in the village and a lot more of Shaendra's daughters but this time... things feel different," Arened confesses, holding you close against him.
        
        "It's because this time you are involved on a personal level. You are lucky I came for a visit, else you'd be even more of a mess," she teases. A second later, the stormcaller pours the greenish tea into a small bowl and presents it to you. "Here, drink it. This ancestral beverage will ease your pain and make the labor smoother for you." 
        
        Since you've got nothing left to lose, you reach for the small container and chug down the [silly
            |chartreuse
            |leaf green
        ] liquid. Without a surprise, it tastes like ass, a dirty mix between a bad gin and mate that flows down your gullet in raging rivers. Vasha didn't lie though, as soon as the hot liquid reaches your stomach, a smooth torpor caresses your neurons and quenches the inferno in your strained loins. Now that the cramps aren't as terrible as they were, you've got enough focus to listen to the vulperine sitting between your legs.
        
        "One, two, push!"
        
        Gritting your teeth, you clench your inner muscles with all you've got for a few seconds then relax, a tremendous effort in your state. It feels like you displaced an immovable object a few inches away before it returned back to its place. "You're doing great! Do this a little more and we'll have little ones in your arms in a minute!"
        
        Easier said than done. Two seconds later, another contraction forces you to push again, a new inhuman request that drives your mind insane with a debilitating mix of bliss and pain. Unable to do anything else, you concentrate yourself on Natalia and Vasha's voice and scream with a maddened fervor with each new aching thrust. Arened holds your hand tight and whispers unintelligible words to your [pc.ears], supporting you the best he can and massaging your temples with as much care as he'd a very fancy vase. Little by little, you feel something moving inside you, something big and warm that's impatient to move out.
        
        "Good, very good! I can see the head, just a little more!"
        
        The perspective of finishing this ordeal invigorates you as you push again, giving all you've got to birth your vulperine kid. A slick, wet mass slides out of you followed a moment later by an acute roar. The tiny fox in Natalia's hands screams as hot lumps of air inflate his small lungs for the first time. He's just so beautiful, even in this state your tired eyes find him absolutely adorable as Vasha delicately cuts the umbilical cord, cleans him a little, and wraps your son in a cozy blanket. She playfully rubs her nose against his muzzle before gently placing him in the cradle her father prepared for your offspring.
        
        "I see another one, keep at it [pc.name]!"
        
        Mustering your willpower, you reiterate your efforts all over again, albeit with looser muscles and a weakened stamina but with a steadfast willpower. A couple of minutes later, another wail fills the room and another kiddo lands in the priestess's hands. This boy is a little smaller than the former but he's far more vigorous. Last but not least, you lay a big girl with round cheeks a few contractions later. She doesn't whimper much, even when her big sister breaks the link between you and her, as if she were too tired to shadow the peaks' bellowing gales. Seeing that you've got nothing left to deliver, Natalia and Vasha slowly clean and heal you while Arened offers you some clear water.
        
        "Good job [pc.name], some harpy broodmothers would kill to have your stamina," the stormcaller teases as they lift you from the stained linens and place you on warm, dry furs near the heart. Arened drops a soft kiss on your forehead before finally letting your hands go and recovering your snoozing kids from the wooden bunk. You are still numbed by the painkiller concoction, and yet you feel so alive, so happy, so light all of a sudden, as if your mind was finally relieved of a titanic burden. A large smile breaks your features as the furry potter places your childrens on your [pc.chest], resting their peaceful bodies on top of you, just close enough for you to smooch them.
        
        "They are magnificent," you whisper, barely able to raise your voice. "Did you pick names for each of our treasures?"
        
        The caretaker nods. "I think that Inigo, Ugo, and Shelly would suit them well, if that's fine with you. We don't usually name them before they open their eyes, when we are sure they will survive, but their [pc.mf
            |father
            |mother
        ] is a tough one, so there's no fear to have for their sake."
        
        You barely have the time to rest a little before Arened's harpies swarm you, eager to see and meet their new siblings. Natalia and Vasha try their best to reduce the flow but there's nothing they can do to stop the multicolor flock from surrounding you with wide, curious eyes — even the toddlers waddle around toward you, intrigued by the little foxes peacefully napping against you. 
        
        "They are so tiny!"
        
        "Can I hold one?"
        
        "No! Me first!"
        
        Arened slowly tuts. "Easy there girls, [pc.name] and your siblings are very tired right now. Let them rest a few hours then we'll play with them. Give [pc.name] a smooch then we will make a big treat for our guest," the furry potter commands. The young chicks produce disappointed sighs but behave nonetheless. In the span of a minute, you get showered with kisses by the feathery sweethearts, leaving your face an even wetter mess than it already was. Feeling a deep torpor embracing you, your [pc.eyes] close and let a snug, dark warmth take you.'

rows.original:
A dim, fruity smell wakes you up hours later. The first thing you notice is the absence of your kids, an existential dread that soon dissipates as you notice Natalia slowly rocking them while Arened and Vasha share a big pie with the over excited harpies. The little ones have a mix of cream and blueberries all over their faces already, not that you'd expect anything else from your flying [silly
                |scamps
                |scoundrels
            ]. Slowly, you push the heavy furs away and put your gear back on before joining them for a well-deserved feast.
            
            "Did I sleep long?"
            
            Vasha shakes her head. "Less than an hour. Natalia barely had the time to clean you and recover her gear," she remarks before handing you a small plate loaded with a large piece of cake. Unable to resist the sultry call of the freshly-baked treat, you dig in with a guilty drive, filling your mouth with a delicious mix of sweet and sour flavors trickling with warm juices. Velun's fur, that's some high class cuisine, especially for such a secluded, barren place.
            
            "It's so tasty! What did you use to make it so good?"
            
            "Lots of love!" the young harpies answer.
            
            Arened snickers. "Flour, milk, eggs, blueberries, a hint of cinnamon, and the secret ingredient," he winks. "I'm glad you like my cooking. I'm many things [pc.name], but I'm far from being a real chef."
            
            "You don't need to be stellar at everything, old man. You are, however, a very good potter and an even better caretaker," the Sorran priestess retorts before checking on your kids again. "I'll help Arened nurse them so you won't need to worry about nursing them, [natalia.hasKids
                |I've got enough milk our kid[natalia.numKids 2|s] and for them
                |I've got enough milk to share with these adorable fiends
            ] — your children will be fine with us."
            
            A couple of minutes later, the half-vulperine and Vasha take their leave, but not before giving a kiss to everyone in the room and congratulating you for a job well done. Thanks to the sugary cake filling their tiny tummies, the young harpies calmed down a lot, dozing out here and there. Slowly, Arened wraps his daughters in thic[silly
                |c
                |k
            ] blankets and place the sleepy girls near the heart, where they can rest without being harassed by the peaks' cool winds. While your foxy lover takes care of his chicks, you give your own kiddos a quick check. The three infants are sleeping soundly in their cradle, lying on their backs and sides under a pair of soft blankets. You can spot a few hints of crimson fuzz on your elder's scalp while reddish-pink ones seem to pierce through the others' skin, like their father's. 
            
            "I still can't believe I made these beautiful treasures."
            
            "I never doubted it," Arened teases. "I'll take good care of them, I'll leave the rest to you, [pc.name]."
            
            The vulperine drops a quick peck on your cheek before taking one of the tired toddlers in his arms. Seeing how considerate he is with kids that aren't his, you have no doubt he'll raise yours well. Slowly, you leave the house[party.som
                |
                | with [companion1.name]
                | with your friends
            ], blowing kisses to the handful of chicks that are still awake and promising them you'll be back soon — they already adopted you as their surrogate mother it seems. It's a bit hard to leave your newborn behind, but you've got to protect their future, not that it stops you from seeing them from time to time. It'll certainly please Arened and his daughters to see you again too.
rows.translation:
几个小时后，一股淡淡的果香将你唤醒。你首先注意到的是孩子们不见了，这种令人不安的感觉很快就被你看到娜塔莉亚正在轻轻摇晃着他们，而阿雷内德和瓦莎则和那些兴奋不已的“女妖”们一起分享着一大块派而消散了。那些小家伙们的脸上已经沾满了奶油和蓝莓的痕迹——对于这些会飞的孩子来说，你本来也没指望他们会有什么不同的表现吧。 [silly
                |调皮鬼们
                |无赖们
            ]慢慢地，你把那些重型的毛皮推到一边，重新穿戴好装备，然后和他们一起享用这顿应得的盛宴。

“我睡了很久吗？”

瓦莎摇了摇头：“不到一个小时。 娜塔莉亚几乎没时间给你清理干净，也没时间收拾她的装备，”她边说边递给你一个装着一大块蛋糕的小盘子。你实在无法抗拒这种新鲜出炉的甜点的诱惑，于是迫不及待地吃了起来，口中充满了甜中带酸的美妙滋味，还有那些渗出的热汁。 维伦的毛皮，这可真是顶级的美味佳肴，尤其是在这样一个偏远而荒芜的地方。

“太好吃了！你用了什么方法才能做出这么美味的东西呢？”

“当然是投入了满满的爱啊！”那些年轻的鹰身女妖这样回答道。
            
            观众们窃笑起来。“面粉、牛奶、鸡蛋、蓝莓，再加上一点点肉桂，还有那个秘密配料，”他眨了眨眼，“很高兴你喜欢我的烹饪……其实我还有很多其他的本领呢。 [pc.name]但我远称不上是一位真正的厨师。”

“老人家，你并不需要在所有事情上都做到完美。不过，你确实是个非常出色的陶艺家，更是一位出色的照顾者。”索兰的女祭司说道，然后又去检查你的孩子们了。“我会帮忙照顾他们，这样你就不用担心这个事情了。 [natalia.hasKids
                |我们的孩子已经有足够的牛奶喝了。[natalia.numKids 2|s] 也是为了他们。
                |我有足够的牛奶来分享给这些可爱的小家伙们。
            ] 你的孩子们在我们这里会很安全的。”

几分钟后，那个有着半狼人血统的女孩和瓦莎离开了，但在离开之前，她们亲吻了房间里的每一个人，并祝贺你们做得非常出色。由于吃了那些甜美的蛋糕，这些小女妖们安静了许多，有的在这里打瞌睡，有的在那里休息。慢慢地，阿雷内德把他的女儿们紧紧地抱在怀里……[silly
                |c
                |k
            ] 用毯子将那些熟睡的小宝贝盖好，把他们放在心脏所在的位置，这样他们就可以安静地休息，而不会受到山峰上凉爽风气的干扰。当你的迷人恋人正在照顾他的“小宝贝”们时，你也可以快速检查一下自己的孩子。那三个婴儿正安详地躺在摇篮里，他们或是仰卧，或是侧卧，身上都盖着柔软的毯子。 你可以看到老人的头皮上有些深红色的绒毛，而那些粉红色的绒毛似乎穿透了其他颜色的毛发，就像他们父亲的那样。

“我仍然无法相信自己竟然做出了这些如此精美的珍品。我从来都没有怀疑过，”阿雷内德调侃道，“我会好好照顾它们的，其余的事情就交给你吧。 [pc.name]那只狐狸轻啄了一下你的脸颊，然后抱起了其中一个疲惫的小孩。看到它对那些并非自己亲生的孩子如此细心、如此体贴，你毫不怀疑它也会把你的孩子照顾得很好。于是，你慢慢地走出了房子。[party.som
                |
                | 与……一起 [companion1.name]
                | 和你的朋友们一起
            ]你向那些还醒着的孩子们飞吻，并向他们承诺很快就会回来——看来他们已经把你当成了他们的代理母亲。把刚出生的孩子留在身边确实有点难，但你必须保护他们的未来，当然，这并不妨碍你偶尔去看他们。看到你再次出现，阿雷内德和他的女儿们肯定也会很高兴的。

"How are our adorable sweethearts going?"

    "They've been longing to see you again," Arened replies, glancing at the wooden cradle then at his chicks. "Their big sisters have been very considerate and eager to take care of them. I had to enforce a quota to stop them from fighting to determine who's going to feed them."
    
    "No! That's not true!"
    
    "It totally is," one of the teens retorts to the little ones. "[pc.name] and Dad's kids aren't dolls to play with."
    
    "Alright alright, everyone settle down. [var0
        |They might not see us but they hear all the ruckus we are making
        |You'll wake them if you continue to be so loud
    ]," Arened grumbles.
    
    Before the situation becomes more heated, you rise from your chair and step toward your vulperine offspring. They are just how you remember, albeit with a denser coat of fur and a little more hair, but they are still the peaceful [var0

        |toddlers
    ] you love from the bottom of your heart. Thic[silly

]那些半人半狮的孩子们很快就吃饱了，他们本来就容易打盹，等他们差不多要睡着的时候，你就把他们放回他们的摇篮里。“真是……太好了，”你低声说道，“真的非常好。” 再详细地描述也无法完全表达这一宁静时刻的美好，但那些小女孩似乎理解了你的意思，于是她们给了你好几個吻。不过，最终你还是得回去继续工作，于是不情愿地从摇篮旁走开了。

Eventually you've got to get back to business though, and reluctantly step back from the cribs.'

rows.original: The growhouse is hardly a feat of engineering, but it is effective; wooden boxes of soil and diced plant scraps are placed under greenhouse-style windows of genuine glass. Plenty of feline-friendly smokeables grow healthily, with some soft parchment sheets stacked nearby. Someone out there is missing their scribing tools, but a cat's gotta smoke, you guess.
rows.translation: 这个种植箱虽然算不上什么复杂的工程杰作，但确实非常有效：人们用木箱装上土壤和切碎的植物残渣，然后把这些箱子放在由真正玻璃制成的温室式窗户下方。许多对猫来说友好的植物都在这里茁壮成长，旁边还堆放着一些柔软的羊皮纸。肯定有人会想念自己的书写工具，但毕竟猫也是需要抽烟的，不是吗？
