rows.original: The manticores sure have a serious setup here; if they had a way to get food on demand, they'd never need to leave. Leticia takes her time joining you up in their growhouse, walking across the selection of planters. "Something to relax with? Let me help you..." Leticia plucks up some parchment, and a tiny pot of lightly-salted water, which she brushes along the paper before neatly tearing a strip out. [pc.isFeline |"Nothing like getting yourself all softened up with a nice big rollup of the nip, huh?" |"I'm not sure you'll get much of a buzz out of this, but I have a little something extra to cut yours with." The manticore mom snips a valerian flower up, makes sure to brush any pollen away, and grinds it into paste to roll with the manticore-nip. "Something nice and soothing..." ] With your smokeables prepared, the two of you climb back down into their living space, dump yourselves into the blankets, and light up. It's a little harsher than anticipated on the first drag, but considering the way the aged manticore-milf handles a great big rip without a moment's complaint, you fight down the urge to cough, eyes watering before you finally suck in some air, and exhale the whole lot through your nose. For a few moments you don't feel much of anything, but the rosy heat that rises into your [pc.ears] doesn't keep you waiting for too long. You sigh and coast the moment out, both you and Leticia endeavouring to keep your exhaling to the window on the opposite side of the room to the cribs... it's likely harmless smoke, but you're not monsters; at the first sign of a cough you're destroying these things. That anxiety fades out eventually, and by the time you take another drag there's a beautiful hue to the world. Leticia pulls her blankets up, flops onto her back, and yawns sleepily. "This is nice, we have a good life up here." "No doubt..." you yawn, copying the motion once you're sure you aren't going to get any ash on yourself. [party.som | |[companion1.name] finds a place to sit and nap, leaving the two of you to relax and catching up on some extra rest [companion1.mf |for him |for her ]self. |Your companions pass on having a smoke themselves, instead opting to leave the two of you to relax, and catch up on some extra rest with a nap. ] You expected conversation to be kicked up once your inhibitions washed away like so much water, instead Leticia spends the entire time sprawled out, purring, and just delighting in the company. It isn't until Catalina and Clara flap out to go and catch some food that she speaks up, a wistful look in her eyes. "I'll be sad when my babes fly the coop for good, I already know they want to explore the colder lands, conquer some old ruined tower of their own, build up a long-term family like I've done." "That won't be for a while, will it?" Leticia smiles ruefully, holding in a lungful of smoke before slowly exhaling. "It doesn't matter what the sundial says, or how many years pass, and how old and grumpy I get, the day they're gone will be too soon and too long both." The two of you chat for a while about families, at least until the twins return, a stripped-down steppe-goat between them. "Heyhey, you girls have a good hunt?" The manti-mom grins, stubbing out the last of her ashes and flapping the air clear with her wings gently. "Yus!" The duo deliver their meals, and it looks like it's time to let the family get to dinner. "See you again soon," you sigh out a last lungful of smoke, feeling a pleasant tingle in the limits of your extremities.
rows.translation: 这些螳螂在这里的确建立了相当完善的生存环境；如果它们能够随时获取食物，就根本不需要离开这里了。莱蒂西亚慢慢地带你来到它们的种植室，一边走过那些摆放整齐的种植盆，一边说道：“想找点东西放松一下吗？让我来帮您吧……” 莱蒂西亚拿出一张羊皮纸和一小罐淡盐水，在纸上轻轻涂抹了几下，然后整齐地撕下了一条纸条。 [pc.isFeline |没有什么比好好地享受一次温暖的按摩更让人放松的了，对吧？ |我不确定你是否能得到它。 很多 这件事本来已经很热闹了，但我还有点特别的东西可以加进去。”那头曼提科尔妈妈摘下一朵缬草花，仔细地擦去花粉，然后将其磨成糊状，再与曼提科尔提取物混合在一起。“一些能带来舒适与放松的效果的东西…… ] 准备好烟具后，你们俩重新回到他们的居住空间，钻进毯子里，点上了烟。第一口吸入时，烟雾确实比预想的要呛人一些，但看到那位年长的雌性曼提科尔如此若无其事地大口吸着烟，丝毫没有抱怨，你也就强忍住想要咳嗽的冲动。过了好一会儿，你终于吸进了一些空气，然后通过鼻子把所有烟雾都呼了出去。 有那么几秒钟，你什么感觉都没有，但那种温暖的感觉却逐渐在你的体内蔓延开来…… [pc.ears] 这个过程并不会让你等待太久。你叹了口气，任由时间慢慢流逝，你和莱蒂西亚都尽量把呼出的气息朝向房间另一侧窗户，远离那些婴儿床……那些烟雾很可能并无危害，但你们毕竟不是怪物；只要有一点咳嗽的迹象，你们就会立刻销毁这些东西。 那种焦虑最终会消退，等到你再次吸一口烟时，世界会呈现出一种美妙的色彩。莱蒂西亚把毯子拉得严严实实，仰面躺下，困倦地打了个哈欠：“这里真好，我们在这里过着很美好的生活。毫无疑问……”你打着哈欠，等确定自己不会被灰烬弄脏后，才模仿着那个动作做了出来。 [party.som | |[companion1.name] 找了个地方坐下来小憩，这样你们俩就可以放松下来，好好休息一下了。 [companion1.mf |对他来说 |为了她 ]自我。 |你的同伴也抽了烟，然后选择离开，让你们俩独自放松，小睡一会儿，补充一些精力。 ] 你原本以为，当你的拘谨像被水冲走一样消失后，谈话会变得活跃起来。然而，莱蒂西亚却一直躺着，发出呼噜声，只是享受着这种陪伴。直到卡塔利娜和克拉拉跑去觅食后，她才开口说话，眼中带着一丝怅惘。 当我的孩子们真正离开家去探索外面的世界时，我会很难过的。我知道他们想要去那些寒冷的地方，去征服那些古老的废墟，然后像我一样建立一个稳定的家庭。” “不过，这个时刻应该还会晚一些吧？莱蒂西亚无奈地笑了笑，屏住一口烟雾，然后缓缓吐了出来。“无论日晷显示什么时间，无论多少年过去，无论我变得多么衰老和脾气多么暴躁，他们离开的那一天，总会显得既太快，又太漫长。你们俩聊了一会儿关于家庭的事情，至少一直聊到那对双胞胎回来——他们中间就像一只被剥去毛皮的草原山羊。“嘿嘿，你们两个找东西找得顺利吗？”那位穿着曼蒂服饰的母亲笑着说道，她熄灭了手中剩下的灰烬，然后轻轻扇动翅膀，让空气重新变得清新。 尤斯！” 两人将饭菜端了上来，看来是时候让这家人开始用餐了。“回头见吧，”你深深地吸了一口烟，感到四肢末端传来一阵愉悦的刺痛感。

rows.original: "Hey, Cait!" You call down from the growhouse to your pretty pink kitty, and — after disentangling herself from your batkitten kids — she scrambles up to join you. "Time to get stoned as fuck?" "Yep." Leticia follows after her, making strides towards her joint-rolling supplies. She gently sprays some lightly salted water over the parchment, cleanly tears it, and gathers up plenty of nip[pc.isFeline|| — and some ground valerian flower for you —] before rolling it into some clean smokables for the three of you to enjoy together. "One moment... Clara, Cata, can you pass up some pillows?" The manti-milf reaches down through the opening, and she's handed up enough bedding for the three of you to get comfortable. "Just in case you're tempted to get messy," she giggles. "Don't want to wake the kittens." Cait giggles, accepting the offered joint with you before looking torn for a lap to sit in once the blankets and pillows are set up. "Oooh, such choices; [pc.name] or the milfymeow." "Both, kitten," Leticia smiles and wraps her tail around your waist, sitting down next to you so that she can sprawl across both of your laps. Which she does, almost immediately. "Just... watch those ashes!" The priestess giggles and takes a slow drag, tension slowly bleeding out of her body. She has her ass in the manticore's lap, giving you the opportunity to rub her ears and enjoy the tits practically pooling out of her robes. She purrs at your touch, and her tail coils around idly through the air sinuously. You too join the duo in smoking, allowing a delightful tingle to creep its way into the tips of your extremities, and the world takes on a softer hue. You all inhale, hold your breaths, and then exhale in sync, echoing sounds of satisfaction while the kitty in your laps grows clearly friskier. "Ah, smoking like this makes me feel like a youngster, you know...." Leticia smiles and squeezes Cait's thigh, which ends up with a paw[silly |b ] trapped between them. "You're plenty young!" Cait grins and wiggles her hips, making sure to grind her bootie into her. She smiles up at you when you pinch the tips of her ears, and her purring takes on a throatier note. "How about I prove it?" rows.original:
This is Natalia, priestess of the village. [natalia.hasKids
        |Ever since she's become the mother of your children, she's started exuding a maternal gravitas. With the whole experience of pregnancy making her already sumptuous body all the more thick and lush, you're reminded that you're the one who [natalia.pregStage 0 1.5 2.5
            |filled out her curves. There's still slime baby weight which clings to her hips and rear — a sign that her body has adjusted itself to make her next childbearing easier.
            |put a kit in her.
            |put a kit in her. Furthermore, the fox-girl's gravid belly bears a distinct, flushed hue which you no doubt is warm to the touch. Her protruding, egg-shaped tummy is so heavy that she has to cradle it with one or even two hands at all times, so full and rich with growing life. It's not long before she gives birth...
        ]
        |[natalia.pregStage 0 .5 1.5 2.5
            |She stands roughly around six feet tall with a lush, ample physique. 
            |The first signs of her pregnancy are beginning to show: the fox-girl's belly has developed into a slight, teardrop protrusion. It's a good, long time before the life inside her bears fruit, but that gives you enough time to appreciate that it's your child in there...
            |Over the course of her pregnancy, Natalia's belly has grown to a taut, egg-shaped dome — it sticks out in front of her in a large, heaving bump. 
            |Ever since she's gotten pregnant with your child, her already ample body has grown to an even more fecund form. Furthermore, the fox-girl's gravid belly bears a distinct, flushed hue which you no doubt is warm to the touch. Her protruding, egg-shaped tummy is so heavy that she has to cradle it with one or even two hands at all times, so full and rich with growing life. It's not long before she gives birth...
        ]
    ]
    
    
    Slitted, golden eyes play with mischief and energy above her cute nose and full, pink lips. Her freckled face is framed by twin scarlet locks; her rich, red hair flows down like to her lower back. The more obviously foxy parts of her are the large, black-tipped ears that sit atop her head, the bushy tail that flicks playfully behind her, a majestic red mane around her neck, and black-furred limbs which end at her upper thighs and arms.
    
    As for her attire, she wears a brown [var0|piece of fabric which hangs over her massive, milk-laden breasts|chest wrap which keeps her large-sized breasts in place], and a loincloth that makes no effort to hide her curvature.
rows.translation:
我是娜塔莉亚，这个村庄的女祭司。 [natalia.hasKids
        |自从她成为了你孩子的母亲之后，她身上就散发出一种母性的威严。怀孕的经历让她原本就丰满的身材变得更加圆润动人，这让你不禁意识到，其实是你自己…… [natalia.pregStage 0 1.5 2.5
            |她的身体曲线更加优美了。不过身上还残留着一些产后的赘肉，这些脂肪堆积在她的臀部和大腿上——这其实说明她的身体正在做出调整，为下一次生育做好准备。
            |让她兴奋不已。
            |她的肚子明显隆起了。更何况，那个狐狸女孩那怀孕的肚子还呈现出一种特有的、泛红的颜色，想必摸起来也会感到温暖。她那凸出的、呈蛋形的肚子实在太重了，以至于她总是不得不用一只甚至两只手来托着它——里面充满了正在成长的生命。用不了多久，她就要分娩了……
        ]
        |[natalia.pregStage 0 .5 1.5 2.5
            |她的身高大约有六英尺，身材丰满匀称。 
            |她怀孕的最初迹象已经开始显现：那个狐狸女孩的腹部出现了一个微微凸出的、呈泪滴状的轮廓。虽然距离胎儿出生还有很长的时间，但这也足以让你意识到，那个正在她体内成长的孩子，其实就是你的孩子……
            |在怀孕期间，娜塔莉亚的腹部逐渐变成了一个紧绷的、呈蛋形的凸起——这个鼓起的部分明显地凸在她的身体前方。 
            |自从她怀上了你的孩子，她原本就丰满的身材变得更加圆润动人。尤其是那个狐狸女孩的孕肚，呈现出一种特有的红润色调，想必摸起来也会感到温暖柔软。她凸出的、呈椭圆形的肚子重得让她不得不始终用一只手甚至两只手托着，里面充满了正在孕育的生命。用不了多久，她就会生下孩子了……
        ]
    ]
    
    
    那双狭长而金色的眼睛中充满了顽皮与活力，她的可爱鼻子和饱满的粉红色嘴唇上洋溢着生机。她那布满雀斑的脸庞被一头双色的猩红色长发环绕着，这些浓密的红发一直垂到她的腰部。她身上那些最显露出“狐狸特质”的部位包括：头顶上那对黑色尖端的耳朵、在身后欢快摆动的浓密尾巴、脖子上那圈华丽的红色鬃毛，以及那些覆盖着黑色毛发的四肢——这些四肢的长度一直延伸到她的大腿和手部臂。

至于她的穿着，她身披一件棕色的…… [var0|那块垂落在她那巨大、充满乳汁的胸脯上的布料|能够固定她那较大尺寸胸部的胸罩]以及一条根本无法遮盖她身形的亚麻布短裙。

rows.original: Strike up a conversation with [natalia.hasKids|your mate|the village priestess].
rows.translation: 与……攀谈起来 [natalia.hasKids|你的朋友|村中的女祭司].
rows.raw: "Strike up a conversation with [natalia.hasKids|your mate|the village priestess]."

rows.original: Having nothing better to do, you sit down with Natalia for a little bit and chat with her about anything and everything that comes to mind. You tell her about the most recent outings you've gone on; she tells you some of the gossip she's heard around the village. From there, the small talk continues till neither of you have anything more to say. This pleasant chat has helped ease your mind.
rows.translation: 由于没有别的事情可做，你就和娜塔莉亚坐下来，随便聊起了各种话题。你跟她讲述了最近参加的一些活动；她则告诉了你一些她在村里听到的闲言碎语。就这样，你们一直闲聊着，直到两人都没有什么可说的了。这种愉快的交谈确实让你的心情变得轻松了许多。
rows.raw: "\n    Having nothing better to do, you sit down with Natalia for a little bit and chat with her about anything and everything that comes to mind. You tell her about the most recent outings you've gone on; she tells you some of the gossip she's heard around the village. [flags.NATALIA_TLK_RELIGION
        |You ask Natalia to give you the talk on Sorra again
        |If anyone in the village could tell you more about Sorra, it'd be the local priestess. You ask Natalia if she's willing to tell you more about her goddess
    ].
    
    "[natalia.fucked
        |[rand
            |Of course!
            |How about I tell you about the migration patterns of various birds that live in the region?" Natalia watches as all of the enthusiasm in your expression begins to drain away. She then titters and says, I'm just kidding,
            |Of course!
        ] 
    ]I'm always ready to share my faith with anyone who's willing to listen. As a priestess, it is my duty to be both shepherd and teacher."
    
    Natalia gestures at the crude statue of Sorra, its wings spread and spear head high to the heavens. "As you already know, the sky goddess, Sorra, is the patron of adventurers and winged beings, with harpies being her chosen people. Get on her bad side, and you'll invite a terrible storm; stay in her good graces, and the elements will preserve you. However, there's more to her than just controlling the winds and weather. Sorra is the giver of freedom. She encourages people to travel and discover new things."
    
    Most of these villagers aren't harpies, and — outside of hunting and foraging — they don't seem to be the traveling sort, so how do they pay respect to the Storm Maiden?
    
    "Aside from the usual reverence? Well, there's a few things she likes, such as: bonfire dances, songs, wind instruments, ritualistic sacrifices, javelins being thrown at the sky."
    
    Wait, is everyone just going to skip over that? Can she go back and repeat what she said?
    
    "What, javelin throwing? Yeah. She likes it when we-"
    
    No. The part where she said ritualistic sacrifices.
    
    She smiles and waves dismissively. "I know. I'm just messing with you. Don't worry, there's none of that here. It's just hunters giving up some of the small game they catch. Nevertheless, the main way that we appease Sorra is by simply living in harmony with the land and her people. In return, our community is given sanctuary and a sense of unity."
    
    [silly
        |So she's a landlord, then.
        
        "Pretty much."
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.NATALIA_TLK_RELIGION
        |你让娜塔莉亚再给你讲讲关于索拉的故事吧。
        |如果村里有人能向你详细介绍索拉，那一定是当地的女祭司。你可以问问娜塔莉亚，看看她是否愿意告诉你更多关于她的女神的故事。
    ].
    
    "[natalia.fucked
        |[rand
            |当然可以！
            |那我来讲讲这个地区各种鸟类的迁徙习性吧？”娜塔莉亚看着你脸上原本洋溢的热情逐渐消退，然后轻声笑着说：“我只是开个玩笑而已。
            |当然可以！
        ] 
    ]我始终愿意与任何愿意倾听的人分享我的信仰。作为一名女祭司，引导人们并传授知识既是我的职责，也是我的使命。

娜塔莉亚指向那座粗糙制作的索拉雕像——它的双翼展开，长矛高举指向天空。 如你们所知，天空女神索拉是冒险者与有翼生物的守护者，而哈比族正是她特别眷顾的种族。如果惹她不高兴，就会招来可怕的暴风雨；而只要让她满意，自然之力就会保护你们。 然而，她的能力并不仅仅局限于操控风与天气。索拉其实是自由的象征——她鼓励人们去旅行、去探索新的事物。
    
    这些村民大多数并不是那种喜欢四处游荡的人，而且除了打猎和采集食物之外，他们似乎也不喜欢四处旅行。那么，他们究竟是如何向风暴少女表达敬意的呢？

“除了那些常规的敬拜仪式之外，其实还有几样东西是她喜欢的，比如：篝火舞、歌曲、吹奏乐器，以及那些献祭仪式和向天空投掷标枪的行为。
    
    等等，难道大家都要忽略这一部分吗？她能重新再说一遍她刚才说的话吗？

“什么，投掷标枪吗？是的，她很喜欢我们……”

不，我是说她提到的那些仪式性的献祭行为。

她只是微笑着，随意地挥了挥手，表示不用再说了。 我知道，我只是开个玩笑而已。别担心，这里根本没有那种事情。那些猎人只是把他们抓到的一些小动物分出来而已。不过，我们安抚索拉的主要方式，就是与这片土地以及她的子民和谐共处。 作为回报，我们的社区获得了庇护与团结感。
    
    [silly
        |那么，她就是房东了。

“差不多吧。
    ]

rows.original: "It's a quaint place, isn't it?" [pc.bg barbarian hunter |She could say that. But, there's nothing wrong with it being quaint. If anything, it reminds you of home |[pc.isDK |This village is an utter backwater in comparison to where you're from |Quaint is certainly a word for it ] ]. Compared to the quarantined city below, the folk here seem almost carefree. It's like this village was spared from the demonic invasion below. "Through the efforts of the storm paladins and our cultivation of Sorra's blessings, we're able to live in relative peace. Sure, we may not be prosperous, what with the scarcity of resources and all, but we're able to live within our means. Each of us has a part to play in the village, and it's through this coexistence that we manage to survive." [flags.NATALIA_TLK_VILLAGE | |What happens if there's a famine or their game migrates elsewhere? "Well..." Natalia pinches her chin and purses her lips, thinking up of possible contingencies in her head. "Sorra and her blessed children have been more than accommodating to us. But, in the event that everything goes tits up and we've got no other choice, we'll just pack up our things and move — start anew. Goddess willing, this stays as a hypothetical." [pc.isDK |Or they could, you know, get off this fucking mountain and find somewhere else to settle before it becomes a problem! Perhaps they can move somewhere that actually has trees and is near a source of freshwater. After that, they can transition to a more self-sustaining system. |But what if the villagers here didn't have to struggle? Wouldn't it be better for them to settle down at a resource-abundant place and transition to a more self-sustaining system? ] Once they've built up a surplus of food through farming, they can actually look forward to having more than three or four dozen people. "I know where you're coming from, [pc.name], and I appreciate your concern, but you underestimate peoples' stubbornness to change. This is what the vulps know — it's been their way of life for generations. I don't doubt my people's ability to adapt, but I don't think they're ready for something like that. If we became more like Khor'minos, we'd lose something that's worth more than gold: our identity." In what regard? "Can you tell me the name of every single person in Khor'minos?" Of course not! That's too many people to keep track of! Not even King Kelsaz could pull that off! "Exactly. We're only able to know so many people. After a certain point, we stop putting value in the individual as our minds start associating them for the 'tribe' they're a part of. Now, if we turn our attention back to the vulp, I could tell you the name and profession of every person here. No member is insignificant. Sure, there may come a time when we'll have to adopt a new way of life in order to survive, but that time is not today. Today, we're just a quaint village." ]
rows.translation: 这个地方真是别有韵味，不是吗？ [pc.bg barbarian hunter |她这么说确实有道理。不过，这种古朴的风格其实并没有什么不好的地方。相反，它反而会让人联想到家乡。 |[pc.isDK |与你们来自的地方相比，这个村庄简直就是偏远闭塞的角落。 |古朴”这个词确实非常适合用来形容它。 ] ]与下方那座被隔离的城市相比，这里的居民似乎过得无忧无虑。这个村庄仿佛躲过了下方的恶魔入侵。 “多亏了风暴圣骑士们的努力，以及我们虔诚地祈求索拉的庇佑，我们才能过上相对安宁的生活。当然，由于资源匮乏，我们的生活并不富裕，但至少我们能够自给自足。在村庄里，每个人都有自己的职责，正是这种共同协作，让我们得以生存下来。 [flags.NATALIA_TLK_VILLAGE | |如果发生了饥荒，或者他们的游戏转移到了其他地方，会怎么样呢？ “嗯……”娜塔莉亚托着下巴，抿着嘴唇，在脑海中思考着各种可能的情况。“索拉和她的孩子们一直对我们非常慷慨。但是，如果真的发生了最糟糕的情况，我们别无选择，那就只能收拾行李搬走，重新开始生活。只要女神保佑，这种情况永远只是一种假设罢了。 [pc.isDK |或者，他们也可以离开这座该死的山，去别的地方安顿下来，免得以后惹上麻烦！也许他们可以搬到真正适合居住的地方去…… 拥有 树木生长在靠近淡水源的地方。在这样的环境下，它们能够逐渐发展成一种更加自我维持的生态系统。 |但如果这里的村民不必再为生存而挣扎，如果他们能够在一个资源丰富的地方安定下来，从而转向一种更加自给自足的生活方式，那不是会更好吗？ ] 一旦他们通过农业生产积累了足够的食物，那么他们实际上就可以容纳三十到四十人以上了。 “我明白你的想法…… [pc.name]我感谢你的关心，但你低估了人们改变的顽固性。对于狼族来说，这早已成为他们世代相传的生活方式。我并不怀疑我的族人具备适应变化的能力，但我觉得他们目前还没有准备好面对这样的改变。 如果我们变得像科尔米诺斯人一样，我们就會失去一些比黄金更珍贵的东西——我们的身份。” “在哪些方面呢？” “你能说出科尔米诺斯每一个人的名字吗？ 当然不行！那样人数太多，根本无法一一记住！就连凯尔萨兹国王也做不到这一点！ “正是这样。我们所能记住的人数是有限的。一旦超过这个限度，我们就不再把个体视为独立的个体来看待了，因为我们的思维会开始将他们视为他们所属的‘群体’的一部分。 现在，如果我们把注意力重新回到这些“狐狸”身上，我可以告诉你们在场的每个人的姓名和职业。没有一个人是无关紧要的。当然，也许会有那么一天，我们必须采取新的生活方式才能生存下去，但今天还不是那天。 如今，我们只不过是一个宁静的村庄罢了。 ]

[var0
        |"If you want to get intimate, I know something else we could do."
        
        Nah, talk will suffice for now.
        
        "If you insist," Natalia says with a dismissive shrug. "Ask away. I am an open book."
        |"Huh, you wanna know more about me? Can't say I've done much of that nowadays since anyone who might wanna ask already knows everything there is about me. Is there anything in particular that you wanna know? I'm an open book."
        |"Oh, curious are you?" Natalia rests a hand on her hip and shifts her weight from one leg to the other. "Is there anything in particular that you wanna know or am I going to have to take a shot in the dark?"
    ]
    
    [rand
        |You want to know how she's able to speak Belharan so fluently. Unlike the rest of her people, she can hold entire conversations with you without skipping a beat. It's like she's a natural!
        
        "That's because I am, dear. You see, I wasn't actually born with the tribe; my dad was, but I grew up with my mom in Khor'minos for about eight or nine years. However, one thing led to another, and now, here I am, carrying on my father's legacy."
        
        That must've been a rough transition.
        
        "You're telling me! I had to learn a whole new language! But, thankfully, members of the community were kind enough to help me. The tricky part in the beginning was not just knowing the words, but also the structure. Vulperine is much different than Belharan. For instance, if you wanted to say 'where is the campfire' in Vulperine format, the literal translation in Belharan would be 'campfire where is.' I could go on about this, but that's not the point of our discussion. What matters is that, yes, I'm bilingual. But, while Belharan may be my mother tongue, Vulperine has become my primary language."
        
        Well, considering Natalia was roughly nine years old when she joined the tribe, and she looks to be around her early twenties, everything she's saying checks out. Natalia has spent more of her life as a vulp than as a Minoan. Nevertheless, it's good to see that none of her Belharan has diminished over the years.
        |You ask Natalia about her ancestry. What's the story there?
        
        "Well, I'm sure you've already noticed the vulpine part; not many know about my minotaur half, though. People tend to assume I'm part human. Can't say I blame them. It's not an easy distinction to make." 
        
        Yeah, you can definitely see how it'd be hard to make that distinction. [natalia.fucked

They can be a pain in the ass, sometimes, if I don't tend to them. Leave them alone for a week or two and they'll be leaking up a storm![natalia.hasKids
                |"
                
                [natalia.anyKids|With how many kits she's given birth to, perhaps that's not a bad thing. Her being as bountiful as she is just means she'll have enough milk to feed all of [pc.isDK
                    |your
                    |her
                ] children's hungry little mouths.|It's a good thing you gave her a kit to feed, then!]
                
                "Being a mother certainly has its perks.
            ] With that said, I love having a massive pair of tits."
            
            You love her tits too.
            
            A mischievous smile forms on your sweetheart's lips. "Then it's a good thing they're all yours, [pc.mascFem
                |big [pc.boyGirl]
                |cutie
            ]."
            
        ]That just leaves one other matter: what's the story behind her parents? [natalia.fucked
            |You want to know who to thank for making the fine lady in front of you.
        ]
        
        "Well, I suppose it all started when my parents first met. At the time, my father, Stokkyr, was still the tribe priest; my mother, Illanis, was a cowgirl who came to the village from the city below. Unfortunately, she couldn't stick around and returned home, but not without a gift from my father — a child. After many moons, I was finally born in the great city of Khor'minos."
        
        At what point did she find her way to the tribe?
        
        Natalia purses her lips, nods slightly, and then intones, "That would be when mom handed me over to dad and never came back."
        
        If she doesn't want to talk about it-
        
        Natalia holds up a hand and shakes her head. "It's fine. Don't worry about it. That happened over a decade ago. Any hard feelings I might've had are long gone." She gives you an airy shrug and continues. "It sucked, but I learned to cherish my new family. Here, I at least have purpose and people respect me. If nothing happened, and I grew up in that city, I probably would've ended up as just another slave for some patrician. I believe that, what my mom did, it was because she had my best interest in mind. Now, is there anything else [natalia.fucked

“算了，现在聊聊天就够了。”

“如果你坚持的话，”娜塔莉亚耸了耸肩，显得有些无所谓，“尽管问吧。我什么都不瞒你。
        |哈，你想了解更多关于我的事情吗？说实话，最近我并没有主动去分享太多信息，因为那些可能感兴趣的人早就已经了解了我所有的情况。有没有什么特别的方面你想知道呢？我可是毫无保留的哦。
        |哦，原来你这么好奇啊？”娜塔莉亚将一只手搭在腰上，身体重心在两条腿之间来回移动，“你是有什么特别想了解的事情吗？还是说我就得随便猜猜看呢？
    ]
    
    [rand
        |你一定想知道，她是怎么能够如此流利地使用贝尔哈兰语的。与她的族人不同，她可以与你进行完整的对话，而从不卡顿或犯错。她简直就像天生就会说这种语言一样！

“那是因为我确实天生就会说，亲爱的。你知道，我其实并不是这个部落的人；我的父亲是，但我是在科尔米诺斯和母亲一起长大的，大概有八九年的时间。然而，种种原因使得我最终走到了这里，继续继承我父亲的使命。
        
        那肯定是一次非常艰难的过渡过程。

“你说得对！我甚至不得不学习一门全新的语言！不过幸运的是，社区里的朋友们都非常热心地帮助了我。刚开始的时候，最棘手的并不是词汇，而是语言的结构。 沃珀琳语与贝尔哈兰语有着很大的不同。例如，如果你想用沃珀琳语表达“篝火在哪里”，那么在贝尔哈兰语中，直译过来就会变成“篝火……在哪里”。我还可以继续举这样的例子，但这并不是我们讨论的重点。 重要的是，我确实是双语者。虽然贝尔哈兰语是我的母语，但伏尔珀琳语已经成为了我的主要交流语言。
        
        嗯，考虑到娜塔莉亚加入这个部落时大概只有九岁，而现在她看起来应该已经二十出头了，她所说的一切都符合常理。娜塔莉亚作为“狼人”的时间，其实比她作为“米诺斯人”的时间还要长。不过，看到她的“贝拉兰之力”这些年来并没有减弱，还是让人感到欣慰的。
        |你询问娜塔莉亚关于她的血统的事情。这其中有什么故事呢？

“嗯，我猜你们应该已经注意到了我那与狐狸相关的血统特征；不过，很少有人知道我还有半人半牛的基因。人们通常会认为我是人类。我也不怪他们，这种区别确实很难区分。”

是啊，确实很难分辨出这种血统特征。 [natalia.fucked
            |既然她也算是个牛仔女孩，那么是不是意味着她的胸部随时都“准备被挤奶”呢？

“你说得没错。”娜塔莉亚掀起上衣，短暂地让你看到了她那迷人的胸部。“自从我有了这些胸部，里面的奶水就一直在晃来晃去。有时候，如果我不好好照顾它们，它们真的会让人很头疼。让它们安静一两周不碰，它们就会开始大量分泌奶水了！[natalia.hasKids
                |"
                
                [natalia.anyKids|考虑到她已经生下了这么多孩子，或许这倒也不是一件坏事。她奶水如此充足，就意味着她有足够的奶水来喂养所有的孩子。 [pc.isDK
                    |你的
                    |她
                ] 孩子们饥饿的小嘴巴。|幸好你给了她一套工具用来觅食，否则就麻烦了！]

rows.original:
"The potter? Yeah, I know him. He and my father are good friends. Together, they helped raise me. In a way, Arened has been like a second father to me. Of course, the same could be said about my father in regards to Arened's daughters. At first, it was just Vasha and I, but now he has a whole flock of adoptive daughters under his wing! He's a good man, but I doubt he'd be able to take care of them all on his own."
    
    At least her father has been able to help lighten the load for him, right?
    
    Natalia shakes her head. "Not as much as he used to. My dad doesn't quite have the energy to keep up with a bunch of lively harpies anymore. He still visits Arened and the girls from time to time, but that duty has mostly fallen down onto me."
    
    How does she feel about inheriting that responsibility?
    
    "Oh, I don't mind it! Sure, Arened's daughters may not be blood-related to me, but I still think and treat those girls like they're my little sisters. It is never a dull moment with them. The village and I are blessed to have them."

        |[rand
            |Kailani's a good woman; however, I can't help but feel that the loss of her parents weighs heavily on her heart."
            
            You ask Natalia what she thinks happened to Kailani's parents.
            
            "I'm not sure, to be honest. I was just a little girl when they disappeared. What I do know is that many of the hunters searched for her parents and came back empty-handed. rows.translation: [flags.NATALIA_TLK_VASHA |"[rand |我记得当瓦莎还是阿雷恩德怀中的新生婴儿时——那时我大概十岁，但这个回忆我永远也不会忘记。她真的是最可爱的小家伙，不过也确实非常爱吵闹，总是大声尖叫个不停！ 那是故意的吗？ “故意做什么？”娜塔莉亚重复道。 是说瓦莎故意大声尖叫的吗？ 风暴她就是非得插那么一句进去，对吧？” 娜塔莉亚轻笑起来：“那并不是故意的。不过我倒希望自己是故意的……说起来，自从索拉赋予我妹妹力量之后，我就发现她只要发出那种叫声，就能召唤出一片风暴云来。那可真是一个既有趣又充满幽默的场景啊。不过，你不得不注意到，娜塔莉亚一直把瓦莎当作自己的妹妹来对待。这是为什么呢？ “嗯，其实我们并没有亲缘关系，但这个道理应该是不言而喻的吧。 至于我为什么称她为姐妹，那是因为我们之间存在着一种超越血缘关系的姐妹情谊。在成长过程中，瓦莎和我一直互相照顾，我们都经历过没有母亲的生活。正是这种共同的经历，让我们紧密地联系在了一起。 如果这都不算姐妹情谊，那我真不知道什么才算。 |从我妹妹还是个小女孩的时候起，她就一直患有慢性癫痫发作。这些发作症状比较轻微，通常来得快去得也快。 不过，看着妹妹经历这些发作，对她来说肯定非常不容易。 “我不知道她为什么会发作，但我知道该怎样才能最好地帮助她。 每当这种情况发生时，我都会把她翻到侧面，确保她周围的环境没有危险物，这样她就不会被什么东西弄伤。不过，对于一个年幼的小女孩来说，亲眼看到这样的场景确实会让人感到害怕。 那种震惊与无助感会让人陷入瘫痪。然而这些年来，我已经习惯了将这种感觉视为与她共处的生活现实。直到……娜塔莉亚沉默了下来，她的耳朵也开始耷拉在头皮上。 [pc.isDK |快说吧！ ]直到什么时候？ “当我听说她那次最严重的发作时，那种恐惧又重新涌上了心头。我并没有亲历那一幕，但其他姐妹们告诉了我事情的严重性；她们描述了她如何在睡梦中挣扎……还有她的尖叫声。我知道，最终那次发作让她获得了魔法力量，还得到了索拉的授权，让她负责保护这些山脉，但事情发生的突然性，以及那种担心结果会不同的恐惧，仍然让我不寒而栗。 [pc.isDK |但结果并没有什么不同；瓦莎依然活得好好的。娜塔莉亚真该别再这么杞人忧天了。 |你不能责怪娜塔莉亚会有这样的担忧。没有人愿意去面对失去挚爱之人的这种可能性。 ]我关心瓦莎，但是那股充满正义感的召唤吸引了她，她响应了它的呼唤。每只鸟最终都必须离开自己的巢穴。我只是希望她的处境不会让她在外面遇到麻烦。 |说来有趣，在最初的几年里，我一直把她当作妹妹来对待。不过，女妖的成长速度可真快，没过多久，她就开始……叫我哥哥了。 我 小妹妹！ ]" |等等，你见过她姐姐了？”娜塔莉亚高兴地问道，“她怎么样？ [vasha.isMom |总体来说，还算不错。 “总体来说？”女祭司重复道，眉头紧锁，微微歪着头，“你是什么意思？” 嗯，自从你让那位乌鸦圣骑士怀孕了之后，她的性情确实平静了许多。 你轻拍娜塔莉亚的肩膀，告诉她她即将成为一名阿姨。 娜塔莉亚愣住了，张大嘴巴看着你。几秒钟后，她紧抿嘴唇，缓缓点了点头，那震惊的表情渐渐变成了钦佩的神情。 [var0 |她开始说话了，说的内容一半是对自己说的，一半是对你说的。“看来我和她真是同道中人啊。希望你清楚自己在做什么…… [pc.name] |至少我知道孩子的父亲是谁……[pc.isFemale |- 呃，到底是谁啊…… ] 是 ] |你描述了与那些过于狂热的鹰身女妖圣骑士们发生的那次冲突。 [natalia.fucked |娜塔莉亚震惊地瞪大了眼睛，低声说道：“哦不。 ]女祭司低下头，深吸了一口气。“很抱歉你们不得不经历这些。 [pc.name]请不要因此责怪她；尽管存在一些误会，但她所做的一切都是出于对家乡的热爱。 ]瓦莎确实是个相当固执任性的女性。不过，听到她仍在为寻找索拉而不懈努力，我还是感到欣慰的。我只希望这场灾难能尽快结束，这样她就能回家了。 ]
rows.raw: " [flags.NATALIA_TLK_VASHA |"[rand |I remember when Vasha was just a newborn babe in Arened's arms — I must've been ten at the time, but it's a memory I'll never forget. She was the cutest little thing, but boy was she noisy. She would squawk up a storm!" Was that deliberate? "Was what deliberate?" Natalia repeats. Saying that Vasha was squawking up a storm. She just had to slip that one in, didn't she? Natalia giggles. "That wasn't intentional. I wish it was, though. That said, ever since Sorra blessed my sis with power, I could see her summoning a storm cloud by squawking." Now that'd be an interesting yet humorous sight to behold. However, you can't help but notice that Natalia has been regarding Vasha as her sister. What's the reason there? "Well, we're not actually related, but I'm sure that goes without saying. As for why I call her sis, that's because we share a sisterhood which goes beyond who our parents are. Growing up, Vasha and I took care of each other. We both know what it's like to be motherless. It's this solidarity which brings us together. If that's not sisterhood, then I don't know what is. |Ever since my sister was a little girl, she's suffered from chronic seizures. They're mild and tend to pass as quickly as they come." Still, that mustn't be easy for her to watch. "I don't know why she's having them, but I know how best to help her. Whenever they'd occur, I'd just roll her on her side and make sure the area around her is clear so she doesn't hurt herself on something. However, when you're just a little girl, seeing that kind of thing firsthand can be frightening. The shock and sense of powerlessness paralyzes you. Over the years, though, I've gotten used to it as a fact of life with her. Until..." Natalia falls silent as her ears begin sag against her scalp. [pc.isDK |Spit it out! ]Until what? "That fear came back when I heard about her worst seizure yet. I wasn't there to witness it, but the other sisters told me of its severity; they described her thrashing in her sleep... they described her screams. I know that it ultimately led to her gaining magical powers and a sacred charge from Sorra to protect the mountains, but the suddenness and the thought of that turning out differently still gives me chills." [pc.isDK |But it didn't turn out differently; Vasha is still alive and kicking. Natalia should stop being such a damn worrywart |You don't blame Natalia for her concern. No one likes to think about the notion of losing a loved one ]. "I care for Vasha, but the gale of righteous purpose beckoned, and she answered its call. Every bird has to leave their nest at some point. I just pray her condition doesn't get her into trouble out there. |It's funny, but for the first few years, I treated her like a little sister. But, with how quickly harpies grow up, it wasn't long before she was calling me the little sister! ]" |"Wait, you've met sis?" Natalia beams. "How is she?" [vasha.isMom |Pretty good, all things considered. "All things considered?" the priestess repeats, furrowing her brow and tilting her head slightly. "What do you mean?" Well, ever since you impregnated the raven paladin, she's calmed down a lot. You pat Natalia's shoulder and tell her that she's going to be an aunt. Natalia stares at you with a dumbfounded, slackjaw look. After a few seconds she tightens her lips and nods slowly, her stunned expression turning into an impressed one. [var0 |She then starts talking, as much to herself as she is to you. "Guess that makes me and her two birds of a feather. I hope you know what you're doing, [pc.name] |"At least I know who the father[pc.isFemale |- erm, who the mother ] is ] |You describe your hostile encounter with the overzealous harpy paladins. [natalia.fucked |Natalia's eyes widen in shock and she mutters, "Oh no." ]The priestess lowers her head and takes a deep breath. "I'm sorry you had to go through that, [pc.name]. Please don't hold it against her; despite the misunderstanding, what she does is out of a place of love for her home ]. Vasha can be quite the headstrong and willful woman. Nevertheless, it's good to hear she's still okay in her holy quest for Sorra. I pray that this evil ends soon so she may return home." ] "

rows.original:
You [flags.NATALIA_BLESSING
        |wish to receive a blessing.
        
        "Of course," Natalia [natalia.fucked
            |simpers
            |says with a faint smile
        ]. "Do you have any goods to donate?"
        
        [var0
            |Unfortunately, you don't.
            |You do!
        ]
        |ask [natalia.fucked
            |your foxy
            |the
        ] priestess if she can grant you a blessing.
        
        "Of course," Natalia says with a faint smile. "If you wish to have the Storm Maiden's protection, though, it's going to cost you."
        
        [natalia.fucked
            |Is it possible for her to give you a discount, or waive the price, since you're her lover? This is for your safety, after all.
            
            "I," Natalia's face scrunches and her ears lower as she shakes her head slightly. After a couple seconds, she sighs defeatedly, looks back toward you, and says, "Fine, but only because I want Sorra to bring you back into my arms." She then gives you a pout and pokes your chest. "Next time won't be free, though. I've got a village to protect."
            
            You thank her and then ask how much electrum you would've had to pay.
            
            "Oh, no, we don't use any of those coins here. Maybe Arened does, but that's because he deals with the treasure hunters that pass through here. As for my services, a donation of wood, food, or workable stone is normally enough. But on that note, let's begin."
            |[pc.hasCredits 100
                |You reach down, grab a pouch of coins off your belt, and hand it to Natalia, but she pushes it back to you.
                
                "Electrum has little value here. We're people of the land
                |How much?
                
                "What?"
                
                How much electrum does she need to perform the ritual? This is important because you're a little short on cash right now.
                
                Natalia's gentle smile becomes an amused one, and she says, "Then I've got good news for you: most of us don't use electrum here
            ]. The only person that I can really think of who'll trade for coins is Arened, and that's because he deals with treasure hunters who pass through here. I'm sure there's some secret collectors here who'd love this stuff, but most of us in the village will only barter with goods. As for my services, a donation of wood, food, or workable stone is more than enough."
            
            [var0
                |As it stands, though, you don't have any goods to donate either.
                
                "Ah." Natalia's ears lower. "Sorry for getting your hopes up." She then perks herself up and says, "At least you know where I'm if you find any!"
                |Perfect! You've got some in your inventory.
            ]
        ]
    ]

“当然可以，”娜塔莉亚带着一丝微笑说道，“不过，如果你想获得风暴少女的保护，那是需要付出代价的。
        
        [natalia.fucked
            |既然你是她的恋人，她会不会给你打折或者免去这笔费用呢？毕竟，这是为了你的安全着想。

“我……”娜塔莉亚皱起了眉头，耳朵也微微下垂，然后轻轻摇了摇头。 几秒钟后，她沮丧地叹了口气，回头看着你说：“好吧，但只是因为我想让索拉再次把你抱进我的怀里。”说完，她撅起嘴，戳了戳你的胸口。“不过下次就不会有空闲时间了。 我有一个村庄需要保护。”

你向她道谢，然后询问需要支付多少电银才能完成任务。

“哦，不，在我们这里并不使用那些硬币。也许阿雷内德会使用，但那是因为他负责接待那些经过这里的寻宝者。 至于我的服务，通常赠送一些木材、食物或可用的石头就足够了。那么，我们就开始吧。
            |[pc.hasCredits 100
                |你伸手从腰带上取下一袋硬币，递给娜塔莉亚，但她又将硬币推了回来。

“在这里，银币并没有什么价值。我们可是这片土地上的居民。
                |多少钱？”

“什么？”

她需要进行这个仪式，需要多少电银呢？这很重要，因为你现在手头确实有点缺钱。

娜塔莉亚原本温柔的微笑此刻变成了带着一丝趣味的笑容，她说：“那么，我有个好消息要告诉你：我们这里大多数人其实都不使用电银。
            ]在我所能想到的范围内，唯一会用物品来交换硬币的人应该是阿雷内德，因为他经常与路过这里的寻宝者打交道。我敢肯定，这里肯定有一些秘密的收藏家会对这些东西感兴趣，但村子里的我们大多数人还是更喜欢用实物来进行交易。至于我的服务，赠送一些木材、食物或者可用的石头，就已经足够了。
            
            [var0
                |不过，目前你也没有任何可以捐赠的物品。

“啊。”娜塔莉亚的低下了头，“抱歉让你们产生了期待。”她随后又振作起来说道：“至少如果你们找到了什么可以捐赠的物品，就知道我在哪里了！
                |太好了！你的库存里有一些这样的物品。
            ]
        ]
    ]

Leading the way, you [dayNight |[natalia.pregStage 0 1.5 |walk over and sit down |escort your pregnant wife ] beneath the outcropping[natalia.pregStage 0 1.5 |, taking shelter in the cool shade | and help ease her down ] |[natalia.pregStage 0 1.5 |make your |escort your pregnant wife ] up the rocky outcropping and [natalia.pregStage 0 1.5 |sit down, letting your [pc.legs] dangle over the edge |help ease her down ] ]. It's as good a place as any. [natalia.pregStage 0 1.5 |Shortly afterwards, Natalia sits next to you and begins unwrapping |Once Natalia is situated on a comfortable spot, you sit down next to her, giving her the honor of ] unwrapping the rations. She's as eager to dig in as you are. [natalia.pregStage 0.5 |Can you blame her, though? After all, she's eating for two now. It's a good thing there's enough rations here to feed three people. ] And, before long, the two of you begin sharing a meal with each other, chatting about anything and everything that enters your head until there's nothing left but the cloth used to hold the food. [natalia.pregStage 0 1.5 2.5 |Natalia pats her furry thighs twice and stands up. "Let's get this ritual started. Oh, and [pc.name]?" Yes? You stand up and brush yourself off. "I appreciate the food and company. Hanging out with you is fun." Always |Natalia shifts and hefts herself off the ground. With a bit of effort, she's able to stand up, but that belly is still growing and it's only only a matter of time before it gets so big that it utterly encumbers her. She exhales, rests a hand on her hip, and gives you a faint smile. "You ready, love?" Almost. You stand up and brush yourself off. Now you're ready |"Alright," Natalia breathes. "Let's get this started." You tousle her hair with a swift pet before standing up and brushing yourself off. Afterwards, you turn around and see your gravid wife in the same spot you left her. rows.original: You set off along one of the gullies, hoping to find a way forward that doesn't involve climbing up or down. The sheer cliff faces press in on you, limiting your options: the peaks are not kind to the grounded, and what few paths there are all seem to be nudging you in a single direction... rows.original:
The titanic Steps of Sorra terminate here, in an arched exitway connecting the exterior of the mountain to its hollowed-out interior. A sign has been posted up in both Belharan and Minoan, reading "Turn Back! The Mountaintops are not safe for lowlanders! Trespassers will be [silly
        |pegged
        |smacked
    ]!"
    
    The wind is howling on the mountain, ripping through you with its bitter chill. All you can do is wrap your arms around yourself and try to keep your teeth from chattering.
rows.translation:
索拉那巨大的脚步在此处终结——一条拱形的通道将山的外侧与内部空洞区域连接起来。在贝拉兰语和米诺安语中，都有一块告示牌竖立在那里，上面写着：“请返回！山顶对低地居民来说并不安全！擅自闯入者将会…… [silly
        |固定不变
        |打了一巴掌
    ]风在山上呼啸着，带着刺骨的寒意侵袭着你。你所能做的，就是紧紧地抱住自己，努力不让牙齿打颤。

rows.original:
You feel compelled to explore these ruins. Something about their dark aura calls to you, makes your heart quicken. 
    
    [party.has cait
        |"Something bad happened here," Cait murmurs, holding her weapon close to her chest. "I can feel the magic in this place like a sour smell."
    ]
    
    [party.has brint
        |"Belharan ruins, not Minoan," Brint observes. "Used to be a town up here. Traded with the kingdom, maybe?"
    ]
    
    [party.has brienne
        |"These are Belharan ruins I think," Brienne observes. "There used to be a trading town up here, maybe?"
    ]
    
    [party.has viv
        |Viviane frowns. "Someone used an unbelievable amount of magic here once, and it's never completely cleared out. It feels like its smothering me."
    ]
    
    Heedless, you press onward into the shattered, burned remains of the villa. In the distance, a tower looms over it, imperious despite the harsh wear of centuries. "What could have done this kind of damage, all the way up here?" you wonder aloud, walking cautiously between hollowed-out homes. The Godswar, you suppose. That's the answer to most such questions. [pc.bg barbarian
        |It reminds you of home — the emptiness that remains, after everyone has long perished.
    ]
    
    Yet something draws you ever deeper, until you've reached the heart of the little villa. You can see the scorch marks on the stone emanate from here, radiating out from the courtyard to blow down the surrounding walls in a cascade of all-consuming flame. You can see scraps of armor strewn around, bits of bronze and frozen wood sticking up from the ever-present snow. Some of it looks Belharan, but other bits... 
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |"Druidic?" Ryn whispers, kneeling down and picking up a wooden crown sitting atop a fallen bit of masonry. One antler is still attached to the side, along with a scrap of threadbare white cloth. "A priestess of the wyld died with these people."
        
        "Hethia's people?" you ask. "What were they doing all the way up here?"
        
        Ryn shrugs. "Fighting something they shouldn't have."
        |You see a crown of wood and antler sitting atop shattered masonry. It looks downright druidic. But you're so far from the Frostwood, from Hethia's people. What were they doing up here so long ago?
    ]
    
    For all the devastation wrought around you, there's one thing that's been left intact in the courtyard: a pyramidal stack of stone near where the blackening is worst, yet they themselves are pristine and unmarred. Something's resting against it, similarly undamaged — a book. Somehow, despite the snow and wind, it's not just intact but unblemished. Magic?
    
    You kneel beside it and dust the snow from the thin wood of its front cover. An evergreen tree is emblazoned on it, painted with delicate artistry. The name 'Oxana' is written across it in a flowing, bold red ink. 
    
    [party.has cait
        |"Isn't that Lady Evergreen's name?" Cait says. Her ears flick. "What's her stuff doing all the way out here?"
    ]
    
    It's been abandoned here for ages. Do you take it?
rows.translation:
你感到有一种强烈的冲动，想要探索这些废墟。它们那阴郁的氛围似乎在吸引你，让你的心跳加速。 
    
    [party.has cait
        |这里发生了不好的事情，”凯特低声说道，将武器紧贴在胸前。“我能感觉到这个地方充满了魔法，那种气息就像酸味一样刺鼻。
    ]
    
    [party.has brint
        |是贝尔哈兰的遗迹，而不是米诺斯的，”布林特观察到，“这里曾经是一座城镇，或许还与那个王国有过贸易往来吧？
    ]
    
    [party.has brienne
        |我想这些应该是贝拉兰的遗迹，”布蕾妮观察道，“这里以前应该有一个贸易城镇吧？
    ]
    
    [party.has viv
        |薇薇安皱起了眉头。“有人曾经在这里使用了大量的魔法，那些魔法至今仍未完全消散。这种残留的力量让我感觉仿佛被它们压制着一样。
    ]
    
    你毫无察觉地继续向前走去，穿过那些被毁坏、烧成焦块的别墅废墟。远处，有一座塔楼耸立在那里，尽管经历了几个世纪的沧桑，它依然显得威严不减。“究竟是什么力量才能造成这样的破坏，甚至蔓延到这么高的地方？”你边走边自言自语，小心翼翼地避开那些被掏空的房子。你猜，肯定是“神战”吧……对于这类问题，这个答案似乎总是正确的。 [pc.bg barbarian
        |它让你想起家乡——在所有人都早已离世之后，那里依然残留着的那种空寂。
    ]
    
    然而，有什么东西在不断地吸引着你，让你不断深入，直到你来到那座小别墅的中心。你可以看到，那些烧焦的痕迹就源自这里，从庭院里向外辐射开来，最终导致周围的墙壁在熊熊烈火中倒塌。地上散落着残破的盔甲，一些青铜碎片和焦木从积雪中露出来。其中有些部件看起来像是贝尔哈兰族的，但其他的…… 
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |德鲁伊教的？”瑞恩轻声说道，他跪下来，捡起了那顶放在倒塌的石块上的木制王冠。其中一根鹿角还完好地固定在王冠的侧面，旁边还有一块破旧的白色布片。“有一位荒野的女祭司和这些人一起死在了这里。”

“赫希娅的人？”你问道，“他们为什么要来到这么高的地方来？”

瑞恩耸了耸肩：“他们在与一些本不该对抗的东西战斗。
        |你看到一顶由木头和鹿角制成的王冠，它矗立在破碎的砖石之上，看起来简直就像是德鲁伊的象征。但你现在距离霜林、距离赫希娅的族人们还有那么远……那么久以前，他们究竟为什么会来到这里呢？
    ]
    
    尽管周围的一切都遭到了破坏，但院子里有样东西却完好无损：在那些被烧黑的地方附近，有一堆呈金字塔形状堆放的石头，而这些石头本身却丝毫没有受到损伤。还有某样东西靠在它们旁边，也同样完好无损——那是一本书。 尽管下着雪，刮着风，但它不仅完好无损，甚至连一点痕迹都没有。这是魔法吗？

你跪在它旁边，将前盖上的积雪拂去。那里雕刻着一棵常青女士，绘画技艺十分精湛。 奥克萨娜”这个名字用流畅而醒目的红色墨水写在上面。 
    
    [party.has cait
        |那不是常青女士的名字吗？”凯特说道。她的耳朵微微一动，“她的东西怎么会出现在这里呢？
    ]
    
    它在这里已经被废弃很久了。你要吗？

rows.original: You pick up the grimoire and tuck it into your pack. It's almost a surprise when nothing horrible happens in response. No traps, no curse, no bound spirits. Just the howl of the wind. You've gained Oxana's Spellbook
rows.translation: 你拿起了那本魔法书，把它放进了背包里。 然而，出乎意料的是，并没有发生任何可怕的事情——没有陷阱，没有诅咒，也没有被束缚的灵魂。只有风在呼啸。 你获得了奥克萨娜的法术书
rows.raw: " You pick up the grimoire and tuck it into your pack. It's almost a surprise when nothing horrible happens in response. No traps, no curse, no bound spirits. Just the howl of the wind. You've gained Oxana's Spellbook "

rows.original: You shake your head and stand, heading back the way you came. Better to leave this be.
rows.translation: 你摇了摇头，站起身来，沿着来时的路往回走。最好还是别再插手这件事了。
rows.raw: "\n        You shake your head and stand, heading back the way you came. Better to leave this be.\n        "

rows.original: It looks like a grave. Be respectful.
rows.translation: 它看起来像是一座坟墓。请保持尊重。
rows.raw: "It looks like a grave. Be respectful."

rows.original:
As grandiose as the baths themselves may be, the courtyard that surrounds the resort complex is no less impressive. Heated by the warmth that spills from the marble and granite building's many exits, various garden beds once meant for ornamental flowers have long since been converted to the growing of more practical plants. Flagpoles that once boasted the banners of the kingdom of Khor'minos and the Belharan Imperium alike have been torn down, replaced by harpy fetishes and other decorations woven together from feathers and hide, declaring the bath resort's new masters for all to see. Parapets along the courtyard's northern balconies keep people from tumbling off; sheltered by the peak, the air in the courtyard is still and heavy. Not oppressive and dark, but more of a dense, cool mugginess like that of walking through heavy morning fog...

    This, then, is as close as one can get to the heart of the harpies' domain without raising the alarm. It's probably a good thing that they're more focused on searching for aerial intruders rather than those on the ground, otherwise you'd have been spotted coming a long way off.
rows.translation: 尽管这些浴场本身已经非常宏伟壮观，但环绕着整个度假区的庭院也同样令人印象深刻。大理石和花岗岩建筑物的众多出口散发出温暖的气息，那些原本用于种植观赏花卉的花园花坛，早已被改用来种植一些更为实用的植物了。 那些曾经悬挂着科尔米诺斯王国与贝尔哈兰帝国旗帜的旗杆早已被拆除，取而代之的是由羽毛与皮革编织而成的鹰身女妖雕像及其他装饰物，这些象征着这个温泉度假胜地新主人的标志，如今已清晰地展现在众目之下。 庭院北侧阳台上的栏杆有效地防止了人们从上面跌落；在山峰的遮挡下，庭院内的空气显得沉闷而凝重。这种氛围并不压抑或昏暗，而是有一种浓密、凉爽的闷热感，就像在浓重的晨雾中行走一样。这，应该就是在不引起警觉的情况下，最接近那些凶猛生物活动范围中心的方法了。幸好它们更关注搜寻空中的入侵者，而不是地面上的目标，否则你早就被发现了。

Not oppressive and dark, but more of a dense, cool mugginess like that of walking through heavy morning fog...

    This, then, is as close as one can get to the heart of the harpies' domain without raising the alarm. It's probably a good thing that they're more focused on searching for aerial intruders rather than those on the ground, otherwise you'd have been spotted coming a long way off."

rows.original:
You approach the statue in the middle of the courtyard — it hasn't been removed like the rest of the original decor, although you see claw marks in the stone where the harpies have tried. The heavy granite statue depicts that of a Belharan in full imperial regalia clasping hands with a minotaur. A small stone relief upon its base reads:

        "This bath resort was commissioned jointly by King Baros Junia of Khor'minos and Baron Victor Reverra of Hawkstone, both as a meeting grounds for our peoples and a place of rest and relaxation. May our mutual respect long stand the test of time."
        
        Something about the statue draws you closer, a familiar sensation — and when you do, your waystone charm flashes briefly. The burst of light is mirrored by something within the statues' clasped hands, radiance strong enough to shine through the cracks in the stone. Well, that explains how the Belharan dignitaries came and went without making the miserable ascent... and why the waystone gem hasn't been plucked from the statue for the matron's hoard. At least now this waystone is open to you, too.
rows.translation:
你走向庭院中央的那座雕像——与其它原有的装饰品不同，这座雕像并没有被移走。尽管在石头上可以看到鹰身女妖们试图破坏它的痕迹，但雕像依然完好地矗立在那里。这座由花岗岩制成的重型雕像描绘的是一位身着完整帝国礼服的贝尔哈兰人与弥诺陶洛斯紧紧握手部的场景。 在其基座上有一块小石刻，上面写着：

“这座温泉度假胜地是由科尔米诺斯的巴罗斯·朱尼亚国王与霍克斯通的维克托·雷维拉男爵共同出资建造的，旨在为两国人民提供交流与聚会的场所，同时也是人们休息放松的理想之地。 愿我们之间的相互尊重能够经得起时间的考验。”

雕像的某些特质让你不由自主地靠近它，那种熟悉的感觉再次浮现——而当你靠近时，你的路石护符会短暂地闪烁起来。那道轻型芒在雕像紧握的双手部之中得到了反射，那种轻型芒强度之大，甚至能够穿透石头上的裂缝照射出来。 原来如此，这就解释了为什么贝拉兰的高官们可以来来去去而无需进行那种繁琐的攀登……也说明了为什么那颗路标宝石至今还没有被从雕像上取下来，被那位女管家收进了她的宝库。至少现在，这颗路标宝石也已经向你敞开了大门。

"
        You approach the statue in the middle of the courtyard — it hasn't been removed like the rest of the original decor, although you see claw marks in the stone where the harpies have tried. The heavy granite statue depicts that of a Belharan in full imperial regalia clasping hands with a minotaur. A small stone relief upon its base reads:

        "This bath resort was commissioned jointly by King Baros Junia of Khor'minos and Baron Victor Reverra of Hawkstone, both as a meeting grounds for our peoples and a place of rest and relaxation. May our mutual respect long stand the test of time."
        
        Something about the statue draws you closer, a familiar sensation — and when you do, your waystone charm flashes briefly. The burst of light is mirrored by something within the statues' clasped hands, radiance strong enough to shine through the cracks in the stone. Well, that explains how the Belharan dignitaries came and went without making the miserable ascent... and why the waystone gem hasn't been plucked from the statue for the matron's hoard. At least now this waystone is open to you, too."

rows.original: On the riverside, just a few hundred yards west of the old Minoan road and in the shadow of a weatherbeaten stone bridge, stands a quaint little collection of squat huts. They're all round, made of stone packed tight with warming dirt, with a minimum of wood outside of a few doors — and even most of those are heavy cloth instead. There's a perhaps three dozen houses scattered around the water's edge, vaguely surrounding a circle of standing stones that makes for the heart of the village. In the midst of the stones is a crude idol of Sorra, wings spread and spear head high to the heavens.
rows.translation: 在河岸边，距离古老的米诺斯道路以西仅几百码的地方，在一座饱经风霜的石桥的阴影下，有一排古朴的小屋。这些小屋都是圆形结构，用石头砌成，石头与保暖的泥土紧密填充在一起；除了几扇门之外，几乎不使用任何木材——而即便是那些门，也大多是用厚重的布料制成的。 在水边散布着大约三十栋房屋，这些房屋大致围成一个由石碑构成的圈，而这个石碑圈正是村庄的中心。在那些石碑的中间，矗立着一尊粗糙的索拉神像，它的双翼展开，长矛高举指向天空。
rows.raw: "\n    On the riverside, just a few hundred yards west of the old Minoan road and in the shadow of a weatherbeaten stone bridge, stands a quaint little collection of squat huts. They're all round, made of stone packed tight with warming dirt, with a minimum of wood outside of a few doors — and even most of those are heavy cloth instead. There's a perhaps three dozen houses scattered around the water's edge, vaguely surrounding a circle of standing stones that makes for the heart of the village. In the midst of the stones is a crude idol of Sorra, wings spread and spear head high to the heavens."

rows.original:
[flags.MANTI_TOWER 1 2
        |This appears to be the entrance point for the peaks' manticore girls, at least if the steep, craggy ridge leading up to a crumbled old tower is any indication. Trying to fly up would be tremendously difficult for those unaccustomed to the gusts of the peaks, and there are more than enough old remains from smashed up birds to prove their unfortunate fate dashed against those rocks.

        This landing spot is covered in the massive paw[silly
            |b-
        ]prints from the manticore girls taking off, and there's a curious aroma on the wind. [party.comp cait
            |Cait tippy-toes and sniffs, tail swishing around. "Oh! Oh wow, the smell of nip travels pretty far, huh?"
        ]
        
        "Ah, there you are..." The twins glide down, wings posed at what you would consider horrifying angles... but make their descent look like a simple thing. "Ready to see our home, beautiful [var0
            |re-mom-ifier
            |[pc.mf
                |father
                |mother
            ] to our children
            |mother to our children
        ]!" The duo [party.som
            |give you
            |give you and [companion1.name]
            |you and your companions
        ] their most winning-est smile. "Come on, we'll show you around!" 
        
        Catalina and Clara scoop an arm each under yours, set their stance, and spring up into the air.
        
        Your heart leaps its way into your throat, wind hits you in a curtain that would send you crashing and falling if not for the massive women on either side. They take to the skies with ease, giggling and wrapping their tails around your ass for extra leverage before depositing you at the entrance to the tower.
        
        There must have been a passageway ascending these cliffs back in the day, though you can't even see the remains of them anymore. Doubly surprising considering they were likely built by Minoans; you've got to have some [silly
            |chonkin' big
            |huge
        ] stairs if you're afraid of a tumble. 
        
        [party.som
            |They give you a few moments to regather your wits from the temporary flight into what felt like a tornado, patting you down.
            |While you're regathering your wits from what felt like a temporary flight into a tornado, the kitties fetch [companion1.name] as well. You get a chance to see just how drastically hard of an angle they take to get down and up from here... and [companion1.name] appears to feel it, shaking [companion1.mf
                |him
                |her
            ]self off and looking at you awkwardly.
            |While you're catching your breath, the girls fetch your companions... which gives you a chance to see just how terrifyingly steep their banking and rising angles are to actually get up and down from this tower. There are plenty of innocent smiles beamed in the directions of your green[party.comp arona
                |-er
            ]-in-the-gills companions
        ] Catalina gives you a reassuring smile, turning to face the entrance of the tower afterwards. "It's not so bad with practice! All the gusts basically create a little vortex you punch through either above, or below! This place is extra good because of it. Nobody bothers us but it's actually super peaceful past the bubble." 
        
        "Welcome!" Clara adds.
        |You're at the jagged cliff face leading up to Leticia's tower, wrapped up in gusts that defy all but the most experienced fliers. It's a mystery as to how they can even make that journey themselves... 

        Thankfully you're a welcome guest to these massive meows, and you call out into the gusts. "Hello?"
        
        This close to the broken cliffs leading up to the tower, your voice is stolen away... but the girls must hear you, as it's only a few moments of waiting before the duo make their way down to say hi. "Saying hi, or headed up, [pc.mascFem
            |handsome
            |beautiful
        ]?"
        |This appears to be the entrance point for the peaks' manticore girls, at least if the steep, craggy ridge leading up to a crumbled old tower is any indication. Trying to fly up would be tremendously difficult for those unaccustomed to the gusts of the peaks, and there are more than enough old remains from smashed up birds to prove their unfortunate fate dashed against those rocks.

        This landing spot is covered in the massive paw[silly
            |b-
        ]prints from the manticore girls taking off, and there's a curious aroma on the wind. [party.comp cait
            |Cait tippy-toes and sniffs, tail swishing around. "Oh! Oh wow, the smell of nip travels pretty far, huh?"
        ]
        
        Unfortunately you can see no way to make that ascent yourself... but at least you're not under attack. You should probably move along.
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.MANTI_TOWER 1 2
        |这个地方似乎是那些居住在山峰上的女妖们的入口处，至少从那条通往一座破败旧塔的陡峭崎岖的小径来看，确实是这样的。对于那些不习惯山峰上狂风肆虐的环境的人来说，试图从空中飞到这里无疑是极其困难的，而那些被狂风击中而摔得粉碎的鸟儿的残骸，足以证明它们遭遇了多么不幸的结局。

这个着陆点被那只巨大的爪子覆盖着……[silly
            |b-
        ]曼提科尔女孩们的身影渐渐远去，风中带着一种奇特的香气。 [party.comp cait
            |凯特踮着脚尖，摇着尾巴四处嗅探。“哦！哇，这种寒冷的气味确实能传播得很远呢，是吧？
        ]
        
        啊，你们来了……”这对双胞胎缓缓下降，他们的翅膀以那些看起来极其怪异的角度展开……但他们的降落过程却显得如此自然、轻松。“准备好看看我们的家了吗，美丽的…… [var0
            |重新母亲化
            |[pc.mf
                |父亲
                |母亲
            ] 给我们的孩子们
            |我们孩子的母亲
        ]！”这对搭档 [party.som
            |给你
            |给你和…… [companion1.name]
            |你和你的同伴
        ] 她们露出最迷人的微笑：“来吧，我们带你们四处看看吧！”

卡塔琳娜和克拉拉各自挽住你的手臂，站好姿势，然后一起跳了起来。

你的心脏仿佛跳到了喉咙里，狂风像一阵巨浪般袭来，要不是有这两位强壮的女性在你们两侧支撑，你们肯定会被吹倒在地。 它们轻松地飞向天空，咯咯笑着，还用尾巴缠住你的身体，为你提供额外的支撑力，然后才将你送到塔楼的入口处。

想必在过去，一定有通道可以沿着这些悬崖向上延伸，不过现在你已经看不到那些通道的遗迹了。 考虑到这些建筑很可能是米诺斯人建造的，这就更加令人惊讶了——毕竟他们肯定具备相应的能力吧。 [silly
            |非常大
            |巨大的
        ] 如果害怕摔倒，就走楼梯吧。 
        
        [party.som
            |他们会给你一些时间，让你从那种仿佛被卷入龙卷风般的混乱中恢复过来，然后他们会对你进行搜身检查。
            |当你还在从那仿佛被卷入龙卷风般的短暂经历中恢复过来时，那些小猫们已经去把东西拿回来了。 [companion1.name] 同样，你也有机会亲眼看到他们为了从这里爬上去或爬下来，究竟付出了多大的努力…… [companion1.name] 似乎感受到了那份颤抖。 [companion1.mf
                |他
                |她
            ]尴尬地站在那里，看着你。
            |当你还在喘息的时候，那些女孩已经去把你的同伴带来了……这让你有机会亲眼看到，从这个塔楼上上下爬下来，那些斜坡的实际倾斜角度是多么恐怖地陡峭。在你的周围，有许多纯真的笑容正朝着你的方向绽放……[party.comp arona
                |后缀“-er”在英语中通常用于构成表示“执行者”或“从事某活动的人”的名词。例如，“writer”表示“写作者”，“driver”表示“驾驶员”。这个后缀在德语等语言中也有类似的用法。
            ]贴身伙伴
        ] 卡塔利娜向你露出了一个安心的微笑，然后转身面向塔楼的入口说道：“只要多加练习，其实并没有那么难！那些阵风基本上都会形成一个小漩涡，你只需要从漩涡的上方或下方穿过即可！这个地方正是因为有这样的环境，才特别适合练习。没有人会打扰我们，在这个‘保护圈’之外，真的非常宁静。”

“欢迎来到这里！”克拉拉也补充道。
        |你此刻正站在通往莱蒂西亚高塔的崎岖悬崖边，狂风肆虐，只有最有经验的飞行者才能在这种环境下顺利前行。他们自己究竟是如何完成这段旅程的，实在是个谜……

幸运的是，你对这些巨大的“喵叫声”来说，无疑是一位受欢迎的访客。于是你对着狂风大声呼喊。 喂？”

这里距离通往塔楼的断崖很近，你的声音似乎被周围的环境吸收了……但那些女孩肯定能听到你的呼唤，因为没过几分钟，她们就会下来跟你打招呼的。 打个招呼，或者去那里看看…… [pc.mascFem
            |英俊的
            |美丽
        ]?"
        |这里似乎是那些居住在山峰上的女妖们的入口处，至少从那条通往一座摇摇欲坠的古老塔楼的陡峭崎岖的小径来看，确实是这样的。对于那些不习惯山峰上狂风肆虐的环境的人来说，试图从空中飞到这里无疑是极其困难的，而那些被狂风击中而摔得粉碎的鸟儿的残骸，足以证明它们遭遇了多么不幸的结局。

这个降落点被那只巨大的爪子覆盖着……[silly
            |b-
        ]曼提科尔女孩们起飞时留下的痕迹，空气中弥漫着一种奇特的香气。 [party.comp cait
            |凯特踮着脚尖，摇着尾巴四处嗅探。“哦！哇，这种寒冷的气味确实能传播得很远呢，是吧？
        ]
        
        不幸的是，你看起来没有任何办法自己完成那次攀登……但至少你没有受到攻击。你最好继续前进吧。
    ]

rows.original: You're damnably close to the mountain's snowcapped peak now, and where snow tumbles down and forms the waterhead there is a great temple jutting out over the flow. Four pillars of jagged, rough rock support a flying dias and altar on a marble floor engraved with circles of interlocking runes flecked with azure crystal. The wind howls through the stones, deafening in its intensity.
rows.translation: 你现在已经距离那座被积雪覆盖的山峰只有很近的距离了。在那些雪水汇聚形成的水边，有一座巨大的寺庙耸立在湍急的水流之上。四根由粗糙的岩石构成的柱子支撑着一块悬空的祭坛，而祭坛则位于一块大理石地面上；地面上刻满了相互交织的符文，这些符文上还点缀着蔚蓝色的水晶。狂风在岩石间呼啸而过，其声势之猛烈，简直震耳欲聋。
rows.raw: "\n    You're damnably close to the mountain's snowcapped peak now, and where snow tumbles down and forms the waterhead there is a great temple jutting out over the flow. Four pillars of jagged, rough rock support a flying dias and altar on a marble floor engraved with circles of interlocking runes flecked with azure crystal. The wind howls through the stones, deafening in its intensity."

rows.original: Although you can't see her, you know that Kailani is somewhere in this area, waiting for your arrival. There's no going back from choosing this option! Be sure you're prepared!
rows.translation: 虽然你看不见她，但你知道，凯拉妮就藏在这个区域的某个地方，正在等待你的到来。 一旦选择了这个选项，就再也没有回头路了！ 一定要做好充分的准备！
rows.raw: "Although you can't see her, you know that Kailani is somewhere in this area, waiting for your arrival. There's no going back from choosing this option! Be sure you're prepared!"

rows.original: Inaya asked you to enter this cave in search of whatever made Kailani start acting differently. You're not expecting any resistance this time around; it ought to be an easy in-and-out, and that's assuming there's even anything to be found.
rows.translation: 伊奈亚让你进入这个洞穴，去寻找那些让凯拉妮行为发生变化的原因。这一次，你并不预期会遇到任何阻力；应该会很容易就能进去又出来吧，当然，前提是那里确实有什么值得寻找的东西。
rows.raw: "Inaya asked you to enter this cave in search of whatever made Kailani start acting differently. You're not expecting any resistance this time around; it ought to be an easy in-and-out, and that's assuming there's even anything to be found."

rows.original: Though the peaks are bleak and difficult place, it's not without its hidden patches of life clinging tenuously to the rocks. Your wanders brings you to one such hidden patch of plantlife, sheltered from the roaring winds by a little outcropping of rock that's allowed loose earth to accumulate, fed by cold water from above. A number of foxberries are eeking out a meager existence here, colorful and sweet. You might take a few, to lighten the load on the bush itself.
rows.translation: 虽然这些山峰显得荒凉而险峻，但那里也隐藏着一些生命迹象——那些植物正紧紧地依附在岩石上生存着。你的漫步最终将你带到这样一片隐蔽的植被地带：一块突出的岩石为这些植物提供了避风的地方，使得松软的土壤得以堆积下来，而从上方流下来的冷水也为它们的生长提供了必要的条件。这里生长着许多…… 狐莓 它们在这里艰难地生存着，色彩鲜艳且甜美。你可以摘一些来减轻这些植物本身的负担。
rows.raw: "\n Though the peaks are bleak and difficult place, it's not without its hidden patches of life clinging tenuously to the rocks. Your wanders brings you to one such hidden patch of plantlife, sheltered from the roaring winds by a little outcropping of rock that's allowed loose earth to accumulate, fed by cold water from above. A number of foxberries are eeking out a meager existence here, colorful and sweet. You might take a few, to lighten the load on the bush itself."

rows.original: You take a clump of the cheerily-colored berried and stow them in your pack. Thus enriched, you head back the way you came.
rows.translation: 你摘下一把色彩鲜艳、结满果实的植物，把它们装进背包。带着这些收获，你便沿着来时的路返回去了。
rows.raw: "\n        You take a clump of the cheerily-colored berried and stow them in your pack. Thus enriched, you head back the way you came."

rows.original: You shake your head and turn back, content to leave the bush to its devices.
rows.translation: 你摇了摇头，转身离去，觉得让那丛灌木自生自灭吧。
rows.raw: "\n        You shake your head and turn back, content to leave the bush to its devices."

rows.original: Life always finds a way, they say... but not always. You find yourself looking at what was, once, a harpy nest — a gathering of grass and woodchips from the lowlands, fortified with small rocks and hidden from the worst of the mountain winds — but it's clearly not seen use in some time. Still, half-buried beneath the snow, you see a [var0] egg peeking out. It's clearly a dud, left as colorful decoration or a marking of territory. You doubt it would be missed, either way.
rows.translation: 人们总说，生活总会找到出路……但也不总是如此。你看到的是曾经被称为“女妖巢穴”的地方——那些用低地采集来的草和木屑堆砌而成的结构，还用小石头加固，足以抵挡山风侵袭……但显然，已经有一段时间没有人使用它了。尽管如此，在积雪的覆盖下，你仍然能看到…… [var0] 蛋 探出头来。很明显，这只是个装饰品，要么用来增添色彩，要么用来标示领地范围。无论如何，你都不会认为它会被人忽略吧。
rows.raw: "\n Life always finds a way, they say... but not always. You find yourself looking at what was, once, a harpy nest — a gathering of grass and woodchips from the lowlands, fortified with small rocks and hidden from the worst of the mountain winds — but it's clearly not seen use in some time. Still, half-buried beneath the snow, you see a [var0] egg peeking out. It's clearly a dud, left as colorful decoration or a marking of territory. You doubt it would be missed, either way.\n "

rows.original: There's little wealth to be found on this bleak mountain, but the egg has a colorful charm to it, you admit. You heft it up and into your pack before returning whence you came.
rows.translation: 在这座荒凉的山上，几乎找不到什么财富，但这个蛋确实有一种别样的魅力，你得承认这一点。你把它拿起来，放进背包，然后便原路返回了。
rows.raw: "\n        There's little wealth to be found on this bleak mountain, but the egg has a colorful charm to it, you admit. You heft it up and into your pack before returning whence you came."

rows.original: You leave the egg where it lies. Perhaps its owner will someday return for it, but you have your doubts.
rows.translation: 你把那个蛋留在它原来的地方。也许它的主人有一天会回来取它，但你也心存疑虑。

rows.original: You just about faceplant when your [pc.foot] catches something buried in the snow. You only just catch yourself on the nearby rocks, thankful that you haven't started a tumble that'll put you back in the foothills in a flat red smear. Glancing down and pushing aside some of the accumulated snow, you find it's not rock underfoot but masonry. Remnants of a forgotten structure, a buried reminder of the late glory of the Belharans that once may have claimed the surface of the land. There's only a few marble slabs and a couple of sturdy stone bricks to be found, but in these dark days you suppose even that can be useful.
rows.translation: 当你差点直接脸着地的时候…… [pc.foot] 你抓到了被雪覆盖的东西。幸亏你及时抓住了附近的岩石，否则就会滚下去，最终变成一片扁平的红色痕迹，重新落在山脚下。你低头看了看，拨开一些积雪，发现脚下的并不是岩石，而是砖石结构——那些是被遗忘的建筑遗迹，它们默默地见证着贝尔哈兰人曾经的辉煌，或许那些建筑曾经覆盖了这片土地的表面。现在只剩下几块大理石板和几块…… 结实的石砖 虽然很难找到，但在这些艰难的时刻，你或许会认为就连这样的东西也有用处。

rows.original:
The wind is picking up, howling across the mountainside, accompanied by the growing rumble of thunder not-so-high above. You instinctively get lower to the ground in an effort to avoid being buffeted by the winds, which proves to be a saving grace. 
    
    A lightning bolt strikes the path a few paces ahead of you, slamming into the stone with enough force to send ice and rocks flying. You stumble back, coughing, as the reek of ozone assails your nose. That damn well nearly hit you! In the burst of light, you catch sight of several dark shapes moving just beyond the cliffside path, great wings propelling them effortlessly despite the gale. 
    
    "Harpies!" you grumble, grabbing for your [pc.weapon]. [zhara.atWF
        |"I don't suppose you're friends of Shar and Zhara, huh?"
        |More of that overgrown dove's flock, you reckon.
    ]
    
    "Trespassers!" a voice shouts back, booming over the howling wind. "These mountains have been defiled enough. First demons, then tomb-robbers, and now you. Enough is enough!"
    
    One harpy wings down from the rest of the pack, hovering just out of arm's reach. She's a particularly tall, athletic member of the species, with a messy mane of black feather-hair spilling down around bronzed skin and dark makeup. She's wearing a breastplate over her loose tunic and clutching a polearm in her hands, its copper head shaped to resemble a thunderbolt. Electricity crackles over the blade.
    
    "I am Vasha, daughter of Shaedra. I am here to give you one warning, lowlander," the woman says, aiming her corruscating polearm at your chest. "Leave this place, or you'll suffer Sorra's wrath."
    
    [party.has agni
        |Agnimitra sighs at your side. "Kids these days!
        
        Maybe she could talk some sense into this zealous crow?
    ]

You glance towards your own harpy. "Agni?"
    
    The red-plumed bard nods and takes wing, flying up close enough that the Sorran warrior could easily reach out and cleave her down if she wanted. The younger harpy hesitates, though, as Agni's got no weapon in hand, just her instrument. 
    
    "Look, kids, I know you think you're doing your duty," Agni says, "but so are we. My good friend [pc.name] here is here trying to save all of Khor'minos from a demon invasion. [pc.HeShe]'s doing Sorra's work."
    
    Vasha sighs. "Ancient, you can't seriously mean to contradict Sorra's own decree."
    
    Agni waves a flickering feather. "Tft. Sorra's decree is writ broad, how could she have known we were coming. The goddess will forgive you for letting us all go on. I'm your blood, and [party.som||[pc.name] here is my friend|these two are my friends] — and, again, trying to stop the whole demon thing."
    
    "Fine!" Vasha throws her hands up. "I will pray on this, Ancient. Don't expect me to stay my hand if you leave [pc.name]'s company and I catch [pc.himHer] here again."
    
    The paladin signals to her followers and takes wing again, begrudgingly leaving you to your devices.
    
    Agni gives you a wink. "See? Easy as they come."
    
    Back to it, then.

rows.original: [var0 |The crunch of snow alerts you to the presence of yet another vulperine hunting party, a trio of huskily-figured, shaggily-furred figures coming straight for you[var2|, led by a curvaceous staff-wielding woman]. On the other hand, the mountain trails are few and long, so it shouldn't be that surprising that you meet someone coming the other way... The vulperines have [rand |some freshly-caught game |a woven fish trap laden with catch |a large boar from the lower slopes strung up ] between them, but set their load down when they notice you, half-reaching for their clubs and axes. |As you make your way along the snow-dusted mountainside, a trio of huskily-figured, shaggily-furred shapes comes around the next bend down the mountain pass. At first you think them lupines — they're about the right height for it, plus the well-muscled canid body shape — but soon realize that their fur's sleeker and more blue than gray, their muscles more wiry than bulky. That, plus the fact that their ears are smaller and rounder and muzzles flatter, quickly lead you to decide against that conclusion. A trio of vulperines, then, but more acclimatized to the cold and height with all that follows, as opposed to their warmer-weather cousins. These guys may look primitive, clad in hides and furs while wielding heavy stone clubs and axes, but that doesn't make them any less of a potential threat. Judging by the numerous small game that they've got strung up amongst them, they know how to swing and throw their weapons just fine. As things stand, though, the mountain trail's too narrow and the cliff face too sheer to avoid the oncoming party. It's all you can do to steady yourself and meet them head-on, hand on your [pc.weapon] should you need it. |Making your way along the mountain trail, you catch sight of yet another vulperine hunting party coming your way: a trio of blue-furred, broad-shouldered hunters and huntresses padding through the snow and pebbles. rows.original: You glance at Cait and ask if she'd like to do the honors of keeping this pack of scruffy savages busy. She's the professional, after all. "Oh?" The pink-haired kitten arches an eyebrow, her tail starting to sway from side to side. "I guess I am, at that! Sure, it's not every day I get to keep you safe and share Mallach's gift at the same time. Just, like, every other day. Alright, you lot, what do you say I show you a whole new world of pleasure?" Given that this scruffy lot clearly doesn't think much of sex as more than a means to having babies, maybe it's time that they have their horizons broadened, isn't that right? [var0 |The curvaceous empath huffs at that. "Or maybe we're capable of doing both at the same time, perhaps?" Cait sticks out her tongue teasingly at the heavyset vixen. "Oh, just you wait and see!" |The vulperine scowls at that. "You know, if you weren't offering yourself up willingly..." Cait sticks out her tongue teasingly. "Don't get ahead of yourself, there's plenty I've got to show you all!" ] The rest of the vulperines descend upon Cait, and your pink kitten flashes you a big thumbs-up as she allows herself to be carried off by the men and women alike. The party ends up behind a conveniently-placed boulder amidst several tufts of dried-out mountain grasses, and while you may not be able to see what's going on behind there, you can hear the yips and yaps coming from behind what passes for a privacy screen.[var0 | Only the empath remains apart from the group, leaning her weight on her staff as she waits for the rest of the hunting party to be done with bored, half-lidded eyes. Not one for some fun herself? "It's just not the same if you don't really have a connection with whom you're mating with," she replies, a little morose. "Being able to feel peoples' minds isn't all lovely, you know." ] The whole affair takes perhaps half an hour before Cait finally emerges once again, looking very smug with herself. She's had a fresh change of clothes, and looks none the worse for the wear; at the same time, you note that none of the vulperines have emerged with her. Did she get them all? "Oh, come on," Cait replies with a wink. "I'm just a lay priestess and not that good — just good enough that those still standing are looking to those who aren't.[var0 | How's that for your kind? I know Sorrans in general can give as good as they take, given how many harpies there are in these mountains, but what about you?" The empath scowls at Cait. "I know a few tricks of my own, but excuse me if I'd prefer to make sure you didn't pull a fast one on mine rather than banter." Cait sticks her tongue out at the curvaceous vixen as the latter retreats and hurries over to the rock. Looking completely smug with herself, your pink kitten gives you a nod. "I was kidding when I said they just thought of sex as a way to make babies, but as it turned out, they weren't much better than that! Hopefully I gave them something to think about! So, shall we be on our way? ]"
rows.translation: 你瞥了眼凯特，问她是否愿意负责让这群粗野的家伙们忙个不停。毕竟，她才是专业人士。 “哦？”粉发的小猫挑了挑眉毛，尾巴也开始左右摇晃起来。“我想我确实应该负责这个任务吧！当然，能有机会保护你们的安全，也不是每天都能有的机会。 以及 同时分享马拉克带来的这份礼物吧。就像平常每天一样。好了，你们觉得怎么样，让我带你们去一个充满乐趣的全新世界吧？” 既然这群人显然认为性只是生育的工具而已，那么也许是时候让他们开阔一下视野了，不是吗？ [var0 |那个身材曲线优美的同理心者听到这话后气呼呼地说：“或者，也许我们能够同时做这两件事吧？” 凯特调皮地吐了吐舌头，对那个身材丰满的泼妇说道：“哦，你就等着瞧吧！ |那只狐狸听了后露出了凶狠的表情：“你知道吗，要是你不是主动献身的话……” 凯特调皮地吐了吐舌头：“别太早高兴，我还有很多东西要给你们看的呢！ ] 其余的雌性狐狸们纷纷围住了凯特，而你的粉色小猫则朝你竖起了大拇指，随后便被那些男女们带走了。派对最终在几丛干枯的山草丛中、一块位置恰到好处的巨石后面结束了。虽然你可能看不到那里发生了什么，但你能听到从那块所谓的“隐私屏障”后面传来的叫声。[var0 | 只有那位富有同理心的人独自站在队伍之外，她倚着手中的法杖，用那双半闭着、显得有些无聊的眼睛等待着其他狩猎队员完成他们的行动。 她自己也不喜欢参与这些娱乐活动吗？ “如果你并没有真正参与其中，那么这一切就完全不一样了…… 连接 就是和你正在交配的那个人啊，”她有些沮丧地回答，“能够感知别人的心思并不总是件好事，你知道的。 ] 整个过程大概持续了半个小时，直到凯特终于再次出现，她看起来显得非常得意。她换上了新衣服，看起来一点也没有受到影响；同时，你也注意到，没有其他女巫和她一起出现。 她是把那些人带去哪里了吗？ 所有哦，别这样吧，”凯特眨着眼睛回答道，“我只不过是个业余的女祭司而已，没什么了不起的。 那个 还不错——仅仅好到足以让那些还坚持着的人开始关注那些已经放弃的人。[var0 | 这对你们这类人来说怎么样？我知道，一般来说，索兰人也是会以牙还牙的——毕竟这些山脉里有很多女妖，但那么…… 你那个具有同理心的人皱着眉头看着凯特：“我也知道一些自己的办法，不过请原谅，我更愿意确保你不会对我耍花招，而不是只是闲聊而已。” 凯特对着这个曲线优美的“狐狸”吐了吐舌头，而那个女人则退后了几步，急忙跑向那块岩石。 那只粉红色的小猫看起来非常得意，还向你点了点头。 “我之前说他们把性仅仅看作是生育的手段，其实只是在开玩笑，但事实证明，他们的想法也没比那好到哪里去！ 希望我给他们提供了一些值得思考的内容！那么，我们现在可以出发了吗？ ]"

rows.original: Volunteer Cait to play nicely with them.
rows.translation: 让志愿者凯特和他们好好相处吧。
rows.raw: "Volunteer Cait to play nicely with them."

rows.original: As you wander the frigid cliffs of the Windy Peaks, you spot movement on the path just ahead of you. It's a vulperine hunting party; from the looks of things, they're not currently on the hunt of any particular creature and are trying to find something to track. One of them has their nose pressed to the ground, investigating either footprints or the scent of a larger creature. Their attention swiftly turns to you when you approach, their hunting weapons raised, but they're quickly lowered once they see you. "Houa," the nearest one starts, raising their hand in greeting – but then their eyes squint as they get a better look at you. "You must be the taminyk that Kailani spoke of," it asks. You confirm; you're familiar with Kailani. "Ah," it answers, looking over its shoulder and nodding to its companions. "You look to join her on the hunt no one else is dumb enough to join her on." ... You're looking to join her on the hunt that no one else is brave enough to join her on, correct. It laughs. "The brave ones are dead, taminyk. It is good to run and hide in the face of a hunt that can not be." It raises its weapon again, in a more defensive posture this time. "But Kailani has told us to test you. We will see if you are as skilled as you are 'brave.'" It's a fight!
rows.translation: 当你在风之峰那冰冷的悬崖间漫步时，发现前方的小路上有人影在移动。那是一支由狐族组成的狩猎队；从他们的样子来看，他们目前并没有在追逐某种特定的猎物，而是在试图寻找某种踪迹。其中一个人将鼻子贴在地面，正在仔细观察脚印或是某种大型生物留下的气味。 当你靠近时，他们的注意力立刻被你吸引了，他们立刻举起了狩猎武器，但看到是你之后，又迅速放下了武器。霍瓦最近的那个人先开始了，他们举手表示问候——但当他们仔细看清你的样子时，眼睛都眯了起来。‘你一定是…… 塔米尼克 就是凯拉妮提到的那个任务，”它问道。 你确认了一下——你确实认识凯拉妮。 “啊，”它回答道，同时回头看了看它的同伴，然后点了点头，“看来你也想加入她的这次狩猎行动吧？毕竟没有其他人会蠢到愿意跟她一起去的。” ……看来你也是想加入那次没人愿意参与的狩猎行动啊。 勇敢的 足够和她一起行动了，对吧？ 它笑了：“那些勇敢的人都已经死了…… 塔米尼克在一场无法逃避的追捕中，逃跑确实是明智的选择。”它再次举起了武器，这次采取了更加防御性的姿态。“但凯拉妮让我们来考验你。让我们看看你是否真的像你自称的那样‘勇敢’。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
