rows.original: [var0 |The crunch of snow alerts you to the presence of yet another vulperine hunting party, a trio of huskily-figured, shaggily-furred figures coming straight for you[var3|, led by a curvaceous staff-wielding woman]. For as desolate as the Windy Peaks are — or at least, for those unable to fly — there certainly are a lot of such parties. On the other hand, the mountain trails are few and long, so it shouldn't be that surprising that you meet someone coming the other way... The vulperines have [rand |some freshly-caught game |a woven fish trap laden with catch |a large boar from the lower slopes strung up ] between them, but set their load down when they notice you, half-reaching for their clubs and axes. |As you make your way along the snow-dusted mountainside, a trio of huskily-figured, shaggily-furred shapes comes around the next bend down the mountain pass. At first you think them lupines — they're about the right height for it, plus the well-muscled canid body shape — but soon realize that their fur's sleeker and more blue than gray, their muscles more wiry than bulky. That, plus the fact that their ears are smaller and rounder and muzzles flatter, quickly lead you to decide against that conclusion. A trio of vulperines, then, but more acclimatized to the cold and height with all that follows, as opposed to their warmer-weather cousins. These guys may look primitive, clad in hides and furs while wielding heavy stone clubs and axes, but that doesn't make them any less of a potential threat. Judging by the numerous small game that they've got strung up amongst them, they know how to swing and throw their weapons just fine. As things stand, though, the mountain trail's too narrow and the cliff face too sheer to avoid the oncoming party. It's all you can do to steady yourself and meet them head-on, hand on your [pc.weapon] should you need it. |Making your way along the mountain trail, you catch sight of yet another vulperine hunting party coming your way: a trio of blue-furred, broad-shouldered hunters and huntresses padding through the snow and pebbles. It's a familiar sight to you at this point: what isn't, though, is the woman leading them. She's no less muscular, but said muscles serve as a solid structure for supporting her considerably more curvaceous body. This is someone who although no less physically fit than her peers, clearly eats a lot better to have so much extra meat. That's not to mention the adornments: mostly of carved ivory and bone, they blend in well with her fur, but there are a couple gaudy pieces that might've come from the local harpies or from within the mountain, gold and silver that really stand out. Some symbol of rank or office would be your best guess, although you're no expert in the anthropology of boreal vulperines. What she's doing out with a hunting party is anyone's guess, but you get the feeling that you'll be finding out pretty soon. The narrow mountain trail precludes any kind of quick retreat or concealment, so it's only a matter of moments before you're upon each other. ] All of a sudden, the entire hunting party comes to a halt, stock-still as if struck by a bolt from the blue. [var3 |Led by the storm empath, all of them raise their muzzles and start sniffing ardently |Setting down their burden, they raise their muzzles and sniff at the air, spreading out in a circle ] — instead of trying to spot you, they're scenting you instead. It doesn't make sense given that you're in full view atop the mountain trail, but the husky vulperines start towards you at a brisk pace, growing more and more excited. [var2 |At last, their excitement reaches a fever pitch; unable to control themselves, the entire hunting party breaks for you in an open sprint. They're worked up to the point where they lope towards you hunched over, seamlessly getting on and off all fours to bound over obstacles in their way as they charge, flushed and panting. This... is quite the reaction, but wholly unsurprising: your own traitorous body starts reacting as well, flushing hot from head to toe. Multiple quivers course through your body as your [pc.cocks] bulge[s |s ] and [pc.vag] clenches with anticipation at the orgy barreling your way. The scent of a breeding bitch and a rutting stud combined into one neat package that you are has clearly gotten them all riled up — now that you know what they want, it'd be so easy to give them what they want and make this easy on everyone... |At last, their excitement reaches a fever pitch; unable to control themselves, the males in the hunting party break for you in an open sprint. They're worked up to the point where they lope towards you hunched over, seamlessly getting on and off all fours to bound over obstacles in their way as they charge with knotted, erect pricks bobbing under them. The remaining vulperines quickly bring up the lead, spreading out to encircle you. Your own traitorous body starts reacting as well, flushing hot from head to toe while your [pc.vag] clenches tight with anticipation. Guess that's what got them so worked up, the scent of a breeding [pc.ra lupine |bitch |vixen ]. Now that you know what they want, it'd be so easy to present yourself and make this easy on everyone... |At last, their excitement reaches a fever pitch; unable to control themselves, the females in the hunting party break for you in an open sprint. They're worked up to the point where they lope towards you hunched over, seamlessly getting on and off all fours to bound over obstacles in their way as they charge, the remaining vulperines quickly bringing up the lead. Your own traitorous body starts reacting as well, flushing hot from head to toe while your [pc.cocks] bulge[s |s ] and throb[s |s ] with anticipation, tenting your clothes. Guess that's what got them so worked up, the scent of a rutting stud. Now that you know what they want, it'd be so easy to give them what they want and make this easy on everyone... |The tension in the air is palpable and, as you soon realize, sexually charged; the way they're approach and fanning out with grins on their faces soon divulge their intentions. Given that you're a canid with no local ties, you're fair game by any measure... guess these hunters weren't just out hunting food, but mates as well. On the other hand, now that you know what they want, it'd be so easy to give them what they want and make this easy on everyone... ] Of course, there's the matter of your pride. Are you going to put up a fight, or just let the vulperines have their way with you?
rows.translation: [var0 |雪地中发出的嘎吱声提醒你，又有一支由三只体格魁梧、毛发蓬松的动物组成的猎队正向你袭来。[var3|在一位身材婀娜、手持法杖的女性的带领下……]尽管风之峰地区显得十分荒凉——至少对于那些无法飞行的人来说是这样——但实际上，这样的旅行队伍确实很多。另一方面，山间的小路数量稀少且路程漫长，因此遇到有人从相反方向走来，其实也不足为奇…… 那些女狼族成员们…… [rand |一些刚捕获的猎物 |一个装满捕获物的编织鱼笼 |一只来自山坡下方的大型野猪出现了。 ] 他们俩正在交谈，但当注意到你的存在时，便立刻放下了手中的负担，同时半伸出手去，想要拿起他们的棍棒和斧头。 |当你沿着被积雪覆盖的山坡前行时，突然有三只体型魁梧、毛发浓密的生物从山路的拐弯处出现了。起初你以为它们是狼——它们的身高和肌肉发达的犬科动物体型确实符合这一特征——但很快你就发现，它们的毛发比灰色更偏蓝色，肌肉也更加纤细而非粗壮。 再加上它们的耳朵更小、更圆，口鼻部也更加扁平，这些特征很快就会让你改变最初的判断。因此，这三只狐狸其实更适应寒冷和高海拔环境，与那些生活在温暖气候地区的同类相比，它们确实具备更多的适应性特征。 这些家伙虽然看起来很原始，身披兽皮，手持重型的石棒和斧头，但这并不意味着他们不会构成任何威胁。从他们悬挂在身上的那些猎物来看，他们显然很擅长使用这些武器进行攻击和投掷。 然而，就目前的情况来看，这条山路太狭窄了，悬崖壁也太陡峭了，根本无法避开迎面而来的队伍。你所能做的，就是稳住自己，迎面与他们对峙。 [pc.weapon] 如果有需要的话。 |当你沿着山路前行时，又看到了另一支由狐狸族成员组成的狩猎队正朝你的方向走来：三名身披蓝色毛皮、肩膀宽阔的猎人和猎妇正踏着积雪和碎石前行。对于你来说，这种场景已经变得十分熟悉了……不过，让你们感到意外的是，带领这支队伍的竟是一位女性。 她的肌肉同样发达，但她表示，这些肌肉为支撑她那更加曲线优美的身体提供了坚实的支撑。虽然她的身体状况与同龄人相当，但显然她的饮食更加合理，因此才能拥有如此出色的体态。 肉更不用说那些装饰品了：它们大多由雕刻过的象牙和骨头制成，与她的毛皮颜色十分协调，但也有几件颜色过于鲜艳的装饰品，这些可能是从当地的鹰身女妖那里得到的，也可能是从山里采集来的；那些金银制成的装饰品尤其显得格外醒目。 最合理的猜测应该是，她佩戴某种象征地位或职务的标志，不过你毕竟不是研究北方狐类人类学的专家。 至于她为什么会和一支狩猎队一起外出，那就只能靠猜测了，但你有种预感，很快就会弄清楚真相的。 这条狭窄的山路根本不可能让人迅速撤退或躲藏，因此你们很快就会相遇。 ] 突然间，整个狩猎队都停了下来，一动不动，仿佛被突如其来的事情惊呆了。 [var3 |在那位具有感知风暴能力的人的带领下，它们全都抬起了鼻子，开始热切地嗅探起来。 |它们放下身上的负担，抬起鼻子嗅了嗅空气，然后围成一圈散开开来。 ] 你这样一做，他们就放松了下来，他们的警惕心也稍微降低了，不再那么戒备了。 [var2 |这位拥有法杖的同理心者将自己从群体中分离出来。 |他们中的一个人脱离了队伍。 ] 从那群人中，有一个人走过来，用带有贝拉罕口音但还算能听懂的语言对你说： “嘿，邻居。 [party.hasCompanions |把一群客人带到楼上…… [pc.ra harpy |浴室 |塔楼 ] |风太大了，根本无法飞行，对吧？ ]你突然意识到，那些女妖们把你当成了当地人…… [pc.ra harpy |考虑到这些山峰上聚集了如此庞大的数量这些恶毒的家伙，这就说得通了——它们的数量之多，简直就像那些贼一样多。 |大概他们不可能记住这些山脉中所有的曼提科尔吧，这也情有可原。 ]点头，你…… [party.hasCompanions |朝……竖起大拇指表示赞赏 [party.compNames] 就在你身后。他们应该知道会发生什么——那些勇敢却又愚蠢的人，不远千里前来，只为了与那个传说中的人物相见…… [pc.ra harpy |女妖 |曼提科尔 ] 女管家和其他人。如果他们是自愿过来的，应该不会有什么坏处吧？ [var2 |同理心 |狐一般的 ] 他耸了耸肩，叹了口气：“只是……请告诉你的夫人，一定要让这些人完好无损地回来。 主要地 等他们完成工作后，大家应该都不会受伤。我们不需要再有更多的人从山里出来，在山坡上寻找失踪人员了。” “好的，那我们就这么定吧。 |在山腰的安全地带，对着远处呼啸的风挥了挥手。今天的天气真是糟糕透了——在这种暴风中飞行，显然是个不明智的选择。步行虽然可能会很慢、很辛苦，但至少你能顺利登上山顶，而不会被风吹到不知什么地方去。 [var2 |同理心 |狐一般的 ] 耸耸肩，叹了口气。 [pc.ra harpy |你对索拉如此信任，可她却连偶尔帮你一下都懒得做。嗯，如果她不按自己的意愿行事，她也就不配被称为自由女神了。 |你们的种族确实很强，但每个人都有自己的极限。说实话，要不是因为我们那永远吃不饱的肚子，我们也不会在这里了。 ] ] 虽然这一切都很好，但你们在邻里间的闲聊方面似乎有点欠缺。有没有什么他们特别想要的东西呢？
rows.raw: " [var0 |The crunch of snow alerts you to the presence of yet another vulperine hunting party, a trio of huskily-figured, shaggily-furred figures coming straight for you[var2|, led by a curvaceous staff-wielding woman]. For as desolate as the Windy Peaks are — or at least, for those unable to fly — there certainly are a lot of such parties. On the other hand, the mountain trails are few and long, so it shouldn't be that surprising that you meet someone coming the other way... The vulperines have [rand |some freshly-caught game |a woven fish trap laden with catch |a large boar from the lower slopes strung up ] between them, but set their load down when they notice you, half-reaching for their clubs and axes. |As you make your way along the snow-dusted mountainside, a trio of huskily-figured, shaggily-furred shapes comes around the next bend down the mountain pass. At first you think them lupines — they're about the right height for it, plus the well-muscled canid body shape — but soon realize that their fur's sleeker and more blue than gray, their muscles more wiry than bulky. That, plus the fact that their ears are smaller and rounder and muzzles flatter, quickly lead you to decide against that conclusion. A trio of vulperines, then, but more acclimatized to the cold and height with all that follows, as opposed to their warmer-weather cousins. These guys may look primitive, clad in hides and furs while wielding heavy stone clubs and axes, but that doesn't make them any less of a potential threat. Judging by the numerous small game that they've got strung up amongst them, they know how to swing and throw their weapons just fine. As things stand, though, the mountain trail's too narrow and the cliff face too sheer to avoid the oncoming party. It's all you can do to steady yourself and meet them head-on, hand on your [pc.weapon] should you need it. |Making your way along the mountain trail, you catch sight of yet another vulperine hunting party coming your way: a trio of blue-furred, broad-shouldered hunters and huntresses padding through the snow and pebbles. It's a familiar sight to you at this point: what isn't, though, is the woman leading them. She's no less muscular, but said muscles serve as a solid structure for supporting her considerably more curvaceous body. This is someone who although no less physically fit than her peers, clearly eats a lot better to have so much extra meat. That's not to mention the adornments: mostly of carved ivory and bone, they blend in well with her fur, but there are a couple gaudy pieces that might've come from the local harpies or from within the mountain, gold and silver that really stand out. Some symbol of rank or office would be your best guess, although you're no expert in the anthropology of boreal vulperines. What she's doing out with a hunting party is anyone's guess, but you get the feeling that you'll be finding out pretty soon. The narrow mountain trail precludes any kind of quick retreat or concealment, so it's only a matter of moments before you're upon each other. ] When it becomes clear to the vulperines who — or more correctly, what — you are, they relax, shifting ever so slightly and no longer quite on guard. [var2 |The staff-wielding empath detaches herself |One of their number detaches ] from the group, approaching you and speaking in passable if accented Belharan: "Hey, neighbor. [party.hasCompanions |Bringing a bunch of guests up to the [pc.ra harpy |baths |tower ] |Wind's so bad that flying's not an option, is it ]?" With a start, you realize that the vulperines have mistaken you for a local — [pc.ra harpy |which makes sense given the sheer number of harpies gathered in these peaks, as thick as the thieves they are |guess they can't remember every single manticore in these mountains, which makes sense ]. Nodding, you [party.hasCompanions |jerk a thumb over your shoulder at [party.compNames] behind you. They should know how it goes, the brave and stupid coming up all this way to have a tryst with the fabled [pc.ra harpy |harpy |manticore ] matron and all. No harm if they're coming up of their own volition, right? The [var2 |empath |vulperine ] shrugs and sighs. "Just... please tell your lady to return these people whole and largely unharmed when they're done. We don't need more people from within the mountain swarming the slopes seeking missing people." Sure, sure. "Good that we can come to an agreement, then." |waggle a hand at the winds howling away beyond the safety of the mountainside. Pretty terrible weather you're having today — it's not a hard decision to avoid flying in this kind of gale. Walking might be slow drudgery, but at least you'll get up the mountain as opposed to being blown off to who-knows-where. The [var2 |empath |vulperine ] shrugs and sighs. [pc.ra harpy |"All that belief in Sorra and she can't be bothered to throw you a bone every now and then. Well, she wouldn't be the goddess of freedom if she didn't do what she wanted." |"Your kind's strong, but we all have our limits. Frankly, we wouldn't be out here ourselves if not for the endless pits of our stomachs." ] ] While all this is well and good, you're running a little dry on neighborly chit-chat. Is there something that they wanted in particular? "

rows.original: As it turns out, the vulperines are more than happy to do most of the talking, eagerly trading gossip with someone who's not one of their own. You play the part of a [pc.race] who's been away for a while, and on their part they soak up every scrap of trivia about anywhere off the mountain that you throw at them. These people may have simple lives, but they're certainly not incurious about the outside world. [rand |"Know anything about what's going up at the old bathhouse?" one of them asks. "There's been quite the raucous caucus coming up from the peak of late — [pc.ra harpy |anything up with your matron, or is it just one of her usual fits?" Sorry, you're way too low in the pecking order to know anything about what goes on in the bathhouse. Everyone knows something's up, that much is clear, but the most you can do about it is keep your head down and hope that it passes without getting to you. "Of course." A weak smile. "I suppose it's the same everywhere you go — we just live as best as we can and hope no one high on the totem pole notices us, yeah?" |did the harpies say anything about it? They're on much better terms with you manticores than they are with us, so..." Sorry, you're just as clueless. Even if there was something going on between the harpies that they felt the need to inform the manticores about, you're nowhere near important enough to catch wind of that sort of news outside of hearsay. "Sorry about that. I was just hoping... well whatever it is that's going on up there, let's just pray that it passes over without dragging our peoples into the problem, yeah? When the harpies sneeze, everyone on the peaks catches a cold..." ] |"Used to be that sometimes minotaurs would come out of the stairs, bring us a couple of things in exchange for furs, hides, that sort of thing. They haven't been out for a couple months now — do you know what's up? We'd go look ourselves, but the scouting parties hadn't gotten several dozen feet past the stairs of Sorra and into the tunnels before losing their nerve." Good thing they did, otherwise they might've never returned. You briefly go over the state of the undertunnels and how Khor'minor is under siege and quarantined for the time being. The vulperines listen with rapt attention, slowly nodding along with your story. "That matches up with what we heard from the scouts. Guess it's a good thing that the mountain slopes are so thick, eh? A whole war going on right under our feet and we had no idea. Well, it shouldn't be anything to worry about — the minotaurs are the best legions in the land. If they don't manage to meet these demons head-on and come out victorious, there's not much we'd be able to do about it, either." That's a pretty sanguine way of looking at it. "[pc.ra harpy |Yeah, I know you harpies get your kicks out of being all aflutter |Yeah, I know you manticores like a bit of excitement ], but why worry? There're big fish, and there're small fish. The other peoples pushed our ancestors all the way up these slopes — there's nowhere to run to, either. So, no point worrying." |"There've been some creepy strangers on the slopes lately. Not quite like anything that we've seen before, either, and they didn't come up through the stairs of Sorra — we'd have known." Creepy strangers? You have a gut feeling and quickly give a brief description of Tollus's cultists to the vulperine, who nods. "All shapes and sizes, some of them with wings and tails, and all of them insisting on wearing those silly black hoods and cloaks when everything in these parts is gray or white. Yeah, that'd be them — certainly not lupine, human or elven at any rate. The harpies and manticores run them off whenever they're spotted, but they're very good at scattering and regrouping as needed." Yeah, they're bad news. Might have something to do with what's going on in the tunnels, or so you've heard. "The constant pressure from everyone has kept them from getting up to... well, whatever it is they're here for, but they just can't take a hint and stay away after being kicked off. It takes a certain kind of craziness to come climbing up these slopes over and over again. They don't get to stay long enough to get up to mischief, but it'd be nice if they just stayed down." Any idea what they're actually up to? "No, but it can't be anything good. We've had to run them off our hunting grounds a couple of times." |How's the hunting been going? Looks like they've had some good luck. "You can say that again. It isn't the right season for it, but the lower slopes are absolutely packed full of game for the last month or two. Perhaps I should be asking why, but then again I'm not going to turn down a gift from the gods." You hear that there's been trouble in the surrounding forests, which has led to the local lupine tribes taking less game from the forests of late. Maybe that's why the animals are ranging further and in greater numbers now. "Maybe, maybe. Whatever the reason, our hands have been kept pretty full — something this good can't last too long. Best to take as much as possible before the animals migrate to wherever it is they're going and leave us cold and hungry again." |"That last tribulation was so exciting, wasn't it?" Yes, yes, of course it was. You didn't get to see it yourself — how did it go down? "The truce grounds was completely and utterly packed like always, everyone wants to see a tribulation go down because it's the only real source of entertainment up here. Well, except for [pc.ra harpy |you harpies with your bathhouse and all, but that's reserved for only the upper crust, isn't it? |the harpies with their bathhouse, but you don't have that in your tower. ] Gods, I only barely fit in because I got there hours early, and you still couldn't move for all the wings, feathers and fur." Um, okay, sure. So, was there anything that happened in particular to make the tribulation that exciting, or was it the usual? "Poor girl made it to up to seven of the nine lightning strikes before her strength finally gave out. That wasn't anything special in and of itself — people fail the tribulation all the time — but the goddess didn't deign to show her mercy. Instead of being bones and ashes, she's still alive without any permanent harm." You smile, nod, and make a mental note that death apparently is considered a better outcome than failure in whatever this %"tribulation" is supposed to be. "She wants to go up again as soon as she can walk, so it probably won't be too long before we're gathering at the truce grounds again for another show. Hopefully this time it'll be even better!" ] The both of you make a little more small talk, but it ultimately gets nowhere — news is unsurprisingly scarce up here in the peaks. At length, the vulperine returns to the hunting party, and they pick up their game of the day before passing you by on the mountain trail. That was close — you get the feeling that this could have gone much differently if they hadn't mistaken you for a neighbor...
rows.translation: 事实证明，这些雌狐们非常乐意主动承担大部分交谈任务，她们会热切地与那些不属于自己群体的人分享各种八卦。而你的角色，则是…… [pc.race] 那些已经离开一段时间的人，对于你告诉他们的关于山外任何地方的琐碎信息，都会倾耳倾听、认真吸收。这些人的生活可能很简单，但他们绝对不对外面的世界缺乏兴趣。 [rand |有人知道老澡堂里发生了什么吗？”其中一个人问道，“最近从那栋楼的顶楼传出来不少嘈杂的声音…… [pc.ra harpy |你的女主管是不是出了什么问题，还是只是她又发脾气了？” “抱歉，你的地位太低了，根本不可能知道浴场里发生了什么。大家都明白肯定有什么不对劲，但你能做的就是低调行事，希望这件事能平息下来，别影响到你。 当然。”她露出一个淡淡的微笑，“我想无论你走到哪里，情况都应该都是一样的吧——我们只是尽力过好自己的生活，希望那些处于权力高层的人不会注意到我们，对吧？ |那些女妖有没有提到过这件事？她们与你们这些螳螂的关系可比与我们好多了，所以…… 抱歉，你同样一无所知。就算女妖们之间有什么事情需要告知螳螂们，你也不够重要，根本不可能提前得到这样的消息，除非只是道听途说而已。 对此我感到很抱歉。我只是希望……不管上面发生了什么，我们都祈祷它能自行平息，不要让我们的人民卷入其中，好吗？当那些‘鹰身女妖’打喷嚏的时候，山峰上的每个人都会感冒的。.." ] |以前有时候弥诺陶洛斯会从楼梯上出来，用毛皮、皮革之类的东西来交换我们的一些物品。不过现在已经有好几个月他们没有出现了——你知道是怎么回事吗？我们自己也想去看看，但是那些探查小队刚走过索拉的楼梯进入隧道没几步，就吓得不敢再往前走了。幸好他们这么做了，否则可能永远也回不来了。”你简要介绍了地下通道的现状，以及科尔米诺尔目前正处于被围困和隔离的状态。那些女狼们全神贯注地听着，一边听你讲述，一边缓缓地点头表示同意。 这与我们从侦察兵那里得到的消息相符。看来那些茂密的山坡真是帮了大忙，对吧？一场大战就在我们足部下进行，而我们却一无所知。不过，应该没什么好担心的——弥诺陶洛斯可是这片土地上最强大的军队啊。 如果他们不能勇敢地面对这些困难并取得胜利，我们也无能为力。” 这种看法还真是相当乐观的。[pc.ra harpy |是啊，我知道你们这些爱挑剔的人就是喜欢看别人手忙脚乱的样子，从中获得乐趣吧。 |是啊，我知道你们这些螳螂兽就喜欢一点刺激感吧。 ]但何必担心呢？世界上有大的鱼，也有小的鱼。其他民族把我们的祖先逼到了这些山坡上——他们也没有地方可逃了。所以，担心也没什么意义。 |最近在山坡上出现了一些令人毛骨悚然的陌生人。他们的行为也与我们以前见过的任何情况都不一样，而且他们并不是从索拉的楼梯那里上来的——如果我们看到他们从那里上来，肯定能立刻察觉到的。” 令人毛骨悚然的陌生人？ 你凭直觉迅速向那位女猎手部描述了托卢斯的信徒们的外貌特征，她点了点头。 “他们形形色色，有的有翅膀和尾巴，而且所有人都坚持穿着那些愚蠢的黑色兜帽和长袍——尽管这一带的景色本来就是灰白调的。 是的，就是它们——肯定不是狼族，也不是人类或精灵。每当人们发现它们的踪迹，鹰身女妖和螳螂女妖就会把它们赶走，但这些生物非常擅长分散然后根据需要重新集结。 没错，它们确实是个麻烦。 可能和隧道里发生的事情有关，你们应该也听说了。” “周围人的不断施压让他们无法去做……嗯，他们来这里本来是想做些什么的，但被赶走之后，他们就是不明白该远离那里才对。 要一次又一次地爬上这些斜坡，确实需要某种程度的疯狂。它们待在上面的時間不够长，也就来不及搞什么恶作剧，但要是它们能……那就再好不过了。 留在了那里。 下去。” 你知道他们到底在搞什么吗？ “不知道，但肯定没什么好事。我们已经好几次把他们从我们的狩猎场赶走了。 |确实如此。虽然现在不是狩猎的最佳季节，但在过去一两个月里，山足部下的地带确实到处都是猎物。 或许我应该问问为什么，但话说回来，我可不会拒绝上天赐予的礼物。 你听说了吗？周围的森林里出了麻烦，因此最近当地的狼族从森林里捕获的猎物也变少了。 也许这就是为什么现在的动物们会迁徙得更远，数量也会更多的原因吧。 “也许吧，也许吧。无论原因是什么，我们的手部头确实一直很忙——这么好的机会不会持续太久的。最好在那些动物们迁移到其他地方之前，尽可能多地捕获它们，否则我们又会陷入寒冷和饥饿之中。" |上一次的试炼真是太刺激了，对吧？” “是啊，当然很刺激。你没亲自看到吧？到底发生了什么？” “像往常一样，休战区里挤满了人——毕竟在这里，试炼才是唯一的真正娱乐方式。嗯，除了…… [pc.ra harpy |你们这些热衷于建造浴场的人，不过那些设施都是为上层社会准备的吧？ |那些长着鹰爪、住在浴场里的女妖……不过你的塔里可没有这样的东西。 ] 天啊，我几乎是勉强才挤进去的——因为我已经提前几个小时就到了那里，而那些翅膀、羽毛和毛皮实在太多了，根本让人动弹不得。” “嗯，好吧。那么，是不是发生了什么特别的事情，才让这次经历变得如此刺激呢？还是说，这一切都只是平常的事情罢了？ 那个可怜的女孩竟然承受了九次闪电袭击中的七次，直到最后体力彻底耗尽。这本身并不算什么特别的事情——毕竟总有人会在这样的考验中失败——但女神却丝毫没有表现出丝毫怜悯之心。 她并没有变成骨头和灰烬，依然活着，也没有受到任何永久性的伤害。” 你微笑着点了点头，同时在心里想：显然，在这场所谓的“磨难”中，死亡反而被认为是一种比失败更好的结果。 她一能走路就想再上去表演，所以我们应该不会等太久，就能再次在停战地点聚集起来，观看另一场表演了。希望这次会更好看一些！ ] 你们俩又闲聊了一会儿，但最终什么结果也没有——在这样的山峰地区，消息本来就很少。最后，那只狐狸回到了狩猎队中，他们捡起了当天的猎物，然后从山路上经过了你身边。 真是差一点……你会觉得，如果他们没有把你误认成邻居的话，事情的发展可能会完全不同……

rows.original:
You head down the shallow embankment between the road and the riverside, towards the tightly-packed couple dozen stone hovels sheltering in the shadow of the old bridge. You can already see people moving around down there, seemingly unconcerned by the whipping winds howling overhead. Down here, beneath the roadbridge, the bluster proves to be not nearly so violent. The villagers are uniquely suited to the climate, too, you come to realize: they're vulperines, fox-featured folk with dense coats of shaggy fur in hues of white, ice-blue, and pale pink. Most of them lean quite voluptuous, augmenting their natural insulation with plump bellies and thick thighs that are all rather poorly hidden under their loincloths and the occasional fur vest or bustier. 

    Compared to the quarantined city below, these folk seem almost carefree. The sound of chatting and laughing soon overpowers the howl of the wind overhead. You see a pregnant mother waddling after a pair of squealing children playing in the snow, no more than ten years old. An elderly fellow sits under a heavy blanket, sharpening the flint tip of a spear that looks better suited to fishing than war. A young man and woman wave at you, their other hands locked adoringly together. A single kit hugs her mother's tail, peering at you with wide eyes. 
    
    Isolated here on the heights of the mountain, this village seems to have been spared the war below. Life goes on as if nothing were amiss.
    
    More folk begin to notice you: heads peek out from doors or from behind clotheslines, and more inviting waves hasten your approach. 
    
    You're met at the edge of the village by a heavyset man, maybe forty years old, with bright golden eyes and a coat of fur that's a mix of cream and reddish pink. Like most of the villagers, he's wearing just a loincloth and a vest of animal hide that leaves his chest bare. The only weapon on him is a flint axe slung through his belt, and his hands are raised in greeting. 
    
    Honestly, if you were colorblind you could almost mistake the man for Garth.
    
    "Hail, travelers," he says. His Belharan's a touch skewed, clearly not his first language. "Be welcome in our village. I am Arened, the potter. What brings you [pc.ra harpy
        |to us, feathered sister?
        |up the mountain?
    ]"
rows.translation:
你沿着道路与河岸之间的矮矮堤岸向下走去，朝着那些紧挨着老桥的、由几十间石砌小屋组成的村落前进。你已经能看到下面的人们在活动着，他们似乎完全不在意头顶上呼啸的狂风。 在道路桥的下方，狂风似乎并没有那么猛烈了。你逐渐意识到，这些村民其实非常适应这种气候：他们属于狐族，拥有狐狸般的面容，身上覆盖着白色、冰蓝色和淡粉色的浓密毛发。 他们中的大多数身材都相当丰满，圆润的腹部和粗壮的大腿为他们的身体提供了天然的保温层，而这些部位在他们的缠缠腰布以及偶尔穿上的毛皮背心或束腰衣的遮掩下，几乎看不出来。 

    与下方那座被隔离的城市相比，这些人们看起来几乎无忧无虑。谈笑声很快盖过了头顶上呼啸的风声。你会看到一位孕妇摇摇摆摆地跟在两个在雪地里玩耍、年龄不超过十岁的孩子后面。 一位老人裹着厚厚的毯子坐着，正在磨利一支矛的燧石尖端——那支矛看起来更适合用来捕鱼，而非作战。一对年轻男女正朝你挥手部，他们的双手部紧紧相握，充满爱意。一只小动物紧紧依偎在它的母亲的尾巴旁，用大大的眼睛盯着你看。 
    
    这个村庄坐落在高山之上，仿佛与山脚下的战争毫无关联。人们的生活依旧照常进行，仿佛什么异常都没有发生。

越来越多的人开始注意到你：有人从门后或晾衣绳后面探出头来，也有人热情地向你招手部，示意你过来。 
    
    在村庄的边缘，有位体格魁梧的男子迎接了你。他大概四十岁左右，金色的眼睛十分明亮，身上覆盖着由奶油色和红粉色混合而成的毛皮。和大多数村民一样，他只穿着一条缠缠腰布和一件用动物皮制成的背心，胸部裸露在外。他身上唯一的武器是一把挂在腰带上的打火石斧，而他正双手部举起，向你表示问候。 
    
    说实话，如果你是色盲的话，几乎会把这个男人错认成加斯。

“各位旅行者，欢迎来到这里，”他说。他的贝尔哈兰语说得有点不流利，显然这不是他的母语。“欢迎来到我们的村庄。我是阿雷内德，这个陶艺师。你们来这里有什么事情吗？ [pc.ra harpy
        |对我们来说，就是那位羽翼丰满的姐妹吧？
        |上山去吗？
    ]"

rows.original:
Arened chuckles. "I hope that you enjoy the sight of snow, then, traveler. And rock. There is much of that, too." He gestures up the mountain.

        "Is there anything worth seeing up here?" you ask.
        
        "Mm, there's plenty of ruins further up. Treasure-hunters used to come that way. Fewer now, with the Kingdom's war under our feet. Temples, mostly. If you care for the old empire's architecture, you won't be disappointed."
        
        The vulperine man waves you towards the village. "But that is a long trek. Come and warm yoursel[party.som
            |f
            |ves
            |ves
        ] by the fire. And pray to Sorra for her blessing, if you have a mind to. Her paladins are fighting hard to keep us safe from the monsters below, and her winds are howling furiously."

You're standing at the heart of a vulperine village, shielded from the raging winds of the mountaintops by a towering, if ill-repaired, minoan bridge above them. There's perhaps three dozen squat, round huts, all made of packed stone and dirt, surrounding a circle of standing stones that make up an altar of Sorra. A river of snowmelt rushes past the village to the north, providing the foxen folk all the drinking water they'd ever need.

    Arened keeps one of the larger houses in the village, with the highest roof of them all by far. [dayNight
        |You can see the fox-man hard at work at his potter's wheel through the open cloth door.
        |The cloth door is drawn closed for the night, though you can see a flickering candle-light inside.
    ]

rows.raw:
"
    You're standing at the heart of a vulperine village, shielded from the raging winds of the mountaintops by a towering, if ill-repaired, minoan bridge above them. There's perhaps three dozen squat, round huts, all made of packed stone and dirt, surrounding a circle of standing stones that make up an altar of Sorra. A river of snowmelt rushes past the village to the north, providing the foxen folk all the drinking water they'd ever need.

    Arened keeps one of the larger houses in the village, with the highest roof of them all by far. [dayNight
        |You can see the fox-man hard at work at his potter's wheel through the open cloth door.
        |The cloth door is drawn closed for the night, though you can see a flickering candle-light inside.
    ]"

rows.original:
A few of the foxes look at you curiously as you approach their Sorran statue, drawn to it by a familiar weight in the charm around your neck — a magical connection that charges the air around you as you draw nearer. You can't even see the waystone idol in the statue, buried inside the crude facsimile of what once might have stood here in ages past, but you can certainly feel it. You hold up your charm to the facade of Sorra, and there's a flash of light from between your fingers, mirrored by a dim glow from between cracks in the statue. One of Sorra's eyes crumbles, revealing a blue crystal buried beneath. 

        The locals watching you gasp, but the waystone is now open to you.
rows.translation:
当你走近那些狐狸的雕像时，有几只狐狸好奇地注视着你。吸引你的是挂在你脖子上的那件饰品所散发出的熟悉气息——那种神奇的力量让你在靠近雕像的过程中感受到周围空气中的变化。你甚至无法看到雕像内部的那块路标神像，它被埋藏在这座粗糙仿制的雕像之中，而这座雕像很可能就是数百年前曾经矗立在这里的。但你可以清楚地感受到它的存在。 你将手中的饰品举向索拉的面孔，手指间迸发出一道轻型芒，这道轻型芒在雕像裂缝中折射出微弱的轻型芒。索拉的一只眼睛开始崩解，露出下面埋藏着的蓝色水晶。 

        周围的当地人都看着你，惊讶得倒抽了一口气，但现在，那条通往目标的路已经向你敞开了。

rows.original: It's impossible to miss the cultist band as you make your way along the mountain trail — their dark robes billow constantly in the constant winds that howl through the peaks and crags[var0|, and not to mention the massive demon centaur clomping away at the head of their party]. In the same way, given the task that Kas has set them to keep them occupied with make-work, it's also impossible for them to miss you, too. It's kind of cathartic in that sense — the knowledge that once your eyes meet, conflict is inevitable. Grabbing their weapons, the demonic cultists drop their pace and sprint across the snowy gravel to get at you, lustful, manic fervor in their gazes. "For Lady Kasyrra and the Master!" Yes, yes, you know that they intend to test you and all that. Time to get this over with. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 当你沿着山间小路前行时，绝对不可能错过那支穿着黑色长袍的邪教乐队——他们的长袍在山峰间呼啸的狂风中不断飘动。[var0|更不用说那个巨大的恶魔半人马正走在他们队伍的最前面了。]同样地，由于卡斯安排了这些任务让他们忙于无意义的工作，他们也不可能注意到你的存在。从某种意义上说，这种安排反而有一种宣泄作用的效果——因为一旦你们的目光相遇，冲突就不可避免了。 他们拿起武器，加快脚步，在雪覆盖的碎石地上飞奔着向你扑来，他们的眼中充满了贪婪与狂热。 “为了卡希拉女士和大师！” 没错，你早就知道他们其实是想考验你之类的。 是时候把这件事解决了。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

Yes, yes, you know that they intend to test you and all that. Time to get this over with. It's a fight! "

rows.original: Traveling through the peaks along the icy mountain trails, [pc.hasEmoteEars |your ears perk up at the sound of |you catch wind of ] a harpy squawking in pleasure not too far off. Not that such noises are out of place in this mountain range, but there's another voice there, presumably the other party in the exchange. One that's familiar to you, and that you remember as not quite human... [party.hasCompanions |Holding up a hand, you signal for [party.compNames] to wait behind you while you scout ahead a little, see if there's a harpy patrol up ahead |While retracing your steps and going around might allow you to avoid the harpies straight in your path, you'd lose a lot of time finding a way around. Maybe checking to see if you can pass by unnoticed might be for the best ]. Those feathery fiends can be quite territorial when the fancy strikes them, and whoever it is on the receiving side of that exchange sounds quite worn out. Pressing yourself against the cliff face, you slink close and peer cautiously around the corner. As it turns out, it really is one of Tollus's posse — similar to, perhaps even one of those you encountered during your adventures in the Rift. It's hard to tell them apart given the voluminous robes and cloaks they wear in the fashion of Tollus himself, but those aren't on at the moment. In fact, you recognize one of the cultist psions who's being ridden into the ground by one of the harpies while the latter's sisters cheer her on. Well, you weren't quite expecting that. Unless this is some kind of devious plan by Tollus to corrupt the harpies — given how this appears completely unplanned on the psion's part, improbable but perhaps not impossible — the demon appears to be on the disadvantage here. Seconds tick by as the harpy finishes up, cum dripping from her egg-slit as she pumps her thighs and pulls herself upright, her sisters throwing in several jeers at the demon for good measure. "Is that all you've got? You really are a quickshot, aren't you? Even the lowlanders we drag up from time to time last longer than you did! Then again, it's only to be expected given that no one wants the likes of you and your ugly — if anything, you ought to be thankful for a pity fuck!" Another chorus of cawing and jeering rises from the massed harpies and they move to flap off, but not before giving the lanky demon a kick in the side. You're not sure how to feel about this — on one hand, Tollus's goons are here, doing whoever knows what. On the other, it looks like the harpies are more than capable of taking care of themselves. After what happened in the Rift and the fact that whole swathes of Tollus's underlings are no longer there, they had to have gone somewhere; while there certainly is a lot happening inside of the mountain, those are mostly Kas' people and confined to the tunnels rather than the mountains' surface. It's all very odd. [party.oneComp quintillus cait |"I don't like this one bit." While you'd been busy watching the harpies, Quin's snuck up beside you to peer over your shoulder. "Wherever these guys go, trouble follows." You don't know about that. Judging by the demon struggling to his feet, the harpies are a force to be reckoned with. Whatever Tollus is planning here, it doesn't look to be working as well as his plan back in the Rift. "Yeah, well, better safe than sorry." And didn't you tell him to stay back while you scouted ahead? "I got worried, especially with all the commotion. You'd been out there for a bit and a half." |"Oh look, it's them again." While you'd been occupied with watching the scene play out, Cait's snuck up beside you to peer over your shoulder; for someone as thick as she is she clearly hasn't lost any of her feline grace. "Looks like the harpies have everything under control." Yeah, looks like it. You may be judging the situation a little too hastily, but whatever Tollus is planning here, it doesn't look like he's set to make much headway. That being said, you did tell Cait to hang back while you scouted ahead... "I got worried, especially when I heard all those harpies squawking; you'd been gone for a while. You wouldn't have fun without me, would you?" ] Well, that's that; the only question that remains is what to do; there's still one groaning demon cultist on the cold, rocky ground trying to pick himself up and crawl to shelter. There's the option of just leaving this small fry and going on your way, or you can interrogate him and see what he knows, even if it might not be much. It's not like he's in any shape to resist you if you were to press the issue...
rows.translation: 沿着冰冷的山间小径，穿越那些险峻的山峰， [pc.hasEmoteEars |一听到这个声音，你的耳朵立刻竖了起来。 |你听说了…… ] 不远处，有只女妖兴奋地尖叫着。虽然在这种山脉中，这样的声音并不罕见，但还有另一个声音——想必是另一方在回应。那个声音你很熟悉，你也记得，它听起来并不像人类的声音…… [party.hasCompanions |你举起一只手，示意着…… [party.compNames] 在你先去探路的时候，我会留在你身后，看看前方是否有女妖巡逻队。 |虽然重新返回原路绕行可以让你避开那些挡在路上的“女妖”，但这样会浪费很多时间来寻找绕行路线。或许，试着看看是否能够悄无声息地通过，反而是更好的选择。 ]那些长满羽毛的家伙，一旦兴致上来，就会变得极具领地意识，而那些成为它们攻击目标的生物，听起来肯定都受了不少苦。你紧贴着悬崖边缘，小心翼翼地绕到拐角处窥视。 结果发现，果然如此…… 是 这是托卢斯的手下之一——或许，甚至就是你在裂隙地带冒险时遇到的那些人中的一员。由于他们都穿着与托卢斯本人一样的宽大长袍，因此很难将他们区分开来，不过现在他们并没有穿这些衣服。 事实上，你认出了其中一名邪教信徒灵能者——她正被一只女妖踩在足部下，而那只女妖的姐妹们还在为她欢呼助威。 嗯，你确实没预料到会这样。除非这是托卢斯为了腐蚀这些女妖而策划的某种阴险计划……不过考虑到这名灵能者的行为看起来完全是一时冲动，这种可能性虽然不大，但也不能完全排除。总之，在这种情况下，这个恶魔似乎处于劣势。 时间一分一秒地过去，那个女妖终于完成了动作，精液从她的阴道中滴落下来，她不断摆动大腿，努力让自己站直起来，而她的姐妹们也纷纷对那个恶魔发出几声嘲笑。 “就这点本事吗？ 你真的吗？ 是 就是个速射而已，对吧？就连我们偶尔从底层抓上来的人，也比你坚持的时间长！不过，这也难怪，毕竟没人会想要你这种人，还有你那丑陋的模样——说实在的，你应该庆幸别人还嫌你太恶心，才没直接把你扔掉才对！一群乌鸦再次发出刺耳的叫声和嘲弄声，然后它们飞走了，但在离开之前，还踢了那个瘦高的恶魔一下。你实在不知道该作何感想——一方面，Tollus的手下们在这里干着谁也搞不清楚的事情。 另一方面，看起来那些女妖完全有能力照顾好自己。在裂隙地带发生了那些事情之后，再加上托卢斯的许多手下已经不复存在，它们肯定去了别的地方；虽然那座山内部确实发生了很多事情，但那些人大多是卡斯的部下，他们被限制在隧道里，而不是山的外面。 这一切都太奇怪了。 [party.oneComp quintillus cait |我一点也不喜欢这个。”当你专心致志地观察那些女妖时，奎因已经悄悄走到你身边，从你肩膀后面探出头来。“这些家伙走到哪里，麻烦就会跟到哪里。” 你可能还不明白这一点。从那个正在努力站起来的恶魔来看，那些女妖确实是一股不可小觑的力量。 无论托卢斯在这里策划了什么，看起来效果都不如他在裂隙地带制定的计划那么好。 “嗯，还是谨慎点总没坏处。” 而且你不是让他留在后面，让你自己去探路吗？ 我真的很担心，尤其是看到周围这么热闹。你已经在外面待了一个半小时了。 |哦，看，又是他们。”当你全神贯注地观察着现场发生的一切时，凯特已经悄悄走到你身边，从你肩膀后面探出头来；对于一个这么胖的人来说，她显然依然保持着那种猫一般的敏捷与灵动。 看起来那些女妖们把一切都控制得很好。” 是啊，看起来确实如此。你可能有点太草率地判断形势了，但不管托卢斯在这里打算做什么，看来他并不会取得什么进展。 话虽如此，你还是让凯特在后面等着，而你自己却去前面探路了…… “我真的很担心，尤其是听到那些鹰鹫在尖叫的时候；你已经离开有一段时间了。没有我，你应该不会玩得开心吧？" ] 好吧，事情就是这样了；现在唯一剩下的问题就是该怎么做。还有那个可怜的恶魔崇拜者，还躺在冰冷坚硬的地上，试图挣扎着爬起来寻找庇护所。你可以选择直接忽略这个小角色，继续你的路；或者你可以审问他，看看他能提供些什么信息，尽管这些信息可能并不多。反正他现在的状态根本不可能反抗你……

rows.translation: 走吧。不管这群人当初为什么要来到这里，显然他们在那些女妖面前毫无进展可言。
rows.raw: "Just go. Whatever this lot came to the peaks for, it's clearly not making any headway amongst the harpies."

rows.original:
No time like the present. Once you're sure the harpies have cleared out, you emerge from cover and swiftly step over to the cultist. His eyes widen as he sees you approaching, and tries to scramble for safety, but you've already closed the distance and are upon him.
    
    "Fuck, not now!"
    
    Yes, now. You reach down, grab the cultist by the scruff of his neck, then shake a little sense into him. The harpies have worn him down to the point where he just doesn't have the will to fight back; it's oozing from his countenance in every conceivable way. This is one of the, if not the most miserable demon you've seen, and that's saying something.
    
    Now, you're not going to hurt him, not if he answers a few questions.
    
    The cultist's eyes dart this way and that, perhaps hoping for rescue to come at this critical juncture; when none of his fellows come riding to the rescue, he slumps his shoulders and sighs, defeated.
    
    "It's not like it's going to hurt anyway. Fine, ask."
    
    You'll be to the point, then. Knowing how Tollus's underlings operate, if there's one of them out in the open, that means there're many more skulking in the shadows. Just what are they up to in the peaks? Does Tollus have his eye on the harpies?
    
    "Actually we're doing nothing."
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Come on now. You promised not to hurt him if he answered a few questions, true, but if he's going to play around with the wording and not keep to the spirit in which the promise was made you're sure you can find some technicality to make life extremely difficult for him.
        
        The demon cultists stares at you wide-eyed. "Honest, we're doing nothing!"
        
        All right, you'll play along. He has one chance to explain, so he'd better make it good.
        |Seriously, you're supposed to buy that? Pull the other one, it's got bells on.
        
        "I-I'm not lying, damn it!"
        
        Okay, then. If he's not lying or stalling for time, then he can explain, and he'd better make it good.
    ]
    
    "Master Tollus told us to help with the Dark Lady's business in the Undermountain, but she's asked us to hang out here as reserves just in case something happens! We've been bored out of our skulls sitting on our asses!"
    
    Sounds like the harpies are plenty bored too, given what's just happened to him. So... that's it? Kas just has them sitting around on the peaks doing nothing instead of putting them to work?
    
    "Yes!"
    
    No barrels of goop? No psionic horrors under the sea? No mischief at all in that broad-ranging vein?
    
    "At least there'd be something to do. Master Tollus made it sound like the Dark Lady needed us, but when we got here she told us that it was all very sweet, but she had enough hands; if we wanted to, we could sit around and she'd call on us if she had need."
    
    Hmm. Given the conflict raging on beneath your feet, you're not sure what to think. [pc.bg soldier
        |Your military experience wonders if the extra warm bodies that Tollus's goons represent would be worth the time — they may have demonic powers and are fanatically loyal to Kas, but on the other hand you doubt that they'd be little more than rabble. More isn't always better, after all; sometimes they just get in each others' way in the rush to become meat for the grinder
        |You're no military expert, but you suspect that getting these cultists up to speed with what's going on and inserting them into whatever plan Kas has would be more trouble than it's worth. On one hand, they have demonic powers and are fanatically loyal to her, on the other they're what they are
    ]. Then there's the matter of the whole cult thing — after what you learned in the Rift, you know full well that Kas is right to be distrustful of anyone or anything that Tollus sends her, even if all appearances are to the opposite.
rows.translation:
现在正是最好的时机。一旦确定那些女妖已经离开，你就立刻从藏身之处冲出来，迅速扑向那个邪教徒。当他看到你靠近时，眼睛顿时瞪得大大的，试图逃跑以求自保，但你已经追上了他。
    
    该死，现在不行！”

但是，现在就必须行动。你伸手部抓住那个邪教徒的脖子，狠狠地摇晃他，让他清醒一点。那些女妖已经把他折磨得彻底没有了反抗的意志；他的脸上到处都流露出这种无力感。 这绝对是你见过的最可怜的恶魔之一，甚至可以说是最可怜的恶魔了，这一点毋庸置疑。

现在，如果你能回答他几个问题，就不会伤害他。

那个邪教徒的目光四处乱转，或许还在期待在这个关键时刻会有人来救他；然而当他的同伴们一个也没有出现来救他时，他只能沮丧地低下肩膀，叹了口气，认输了。
    
    反正也不会有什么坏处吧。好吧，问吧。”

这样的话，你就直截了当了。了解Tollus的手部下们的行事方式后，如果他们中有一个人公然现身，那就意味着还有更多人潜伏在暗处。 他们在那些山峰里到底在干什么？Tollus是不是在盯着那些女妖看？

“其实我们什么也没做。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |得了吧，你当初可是承诺过，如果他回答几个问题，就不会伤害他，对吧？但既然他总爱玩文字游戏，不遵守当初的承诺精神，那你总该能找些借口，让他陷入麻烦吧。

那些恶魔崇拜者瞪大眼睛看着你：“真的，我们什么都没做！”

好吧，那就随你便吧。他只有一次机会来解释，所以最好好好利用这个机会。
        |说真的，你真的打算买那个吗？还是选另一个吧，那个上面还有铃铛呢。

“我、我没有撒谎，真的！”

好吧，那就算了。如果他不是在撒谎，也不是在拖延时间，那他就应该解释清楚，而且最好能给出一个合理的理由。
    ]
    
    托卢斯大师让我们帮忙处理暗黑女士在山腹深域的事情，但她又让我们在这里待着，作为后备力量，以防万一发生什么意外！我们坐在这里无聊死了！
    
    听起来那些女妖们也觉得非常无聊，毕竟他刚刚遭遇了那些事情。那么……就只是这样吗？Kas只是让它们在山峰上无所事事地待着，而不让它们去干活吗？

“是的！”

没有那些黏稠的液体吗？ 海底下没有灵能恐怖生物？也没有任何与之相关的麻烦事发生吗？

“至少还能有点事情可做啊。托卢斯大师说得好像暗影女士需要我们，但当我们来到这里后，她却告诉我们一切都很顺利，她已经有足够的人手部了；如果我们愿意的话，就可以待在旁边休息，等她需要我们的时候再叫我们过去。嗯，考虑到你们足部下正在发生的这场冲突，你们确实不知道该作何反应。 [pc.bg soldier
        |你的军事经验让你不禁思考：托卢斯的那些手下所带来的这些“额外战斗力”是否真的值得花费时间去培养？他们或许拥有恶魔般的力量，也对卡斯充满了狂热的忠诚，但另一方面，你又怀疑他们其实不过是一群乌合之众罢了。毕竟，数量多并不一定意味着力量强；有时候，他们在争先恐后地成为牺牲品的过程中，只会互相妨碍、互相干扰而已。
        |你虽然不是军事专家，但你觉得让这些狂热信徒尽快了解当前的情况，并将他们纳入卡斯制定的任何计划中，所带来的麻烦恐怕会远远超过其带来的好处。一方面，他们拥有恶魔之力，而且对卡斯充满了狂热的忠诚；另一方面，他们本身也就只是那样的人罢了。
    ]然后还有那个邪教组织的问题——在经历了在Rift发生的那些事情之后，你应该很清楚，Kas对Tollus派给她的任何人或任何事物保持警惕是完全正确的，即使表面上看上去一切似乎都与此相反。
rows.raw:
"
    No time like the present. Once you're sure the harpies have cleared out, you emerge from cover and swiftly step over to the cultist. His eyes widen as he sees you approaching, and tries to scramble for safety, but you've already closed the distance and are upon him.
    
    "Fuck, not now!"
    
    Yes, now. You reach down, grab the cultist by the scruff of his neck, then shake a little sense into him. The harpies have worn him down to the point where he just doesn't have the will to fight back; it's oozing from his countenance in every conceivable way. This is one of the, if not the most miserable demon you've seen, and that's saying something.
    
    Now, you're not going to hurt him, not if he answers a few questions.
    
    The cultist's eyes dart this way and that, perhaps hoping for rescue to come at this critical juncture; when none of his fellows come riding to the rescue, he slumps his shoulders and sighs, defeated.
    
    "It's not like it's going to hurt anyway. Fine, ask."
    
    You'll be to the point, then. Knowing how Tollus's underlings operate, if there's one of them out in the open, that means there're many more skulking in the shadows. Just what are they up to in the peaks? Does Tollus have his eye on the harpies?
    
    "Actually we're doing nothing."
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Come on now. You promised not to hurt him if he answered a few questions, true, but if he's going to play around with the wording and not keep to the spirit in which the promise was made you're sure you can find some technicality to make life extremely difficult for him.
        
        The demon cultists stares at you wide-eyed. "Honest, we're doing nothing!"
        
        All right, you'll play along. He has one chance to explain, so he'd better make it good.
        |Seriously, you're supposed to buy that? Pull the other one, it's got bells on.
        
        "I-I'm not lying, damn it!"
        
        Okay, then. If he's not lying or stalling for time, then he can explain, and he'd better make it good.
    ]
    
    "Master Tollus told us to help with the Dark Lady's business in the Undermountain, but she's asked us to hang out here as reserves just in case something happens! We've been bored out of our skulls sitting on our asses!"
    
    Sounds like the harpies are plenty bored too, given what's just happened to him. So... that's it? Kas just has them sitting around on the peaks doing nothing instead of putting them to work?
    
    "Yes!"
    
    No barrels of goop? No psionic horrors under the sea? No mischief at all in that broad-ranging vein?
    
    "At least there'd be something to do. Master Tollus made it sound like the Dark Lady needed us, but when we got here she told us that it was all very sweet, but she had enough hands; if we wanted to, we could sit around and she'd call on us if she had need."
    
    Hmm. Given the conflict raging on beneath your feet, you're not sure what to think. [pc.bg soldier
        |Your military experience wonders if the extra warm bodies that Tollus's goons represent would be worth the time — they may have demonic powers and are fanatically loyal to Kas, but on the other hand you doubt that they'd be little more than rabble. More isn't always better, after all; sometimes they just get in each others' way in the rush to become meat for the grinder
        |You're no military expert, but you suspect that getting these cultists up to speed with what's going on and inserting them into whatever plan Kas has would be more trouble than it's worth. On one hand, they have demonic powers and are fanatically loyal to her, on the other they're what they are
    ]. Then there's the matter of the whole cult thing — after what you learned in the Rift, you know full well that Kas is right to be distrustful of anyone or anything that Tollus sends her, even if all appearances are to the opposite.
    "

rows.original: You give the cultist another shake. If him and his fellows are here, where's Tollus, then? "The master's headed for the coast. Didn't tell us where, only that he had very important work to do. Of course, all of his work's important, so that doesn't say very much." Well, that's been very informative, you guess. [party.oneComp quintillus cait |Quin's been listening in to all this, and you turn to him with a nod. Does this sound right? "Against my better judgement, I think this one's telling the truth, [pc.name]." Oh? "Think about it. Tollus is driving to those ends which he was so kind to outline in his notes, and that means he needs to be sure that the goons who surround him are loyal to him, not the demoness. He always ran the cult as a personality thing with him at the center, and being upstaged like that must've pissed him off to no end. Seriously, though, for what he's gearing up to do, I really wouldn't want someone to get inspired by loyalty to the red bitch all of a sudden." That makes sense, yeah. Sending those loyal to Kas here would be a discreet way to get them out of his hair while he takes his inner circle and those personally loyal to him eastward for whatever he's planning. "See? It all matches up. I'm the last person in all the world inclined to be charitable to these chucklefucks, so if I say I don't think he's lying, I mean it." |You notice Cait's been at your side all this while, and call over your pink kitten. No doubt she's heard everything this demon cultist's had to say — what does she think? Does she smell a lie here? "His emotions aside, [pc.name], I do think he's telling the truth." Hmm. What's her reasoning here? "Think about it. Tollus is plotting against the demoness he ostensibly serves, and that means he needs to be sure that his underlings who surround him are loyal to him, not her. If I were as miserable and jealous a creature as he is, I'd want to be absolutely sure that no one was going to turn against me once it became undeniable that I was planning to overthrow my so-called mistress. It must have burned him to have control of his little cult wrested away from him..." That makes sense, yeah. Sending those loyal to Kas here would be a discreet way to get them out of his hair while he takes his inner circle and those personally loyal to him eastward for whatever he's planning. |Thinking about it, there is the possibility that the cultist isn't lying. Not just because this particular specimen doesn't have the emotional continence to do so, but also because it makes sense. If Tollus is going to plot against Kas, he needs to be sure that he's surrounding himself with underlings that he can trust, inasfar as he can trust anyone — which means his inner circle and others who he believes owe their loyalty to him and not Kas as the cult's ostensible leader. Yes, the pieces do fall into place from that perspective — now that he doesn't need so many hands to handle the labor-intensive mess in the Rift, sending the cast-offs to help out Kas is a plausibly deniable way of getting them out of his way. Meanwhile, he's heading east for the coast, no doubt up to nothing good... ] "C-can I go now?" One last question. Since there's a whole bunch of Tollus's cast-offs sitting around on these miserable peaks doing nothing, you don't suppose his fellows will be getting in your way while you're about your business? Itchy fingers? Sore butts from sitting around too long? Getting bored? "N-not so much getting bored, but the Dark Lady's orders to test you still stand. She still wants you stronger, and we can't disobey." Can't, or won't? "B-both!" You'd ask what he means by that, but by the looks of the cultist you're pretty sure he doesn't know entirely himself. Well, even if it looks like these cultists aren't officially up to no good in the peaks, they're going to be trouble for you nonetheless... perhaps even more since they don't really have anything to do. Oh, bother. "Can I go now?" [pc.isDK |Yeah, sure. He'd better beat it before you change your mind. With a shrug, you toss the demon to the ground, watching him scramble to his knees and half-scurry, half-shuffle away. Honestly, he might be just about the most miserable creature you've seen all week. |Well, you promised and he answered to the best of his ability, so fair's fair. You let the demon cultist slump to the ground, then watch him scramble away. Creature's miserable enough that one might feel sorry for him, just a little. ]
rows.translation: 你又摇晃了那个狂热信徒一下。如果他和他的同伙都在这里，那么托卢斯到底在哪里呢？ “大师已经前往海岸了。他没有告诉我们具体去了哪里，只是说有非常重要的事情要去做。当然，他说的所有事情都很重要，所以这也说明不了什么。” 嗯，看来这些信息还挺有用的吧。 [party.oneComp quintillus cait |奎因一直在听这些对话，你现在向他点头示意，然后问道：“这样表达听起来合适吗？” “尽管我本应该更谨慎一些，但我觉得这个人说的是实话。 [pc.name]哦？” “仔细想想吧。Tollus正在朝着他在笔记中详细阐述的目标前进，这意味着他必须确保那些围绕在他身边的手部下都是忠诚的…… 他而不是那个女恶魔。他一直把那个邪教组织当作展示自己个人魅力的平台，让自己处于中心位置；而被人这样抢了风头，肯定让他恼火至极。说真的，考虑到他接下来打算做的事情，我…… 真的 肯定不希望有人会因为对那个红发女人的忠诚而突然受到启发吧。” 确实有道理。把那些对卡斯忠心耿耿的人派到这里来，其实是一种巧妙的方式——这样就能让他们远离他的视线，而他自己则可以带着自己的核心团队以及那些对他个人来说绝对忠诚的人向东进发，去执行他正在策划的那些事情。 “看吧？一切都说得通了。在这个世界上，我最不可能对这些蠢货心生怜悯，所以如果我说我认为他没有说谎，那一定是认真的。 |你注意到凯特一直都在你身边，于是叫来了你的粉色小猫。毫无疑问，它已经听完了这个恶魔崇拜者所说的一切——它是怎么想的呢？它是否感觉这里面有谎言？ “先不说他的情绪…… [pc.name]我确实认为他在说真话。” 嗯，她这么想的理由是什么呢？ “仔细想想吧。托卢斯正在密谋反对他表面上所侍奉的那位女恶魔，这意味着他必须确保自己身边的那些下属都是忠诚的…… 他不是她。如果我也像他那样痛苦又嫉妒，我一定会想尽一切办法确保，在自己打算推翻那个所谓的“情妇”这一事实变得无可否认之后，绝对没有人会背叛我。他的小圈子被别人夺走控制权，这种感觉一定让他痛苦不堪。……” “嗯，这样确实挺合理的。把那些对卡斯忠心耿耿的人派到这里来，既可以让他们远离卡斯的视线，同时也能让他带着自己的核心团队以及那些对他个人来说绝对忠诚的人向东去执行他的计划。 |仔细想想，还是…… 是 这个狂热者可能并没有说谎。不仅仅是因为这个特定的个体缺乏说谎所需的情绪控制力，更因为这种说法在逻辑上是合理的。如果Tollus真的打算背叛Kas，他就必须确保自己身边围绕着那些他可以信任的部下——当然，前提是他真的能够信任任何人。这意味着他的核心团队，以及那些他认为应该效忠于他而非作为这个邪教表面领袖的Kas的人，都应该被纳入他的信任范围之内。 没错，这些线索确实都在暗示着这一点。 做 从这个角度来看，一切就都说得通了——既然他不再需要那么多人手部来处理裂谷地区那些繁琐的工作，那么把那些被淘汰的人派去帮助卡斯，就是一种可以轻易推脱的借口，从而让他们不再妨碍自己。与此同时，他正朝着东部海岸方向前进，毫无疑问，他是有所图谋的…… ] 我…现在可以走了吗？” 还有一个问题。既然有那么多被托卢斯抛弃的人在这些荒凉的山峰上无所事事，你不会觉得他们在你做事的时候会妨碍你吧？ 手部痒吗？因为坐得太久而屁股疼吗？觉得无聊了吗？ “嗯，倒不是觉得无聊，但是暗影女士命令我们要测试你们，这个命令依然有效。她还是希望你们变得更强大，而我们不能违抗她的命令。做不到，还是不愿意做呢？” “两者都是！” 你可能会问他这话是什么意思，但从这些狂热信徒的表现来看，你很确定他自己也不太清楚。嗯，即使这些狂热信徒在山峰上没有明显的恶作剧行为，他们仍然会给你带来麻烦。..也许甚至更明显，因为他们其实根本没有什么事情可做。 哦，算了。 “我现在可以走了吗？ [pc.isDK |嗯，当然。他最好在你改变主意之前赶紧离开。你耸了耸肩，把那个恶魔扔到地上，看着他挣扎着跪倒在地，然后半爬半跑地逃走了。说真的，他可能是你这周见过的最可怜的生物了。 |嗯，你当初答应过，他也已经尽了最大努力去回答那些问题，所以公平点来说，大家都是公平对待的。你把那个恶魔崇拜者打倒在地，然后看着他仓皇逃走……那个家伙的样子实在可怜，让人都有点同情他了，只不过是稍微有点而已。 ]

rows.original: You consider the situation, then shrug and make to leave. Whatever the problem is here, it's not going to be bothering the harpies firmly entrenched in their peaks — no, the problem is more within the mountain than on it. Putting away your [pc.weapon], you shrug and watch the cultists psion drag himself out of sight before turning to go yourself.
rows.translation: 你考虑了一下当前的情况，然后耸了耸肩，准备离开。无论这里存在什么问题，它都不会影响到那些牢牢栖息在山顶上的鹰鹫——不，问题其实更出在山体内部，而不是表面。把你的……收起来吧。 [pc.weapon]你耸了耸肩，看着那些狂热信徒用灵能将自己拖到视线之外，然后才转身离开。

Putting away your [pc.weapon], you shrug and watch the cultists psion drag himself out of sight before turning to go yourself.\n    "

rows.original: [party.oneComp quintillus cait |"Guess that's that, huh." You raise an eyebrow. One would've thought Quin would protest more at you just letting one of Tollus's posse go. "Previously, I would, yeah. But now..." Quin looks thoughtful and taps the bridge of his nose. "After everything that's happened, especially in the Rift, it's become clear that a lot of the chumps in Tollus's rank and file aren't really all there. I don't even think most of them are there voluntarily, at least to begin with; they're not those whom I knew who followed Tollus of their own free will. Even if these chumps aren't who they used to be, they're press-ganged, and maybe they can be cured somehow, I don't know. Restored to their former selves. "Don't get me wrong, that doesn't mean I'm going to let up on those who know what they're doing, especially Tollus's inner circle; those who I still remember from my old days are going to be getting it. rows.original:
The last of the dark-robed demons falls to the snow with a heavy crunch, gasping and panting; for all the powers Kasyrra's granted them and what they've gained themselves in the demonification process, they still weren't a match for you.[var0
        | Even the massive, scaled demontaur has been downed, flanks heaving as he lies on the ice. He's not getting up again anytime soon, that's for sure.
    ]
    
    Well then, looks like you've passed this test with flying colors; no doubt Kas will be so proud of you for keeping her underlings in line and keeping them from getting too bored. What, if anything, are you going to do with them now that they're at your mercy?
rows.translation:
最后那个身穿黑袍的恶魔重重地倒在雪地上，喘着粗气，奄奄一息；尽管卡希拉赋予了他们力量，也让他们在恶魔化的过程中获得了种种能力，但他们终究还是无法与你抗衡。[var0
        | 就连那头庞大且体型庞大的破坏巨兽也被击倒了，它躺在冰面上，身体不断抽搐。可以肯定的是，它在短时间内是不会再站起来了。
    ]
    
    那么，看来你这次测试表现得非常出色；毫无疑问，卡丝会为你感到无比骄傲的——你让她的下属们守规矩，也防止他们太无聊。现在他们完全处于你的掌控之下，你打算对他们做些什么呢？

rows.original:
Shrugging, you put away your weapon, turn your back and leave the groaning demons on the ice. They've been well-beaten — that should satisfy whatever orders Kas has given them. By the time they've licked their wounds and are ready to get up to any more shenanigans, you'll be long gone; either way, they're not going to be a problem for you.
        
        Let them return to their mistress and report what happened; no doubt she'll be pleased with your progress. You, on the other hand, don't have the time to stand here all day; the harpies can clean up well enough.
rows.translation:
你耸了耸肩，收起了武器，转身离开了那些在冰面上呻吟的恶魔。他们已经被打得落花流水——这样应该就能满足卡斯给他们的任何命令了。等到他们伤势痊愈，准备再次搞出什么幺蛾子的时候，你早就走远了；无论如何，他们都不会再给你带来任何麻烦。
        
        让他们回到主人身边，把发生的事情报告给她吧；毫无疑问，她会对你的进展感到满意的。而你，也没有时间整天站在这里；那些女妖们完全有能力把这里清理干净。

rows.raw: "You've passed this so-called test, and there's nothing else you need to prove to Kas' underlings."

rows.original: You stagger back as the cultists close in, knocking your [pc.weapon] away from you and out of your reach. [party.hasCompanions |[comp1.name] moves in with the last of [comp1.hisHer] strength to try and defend you from the incoming figures, but is soon overwhelmed by the demonically-fuelled fanatics, pushed to the side and left ignored once they're sure [comp1.heShe]'s not getting up again. Looks like they've only got eyes for you — which isn't surprising, given that the orders they received from Kas all that time ago still stand. |You scramble for it, but are stopped short by the group of cultists picking you up by the scruff of your neck and shoving you face-first into the powdery snow to the sound of raucous laughter. It's clear that none of the demon cultists are taking this very seriously, indulging their whims and fancies even though you've demonstrated yourself to be a foe of some power in the past. Then again, they're the ones standing, and not you... ] "Well, I wasn't expecting us to win!" one of them says with a chuckle, kicking snow onto you. "After what happened back down at the Winter City and the Rift... c'mon, you threw the fight on purpose to see what we'd do to you if you lost, right? You can't be that much of a pushover if you survived all that Lady Kasyrra said you did!" Maybe... maybe you just have a cold today. "Aha! Well, you still haven't lost your sense of humor. If you're that desperate to have us ravish you, you can just ask... even though it's been some time, everyone remembers quite well what exactly the Dark Lady told us we could do with you should we actually beat you. It's miserably boring up here, after all; you don't mind providing a bit more entertainment, don't you?"

rows.original: With a final kick of snow on your face and hearty chuckle, the demons make to leave, turning their backs on you and trotting off. Wait wait wait. This makes absolutely no sense at all. They have you at their mercy, and they're just going to leave? "The mistress was very clear about what was to be done with you, meddler. You'll be the final piece to fall in place in her crowning plan... but until then, there're still plenty of chances to get stronger. Certainly someone who's struck so many blows against us threw this fight — you'd better have been, or she's going to be so disappointed with you. However bored we may be waiting around here, we're not about to disobey her orders, so you can count yourself lucky." You can only shake your head at the insanity of it all — but then, these are the ones who are fanatically loyal to Kas and not Tollus, aren't they? "So why don't you get over your cold and join us for some more fun sometime? We'll be waiting." The crunching sound of footsteps upon the snow and ice slowly begins to fade as the demons depart, and you lie there in the snow for a little while before some semblance of strength returns to your limbs and you're able to struggle woozily to your feet. [party.has quintillus |Quin's a little way off groaning in the snow, and you step over to give him a hand up. "Damn," he spits. "That smarts. They got lucky, we got overconfident. Won't be happening again." You're more wondering about the fact that the cultists just let you go like that... even if it was on Kasyrra's instructions, you'd have expected more defiance than that in them. "Yeah. The cult I was in back then wouldn't have hesitated to off us on the spot, if not carry us back as sacrifices. Kind of ironic that a demon's more merciful than that asshole Tollus. Come on, [pc.name] — let's be on our way. I've got a wounded ego to walk off." |Time to make like a tree and leave, if you know what's good for you... ]

You can only shake your head at the insanity of it all — but then, these are the ones who are fanatically loyal to Kas and not Tollus, aren't they? "So why don't you get over your cold and join us for some more fun sometime? We'll be waiting." The crunching sound of footsteps upon the snow and ice slowly begins to fade as the demons depart, and you lie there in the snow for a little while before some semblance of strength returns to your limbs and you're able to struggle woozily to your feet. [party.has quintillus |Quin's a little way off groaning in the snow, and you step over to give him a hand up. "Damn," he spits. "That smarts. They got lucky, we got overconfident. Won't be happening again." You're more wondering about the fact that the cultists just let you go like that... even if it was on Kasyrra's instructions, you'd have expected more defiance than that in them. "Yeah. The cult I was in back then wouldn't have hesitated to off us on the spot, if not carry us back as sacrifices. Kind of ironic that a demon's more merciful than that asshole Tollus. Come on, [pc.name] — let's be on our way. I've got a wounded ego to walk off." |Time to make like a tree and leave, if you know what's good for you... ] "
