rows.original: Kailani provides for the village as one of its huntresses, and you encountering one of her traps is how you two met. Ask her about her work.
rows.translation: 作为村里的猎手之一，凯拉妮为村庄做出了贡献，而你正是遇到了她设置的陷阱，才与她相识的。不妨去问问她关于她的工作吧。
rows.raw: "Kailani provides for the village as one of its huntresses, and you encountering one of her traps is how you two met. Ask her about her work."

rows.original: Kailani mentioned a few times now that she's on the hunt for something. When you first met her on the pathway around the mountain, she had set up a tripwire trap across the road in hopes of getting the drop on whatever monster, or monsters, live inside the cave, but you had mangled that attempt[var0 | by accident ]. You may or may not look it, but you're something of an accomplished journey[pc.manWoman] yourself. You know your way around dealing with everything from some wild animals, to highwaymen looking for an easy target, to demons and their hordes. She once said that none of the other hunters in the village had the skill or the courage to join her... but what about you? You've had the skill and courage to make it this far, after all. Kailani scrunches her nose as she listens to you justify yourself to her. "You are not of the village," she states, leaning back as she crosses both her arms and her legs. "I do not know what it is you hunt in other lands, but this is not the same. You saw the bones. The prey is large; it is strong; it wants to eat; and it is smart. I could not hunt it, and so, you could not." You're not suggesting you hunt it. You're suggesting that you and her pair together to hunt it. Like she said, it's too smart to be caught by a trap outside of its cave, but she didn't outright deny the possibility of some hunters being more proactive by hunting it directly in its own home. You and her[party.som | | and [comp1.name] | and [comp1.name] and [comp2.name] ] could go into the cave, hunt whatever it is she's after, and then she can finally move on with her life.[party.solo | Kailani's brow furrows as she eyes you, from your head to your feet. You can tell from the look in her eyes that, even if she believes that you're capable, you're nonetheless not quite what she was looking for. But then again, what she was 'looking for' was just another hunter from the village, and they've all turned her down... | "No," Kailani answers sternly. "This is my hunt. I will not take one more." Wait, what? If she didn't want help, why did she say that one thing about the other hunters in the village 'not having the guts?' That sounded a lot to you like she wanted help, but nobody was brave enough to give it. Kailani's brow furrows and her head tilts in one direction, looking at you like you had just said something foolhardy and she's trying to decipher what you meant. "Oh!" she says, her eyes widening. "I have done you wrong. I will not take one more. It will be you and only you." Oh, that makes a bit more sense. ... Wait, no it doesn't. If this thing is so big and strong and smart, why wouldn't she want to go in with everyone she can to make sure the job is done? There's safety in numbers, and all that. "The hunt is hwilimbillickt. To hunt to feed the village – we all hunt. That is life. To stay to the hwilimbillickt as we hunt to feed the village could hurt the ibulimo, and if the ibulimo are hurt, the village is hurt." She looks to her left, towards the spear leaning the wall of her hut. "But to hunt for the self... to hunt for me, and my wants... that is not the same. As that is not the same, the hunt, too, is not the same." So... if she can't ask for a whole hunting party to go with her, then, who can she ask to go with her? "One more," she says, extending her right index finger into the air. "Any one that I want. I will hunt; the one I bring will see." Herself, and a spotter, then. It'd be just you two. ] Kailani sighs through her nose, her lips pursing as she considers what it is you're suggesting. Her hands rest on her knees, her fingers clenching through her fur over and over as she seriously considers it. Perhaps, to her, asking an outsider for help with her hunt would be a sign of weakness – she's said, proudly, that she's the best hunter in the village, and she's really been struggling to hunt this thing in those caves. But on the other, having some help and chasing the beast down has clearly crossed her mind, and nobody else is willing to help... Kailani closes her eyes and takes another deep sigh through her nose. When she opens them again, her eyes lock onto yours with more surety and determination than before. "No," she says[party.solo | | again ]. You frown. "Not as you are," she continues. "You tell of hunts of your own in the world you come from. Show me your skill as ibulim, [pc.name]. If your skill is as you say it is, then I will take you on the hunt." She wants you to show her how good you are at hunting. You'll admit: you've been through a lot, but you've never really hunted before; not in the sense that she's probably thinking. You could probably kill a wild animal just fine, if she gave you a bit of time– "No," she says again, shaking her head and causing her shaggy fur with swish with the motion. "The village ibulimo will not go with me to hunt where the prey is, [pc.name]. They will not go; it is... uh," she stutters, her eyes rolling as she thinks of the word. "Uwlbrift. We may not come home." She leans forward, her hands clasping together as her eyebrows arch upward. "You may have skill... but I must know if you can keep safe. It is not only the hunt; it is so that you are not the hunt." [pc.isDK |Look, she keeps walking circles around what whatever task it is she has in mind, and you're starting to get a little impatient. ]What is it that she wants you to do? "Vulp ibulimo hunt," she says, motioning to the door of her hut with her right hand. "Their prey is omlinawo, but they must keep safe and not be the hunt. You will hunt vulp ibulimo. They will not go with me... but if you can hunt them, I will know that your skill is with my own[pc.ra harpy manticore |. You are taminyk, [pc.name], and the vulps are good with your kind. I will let all know that it is a test that you are meant for; ibulimo vulps will know to press you in the wild |. You are taminyk, [pc.name], and the vulps are good with your kind. I will let all know that it is a test that you are meant for; ibulimo vulps will know to press you in the wild ]." [pc.isDK |She wants you to go out and hunt some foxes. You can do that. Y |Wait, she wants you to 'hunt' her fellow vulperine hunters? That's... that's a little intense, isn't it? "You will not hunt to kill, [pc.name]," she says with a deflated sigh. You're already off to a bad start. "'Hunt' is not the word I want, but I do not know the word that I want." Oh, right. Well, in that case, y ]ou ask her... when you know you're done. "It is your skill that will find me," she answers with a sly smile; her cheeks rise high enough to conceal the mischievousness in her eyes. "For a taminyk to hunt ibulimo vulps, I would know." She crosses her legs and looks down as she hums, resting her chin on her hand. "But... let us say... if you hunt ten – no... if you hunt ten-and-five vulps, I will know your skill is real." Alright then: it sounds like you have your objectives clear.

rows.raw: ' Kailani mentioned a few times now that she's on the hunt for something. When you first met her on the pathway around the mountain, she had set up a tripwire trap across the road in hopes of getting the drop on whatever monster, or monsters, live inside the cave, but you had mangled that attempt[var0 | by accident ]. You may or may not look it, but you're something of an accomplished journey[pc.manWoman] yourself. You know your way around dealing with everything from some wild animals, to highwaymen looking for an easy target, to demons and their hordes. She once said that none of the other hunters in the village had the skill or the courage to join her... but what about you? You've had the skill and courage to make it this far, after all. Kailani scrunches her nose as she listens to you justify yourself to her. "You are not of the village," she states, leaning back as she crosses both her arms and her legs. "I do not know what it is you hunt in other lands, but this is not the same. You saw the bones. The prey is large; it is strong; it wants to eat; and it is smart. I could not hunt it, and so, you could not." You're not suggesting you hunt it. You're suggesting that you and her pair together to hunt it. Like she said, it's too smart to be caught by a trap outside of its cave, but she didn't outright deny the possibility of some hunters being more proactive by hunting it directly in its own home. You and her[party.som | | and [comp1.name] | and [comp1.name] and [comp2.name] ] could go into the cave, hunt whatever it is she's after, and then she can finally move on with her life.[party.solo | Kailani's brow furrows as she eyes you, from your head to your feet. You can tell from the look in her eyes that, even if she believes that you're capable, you're nonetheless not quite what she was looking for. But then again, what she was 'looking for' was just another hunter from the village, and they've all turned her down... | "No," Kailani answers sternly. "This is my hunt. I will not take one more." Wait, what? If she didn't want help, why did she say that one thing about the other hunters in the village 'not having the guts?' That sounded a lot to you like she wanted help, but nobody was brave enough to give it. Kailani's brow furrows and her head tilts in one direction, looking at you like you had just said something foolhardy and she's trying to decipher what you meant. "Oh!" she says, her eyes widening. "I have done you wrong. I will not take one more. It will be you and only you." Oh, that makes a bit more sense. ... Wait, no it doesn't. If this thing is so big and strong and smart, why wouldn't she want to go in with everyone she can to make sure the job is done? There's safety in numbers, and all that. "The hunt is hwilimbillickt. To hunt to feed the village – we all hunt. That is life. To stay to the hwilimbillickt as we hunt to feed the village could hurt the ibulimo, and if the ibulimo are hurt, the village is hurt." She looks to her left, towards the spear leaning the wall of her hut. "But to hunt for the self... to hunt for me, and my wants... that is not the same. As that is not the same, the hunt, too, is not the same." So... if she can't ask for a whole hunting party to go with her, then, who can she ask to go with her? "One more," she says, extending her right index finger into the air. "Any one that I want. I will hunt; the one I bring will see." Herself, and a spotter, then. It'd be just you two. ] Kailani sighs through her nose, her lips pursing as she considers what it is you're suggesting. Her hands rest on her knees, her fingers clenching through her fur over and over as she seriously considers it. Perhaps, to her, asking an outsider for help with her hunt would be a sign of weakness – she's said, proudly, that she's the best hunter in the village, and she's really been struggling to hunt this thing in those caves. But on the other, having some help and chasing the beast down has clearly crossed her mind, and nobody else is willing to help... Kailani closes her eyes and takes another deep sigh through her nose. When she opens them again, her eyes lock onto yours with more surety and determination than before. "No," she says[party.solo | | again ]. You frown. "Not as you are," she continues. "You tell of hunts of your own in the world you come from. Show me your skill as ibulim, [pc.name]. If your skill is as you say it is, then I will take you on the hunt." She wants you to show her how good you are at hunting. You'll admit: you've been through a lot, but you've never really hunted before; not in the sense that she's probably thinking. You could probably kill a wild animal just fine, if she gave you a bit of time– "No," she says again, shaking her head and causing her shaggy fur with swish with the motion. "The village ibulimo will not go with me to hunt where the prey is, [pc.name]. They will not go; it is... uh," she stutters, her eyes rolling as she thinks of the word. "Uwlbrift. We may not come home." She leans forward, her hands clasping together as her eyebrows arch upward. "You may have skill... but I must know if you can keep safe. It is not only the hunt; it is so that you are not the hunt." [pc.isDK |Look, she keeps walking circles around what whatever task it is she has in mind, and you're starting to get a little impatient. ]What is it that she wants you to do? "Vulp ibulimo hunt," she says, motioning to the door of her hut with her right hand. "Their prey is omlinawo, but they must keep safe and not be the hunt. You will hunt vulp ibulimo. They will not go with me... but if you can hunt them, I will know that your skill is with my own[pc.ra harpy manticore |. You are taminyk, [pc.name], and the vulps are good with your kind. I will let all know that it is a test that you are meant for; ibulimo vulps will know to press you in the wild |. You are taminyk, [pc.name], and the vulps are good with your kind. I will let all know that it is a test that you are meant for; ibulimo vulps will know to press you in the wild ]." [pc.isDK |She wants you to go out and hunt some foxes. You can do that. Y |Wait, she wants you to 'hunt' her fellow vulperine hunters? That's... that's a little intense, isn't it? "You will not hunt to kill, [pc.name]," she says with a deflated sigh. You're already off to a bad start. "'Hunt' is not the word I want, but I do not know the word that I want." Oh, right. Well, in that case, y ]ou ask her... when you know you're done. "It is your skill that will find me," she answers with a sly smile; her cheeks rise high enough to conceal the mischievousness in her eyes. "For a taminyk to hunt ibulimo vulps, I would know." She crosses her legs and looks down as she hums, resting her chin on her hand. "But... let us say... if you hunt ten – no... if you hunt ten-and-five vulps, I will know your skill is real." Alright then: it sounds like you have your objectives clear. '

rows.original: With a self-assured smirk on your face, you ask Kailani if she's heard anything about your reputation lately. According to her, news of your 'hunting prowess' ought to have traveled quickly; she's the one that said 'your skill would find her.' Kailani doesn't quite share your enthusiasm: she sits, her right leg up and her ankle resting on her left knee, leaning back on her pile of grass and straw as she regards you with an unamused look. Her eyes are narrowed and her mouth is pursed tightly closed.[party.solo | | "And you did it on your own," she says, more of a statement than a question. The vulperine hunters were always in groups of at least three, sometimes more. Were you expected to beat them all on your own? ] Kailani's chest heaves as she takes a long, exaggerated sigh. She rolls her head back, looking up at the ceiling of her hut; you can see the corners of her lips bend downward as she considers what it is she needs to do next. "It was not a task you were to do, [pc.name]," she says dejectedly. "The ibulimo of the village were to stop you." She gave you a task that she thought was impossible? A task that couldn't be done? "Yes," she says flatly, annoyed at both the question and herself. "I now know of your skill. You are as much an ibulim as any other hunter of the village. If you could hunt ten-and-five of us, then you may help me hunt the beast." So, then, what's the problem? You thought she wanted help. You figured she would have been excited to know that you weren't just some foreigner that couldn't put [pc.hisHer] electrum where [pc.hisHer] mouth is. Kailani takes another sigh, her eyes wide open at the ceiling. She ignores your question for a while, letting it hang stiffly in the air between you two. From the look in her eyes, she knows what answer she wants to give, but, for one reason or another, she can't give it. "[pc.name]," she says slowly, chewing through your name like it was gum in her mouth. "My umwricht and umfracht were lost by that cave. The beast in the cave is why they are not here. I do not know this... but I know this." She fixes her sitting position, leaning forward to address you more directly. Her brow is bent into an angry furrow; her eyes widen; and her pupils shrink. She's getting amped up from thinking about it. "It could get us, too." At this point, you're used to a little bit of excitement and higher stakes. You can help Kailani get the closure she's been after all her life. You've forced her to acknowledge your skill as a... well, at the very least, a survivalist. None of the other village hunters are brave enough to go with her, but you're not a village hunter. It's up to her if she wants to go. She stares into your eyes for a moment, trying to see if you'll crack. You don't. "Why?" she suddenly asks, shaking her head in disbelief. Her eyebrows arch upward sympathetically, and the intense, forceful gaze in her eyes softens to something more akin to a plea. "Why do you do this? You are not of the village. We only met not so long ago!" [pc.isDK |The truth is, she's hot. You wouldn't go this far if you didn't think there wasn't some action in it for you at the end. And[pc.isVirgin | |, given your track record so far, ] you're probably right: Kailani is a single mom that's adopted her cousin's daughter. There are definitely some biological alarms going off inside of her right this second. If you did this for her, she'd probably put out on the spot. But if you told her that, it might put her off. Women tend not to appreciate it when you only do things for them so you can fuck them. So, you lie: you tell her you're doing it because, where you come from, helping others is the right thing to do. You may be a taminyk, but everybody hurts the same. |You didn't realize you needed an excuse to help somebody. Kailani's hurting: her parents went missing when she was young and she's been holding in that kind of angst all her life. Helping others when they're in a bad way like that is just the right thing to do, whether you're from a a place like Hawkethorne or if you're from a tribal vulperine village. (That, and, you have to admit, Kailani's awfully cute when she smiles...) ] Kailani's eyes widen and her jaw hangs slack. The fact that you'd go so far out of your way, and risk yourself, just because she needs the help and you're the only one to come to her aid... She stares at you with wide, unblinking, deep-blue eyes for a long moment, totally caught off-guard. She opens her mouth, hesitates, closes it, opens it again, and says nothing. Eventually, she regains her focus, and, with renewed conviction, she stands from her pile of grass, takes three steps towards her spear, and grabs it with a quick swing of her hand. "I will go to the cave where me met," she says, lifting the butt of her spear and pointing it toward you. "Wait a time, and then join me[party.solo | |. Alone ]." With her instructions made clear, she leaves the hut, her spear in hand, taking long strides as she goes. Although her pace is quick and forceful, you can tell that her tail is wagging way more than it needs to. After giving her a few minutes head-start, you get up and leave her hut. She wanted you to meet her at the cave where you two first met...
rows.translation: 你脸上带着自信的微笑，询问凯拉妮是否最近听说过关于你的名声的什么消息。据她所说，关于你“狩猎技巧”的传闻应该已经传开了；正是她说过“你的能力总会找到她”。 然而，凯拉妮并没有你这样的热情：她坐着，右腿搭在左膝上，脚踝搁在左膝上，靠在那一堆草和稻草上，用一种并不感兴趣的眼神看着你。她的双眼微微眯起，嘴唇紧紧地抿着。[party.solo | | 而你是独自完成了这一切，”她说，这话更像是一种陈述，而非疑问。 那些狡猾的猎手们总是至少三个人一组行动，有时人数还会更多。难道别人真的期望你独自击败他们所有人吗？ ] 凯拉尼长长地叹了口气，她的胸膛随着这一声叹息而剧烈起伏。她将头向后仰，望着小屋的天花板；可以看出，当她在思考接下来该做什么时，她的嘴角正向下弯曲。 “那本来就不应该是你去做的事情…… [pc.name]真是太糟糕了，”她沮丧地说道。 “这个…… ibulimo 村里的所有人都会阻止你。” 她给了你一个她认为根本不可能完成的任务，对吧？ “是的，”她平淡地回答道，既对这个问题感到恼火，也对自己的决定感到不满。“现在我终于知道你的能力了。你确实是个…… 暴食症 就像村里的其他猎人一样。如果你能抓到我们十五个，那么你就可以帮我去捕捉那头野兽了。 那么，问题出在哪里呢？你以为她需要帮助，你以为她会很高兴地知道你并不是那种毫无能力的外国人…… [pc.hisHer] 电铬币，在哪里 [pc.hisHer] 凯拉尼又叹了口气，双眼直直地望着天花板。她暂时忽略了你的问题，让这个问题在你们之间悬而未决。从她的眼神中，我能看出她心里已经有了答案…… 想要 本来她是愿意给的，但由于种种原因，她最终没能把东西交给对方。[pc.name]我的……”她缓缓说道，口中反复咀嚼着你的名字，就像在嚼口香糖一样。“我的…… 嗯……这个名称听起来有点特别吧。 以及 运费 他们被那个洞穴迷路了。洞穴里的野兽就是他们没有出现在这里的原因。我并不知道这些……但我 知道 这个……”她调整了自己的坐姿，向前倾身，以便更直接地与你对话。她的眉头紧锁，显得非常愤怒；眼睛瞪得大大的，瞳孔也缩小了——显然，一想到这件事，她就变得情绪激动起来。“这种事情也可能发生在我们身上。此时，你已经习惯了这种紧张刺激的氛围，也习惯了更高的风险。你可以帮助凯拉妮实现她一生都在追求的目标。你让她不得不承认，你的能力至少……嗯，至少足以让你在生存竞争中取得成功。 其他村里的猎人都没有足够的勇气陪她一起去，但你不是村里的猎人。是否要去，完全由她自己决定。 她凝视着你的眼睛，试图看你是否会动摇。但你没有。 为什么？”她突然问道，难以置信地摇了摇头。她的眉毛微微上扬，露出同情的神情，眼中那充满力量和坚定的目光也变得柔和起来，仿佛在恳求着什么。“你为什么要这么做？你又不是这个村子的人。 我们其实也是不久前才认识的！ [pc.isDK |事实上，她真的很性感。如果你不觉得最终自己也能有所收获，你是不会这么做到的。毕竟……[pc.isVirgin | |鉴于你迄今为止的表现， ] 你可能是对的：凯拉尼是一位单亲妈妈，她收养了自己表妹的女儿。此刻，她的内心肯定正在产生一些生理上的反应。如果你真的为她做了这件事，她很可能会当场情绪崩溃的。 但如果你告诉她这一点，反而可能会让她反感。女性通常不会欣赏你只是为了与她们发生关系才为她们做事。 所以，你就撒谎吧——告诉她你这么做是因为在你成长的环境中，帮助他人是理所应当的事情。 你或许就是那个人。 塔米尼克但每个人受到的伤害都是相同的。 |你之前根本没意识到，帮助别人其实需要一个理由或借口。凯拉尼现在很痛苦：她在小时候父母就失踪了，这一辈子她都在压抑着这种痛苦。当别人处于这样的困境中时，帮助他们才是正确的做法——无论你来自鹰棘镇这样的地方，还是某个部落村落。 （而且，你得承认，凯拉尼笑起来的时候真的超级可爱……） ] 凯拉妮的眼睛瞪得大大的，下巴都快掉下来了。你竟然不惜冒这样的风险，仅仅因为她需要帮助，而你又是唯一愿意伸出援手的人…… 她用那双深蓝色的眼睛紧紧地盯着你，好一会儿都没有眨眼，完全被这一幕惊呆了。 她张了张嘴，又犹豫了一下，然后又闭上嘴，再次张开嘴，却什么也没说。 最终，她恢复了专注，带着更加坚定的决心，从那堆草堆中站起身来，朝着自己的长矛走了三步，然后迅速伸手抓起了它。 我会去那个我们初次相遇的洞穴，”她说着，举起了手中的长矛，将其指向你的方向。“你等一会儿，然后再来找我吧。[party.solo | |. 独自一人 ]在明确了她的指示后，她手持长矛，大步离开了小屋。虽然她的步伐迅速而有力，但你可以看出，她的尾巴摇得实在有些过度了。 等她领先了几分钟后，你也起身离开了她的小屋。她希望你在你们初次相遇的那个洞穴与她会面……

Women tend not to appreciate it when you only do things for them so you can fuck them. So, you lie: you tell her you're doing it because, where you come from, helping others is the right thing to do. You may be a taminyk, but everybody hurts the same. |You didn't realize you needed an excuse to help somebody. Kailani's hurting: her parents went missing when she was young and she's been holding in that kind of angst all her life. Helping others when they're in a bad way like that is just the right thing to do, whether you're from a a place like Hawkethorne or if you're from a tribal vulperine village. (That, and, you have to admit, Kailani's awfully cute when she smiles...) ] Kailani's eyes widen and her jaw hangs slack. The fact that you'd go so far out of your way, and risk yourself, just because she needs the help and you're the only one to come to her aid... She stares at you with wide, unblinking, deep-blue eyes for a long moment, totally caught off-guard. She opens her mouth, hesitates, closes it, opens it again, and says nothing. Eventually, she regains her focus, and, with renewed conviction, she stands from her pile of grass, takes three steps towards her spear, and grabs it with a quick swing of her hand. "I will go to the cave where me met," she says, lifting the butt of her spear and pointing it toward you. "Wait a time, and then join me[party.solo | |. Alone ]." With her instructions made clear, she leaves the hut, her spear in hand, taking long strides as she goes. Although her pace is quick and forceful, you can tell that her tail is wagging way more than it needs to. After giving her a few minutes head-start, you get up and leave her hut. She wanted you to meet her at the cave where you two first met... "

rows.original: You stand in the middle of the road, where it curves around the mountain bend to your right, hugging the protruding cliff face. The dried, dead tree hangs above you as a landmark – and you're careful to make sure that none of its branches are pulled taut and that there are no hidden surprises waiting for you. But no: all is as it seems. No hidden traps; no tripwires for someone to bumble into. And, in particular, there's no Kailani. [party.solo | |She told you to come alone, though. Maybe she's nearby, and she's waiting for you to follow her instructions. You turn to [comp1.name][party.som | | | and [comp2.name] ] and tell [party.som | |[comp1.himHer] |them ] to wait on the road: whatever happens next, Kailani will only do it with you. [party.oneComp agnimitra arona atugia azyrran brienne brint cait etheryn kiyoko quintillus viviane |"I gotta say, [pc.name], this doesn't really sound like the best idea at face value," Agnimitra says, preening the feathers on her arms uncomfortably as she stares into the mouth of the cave. "But I guess this is your call. You only live once, am I right?" |"Man, I can't even come in to watch?" Arona pouts, adjusting the grip on her hammer as it sits on her shoulder. That's up to Kailani, and she seemed pretty adamant that only her and one other went into that cave, so... "Those fox people have no idea how to have fun," she snorts, the corner of her mouth crooking slightly in agitation. "Hell, if it were me, I'd go in there and break the neck of whatever's living in there by myself. None of this 'spotter' bullshit." She looks from the cave, then to you, nudging you with her arm as a confident smirk spreads across her lips. "Bring me back something, yeah? It just isn't a proper kill if there's no trophy!" |"You know I trust you, [pc.name], an' I know what you're capable of," Atugia says as she cautiously eyes the mouth of the cave. "Just... you know. It's just you an' that vulperine lady in there. Don't give me a reason to start huntin' whatever's in there myself." |Azyrran eyes the mouth of the cave, her nose scrunching up at the sight of it. "I don't like this," she says, more as a general statement than to you. [azzy.kdb |"This feels off, somehow." Does she not trust Kailani? "I don't think she's lying," Azzyran answers in a somewhat-roundabout way. "But that's not putting me at ease, either. If she's telling the truth, then whatever is in there has one-upped a village of hunters for at least two generations." She crosses her arms as she eyes you, then the cave, her finger tapping against her chitin. "Watch each other's backs in there." |"This feels off, somehow." Does she not trust Kailani? "I don't think she's lying," Azzyran answers in a somewhat-roundabout way. "But that's not putting me at ease, either. If she's telling the truth, then whatever is in there has one-upped a village of hunters for at least two generations." She crosses her arms as she eyes you, then the cave, her finger tapping against her chitin. "If I think for even a second that things are going south, I'm heading in there myself and dragging you both out, you got it?" |"[silly |The vibes are off. |I kinda get this tingly feeling from my spine to my butt when I look at it. ]" Does she not trust Kailani? "Oh, that cute little number?" she asks. "I trust her plenty. I just..." She pauses, chewing at nothing for a moment as she tries to put her words together. "I dunno. This feels gross and I don't like it, is all." ] |Brienne eyes the mouth of the cave; you watch her tail flick anxiously as she studies it. You ask her if she's fine with you going in with Kailani. "Oh, yeah, I'm not worried at all," she says, rolling her shoulders at the question, like it wasn't even one worth asking. "I know how you take care of yourself, [pc.name]. You can handle a dank cave. If I want to go in with you, it's because hunting a deadly beast like that sounds like an exciting time to me." Still, her mouth crooks a bit as she looks at the cave once more. She sighs in and out through her nose. "That said, Kailani has a little girl waiting for her back home. You make sure she gets back, alright?" |Brint eyes the mouth of the cave; you watch his tail flick anxiously as he studies it. You ask him if he's fine with you going in with Kailani. If I want to go in with you, it's because hunting a deadly beast like that sounds like an exciting time to me." Still, his mouth crooks a bit as he looks at the cave once more. He snorts. "That said, Kailani has a little girl waiting for her back home. You make sure she gets back, alright?" |Cait eyes the mouth of the cave nervously; her hands wring together and her tail wraps around her legs, its fur standing on end. "I don't like the look of this," she says, her voice crackling dryly. Her eyes keep glancing at the bones in front of the cave. "You're really going to go in there with just Kailani?" [pc.isDK |You agree that it's a dumb and reckless tradition, but, yeah. You're going to do something dumb and reckless. |You try to assure her that Kailani is an expert – she's the best hunter in the village (according to her). It may be a little reckless, but you'll have the best vulperine around to help you out. ] "Okay..." she says haltingly. She's not totally convinced. |Etheryn's eyes narrow as she investigates the mouth of the cave. She tugs on her [etheryn.weapon] as she looks it over, trying to find something. "I'm a bit familiar with animals," she says slowly, her teeth nibbling into her bottom lip as she frowns at the cave. "But this doesn't... this doesn't seem right." You ask her what she means. "Like... whatever's in there isn't totally... bestial," she tries to answer. "It might not just be an animal in there, [pc.name]. But I doubt it's human, either..." [pc.isDK |Well, that clears things up. |That... doesn't really clear things up for you, but you thank her for her input regardless. ] |Kiyoko folds her hands into the sleeves of her kimono, her head hung low and her eyes closed. "I think I can hear breathing in there," she says eventually. "There's definitely something in that cave." Her ears twitch and turn again. "There might be more than one." You'll be sure to pass that on to Kailani when you find her. |Quintillus shivers – for the first time since you had really entered the Windy Peaks. Whatever's getting to him, it isn't the cold. "I got a bad feeling about that cave, [pc.name]," he says, nodding towards the mouth of it. "Although, I guess all the bones in front of it ought to tell us more than enough, yeah?" He chuckles once at his own observation[pc.isDK |. You don't |, and you reciprocate, although the energy clearly isn't with either of you ]. "Look, just," he says haltingly, "stick with that fox lady. She knows what's up. Don't try being a hero." |Viviane crosses her arms protectively, turning away slightly from the mouth of the cave. "We could head back to my house and I could give you some enchantments to ensure your success, [pc.name]. You know, to make the odds as well in your favor as we can." While you appreciate the offer, Kailani gave you a task that she thought was impossible, and you still overcame it. If you could do that, then, surely, whatever's in that cave isn't going to provide a harder challenge. Viviane sighs, but nods her head in acceptance. "Alright," she says. "Bring me back some [viv.isDemon |entrails |fur, teeth, claws, anything like that ] to study, then." ] ] You step forward, towards the mouth of the cave, feeling the warm air from within billow towards you. That, combined with the structure of the cave's opening, makes it feel like the very earth itself has opened its mouth and is daring you to enter[party.som | |. [comp1.name] stands where you left [comp1.himHer], watching you leave |. [party.compNames] stand where you left them and watch you leave ][pc.cunningRange 0 75 |, but you're not dumb enough to go into that cave without Kailani by your side, and you doubt she would have gone ahead without you. Just as you approach the cave, a flattened mound of snow to your right begins to shuffle, then break and rise as something within it starts to stand. Rising from underneath the snow is Kailani, standing with all the grace and leisureliness of a person that buries themselves in snow the same way you pull the bedsheets off you when you get up in the morning. The snow clings to her fur and her paltry clothes, but she doesn't even brush any of it off, as if this were just a normal thing for her. In her right hand is her spear, gripped tightly, with the sharp end pointed in your direction. |, but you're not about to enter without Kailani– As you approach, you notice that there's a mound of snow just to your right, next to the opening to the cave. It's an obscure thing to note... but you also notice that the snow around it seems unnaturally silted upwards, as if it had been brushed into a pile. When you first met Kailani, she burst out of a snow mound just like this one... As if on cue, the snow breaks, then rises, as Kailani stands from underneath it with all the grace and leisureliness of a person that buries themselves in snow the same way you pull the bedsheets off you when you get up in the morning. The snow clings to her fur and her paltry clothes, but she doesn't even brush any of it off, as if this were just a normal thing for her. In her right hand is her spear, gripped tightly, with the sharp end pointed in your direction. ] "[party.solo |Are you done with what you need to do?" Kailani asks you, her eyes narrowed and her brow furrowed. She's deadly serious about this hunt – and how it could go poorly. You tell her that you are. |Have you said what you need to say?" Kailani asks, nodding back towards your companion[party.som | | |s ], and you tell her that you have. ] "Good." She turns her head to the cave's mouth, looking up at its ceiling; you two are close enough that you can see the roof of the cave, and the dirt clinging to its rocks and the few dangling roots of whatever weeds are growing from its top. "No thing has come in or out of this cave this day. We go quick, and we go hard. The kinbuna is ours." [party.has Kiyoko |Actually, before you start: your companion – the kitsune woman with long ears – she told you that she could hear more than one creature in the caves. She has really good ears, and you trust her judgment. After all, if you didn't, she probably wouldn't still be here with you. Kailani's face crinkles and her lips curl upward, almost in disgust. "The wrick kimna-wuute?" she asks under her breath, staring towards Kiyoko with an odd expression of conflicted disdain. But as soon as the expression starts, it stops. "I will keep that in mind," she says, more directly to you, as she turns and faces the cave. |Before you start, you were wondering: she's the best hunter in the village and all, but... according to what she just said, nobody and nothing has gone in or out of this cave all day. How can she be so sure that there's anything in there at all? "The bones are a good start," she says humorlessly as she motions to the piles of discarded bones lining the floor of the cave's entrance. "But if you still are not sure, try with your nose." She turns her head towards the cave and takes a long, exaggerated sniff, her nostrils opening up as the air passes through them. You do as she does and sniff as well[pc.ra lupine |... and sure enough, you smell something unusual. Something that doesn't quite smell like the damp rocks you'd expect a cave to smell like. "You know now, yes?" Kailani asks, recognizing the look in your eyes. "That is fur. |, but your nose isn't nearly as strong as hers: all you smell is the crisp, cold air of the mountain, and maybe a little bit of damp heat coming from deeper inside the cave. "You will smell it when we hunt," she assures. "It is fur. ] Breath. Waste that is stuck to their legs. That is the kill of their last hunt. That is the smell of a beast." She points her spear forward, the staff end pushing up against her forearm. "This is not just a beast den... the beast is there. All that I am as an ibulim is sure of it." ] She reaches toward you and grabs you by the wrist, suddenly and strongly yanking you beside her. "You will stay close," she says sternly, her voice lowered to a whisper. "You have skill. I know that now. But this is our first hunt. I do not know how you hunt, and you do not know how I hunt." She pauses – and you can see the hesitation in her eyes. You aren't a vulperine of the village. She's probably had tons of experience hunting with the others of her kind, but because none of them have the gumption to do what you're about to do, you're her only choice... and she's faltering. You look back into the cave; you can't see how far down it goes. A botched hunt could end poorly for you both. Kailani, however, steels herself first. She's here, and whether or not you two are prepared, you're the only chance she has at some closure. She crouches low, her hands against the drier floor of the cave's opening as she sidles her way forward, one step at a time, her spear at the ready. There's no going back. You ready your own [pc.weapon] and stay one tail-length of hers away from her body.

|不过，她其实是让你独自过来的。也许她就在附近，正在等着你按照她的指示行动。你转身…… [comp1.name][party.som | | | 以及 [comp2.name] ] 并告诉他们 [party.som | |[comp1.himHer] |他们 ] 无论未来会发生什么，凯拉妮只会和你一起面对。 [party.oneComp agnimitra arona atugia azyrran rows.original: You and Kailani stay crouched as you make your way deeper into the caves, trying to watch your footing as closely as you can and make as little noise as possible. Whatever's in this cave, it doesn't know that you two are here yet, and you both want to keep it that way. The light from the outside is starting to dim slightly, but not enough that you can't comfortably see a fair distance in front of yourself – every bend in the cave is getting darker and darker, but you can still make out the smaller details of the cave surrounding you. Suddenly, [pc.raMulti kitsune lupine catfolk batfolk harpy |you hear the sound of stone crackling against stone as something in the cave disturbs the area – something other than yourself |you hear the sound of stone crackling against stone as something in the cave disturbs the area – something other than yourself |you see something glint deeper inside the cave: something less natural than the quartz growing out of the walls |you see something glint deeper inside the cave: something less natural than the quartz growing out of the walls |you see something glint deeper inside the cave: something less natural than the quartz growing out of the walls |you can feel the air pressure in the cave suddenly shift, causing the finer hairs on your arms to stand on end ]. You're not alone. You gently place your hand on Kailani's shoulder, and she understands that as you trying to tell her to stop. Cautiously, you both peer around the next corner in the cave's winding, twisting tunnels. The pathway was already wide; around the next bend, it opens into a cavity that's unusually flat and stamped clean, with walls that look like they've almost been sanded smooth in some places. The floor of the cave is oddly tidy: not totally free of pebbles or debris, but also not nearly as messy as you'd expect a place as wild as a cave might be. A wicked, watery stench, like the cross between a skunk, a rotten fish, and a beached turtle, assaults your nose, and you fight to wretch or even exhale sharply, which would give away your position. Kailani, for her part, seems totally unperturbed by the smell. In the middle of the cavity is a particular creature that you've never seen before: a smaller, stout, bipedal thing, with grotesquely long arms and legs and walking with a gait that's far too wide to be natural. It walks about the cavity, inspecting one little cranny and flicking away a tiny pebble before moving to the next; every time it finds something worth picking up and inspecting, there's an odd, shrill, but fluid whistling sound, as if it's 'talking' to itself and appraising every find it makes. For as gangly as it is, it's also weirdly thin, looking like it'd weigh sixty pounds soaking wet, although it's difficult to truly tell how large it is: its whole body is covered in dark-brown hair, all its strands straightened and completely knotless with meticulous attention to detail. It's not like any animal you've ever seen before... but it's certainly not like any race you've ever met, either. It has arms and legs, and its general body shape is like yours or Kailani's, but it's... not. It's something else. You look to Kailani; you ask her with your eyes if this is the creature you two are hunting. She once described it as 'big[pc.heightRange 0 96 | |, maybe bigger than you ],' and this doesn't match the description. She lifts her nose and shakes her head... but she readies her spear regardless. Whatever it is she's after, it's deeper in the cave, and she intends to go through this thing to get to it. She looks at you and raises her free hand, extending three fingers upward. She closes one back into her fist, nodding her head as she does, counting down and making sure that you're following along with her timing. You weren't expecting that particular type of coordination from someone that didn't natively speak Belharan, but you're glad that she can. When her last finger closes into her fist, you and her lunge forward, your [pc.weapon] at the ready. You're as quiet as you can be – but the sound of two large hunters rapidly approaching causes the creature to turn towards you, its beady red eyes illuminating its flattened, hairy face in the comparatively dark light of the cave. If you want to make as little noise as possible, you need to kill this thing quickly!
rows.translation: 你和凯拉尼蹲着身子，继续向洞穴深处前进，尽量小心地留意脚步，同时尽量减少发出的声响。无论这个洞穴里藏着什么，它目前还不知道你们的存在，而你们也希望保持这种状态。 外面的轻型线已经开始变暗，但还不至于让你无法清楚地看到前方一定距离内的景象——洞穴中的每一个弯道都变得越来越昏暗，不过你仍然能够分辨出周围洞穴中的那些细微结构。 突然， [pc.raMulti kitsune lupine catfolk batfolk harpy |你听到了石头相互碰撞发出的声响，因为洞穴里的某个东西扰乱了这里的平静——那个东西显然不是你。 |你听到了石头相互碰撞发出的声响，因为洞穴里的某些东西扰乱了这片区域——那些东西显然不是你。 |你在洞穴的深处看到有东西在闪烁：那些东西与从洞壁上生长出来的石英相比，显然不属于自然形成的。 |你在洞穴的深处看到有东西在闪烁：那些东西与从洞壁上生长出来的石英相比，显然不属于自然形成的。 |你在洞穴的深处看到有东西在闪烁：那些东西与从洞壁上生长出来的石英相比，显然不属于自然形成的。 |你能感觉到洞穴内的气压突然发生了变化，这种变化使得你手臂上细小的毛发都竖了起来。 ]你并不孤单。你轻轻地将手放在凯拉尼的肩上，她明白你这是在试图让她停下来。 你们小心翼翼地绕过洞穴中那些蜿蜒曲折的隧道，向下一个拐角处望去。 这条小路已经相当宽阔了；在下一个拐弯处，它会通向一个异常平坦、整洁的空洞，洞壁在某些地方似乎还被打磨得十分轻型滑。洞穴的地面也出奇地整洁：虽然并非完全没有小石子或杂物，但也不像人们想象中那样杂乱无章。 一种邪恶而刺鼻的气味，仿佛是臭鼬、腐烂的鱼和搁浅的海龟混合在一起散发出来的，这种气味猛烈地冲击着你的鼻子，让你不得不强忍住恶心，甚至不得不急促地呼吸，生怕因此暴露自己的位置。而凯拉尼，对她来说，这种气味似乎完全没有任何影响，她似乎丝毫没有受到任何干扰。 在那个空洞的正中央，有一种你从未见过的生物：它体型较小，身材粗壮，是两足行走的生物，它的手臂和腿长得异常长，行走时的步幅宽得简直不像是自然生物该有的。它在空洞里四处走动，仔细检查每一个小角落，把那些小小的石子拨到一边，然后再继续前进；每当它找到值得捡起来仔细观察的东西时，就会发出一种奇怪而尖锐、但却连贯的哨声，仿佛它在自言自语，也在评价自己找到的每一样东西。 尽管它的体型看起来粗壮，但实际上却异常纤细，看起来就算完全浸湿了，重量也应该只有六十磅左右。不过，真正要判断它的大小其实并不容易：它的整个身体都覆盖着深棕色的毛发，每一根毛发都被精心打理得笔直无结，显示出主人为之付出的细心与耐心。 它与你见过的任何动物都不一样……但它也绝对不属于你曾经遇到的任何种族。它有手臂和腿，整体体型也和你们或凯拉尼相似，但它……并不是。它是一种完全不同的生物。 你看向凯拉尼，用眼神询问她：这就是你们一直在寻找的那种生物吗？她曾经描述过它“体型很大”。[pc.heightRange 0 96 | |也许比你还要大。 ]但这与描述不符。”她挺了挺鼻子，摇了摇头……但还是准备好了长矛。无论她想要什么，那一定藏在洞穴的更深处，而她决心要穿过这一切去找到它。 她看着你，抬起空闲的那只手，伸出三根手指向上。然后她把其中一根手指收回到拳头里，一边点头一边倒数，确保你在她的节奏下配合行动。你本来没指望一个不会说贝尔哈兰语的人能够做到这种协调性，但看到她真的做到了，你还是感到很高兴。 当她的最后一根手指握紧成拳时，你和她会同时向前冲去，你的…… [pc.weapon] 随时准备行动。你尽量保持安静，但这时，两个大型猎手迅速接近的声音让那只生物转向了你。在洞穴相对昏暗的轻型线中，它那闪着红轻型的眼睛让它那扁平而多毛的脸庞显得格外清晰。 如果你想尽量减少噪音，就必须尽快解决这个麻烦！
rows.raw: " You and Kailani stay crouched as you make your way deeper into the caves, trying to watch your footing as closely as you can and make as little noise as possible. Whatever's in this cave, it doesn't know that you two are here yet, and you both want to keep it that way. The light from the outside is starting to dim slightly, but not enough that you can't comfortably see a fair distance in front of yourself – every bend in the cave is getting darker and darker, but you can still make out the smaller details of the cave surrounding you. Suddenly, [pc.raMulti kitsune lupine catfolk batfolk harpy |you hear the sound of stone crackling against stone as something in the cave disturbs the area – something other than yourself |you hear the sound of stone crackling against stone as something in the cave disturbs the area – something other than yourself |you see something glint deeper inside the cave: something less natural than the quartz growing out of the walls |you see something glint deeper inside the cave: something less natural than the quartz growing out of the walls |you see something glint deeper inside the cave: something less natural than the quartz growing out of the walls |you can feel the air pressure in the cave suddenly shift, causing the finer hairs on your arms to stand on end ]. You're not alone. You gently place your hand on Kailani's shoulder, and she understands that as you trying to tell her to stop. Cautiously, you both peer around the next corner in the cave's winding, twisting tunnels. The pathway was already wide; around the next bend, it opens into a cavity that's unusually flat and stamped clean, with walls that look like they've almost been sanded smooth in some places. The floor of the cave is oddly tidy: not totally free of pebbles or debris, but also not nearly as messy as you'd expect a place as wild as a cave might be. A wicked, watery stench, like the cross between a skunk, a rotten fish, and a beached turtle, assaults your nose, and you fight to wretch or even exhale sharply, which would give away your position. Kailani, for her part, seems totally unperturbed by the smell. In the middle of the cavity is a particular creature that you've never seen before: a smaller, stout, bipedal thing, with grotesquely long arms and legs and walking with a gait that's far too wide to be natural. It walks about the cavity, inspecting one little cranny and flicking away a tiny pebble before moving to the next; every time it finds something worth picking up and inspecting, there's an odd, shrill, but fluid whistling sound, as if it's 'talking' to itself and appraising every find it makes. For as gangly as it is, it's also weirdly thin, looking like it'd weigh sixty pounds soaking wet, although it's difficult to truly tell how large it is: its whole body is covered in dark-brown hair, all its strands straightened and completely knotless with meticulous attention to detail. It's not like any animal you've ever seen before... but it's certainly not like any race you've ever met, either. It has arms and legs, and its general body shape is like yours or Kailani's, but it's... not. It's something else. You look to Kailani; you ask her with your eyes if this is the creature you two are hunting. She once described it as 'big[pc.heightRange 0 96 | |, maybe bigger than you ],' and this doesn't match the description. She lifts her nose and shakes her head... but she readies her spear regardless. Whatever it is she's after, it's deeper in the cave, and she intends to go through this thing to get to it. She looks at you and raises her free hand, extending three fingers upward. She closes one back into her fist, nodding her head as she does, counting down and making sure that you're following along with her timing. You weren't expecting that particular type of coordination from someone that didn't natively speak Belharan, but you're glad that she can. When her last finger closes into her fist, you and her lunge forward, your [pc.weapon] at the ready. You're as quiet as you can be – but the sound of two large hunters rapidly approaching causes the creature to turn towards you, its beady red eyes illuminating its flattened, hairy face in the comparatively dark light of the cave. If you want to make as little noise as possible, you need to kill this thing quickly!"

rows.original:
With ruthless efficiency, the beast – whatever it is, or was – lies dead in a heap on the floor of the cave. Even with you getting a more up-close look at it, you can barely discern where its body ends and where its arms and legs begin. The massive amount of hair sprouting all over its body obscures its wounds and not only prevents you from getting a better look at whatever it is, but also keeps the blood from its injuries from seeping out. And the stench isn't getting better...
 
    Kailani, however, pays her latest kill no attention whatsoever. She grips her spear in her right hand, halfway down its pole, and gets back into the crouched position she was in earlier. She waves you forward, and you follow suit, getting back into position right beside her.
rows.translation: 以极其残忍且高效的方式，那个怪物——无论它究竟是什么——已经死在洞穴的地板上，成一堆无生命的残骸。即使你凑近仔细观察，也几乎无法分辨它的身体在哪里结束，而它的手臂和腿又从哪里开始。 它身上长出的大量毛发遮住了它的伤口，不仅让你无法清楚地看到那些伤口的具体情况，还阻碍了伤口处血液的流出。更何况，那股恶臭也越来越难闻了。然而，凯拉尼完全没有在意自己刚刚完成的这次击杀。她用右手握住长矛，将矛柄握在中间位置，然后重新摆出刚才那蹲伏的姿势。她示意你向前走，你便照做了，重新站在她的身边。

The massive amount of hair sprouting all over its body obscures its wounds and not only prevents you from getting a better look at whatever it is, but also keeps the blood from its injuries from seeping out.     Kailani, however, pays her latest kill no attention whatsoever. She grips her spear in her right hand, halfway down its pole, and gets back into the crouched position she was in earlier. She waves you forward, and you follow suit, getting back into position right beside her."

rows.original: The little bastard is slipperier than he looks! Even with you and Kailani together, it manages to evade you both long enough to slip out of your reach, and off it runs deeper into the cave, making more of those high-pitched whistles as it runs. It dashes away with a wide, awkward stumble, like a deer galloping sideways, as its panicked whistling bounces off the walls and echoes deeper into the cave. Kailani growls in frustration, her breath coming out as a throaty rasp. She stamps the butt end of her spear against the floor of the cave. "Our kinbuna is no more," she says bitingly as she readies her spear into an attacking stance: both hands gripped tightly onto the shaft, with the pointed end facing forward. "Our hunt is now... loud." You ask her if it isn't better to retreat. Whatever's in there will be expecting you now. "No!" she answers bitingly, shaking her head hard enough to cause her long, messy hair to sway. "The hunt is smart; it will leave this cave. I will need to find it again; it would be too long, and it may take more vulps." She turns her head to you, her deep blue eyes piercing into you with a determined, bordering on angry, stare. "The wait is done. We hunt now!" You and Kailani may not have the advantage anymore, but no matter what, she's determined to see this through. You're in it for good now!
rows.translation: 那个小混蛋比看上去要狡猾得多！就算你和凯拉尼在一起，它也能设法躲开你们，然后迅速跑进洞穴的深处，一边跑一边发出那些高亢的哨声。 它以一种笨拙而慌张的姿态冲了出去，就像一只侧着身子奔跑的鹿一样，它那惊慌的鸣叫声在洞壁上回荡，声音越来越远，传入了洞穴的深处。 凯拉尼恼怒地低吼着，她的呼吸声听起来像是一种沙哑的嘶吼。 她将长矛的尾部敲在洞穴的地板上，说道：“我们的…… 金分纳 已经不行了，”她咬牙说道，同时将长矛调整到攻击姿态：双手部紧紧握住矛柄，尖锐的矛头朝前。“我们的行动现在……已经引起了太多注意。” 你问她，撤退不是更好的选择吗？ 里面的一切现在应该都在等着你了吧。 “不！”她厉声回答，用力摇头，导致她那又长又乱的头发随之摆动。“那个猎物很聪明，它会离开这个洞穴的。我必须重新找到它；否则会花费太长时间，也许还需要其他狼来帮忙。她转过头看着你，那深蓝色的眼睛里充满坚定的目光，几乎带着一丝愤怒。“等待已经结束了。我们现在开始狩猎吧。 现在你和凯拉妮可能已经不再处于有利地位了，但无论如何，她都决心要把这件事完成。现在，你已经彻底卷入其中了！

rows.original:
You stay one step behind Kailani, running your hand along the cool, smooth walls of the cave. Up ahead is a light source illuminating the walls and guiding you deeper, and you can hear the familiar crackling of fire just around the next corner. It's a wonder that these caves have the oxygen to sustain a fire and that the place isn't flooded with smoke.

    Kailani crouches down, her spear at ease in her right hand as she motions you to stop. There's one last corner for you two to round before you're right on top of whatever it is you're hunting (at least, you presume, given the sounds and lights). She peers just around the bend of the last tunnel, careful not to reveal too much of herself, and once she's confident that your vantage point is concealed, she waves you ahead, but slowly.
    
    As quietly as you can, you crawl behind Kailani to get a look at what it is she's seeing. The passageway opens up into another cavity, not unlike the one from before with the smaller creature, but this one is much larger: easily the size of the Frost Hound Tavern back in Hawkethorne, if not a little larger. Like before, the walls have been kept unnaturally clean and smooth; the walls are decorated with dying roots and plant vines, although they look like they've been placed there intentionally and meticulously, trying to get the decor just right. In the center of the cave is a small bonfire, barely large enough to warm a room, and the reason why the cave hasn't been flooded with smoke so far is because the cavity is porous, with offshoots leading into other cave networks dotting the place all over.
    
    While the walls have been kept clean, the floors are... haphazard. There are clean, trampled-smooth spots all over, but in one corner of the room is a pile of assorted bones, not unlike the ones laying out in front of the cave's mouth, although some of them look like they've been placed specifically – almost like they were trophies, something to admire.
    
    The stench from the previous cavity has gotten much worse deeper into the caves you've gone, and it's not difficult to see why – in this last room of the cave, there's a whole family of the weird, short, overly hairy creatures, but one of them in particular really stands out: one of them is like the others, but it's tall as hell[pc.heightRange 0 96
        |
        |, roughly around your own immense height
    ]; it's just as hairy as the smaller ones, but it's hair is much darker in brown hue, and it's got arms and legs like it's stuffed cinder bricks underneath its hair; and while the others have beady, bioluminescent red eyes, this one has all white eyes going straight into a pupil the size of a coin, with no colored iris. And there's something else to it as well: streaks of odd, unhealthy colors course through its fur, ranging from greens to whites. The influence of the corruption purveying the land has run deep through this beast.
    
    Kailani's fur bristles at the sight of it. That's it; that's the thing she's been hunting.
    
    [flags.KAILANI_MON 1
        |The creatures of the cave mill about in the cave, each of them taking to some different form of task: one of the smaller ones tends to the fire, poking at it with small, spindly sticks and occasionally adding more to its fuel; another two groom the large one, poking through its thick hair in search of gnats and ticks, and once they find one, they flick it straight into the fire. None of them have any idea that you're there – you and Kailani are quiet enough that if you lunged right now, you'd have an easy advantage on them all.
        
        You look to Kailani: this is her hunt, and for all your skill, this sort of animal-trapping isn't your expertise. Although, it's hard to really say that any of those things down there are 'animals.' They're not quite human, or any other bipedal race that you've met or known, but they're not quite animals, either...
        
        Kailani watches them all intently, her eyes scrunched in concentration. She's not just looking at the beasts down there: she's looking all over the caves, from the porous holes to the decorative, rotting vines, to her own vantage point just a few feet up a curved slope from where the beasts are. You're waiting on her word, or for her to wave her hand or for her to motion for you to back up, or advance, or anything, but she's really taking her time with strategizing your approach.
        
        Finally, she crinkles her nose in frustration and lets out a short sigh. She grips her spear in her right hand and looks to you, checking to make sure that you're as ready as she is. She nods at you, and you nod to her, readying your own [pc.weapon] in hand – although she clearly doesn't like to take the fast-and-furious approach, there aren't a lot of options available to either of you without trying to work your way through the cave networks for a different approach, and even then, who's to say it'd be better?
        
        She raises her hand with three fingers raised, counting down as she had last time. This is it: it's you and Kailani against whatever this beast is. The fact that it exists at all, after all of Kailani's failed attempts to capture it, is validating enough – now all you need to do is get the kill.
        
        She closes her fingers, one after the other, and once she makes a fist, you both lunge forward, your weapons pointed towards the now-very-surprised beast.
        |The shrill whistling of the panicked, hairy little thing from earlier in the cave rings against the cavity's walls with such pitch and volume that it's starting to hurt your ears, and when it reaches its friend and starts telling them what's happened, they all start to get agitated and alert as well. The giant one was sitting on its haunches and warming itself by the little fire they had going; once it understands that something is amiss, it slaps the rocky floor hard enough that you can feel the vibration from where you are, and it gets up onto its massive legs and feet, ready for anything.
        
        You look to Kailani, awaiting her instruction. Whatever advantage you had is long lost, and, from the furrow in her brow and the readjusting grip on her spear, she looks like she might be considering a retreat. Although the beasts are agitated, they haven't spotted you two yet – although that's only a matter of time. She needs to make a decision, and quickly.
        
        Tightly closing her eyes and firmly gripping onto her spear, she looks to you, her eyes narrowed with determination. This thing is wily and cunning; it's evaded her traps up until this point, and if she lets this opportunity go, there's no telling whether or not she'll ever get another opportunity like this.
        
        She nods to you and lifts her spear, asking you if you're ready. You're here, and it's there: you're as ready as you're going to be. You nod back, your own [pc.weapon] at the ready.
        
        With a deep breath, Kailani vaults around the cover of your hiding spot, her spear raised above her head as she bellows a war cry. The beasts, all already alert and ready, whip towards you both as you charge towards them. The only way out of the cave is directly behind you: at the very least, you have them cornered. You'll have to make the most out of every advantage you can get!
    ]
rows.translation:
你紧随凯拉尼的足部步，手触着洞穴中冰冷而轻型滑的墙壁。前方有轻型源照亮着墙壁，指引着你继续前进，而就在下一个拐角处，你听到了那熟悉的火焰噼啪声。真是不可思议——这些洞穴里竟然有足够的氧气来维持火焰的燃烧，而且这个地方也没有被浓烟笼罩。

    凯拉尼蹲了下来，右手稳稳地握着长矛，示意你停下来。在你们最终到达正在追逐的目标之前，还有最后一个拐角需要绕过去。根据那些声音和轻型线，你们应该已经离目标很近了。她小心翼翼地窥视着最后一个隧道的拐角处，确保自己不会暴露太多，等到确认你们的位置已经隐蔽好后，她才缓缓地示意你们继续前进。
    
    你尽量悄无声息地爬到凯拉妮身后，想看看她在看什么。通道通向另一个空腔，和之前那个有小型生物的空腔很相似，但这个空腔要大得多：至少有鹰棘镇镇上“霜猎犬酒馆”那么大，甚至可能还要更大一些。 和以前一样，这些墙壁被保养得异常干净、轻型滑；墙上装饰着那些快要枯死的根茎和藤蔓，不过看起来这些装饰品是被人刻意且精心地摆放在那里的，似乎人们一直在努力让这种装饰效果达到完美。 洞穴的中心有一堆小篝火，其规模甚至连一个房间都难以温暖。而之所以洞穴至今还没有被浓烟充满，是因为这个洞腔结构多孔，有许多分支通道通向其他洞穴网络，这些分支遍布整个洞穴区域。
    
    虽然墙壁保持得非常干净，但地板却显得杂乱无章。到处都是被踩得平整的干净区域，但在房间的一个角落里，却堆着一堆各式各样的骨头，这些骨头与洞穴入口处摆放的那些骨头颇为相似——只不过其中有些骨头看起来似乎是被特意摆放好的，几乎就像是一些战利品，值得人们欣赏。
    
    当你继续深入洞穴时，之前那个洞穴里散发出来的恶臭变得愈发浓烈了。其实原因也很明显——在这个洞穴的最后一个房间里，有一整群外形怪异、身材矮小且毛发浓密的生物，而其中有一只尤其引人注目：它和其他同类看起来没什么不同，但它的个头却高得离谱。[pc.heightRange 0 96
        |
        |大致相当于你自己的身高吧
    ]它的毛发和那些较小的生物一样浓密，但颜色要深得多，呈棕褐色。在它的毛发下面，似乎藏着一些像填充过的煤砖一样的东西，因此它才拥有手臂和腿。而其他那些生物都长着发轻型的红色眼睛，但这只生物的眼睛却是纯白色的，瞳孔大得像一枚硬币，根本没有彩色的虹膜。 而且还有其他一些异常之处：它的毛皮上分布着一些奇怪的、不健康的颜色，从绿色到白色都有。这片土地上弥漫的腐朽气息已经深深地影响了这种生物。

看到这一幕，凯拉尼的毛皮不由得竖了起来。 就是这个；这就是她一直在寻找的东西。
    
    [flags.KAILANI_MON 1
        |洞穴里的生物们在洞中忙碌着，每一只都承担着不同的任务：其中一些体型较小的生物负责照看火堆，它们用细长的小棍子不断拨动火焰，偶尔还会添加一些燃料；另外两只则负责清理那只体型较大的生物，它们仔细地梳理它浓密的毛发，寻找蚊虫和蜱虫，一旦发现这些害虫，就会立刻将它们扔进火里。 他们当中没有人知道你的存在——你和凯拉尼行动得如此隐秘，以至于如果你现在突然出手，绝对能够轻松取得优势。
        
        你望向凯拉尼：这是她的狩猎行动，尽管你技艺高超，但这种设陷阱捕捉动物的方法并不是你的强项。不过，说实话，那些生物根本算不上“动物”……它们既不完全是人类，也不属于你曾经遇到过的任何其他两足生物种族，但同时，它们也确实算不上动物……
        
        凯拉尼全神贯注地观察着他们，她的目光紧紧地锁定在那些野兽身上。她关注的不仅仅是地下的那些野兽，而是整个洞穴——从那些多孔的洞穴壁，到那些装饰性的、已经腐烂的藤蔓，再到她自己所处的位置——这个位于距离那些野兽几英尺高的弯曲斜坡上。你们都在等待她的指令，等待她挥挥手，或者做出某个手势，告诉你们是该后退、前进，还是该采取其他行动。但实际上，她正在仔细地思考该如何制定你们的进攻策略。
        
        最后，她沮丧地皱了皱鼻子，轻轻叹了口气。她用右手握住长矛，看着你，确认你也已经准备好了。她向你点了点头，你也回应了她一个点头，然后也做好了准备。 [pc.weapon] 目前来说——虽然她显然不喜欢采取那种激进的方式，但对于你们双方来说，如果不尝试通过洞穴网络寻找其他的解决方法，其实也没有太多其他选择。而且，即便这样做了，谁又能保证那种方法会更好呢？
        
        她举起手，伸出三根手指，像上次那样开始倒计时。就是现在了：你和凯拉妮必须联手对抗这个怪物。毕竟，在凯拉妮多次尝试捕捉它却都以失败告终之后，这个怪物的存在本身就已经说明了它的危险性——现在你们要做的，就是把它消灭掉。
        
        她逐个弯曲手指，当她的拳头终于握紧时，你们俩同时向前冲去，手中的武器都指向了那只此刻显得极为惊慌的野兽。
        |早些时候在洞穴里出现的那个惊慌失措、浑身长满毛的小生物，它那尖锐的鸣叫声在洞壁间回荡，音调高亢、音量巨大，简直让人耳朵都快疼起来了。当它找到它的同伴们，把发生的事情告诉它们时，那些同伴们也都开始变得焦躁不安、警觉起来。 那只巨大的生物正盘坐在地上，借着他们生起的小火取暖；一旦它察觉到有什么不对劲，就会用它那强有力的爪子猛烈地拍打岩石地面，以至于你在远处就能感受到震动。然后它就会站起身来，用它那粗壮的腿足部准备应对任何可能发生的情况。
        
        你望向凯拉妮，等待她的指示。你原本拥有的任何优势早已消失无踪，而从她紧锁的眉头以及重新握紧长矛的动作来看，她似乎正在考虑是否应该撤退。虽然那些野兽已经变得焦躁不安，但它们还没有发现你们两个——不过这只不过是时间问题罢了。她必须尽快做出决定。
        
        她紧紧闭上双眼，双手牢牢握住长矛，目轻型坚定地注视着你。这个敌人狡猾异常，至今一直躲过了她的陷阱；如果她错过了这次机会，恐怕再也不会有这样的机会出现了。
        
        她向你点了点头，然后举起了长矛，询问你是否准备好了。你已经到了这里，目标也就在眼前——你已经做好了所有的准备。你也点了点头，表示自己确实已经准备好了。 [pc.weapon] 做好准备。

凯拉尼深吸一口气，从藏身处的掩体后冲了出来，长矛高举在头顶，同时发出一声战斗呐喊。那些早已处于警戒状态的野兽在你们冲向它们的同时也迅速向你们扑来。洞穴的唯一出口就在你们的身后——至少，你们已经把它们逼入了绝境。你们必须充分利用一切可用的优势！
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    You stay one step behind Kailani, running your hand along the cool, smooth walls of the cave. Up ahead is a light source illuminating the walls and guiding you deeper, and you can hear the familiar crackling of fire just around the next corner. It's a wonder that these caves have the oxygen to sustain a fire and that the place isn't flooded with smoke.

    Kailani crouches down, her spear at ease in her right hand as she motions you to stop. There's one last corner for you two to round before you're right on top of whatever it is you're hunting (at least, you presume, given the sounds and lights). She peers just around the bend of the last tunnel, careful not to reveal too much of herself, and once she's confident that your vantage point is concealed, she waves you ahead, but slowly.
    
    As quietly as you can, you crawl behind Kailani to get a look at what it is she's seeing. The passageway opens up into another cavity, not unlike the one from before with the smaller creature, but this one is much larger: easily the size of the Frost Hound Tavern back in Hawkethorne, if not a little larger. Like before, the walls have been kept unnaturally clean and smooth; the walls are decorated with dying roots and plant vines, although they look like they've been placed there intentionally and meticulously, trying to get the decor just right. In the center of the cave is a small bonfire, barely large enough to warm a room, and the reason why the cave hasn't been flooded with smoke so far is because the cavity is porous, with offshoots leading into other cave networks dotting the place all over.
    
    While the walls have been kept clean, the floors are... haphazard. There are clean, trampled-smooth spots all over, but in one corner of the room is a pile of assorted bones, not unlike the ones laying out in front of the cave's mouth, although some of them look like they've been placed specifically – almost like they were trophies, something to admire.
    
    The stench from the previous cavity has gotten much worse deeper into the caves you've gone, and it's not difficult to see why – in this last room of the cave, there's a whole family of the weird, short, overly hairy creatures, but one of them in particular really stands out: one of them is like the others, but it's tall as hell[pc.heightRange 0 96
        |
        |, roughly around your own immense height
    ]; it's just as hairy as the smaller ones, but it's hair is much darker in brown hue, and it's got arms and legs like it's stuffed cinder bricks underneath its hair; and while the others have beady, bioluminescent red eyes, this one has all white eyes going straight into a pupil the size of a coin, with no colored iris. And there's something else to it as well: streaks of odd, unhealthy colors course through its fur, ranging from greens to whites. The influence of the corruption purveying the land has run deep through this beast.
    
    Kailani's fur bristles at the sight of it. That's it; that's the thing she's been hunting.
    
    [flags.KAILANI_MON 1
        |The creatures of the cave mill about in the cave, each of them taking to some different form of task: one of the smaller ones tends to the fire, poking at it with small, spindly sticks and occasionally adding more to its fuel; another two groom the large one, poking through its thick hair in search of gnats and ticks, and once they find one, they flick it straight into the fire. None of them have any idea that you're there – you and Kailani are quiet enough that if you lunged right now, you'd have an easy advantage on them all.
        
        You look to Kailani: this is her hunt, and for all your skill, this sort of animal-trapping isn't your expertise. Although, it's hard to really say that any of those things down there are 'animals.' They're not quite human, or any other bipedal race that you've met or known, but they're not quite animals, either...
        
        Kailani watches them all intently, her eyes scrunched in concentration. She's not just looking at the beasts down there: she's looking all over the caves, from the porous holes to the decorative, rotting vines, to her own vantage point just a few feet up a curved slope from where the beasts are. You're waiting on her word, or for her to wave her hand or for her to motion for you to back up, or advance, or anything, but she's really taking her time with strategizing your approach.
        
        Finally, she crinkles her nose in frustration and lets out a short sigh. She grips her spear in her right hand and looks to you, checking to make sure that you're as ready as she is. She nods at you, and you nod to her, readying your own [pc.weapon] in hand – although she clearly doesn't like to take the fast-and-furious approach, there aren't a lot of options available to either of you without trying to work your way through the cave networks for a different approach, and even then, who's to say it'd be better?
        
        She raises her hand with three fingers raised, counting down as she had last time. This is it: it's you and Kailani against whatever this beast is. The fact that it exists at all, after all of Kailani's failed attempts to capture it, is validating enough – now all you need to do is get the kill.
        
        She closes her fingers, one after the other, and once she makes a fist, you both lunge forward, your weapons pointed towards the now-very-surprised beast.
        |The shrill whistling of the panicked, hairy little thing from earlier in the cave rings against the cavity's walls with such pitch and volume that it's starting to hurt your ears, and when it reaches its friend and starts telling them what's happened, they all start to get agitated and alert as well. The giant one was sitting on its haunches and warming itself by the little fire they had going; once it understands that something is amiss, it slaps the rocky floor hard enough that you can feel the vibration from where you are, and it gets up onto its massive legs and feet, ready for anything.
        
        You look to Kailani, awaiting her instruction. Whatever advantage you had is long lost, and, from the furrow in her brow and the readjusting grip on her spear, she looks like she might be considering a retreat. Although the beasts are agitated, they haven't spotted you two yet – although that's only a matter of time. She needs to make a decision, and quickly.
        
        Tightly closing her eyes and firmly gripping onto her spear, she looks to you, her eyes narrowed with determination. This thing is wily and cunning; it's evaded her traps up until this point, and if she lets this opportunity go, there's no telling whether or not she'll ever get another opportunity like this.
        
        She nods to you and lifts her spear, asking you if you're ready. You're here, and it's there: you're as ready as you're going to be. You nod back, your own [pc.weapon] at the ready.
        
        With a deep breath, Kailani vaults around the cover of your hiding spot, her spear raised above her head as she bellows a war cry. The beasts, all already alert and ready, whip towards you both as you charge towards them. The only way out of the cave is directly behind you: at the very least, you have them cornered. You'll have to make the most out of every advantage you can get!
    ]"

rows.original: Ten years later... Your name is Ibulim Inaya. You've lived in the vulperine village of the windy mountain all your life. You're twenty years old. Your life's been... pretty lonely for you. Your mom died giving birth to your sister, and your sister didn't make it past her first night. Your father left you the next day, so grief-stricken that he couldn't handle the pressure, and he simply walked out on you (or so you've been told). From the time you were three, you were raised by your cousin, Kailani, until you were ten – when she went out hunting one day with a taminyk, a foreigner, and they both disappeared, never to be heard from again. You've never formed a connection with anyone ever since. Why bother? Being with someone only leads to heartache. You're better than your father and you're better than Kailani, and you've gotten to this point by yourself. Kailani was once hailed as the greatest hunter in the village, and you've surpassed her on your own grit and skill: you've never hunted with a party, and every kill you've ever made is your own. You are the greatest ibulim in the history of the village. Still... there's a local legend about the caves dotting the cap of the mountain. One of them is lined with bones, and although they're all from animals, typically big game like moose, you've been told all your life to stay away from them. Something obviously lives in there, and whatever it is, it's large, strong, and cunning enough to evade your village of hunters for generations. Not even Kailani could prove that it existed. But you can. You're Ibulim Inaya. You're better than Kailani ever was. Some of the stories you've heard are that Kailani and her taminyk were last spotted in the area before they vanished forever. The implication, obviously, being that they went into the cave and then were hunted themselves – or, perhaps, whatever was in the cave came out. Every time you set a trap, no matter how strong it is, it's always either ignored completely, or, the few times it is tripped, it's been torn apart, unable to contain whatever's tripping them. The most you've been able to do is prove that it exists, something that Kailani struggled to do. The only recourse, then, is direct. To go into that cave and hunt whatever's in there with your own hands. If you can kill the creature inside that cave and bring its head home, you'll finally prove to the others that you're the best there ever was, and you did it all by yourself. You'll finally prove that you're better than Kailani and everyone can finally stop comparing you to her, and they can finally stop telling you to 'not make the same mistakes she made.' In your right hand is your spear, hand-crafted with a sharpened tip and leathers that you had tanned and dyed brown, yellow, and green. Like everything you've done in life, you made this spear yourself, and it's your most valuable hunting tool – and it's all that you need. Fearlessly, you make your way into the cave. Today's the day you do what Kailani couldn't.
rows.translation: 十年后…… 你的名字是伊布利姆·伊纳亚。你一生都生活在那座风声呼啸的山上的狐狸村中，现在你二十岁了。 对你来说，这一生……相当孤独。你的母亲在生下你妹妹的时候去世了，而你妹妹也在出生后的第一个夜晚就夭折了。 你的父亲在第二天就离开了你，他悲痛得无法承受这种压力，于是就这样抛弃了你（至少你是这么听说的）。从你三岁起，就是你的表姐凯拉尼在抚养你，直到你十岁那年——那天她带着你出去打猎…… 塔米尼克一个外国人，然后他们俩都消失了，从此再没有任何消息。 从那以后，你再也没有与任何人建立起深厚的感情。何必呢？与人交往只会带来痛苦。你比你父亲更优秀，也比凯拉尼更出色，这一切都是你靠自己努力取得的。凯拉尼曾经被誉为村里最出色的猎人，但凭借自己的毅力和技巧，你已经超越了她——你从未与他人合作进行狩猎，每一次猎杀都靠你自己完成。你才是最出色的那个人。 暴食症 在这个村庄的历史中，确实存在着关于遍布在山顶那些洞穴的传说。其中有一个洞穴里布满了骨头，虽然那些骨头都来自动物，通常是像麋鹿这样的大型猎物，但人们从小就被教导要远离那些洞穴。 显然，那里有某种生物居住着。不管那是什么，它体型庞大、力量强大，而且狡猾到足以让你们的猎人们几代人都无法捕捉到它。就连凯拉尼也无法证明它的存在。 但是你可以做到。因为你就是伊布利姆·伊纳亚。 你比凯拉妮还要优秀。 有些人传说，凯拉妮和她…… 塔米尼克 人们最后一次在那个地区看到它们，之后它们就永远消失了。显然，这意味着它们进入了洞穴，然后遭到了猎杀——或者，也许洞穴里有什么东西把它们赶走了。每次你设置陷阱，无论那些陷阱有多厉害，它们要么被完全忽视，要么在极少数情况下…… 是 它已经支离破碎，再也无法阻挡那些导致它们崩溃的因素了。你们所能做的，最多也就是证明它的存在——而就连凯拉尼，也曾经为此陷入困境。 那么，唯一的办法就是直接行动。走进那个洞穴，亲手部抓住里面那些东西。 如果你能杀死那个洞穴里的怪物，并把它的头带回家，你就终于能够向所有人证明，你是迄今为止最出色的那个人，而且这一切都是你独自完成的。你将最终证明自己比凯拉尼更优秀，这样大家就再也不会把你和她相提并论了，也不会再劝你“不要重蹈她的覆辙”了。你的右手部握着这支长矛，它是你亲手部制作的——矛头经过精心打磨，矛身则由你鞣制并染成棕色、黄色和绿色的皮革制成。就像你人生中做过的每一件事一样，这支长矛也是你亲自打造的，它是你最珍贵的狩猎工具，也是你进行狩猎时所需要的全部装备。 你毫无畏惧地走进了洞穴。今天，就是你完成凯拉妮未能做到的事情的日子。

rows.original: With that final blow, you and Kailani stand alone in the cavity, having come out victorious. [flags.KAILANI_MON 1 |Although it may have been a cheap shot to open with, it was still a hard-fought battle, and you needed every advantage you could get. Hunting isn't about fairness – it's about survival, or, in this case, honor. Kailani has |Even with your disadvantage at the start – your targets were aware of you, and they outnumbered you nearly three to one – you and Kailani proved that you two are above and beyond what an ibulim of the vulperine village is expected to do. With this, Kailani's honor is assured, not only with the village, but with herself. She's ] finally gotten the hunt that she was looking for. You stand, panting as the adrenaline slowly starts to wear through your body, surveying the floor of the cavity you're in. The dim light of the little bonfire is nearly out; you don't have a lot of time left before it extinguishes, and there isn't a lot of material left in the cave for you to feed it to keep going. Still, [party.comp Arona Viviane |there's more than enough time to pull out a few teeth or something – Arona wanted a trophy, and short of you chopping off the whole head (which would definitely [arona.isDom |earn you some hot orc dick |get you laid ]), this ought to be plenty[party.has Viviane |. The only thing you're really finding is bones and a bad stench. You'll need a deep bath after this. ] Kailani, though, is oddly still and stoic, standing over the bones of the creatures that had been brought down and probably consumed in this part of the cave. Her grip on her spear is tight enough to make the white fur on her knuckles stand on end. Her tail droops listlessly behind her legs, and her breathing is still and steady through her nose. You peer over her shoulder, expecting only to find a pile of miscellaneous bones, from femurs to ribs to maybe a misshapen skull or two. And that's mostly what you find... But among the debris, jutting somewhat out of the piled-high bones of victims, is a piece of wood. It's old and rotten through; its bright, wooden colors replaced with something darker and foul, the many years of wear and decay surrounding it having taken their toll. It slumps underneath its own weight, and the tip of it's been splintered off, probably used as firewood at one point, making it difficult to tell how long the stick was. Visible in the dim light of the bonfire are leather straps, dyed yellow, green, and brown, with red highlights strewn about, although it's been so neglected over the years that they've been rotten dark-green and covered in grime and mold. Kailani stares at it. Her hands are shaking. Without another word, she turns, her fur bristling and her hair swaying with the sudden jerking motion. She makes her way back to the mouth of the cave, her grip so tight on her spear that she might just snap the whole thing in half with her fingers alone. She doesn't beckon you to follow her. She's making no attempts to conceal herself like she did on the way in, but even still, her footfalls are quiet as the night. She left the stick with the tanned leathers in the bones, undisturbed. [party.has Arona Viviane |After helping yourself to your trophies, y |Y ]ou're quick to follow suit behind her. This isn't a place you want to be alone in... and the stench is really starting to get to you.
