rows.original: Your walk back from the cave is awkwardly quiet. You had expected Kailani to walk with the gait of a woman that had truly accomplished something; a proud, upright swagger that let the world know that she was in charge and that she had done something nobody in history had ever done before. You had expected her to be the queen of the walk, and for her to gladly crow about her accomplishments to anyone would listen: you had expected that, as soon as she got back into the village, she'd gather up a party of hunters and head back to the caves so that they could collect the spoils and make use of whatever they could in there. And what you get is... while Kailani keeps her back straight, her head is hung low on her neck. Her grip on her spear alternates between squeezing the wood so hard that it may splinter, to the whole thing rolling limply on her crooked fingers, batting against her thigh as she steps. Her tail is hung so low that it drags across the ground as she walks, and her long, scraggly hair cascades over her eyes, obscuring them from your sight. Her feet drag across the ground, kicking up pebbles and snow with her every step; a far cry from the professional huntress that she is, able to track any prey without leaving a trace. When you two return to her village, it's not with any fanfare or congratulations. Vulperines of the village look in your direction, but they do not approach or do so much as call out to either of you. It's fortunate that Kailani's hut is so close to the village's entrance; it puts you out in public like this for as short a time as possible. Inside the hut is Inaya, sitting in front of tanned leather on a rack, her fingers dipped in colored dyes and painting whatever image she can think of to pass the time. As soon as Kailani enters the hut, she whips her fingers a few times to shake-dry them, and she lunges to her feet, going straight to Kailani and wrapping her arms around Kailani's legs. "Kailani!" Inaya says, squeezing her guardian tightly, welcoming her back home. Kailani barely acknowledges her; she rests her open hand on Inaya's head and gives her hair an energy-less little ruffle. It's clearly an unusual greeting, because Inaya looks up at her, confused. "Yol oom igue?" Inaya asks her, her eyebrows arching with concern. Kailani takes a long, deep sigh through her nose, in and out. Her tail twitches once, unable to have the strength to lift higher than a few inches. "Ui na igue,," she answers, her voice barely above a whisper and lacking any sort of energy. Her hand moves to the back of Inaya's head and holds her close, pressing the kit against the leather of her kilt and holding her there for a moment. "[dayNight |Wremnick ma. |Imor ma ou yoll. ] [pc.name] win ui nelm wulim." You don't speak Kailani's language, but you recognize the tone: she's not in the mood for questions or arguments, and whatever it is she just told Inaya to do, she will do it. Inaya hesitates at first, but then does as Kailani says, pulling away from her before [dayNight |dashing past you and out into the open air of the village |slinking backward and making her way towards her room – but not before stopping at the tanned leather rack and picking up her dyes ]. With that, you're left alone with Kailani in her hut. You stand there awkwardly, fidgeting where you stand. Kailani had just told Inaya to leave, and she's been totally beside herself ever since you two had finished with that thing in the cave. Kailani takes a few steps away from you and, without looking, sets her spear down, the point gently resting against the stone wall, exactly where she normally keeps it. But she doesn't let go: she stands still, holding the spear, letting her thumb brush against the worn-smooth wood of the weapon. ... So... you ask her if you should– With a sudden burst of speed, Kailani pivots around, her arms wrapping so tightly around you that you'd think she was drowning and she was clinging to you for her life. Her face buries into the crook of your neck, her breath coming out in long, drawn-out shudders. You can feel her whole body shaking from head to toe – her fur is so thick that it obscured it before, except for her hands where it was thinner, but now that she's on you like this, she was probably shivering the entire walk back from the cave. Kailani sniffles once, her nose blocking up with mucus, and when she exhales, it's with a melancholic sigh, like she's either about to start crying, or she's just finishing. Her hands adjust and readjust on your [pc.upperGarments], trying to find a comfortable spot to grip onto you, but she simply can't find one. Her mouth opens and she chokes out another sob, just a step away from [silly |ugly-crying |breaking down ] on you right then and there. [pc.isDK |This is always the most awkward part about getting with a girl – all the emotions involved. She better be worth all this effort. Putting on airs, you guide her down to the floor of her hut. |You gently guide her down, putting you both on your knees as you rest on the floor of the hut. ] Kailani's claws dig through your effects slightly, etching at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], but you don't mind[pc.isDK |; you're okay if she's a scratcher ]. Kailani rests against you, putting most of her body weight against you for stability as she stutters and sniffles; she never starts outright crying, but she's on a razor-thin edge and could start at any moment. It takes her several minutes to regain her composure enough that she can speak at all. "Umwricht win unfracht muwl nelm fil grrulm ankt," she says, her voice cracking in different parts of her sentence. "They are gone. I... I... this was to bring me peace, but..." You don't know a lot about Kailani's language, but from speaking with her as often as you had, you recognize some of the words in there as her talking about her parents. [pc.isDK |You rub at her shoulders to try and calm her down, and you tell her that, yes, her parents are gone – but she took out the thing that did that to her. In your culture, you like to believe that, when people die, their spirit go to the heavens and watch down on you from above: if Kailani's parents are watching her, they're no doubt satisfied that they were not only avenged, but that they raised the best motherfucking hunter her people has ever known. She probably doesn't know what the word 'motherfucking' means, but the general message gets through to her... and it seems to work in calming her down. She pulls away from you, her deep-blue eyes hidden behind a veil of watery tears that threaten to course down the side of her cheeks – but, for the first time since she started, her breathing starts to even out. |On the one hand, perhaps the best thing to say is nothing. Kailani's in a fragile position, and it'd be easy to push her too far in any direction. But on the other... maybe she just needs you to say something. Anything at all[pc.isBimbo |. So, you say the first thing that comes to mind: you ask her if she's hungry. Kailani sniffles a bit, pulling back just enough so that her watery eyes can look into yours. "What?" she asks, her tone lilting upwards, almost in disbelief that you'd ask that. "Why?" You dunno, just... whenever you get upset, you find that food helps you calm down a little. Sometimes, when you got problems in your life, you just gotta handle things one at a time, and an empty stomach is something that's easy to fix, you know? One less problem to worry about. And besides: she did the thing! The thing that she wanted to do ever since she was a little girl! Sure, it's not going to fix the past... but it's one less thing to worry about, y'know? She really accomplished something today, and that's cause for a big celebration! Starting with a big dinner! Kailani looks into your eyes, her mouth hanging slack, the tears threatening to course down the sides of her furry cheeks the longer she looks at you – and then, with a choking laugh, her lips slowly start to spread into a thin, but honest, smile. |. It's true that dealing with the beast in that cave wasn't going to undo the past – but that was never something she was trying to accomplish. What she had done was give herself closure: the truth hurt to learn, but now she not only knows what happened to her parents, but she also gave them peace, knowing that their daughter had grown up to be such an accomplished, successful hunter for their village. If they could see her now, they'd be proud to know that the Ibulim family line has never been in more capable hands. It hurts now, but that pain will pass. Honestly, it's hard to know if you said too much, or too little, or if Kailani even understood half the words that you said – you sort of doubt she knows what the word 'closure' means, or if she'd understand it even if you explained it. But, all the same, you could feel her relax in your arms the more that you spoke, and her breathing slowly started to even out by the time you were finished. After another few moments of her regaining her strength, she eventually pulls away from you just enough that she can look into your eyes. Her deep-blue eyes are veiled by a thin sheen of water as her tears threaten to start sliding down the sides of her furry cheeks – but her expression slowly regains its composure, the strength returning to her eyes. ] ] Although her hands are still shaking, Kailani reaches up with both of them, her clawed fingers disengaging from your back for the first time since you two slumped down. She places her palms on both of your own cheeks, her thumbs gently rubbing at your cheekbones as she caresses you affectionately. "[pc.name]," she says. Her voice is still uneven, but her tone has evened out a bit so that her voice isn't cracking. "It is good of you to be in the home of the Ibulim."
rows.translation: 你从洞穴中走出来时，四周一片诡异的寂静。你原本期待着凯拉妮能以一个真正取得了成就的女人的姿态行走——那种充满自豪感、昂首挺胸的步伐，能让全世界都知道她才是掌舵人，而且她做了一件历史上从未有人做过的事情。 你原本以为她会成为行走方面的佼佼者，会兴高采烈地向任何愿意听的人炫耀自己的成就；你原本以为，她一回到村子，就会召集一群猎人，再次前往那些洞穴，把里面的战利品收回来，并充分利用它们。 而你看到的是……当凯拉妮挺直背部行走时，她的头却低垂在脖子上。她握住长矛的手部时，有时会用力过猛，以至于木杆都有可能会折断；而有时，长矛又会软软地挂在她弯曲的手部指上，随着她的足部步移动而不断撞击着她的大腿。 她的尾巴垂得过低，走路时尾巴会拖在地面上；她那又长又乱蓬蓬的头发披在脸上，遮住了她的双眼。她的足部步在地面上拖动，每走一步都会踢起小石子和积雪——这与她那身为专业猎手部的身份截然不符，因为作为一名猎手部，她本应能够毫无痕迹地追踪任何猎物。 当你们俩回到她的村庄时，并没有任何庆祝或欢呼声。村里的雌狼们朝你们的方向看了一眼，但并没有上前来，甚至没有叫你们任何一声。幸运的是，凯拉尼的小屋离村庄入口很近，这样你们就能尽快回到公共区域，避免在村子里待太久。 小屋里，伊奈亚坐在一张架子前，面前摆着经过鞣制的皮革。她的手部指浸在各种彩色染料中，正在绘制着脑海中浮现出的各种图案，以此来消磨时间。当凯拉尼走进小屋时，伊奈亚迅速将手部指甩了几下，让染料风干，然后立刻站起身来，跑到凯拉尼身边，将双臂环绕在她的腿上。 凯拉妮！”伊奈亚紧紧握住她的守护者，热情地欢迎她回家。凯拉妮几乎没有理会她，只是将手部掌轻轻放在伊奈亚的头上，无力地拨了拨她的头发。这种问候方式显然很不寻常，因为伊奈亚困惑地抬头看着她。 "这是什么路啊？伊奈亚关切地问道，她的眉毛微微蹙起。” 凯拉妮通过鼻子深深地吸了一口气，又缓缓呼出。她的尾巴抽动了一下，却无力将它抬得更高，只能微微摆动几英寸而已。嗯，好吧……嗯，”她回答道，声音轻得几乎像是在耳语，完全没有丝毫活力。她的手部伸到伊奈亚的脑后，将她紧紧抱在怀里，把那个小包按在她的短裙皮革上，就这样抱了一会儿。[dayNight |雷姆尼克先生。 |伊莫尔，我的道路。 ] [pc.name] win ui nelm wulim.你虽然不会说凯拉妮的语言，但你能听出她的肌肉度：她现在没有心情回答问题或争论，而且无论她刚刚让伊娜亚去做什么，她…… 会 去做吧。初时，Inaya有些犹豫，但最终还是按照Kailani的建议做了，然后离开了她。 [dayNight |从你身边飞快地掠过，进入了村庄的露天区域。 |她悄悄地后退着，朝着自己的房间走去——但在那之前，她先停在了那个鞣制过的皮革架子前，拿起了自己的染料。 rows.raw: " Your walk back from the cave is awkwardly quiet. You had expected Kailani to walk with the gait of a woman that had truly accomplished something; a proud, upright swagger that let the world know that she was in charge and that she had done something nobody in history had ever done before. You had expected her to be the queen of the walk, and for her to gladly crow about her accomplishments to anyone would listen: you had expected that, as soon as she got back into the village, she'd gather up a party of hunters and head back to the caves so that they could collect the spoils and make use of whatever they could in there. And what you get is... while Kailani keeps her back straight, her head is hung low on her neck. Her grip on her spear alternates between squeezing the wood so hard that it may splinter, to the whole thing rolling limply on her crooked fingers, batting against her thigh as she steps. Her tail is hung so low that it drags across the ground as she walks, and her long, scraggly hair cascades over her eyes, obscuring them from your sight. Her feet drag across the ground, kicking up pebbles and snow with her every step; a far cry from the professional huntress that she is, able to track any prey without leaving a trace. When you two return to her village, it's not with any fanfare or congratulations. Vulperines of the village look in your direction, but they do not approach or do so much as call out to either of you. It's fortunate that Kailani's hut is so close to the village's entrance; it puts you out in public like this for as short a time as possible. Inside the hut is Inaya, sitting in front of tanned leather on a rack, her fingers dipped in colored dyes and painting whatever image she can think of to pass the time. As soon as Kailani enters the hut, she whips her fingers a few times to shake-dry them, and she lunges to her feet, going straight to Kailani and wrapping her arms around Kailani's legs. "Kailani!" Inaya says, squeezing her guardian tightly, welcoming her back home. Kailani barely acknowledges her; she rests her open hand on Inaya's head and gives her hair an energy-less little ruffle. It's clearly an unusual greeting, because Inaya looks up at her, confused. "Yol oom igue?" Inaya asks her, her eyebrows arching with concern. Kailani takes a long, deep sigh through her nose, in and out. Her tail twitches once, unable to have the strength to lift higher than a few inches. "Ui na igue,," she answers, her voice barely above a whisper and lacking any sort of energy. Her hand moves to the back of Inaya's head and holds her close, pressing the kit against the leather of her kilt and holding her there for a moment. "[dayNight |Wremnick ma. |Imor ma ou yoll. ] [pc.name] win ui nelm wulim." You don't speak Kailani's language, but you recognize the tone: she's not in the mood for questions or arguments, and whatever it is she just told Inaya to do, she will do it. Inaya hesitates at first, but then does as Kailani says, pulling away from her before [dayNight |dashing past you and out into the open air of the village |slinking backward and making her way towards her room – but not before stopping at the tanned leather rack and picking up her dyes ]. With that, you're left alone with Kailani in her hut. You stand there awkwardly, fidgeting where you stand. Kailani had just told Inaya to leave, and she's been totally beside herself ever since you two had finished with that thing in the cave. Kailani takes a few steps away from you and, without looking, sets her spear down, the point gently resting against the stone wall, exactly where she normally keeps it. But she doesn't let go: she stands still, holding the spear, letting her thumb brush against the worn-smooth wood of the weapon. ... So... you ask her if you should– With a sudden burst of speed, Kailani pivots around, her arms wrapping so tightly around you that you'd think she was drowning and she was clinging to you for her life. Her face buries into the crook of your neck, her breath coming out in long, drawn-out shudders. You can feel her whole body shaking from head to toe – her fur is so thick that it obscured it before, except for her hands where it was thinner, but now that she's on you like this, she was probably shivering the entire walk back from the cave. Kailani sniffles once, her nose blocking up with mucus, and when she exhales, it's with a melancholic sigh, like she's either about to start crying, or she's just finishing. Her hands adjust and readjust on your [pc.upperGarments], trying to find a comfortable spot to grip onto you, but she simply can't find one. Her mouth opens and she chokes out another sob, just a step away from [silly |ugly-crying |breaking down ] on you right then and there. [pc.isDK |This is always the most awkward part about getting with a girl – all the emotions involved. She better be worth all this effort. Putting on airs, you guide her down to the floor of her hut. |You gently guide her down, putting you both on your knees as you rest on the floor of the hut. ] Kailani's claws dig through your effects slightly, etching at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], but you don't mind[pc.isDK |; you're okay if she's a scratcher ]. Kailani rests against you, putting most of her body weight against you for stability as she stutters and sniffles; she never starts outright crying, but she's on a razor-thin edge and could start at any moment. It takes her several minutes to regain her composure enough that she can speak at all. "Umwricht win unfracht muwl nelm fil grrulm ankt," she says, her voice cracking in different parts of her sentence. "They are gone. I... I... this was to bring me peace, but..." You don't know a lot about Kailani's language, but from speaking with her as often as you had, you recognize some of the words in there as her talking about her parents. [pc.isDK |You rub at her shoulders to try and calm her down, and you tell her that, yes, her parents are gone – but she took out the thing that did that to her. In your culture, you like to believe that, when people die, their spirit go to the heavens and watch down on you from above: if Kailani's parents are watching her, they're no doubt satisfied that they were not only avenged, but that they raised the best motherfucking hunter her people has ever known. She probably doesn't know what the word 'motherfucking' means, but the general message gets through to her... and it seems to work in calming her down. She pulls away from you, her deep-blue eyes hidden behind a veil of watery tears that threaten to course down the side of her cheeks – but, for the first time since she started, her breathing starts to even out. |On the one hand, perhaps the best thing to say is nothing. Kailani's in a fragile position, and it'd be easy to push her too far in any direction. But on the other... maybe she just needs you to say something. Anything at all[pc.isBimbo |. So, you say the first thing that comes to mind: you ask her if she's hungry. Kailani sniffles a bit, pulling back just enough so that her watery eyes can look into yours. "What?" she asks, her tone lilting upwards, almost in disbelief that you'd ask that. "Why?" You dunno, just... whenever you get upset, you find that food helps you calm down a little. Sometimes, when you got problems in your life, you just gotta handle things one at a time, and an empty stomach is something that's easy to fix, you know? One less problem to worry about. And besides: she did the thing! The thing that she wanted to do ever since she was a little girl! Sure, it's not going to fix the past... but it's one less thing to worry about, y'know? She really accomplished something today, and that's cause for a big celebration! Starting with a big dinner! Kailani looks into your eyes, her mouth hanging slack, the tears threatening to course down the sides of her furry cheeks the longer she looks at you – and then, with a choking laugh, her lips slowly start to spread into a thin, but honest, smile. |. It's true that dealing with the beast in that cave wasn't going to undo the past – but that was never something she was trying to accomplish. What she had done was give herself closure: the truth hurt to learn, but now she not only knows what happened to her parents, but she also gave them peace, knowing that their daughter had grown up to be such an accomplished, successful hunter for their village. If they could see her now, they'd be proud to know that the Ibulim family line has never been in more capable hands. It hurts now, but that pain will pass. Honestly, it's hard to know if you said too much, or too little, or if Kailani even understood half the words that you said – you sort of doubt she knows what the word 'closure' means, or if she'd understand it even if you explained it. But, all the same, you could feel her relax in your arms the more that you spoke, and her breathing slowly started to even out by the time you were finished. After another few moments of her regaining her strength, she eventually pulls away from you just enough that she can look into your eyes. Her deep-blue eyes are veiled by a thin sheen of water as her tears threaten to start sliding down the sides of her furry cheeks – but her expression slowly regains its composure, the strength returning to her eyes. ] ] Although her hands are still shaking, Kailani reaches up with both of them, her clawed fingers disengaging from your back for the first time since you two slumped down. She places her palms on both of your own cheeks, her thumbs gently rubbing at your cheekbones as she caresses you affectionately. "[pc.name]," she says. Her voice is still uneven, but her tone has evened out a bit so that her voice isn't cracking. "It is good of you to be in the home of the Ibulim.""

rows.original: Kailani had a hard time with letting you go after that: her arms stayed wrapped around you and every time you shuffled a bit, she would shuffle with you, just to make sure that you two didn't pull too far apart. [pc.dcb |Kailani's proving to be worth way too much effort just for some fox poon. It was one thing to try and seduce her; now, she's got you cave-diving, hunting big-ass half-animals that you've never seen before, and she's getting all emotional about shit you don't care about. If she doesn't put out soon, you're tempted to just leave. |Taking out that half-animal thing in the cave was physically draining, but the emotional release after dealing with that demon for the past however many years of her life is probably way more taxing for her. The best thing you can do for the poor girl is just let her cling to whatever makes her comfortable right now – and that happens to be you. |You were kinda hoping that she'd take you up on your offer to go get something to eat, because... well, you're getting hungry yourself. But Kailani doesn't want to go anywhere without you, and you're not about to say no to some cuddling. In part because Kailani really needs it, and in part because cuddles are great, and in part because Kailani is so darn fluffy that it's like hugging a whole blanket. ] The only movement you two do is move from the cold, hard floor of her hut to one of the grass-and-straw piles that serve as her furniture, which is marginally softer and warmer. Her arms, and eventually her legs, are wrapped tightly around you, squeezing you like a child would squeeze a plush toy when they're having a bad dream. With your body so tightly constricted by hers, you're not about to go anywhere, so... you might as well settle in for a time. You shut your eyes and pass out. It's been an exhausting day for you too... ... [dayNight |When you awake, the orange light of the setting sun streams into Kailani's hut through her door-less entrance |When you awake, the gentle sunlight of the rising morning sun streams into Kailani's hut through her door-less entrance ]. You don't think you were out for very long, based on how rested you are – and how stiff your body is from being someone else's squeeze toy. When you stir, Kailani turns her head to look up at you, her blue eyes locking onto yours. Your vision is bleary at first, but with a few hard blinks, you look back into her eyes, watching her as she studies you with an expression like she had never seen [pc.ra vulperine |another vulperine |a [pc.race] ] in her life. Her mouth is slightly agape, but her breathing is steady through her nose. The fur around her eyes has dried; you can't even tell that she was on the verge of crying just a little while ago. You say hello to Kailani, and her fingers suddenly clench on you, raking across your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] gently. Her pupils dilate just a little bit, and you think you can feel her heartbeat through her [pc.isDK |fat tits and her ]thick fur. She takes a long while to respond. "Would you like to eat?" she asks you, her lips curling up at their edges slightly.[pc.isBimbo | God, you thought she'd never ask! ] After disentangling herself from your body, Kailani instructs you to stay there as she heads for the village's bonfire. When she returns only a few minutes later, she's carrying a pair of thick slabs of meat that you don't recognize: not steak, but something equally fatty and gristly. Probably moose or something, given where you are. Rather than a plate, Kailani gives you a thin sheet of fabric woven from hemp to lay across your lap, and rather than forks and knives, you're meant to eat it with your fingers. It's a bit primeval and messy, especially compared to where you come from, but... well, you're in her culture, and if it's good enough for her and the other vulperines, it'll be good enough for you. The meat itself was undressed and lacked any seasoning whatsoever – but it was marinated and roasted to perfection, giving it a soft enough texture to bite into without making it unsatisfying. You'll have to ask her how her people prepares it: you've never eaten steak that's been cooked this expertly before back home. Her people has had a lot of time learning how to prepare meat as well as they have, and it shows. Kailani's been oddly quiet and reserved the entire time you two share your meal: she watches you intently, trying to judge your reaction to everything from the food she brought you to her company. Every time you sigh a little loudly or you grunt as your teeth sinks into the meat, her ears visibly perk and shift in your direction, like she's expecting you to say or do something and she's trying to stay ready to react to it. She finishes her steak before you do, and she keeps her hands folded on her lap beneath her hemp bib, waiting patiently for you to finish yours. She keeps mumbling words to herself, her lips jumbling over each other as she rehearses something that she's trying to say, but every time she looks like she might have something figured out, she hesitates, sometimes clears her throat, and then just waits again. When you finish your meal, [pc.dcb |you tell her to speak her mind. This isn't the same fierce huntress that conquered her demons in that cave less than a day ago; it's not like her to be so nervous over whatever it is she's got her mind on. |you tell her that if she has something on her mind, she can just say it: you're not going to judge her or think differently of her no matter what happens. You two had accomplished something major less than a day ago; whatever it is she wants to say can't be scarier than that, can it? |you tell her that she's cute when she's all fidgety and shy like she is now. But she doesn't have any reason to be! If she has something she wants to say, you're pretty good at listening. Better at listening than talking, that's for sure. Sometimes you talk too much; sometimes you talk too little. But anyway, she's been sitting there for a while, looking like she's got something on her mind, and it's not going to get off her mind until she says it! ] Kailani sighs through her nose. "Shua nim?" she asks herself beneath her own breath before opening her eyes. Unexpectedly, she gets off her pile of grass and straw and shuffles toward you on her knees, making her way towards you until both of her hands find your forearm. She looks deeply into your eyes – then freezes, suddenly at a total loss for ideas on what to say or do. She can't help but laugh to herself. "I do not know what to do now," she admits. "My umfracht did not tell me." Her... mother? What didn't her mother tell her? Kailani's tail swishes erratically behind herself, using enough force to sway her entire rump and kick up some of the dust on the floor of her hut. "This is how my umfracht asked my umwricht to mate," she answers. "First, with warmth. Then, with meat. Then..." She laughs again, much more sheepishly, unable to keep her eyes steady on you. "She did not say. I do not know what more to do." Whoa, whoa, whoa. Does that mean that Kailani wants to mate with you? "No vulp in the village would do what you did for me," she responds, the words suddenly coming to her a little more easily. "With you, my life is... new. I was taught that my mate would be with me and our kits. No vulp would think that the prey in the cave was real; no vulp would go in that cave with me, but you did." Her eyes go down to your arm as her hand travels down it, wrapping her fingers in between yours. "It hurts. My umwricht and umfracht will not come home. But it is... with you, [pc.name], and what you did, that I can let it go. I can be the ibulim that the village has need of. I can be the umfracht to Inaya that I want to be." She pauses, her grip resting in yours for a long while. You squeeze her fingers; she smiles a bit, sighs, and squeezes back. "I do not have a mate," she says, turning her eyes back up to you. "I want it to be you." Before you jump to any conclusions, you ask her what being a 'mate' means to her and her culture. "It means," she responds dryly as she stands, pulling you up with her. She nods to one of the partitioned rooms in the hut – her own room. "We go in there."

[dayNight |当你醒来时，落日的橙色光芒透过凯拉尼那没有门的入口，洒进了她的小屋。 |当你醒来时，清晨柔和的阳光透过凯拉尼那没有门的入口，洒进了她的小屋。 ]从你现在的状态来看，你觉得自己离开的时间其实并不长——毕竟你的身体还那么僵硬，显然是因为被别人当成了“挤压玩具”。 在她的一生中，她的嘴巴微微张开，但呼吸依然通过鼻子进行，十分平稳。她眼睛周围的毛发已经干掉了，根本看不出来刚才她还差点哭出来。 你向凯拉尼打招呼，她的手部指突然紧紧抓住了你的手部，用力地抓着…… [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] 她的瞳孔微微放大，你仿佛能感受到她的心跳通过她的身躯传递出来。 [pc.isDK |那个胖女人和她…… ]浓密的毛发。 她过了好一会儿才回答：“你想吃东西吗？”她问道，嘴角微微上扬。[pc.isBimbo | 天啊，你居然以为她永远不会问这个问题！ ] 在从你的身体中分离出来后，凯拉妮命令你待在原地，而她则走向村庄里的篝火。几分钟后她回来时，手部里拿着一块块你并不认识的厚肉：不是牛排，而是某种同样油腻且肉质粗糙的肉类。 考虑到你所在的地方，那应该是一种麋鹿之类的动物吧。 |你告诉她，让她把心里的话说出来。现在的她，已经不是不到一天前在那个洞穴里战胜了自己内心恐惧的那个坚强女战士了；她平时可不会因为某件事而变得如此紧张不安。 |你告诉她，如果她有什么心事，可以直接说出来：无论发生什么，你都不会评判她，也不会对她有别的看法。不到一天前，你们俩还共同完成了一件非常重要的事情；她想说的任何事情，应该都不会比这更令人难堪吧？ 嗯……这个名称听起来有点特别。 以及 运费 不会回家。但它……与你同在。 [pc.name]你所做的一切，让我能够释怀。现在，我可以成为…… 暴食症 这个村庄所需要的东西，我可以成为提供这些东西的人。 运费 我想对稻叶说，我想成为她的伴侣。” 她停顿了一下，双手部紧紧握住你的手部，过了好一会儿才松开。你轻轻捏了捏她的手部指，她微微一笑，然后叹了口气，也反过来捏了捏你的手部指。 “我还没有伴侣，”她说着，又将目轻型重新投向你。 我希望那个人是你。” 但在你急于下任何结论之前，你应该先问问她，在她看来，“伴侣”这一概念意味着什么，以及这一概念在她的文化中代表着什么。 “这意味着……”她站起来，一边说一边拉着你一起走，语气有些冷淡。 她指向小屋里那间被隔开的房间——那是她的房间。“我们进去吧。
rows.raw: " Kailani had a hard time with letting you go after that: her arms stayed wrapped around you and every time you shuffled a bit, she would shuffle with you, just to make sure that you two didn't pull too far apart. [pc.dcb |Kailani's proving to be worth way too much effort just for some fox poon. It was one thing to try and seduce her; now, she's got you cave-diving, hunting big-ass half-animals that you've never seen before, and she's getting all emotional about shit you don't care about. If she doesn't put out soon, you're tempted to just leave. |Taking out that half-animal thing in the cave was physically draining, but the emotional release after dealing with that demon for the past however many years of her life is probably way more taxing for her. The best thing you can do for the poor girl is just let her cling to whatever makes her comfortable right now – and that happens to be you. |You were kinda hoping that she'd take you up on your offer to go get something to eat, because... well, you're getting hungry yourself. But Kailani doesn't want to go anywhere without you, and you're not about to say no to some cuddling. In part because Kailani really needs it, and in part because cuddles are great, and in part because Kailani is so darn fluffy that it's like hugging a whole blanket. ] The only movement you two do is move from the cold, hard floor of her hut to one of the grass-and-straw piles that serve as her furniture, which is marginally softer and warmer. Her arms, and eventually her legs, are wrapped tightly around you, squeezing you like a child would squeeze a plush toy when they're having a bad dream. With your body so tightly constricted by hers, you're not about to go anywhere, so... you might as well settle in for a time. You shut your eyes and pass out. It's been an exhausting day for you too... ... [dayNight |When you awake, the orange light of the setting sun streams into Kailani's hut through her door-less entrance |When you awake, the gentle sunlight of the rising morning sun streams into Kailani's hut through her door-less entrance ]. You don't think you were out for very long, based on how rested you are – and how stiff your body is from being someone else's squeeze toy. When you stir, Kailani turns her head to look up at you, her blue eyes locking onto yours. Your vision is bleary at first, but with a few hard blinks, you look back into her eyes, watching her as she studies you with an expression like she had never seen [pc.ra vulperine |another vulperine |a [pc.race] ] in her life. Her mouth is slightly agape, but her breathing is steady through her nose. The fur around her eyes has dried; you can't even tell that she was on the verge of crying just a little while ago. You say hello to Kailani, and her fingers suddenly clench on you, raking across your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] gently. Her pupils dilate just a little bit, and you think you can feel her heartbeat through her [pc.isDK |fat tits and her ]thick fur. She takes a long while to respond. "Would you like to eat?" she asks you, her lips curling up at their edges slightly.[pc.isBimbo | God, you thought she'd never ask! ] After disentangling herself from your body, Kailani instructs you to stay there as she heads for the village's bonfire. When she returns only a few minutes later, she's carrying a pair of thick slabs of meat that you don't recognize: not steak, but something equally fatty and gristly. Probably moose or something, given where you are. Rather than a plate, Kailani gives you a thin sheet of fabric woven from hemp to lay across your lap, and rather than forks and knives, you're meant to eat it with your fingers. It's a bit primeval and messy, especially compared to where you come from, but... well, you're in her culture, and if it's good enough for her and the other vulperines, it'll be good enough for you. The meat itself was undressed and lacked any seasoning whatsoever – but it was marinated and roasted to perfection, giving it a soft enough texture to bite into without making it unsatisfying. You'll have to ask her how her people prepares it: you've never eaten steak that's been cooked this expertly before back home. Her people has had a lot of time learning how to prepare meat as well as they have, and it shows. Kailani's been oddly quiet and reserved the entire time you two share your meal: she watches you intently, trying to judge your reaction to everything from the food she brought you to her company. Every time you sigh a little loudly or you grunt as your teeth sinks into the meat, her ears visibly perk and shift in your direction, like she's expecting you to say or do something and she's trying to stay ready to react to it. She finishes her steak before you do, and she keeps her hands folded on her lap beneath her hemp bib, waiting patiently for you to finish yours. She keeps mumbling words to herself, her lips jumbling over each other as she rehearses something that she's trying to say, but every time she looks like she might have something figured out, she hesitates, sometimes clears her throat, and then just waits again. When you finish your meal, [pc.dcb |you tell her to speak her mind. This isn't the same fierce huntress that conquered her demons in that cave less than a day ago; it's not like her to be so nervous over whatever it is she's got her mind on. |you tell her that if she has something on her mind, she can just say it: you're not going to judge her or think differently of her no matter what happens. You two had accomplished something major less than a day ago; whatever it is she wants to say can't be scarier than that, can it? |you tell her that she's cute when she's all fidgety and shy like she is now. But she doesn't have any reason to be! If she has something she wants to say, you're pretty good at listening. Better at listening than talking, that's for sure. Sometimes you talk too much; sometimes you talk too little. But anyway, she's been sitting there for a while, looking like she's got something on her mind, and it's not going to get off her mind until she says it! ] Kailani sighs through her nose. "Shua nim?" she asks herself beneath her own breath before opening her eyes. Unexpectedly, she gets off her pile of grass and straw and shuffles toward you on her knees, making her way towards you until both of her hands find your forearm. She looks deeply into your eyes – then freezes, suddenly at a total loss for ideas on what to say or do. She can't help but laugh to herself. "I do not know what to do now," she admits. "My umfracht did not tell me." Her... mother? What didn't her mother tell her? Kailani's tail swishes erratically behind herself, using enough force to sway her entire rump and kick up some of the dust on the floor of her hut. "This is how my umfracht asked my umwricht to mate," she answers. "First, with warmth. Then, with meat. Then..." She laughs again, much more sheepishly, unable to keep her eyes steady on you. "She did not say. I do not know what more to do." Whoa, whoa, whoa. Does that mean that Kailani wants to mate with you? "No vulp in the village would do what you did for me," she responds, the words suddenly coming to her a little more easily. "With you, my life is... new. I was taught that my mate would be with me and our kits. No vulp would think that the prey in the cave was real; no vulp would go in that cave with me, but you did." Her eyes go down to your arm as her hand travels down it, wrapping her fingers in between yours. "It hurts. My umwricht and umfracht will not come home. But it is... with you, [pc.name], and what you did, that I can let it go. I can be the ibulim that the village has need of. I can be the umfracht to Inaya that I want to be." She pauses, her grip resting in yours for a long while. You squeeze her fingers; she smiles a bit, sighs, and squeezes back. "I do not have a mate," she says, turning her eyes back up to you. "I want it to be you." Before you jump to any conclusions, you ask her what being a 'mate' means to her and her culture. "It means," she responds dryly as she stands, pulling you up with her. She nods to one of the partitioned rooms in the hut – her own room. "We go in there.""

rows.original:
... This is going to be a hard one to explain to her. There’s a language barrier, some culture shock, and some regular misunderstandings going on here. But at the end of the day, you’re... you’re just not comfortable with making this sort of leap.

                Using as gentle a tone and as simple a set of words as you can, you explain to Kailani that you didn’t do everything that you did for her for a reward – and as much as she wants to reward you, what she has in mind (besides the breakfast) isn’t something that you’re prepared to accept. It’s not the mating: it’s being called a 'mate’. That’s a big commitment. She’s putting a lot of expectations on you. Your lifestyle means you can’t sit still and raise a family the same way she’s probably expecting you would. You can’t be what she wants you to be.
                
                Her expression freezes on that hopeful, waiting smile she had when she first explained her intentions, but the crease of her brow rises and her pupils begin to contract. Her fingers tremble, still gripped onto your effects. You recognize her body language: it’s not shame she’s feeling, or sadness, or, thankfully, anger – it’s embarrassment. She went through all of that, all to hear that she read you wrong.
                
                "It is okay," Kailani says reassuringly. From the quiver in her voice, she only half-means it. "You are right: you are not of the village, [pc.name]. I can not make you do a thing you can not do."
                
                At that, Kailani releases you from her grip, and she sits back down. She doesn’t demand that you get out. On the contrary, she says nothing at all, all but inviting you to sit back down and pretend that this discussion didn’t happen at all. But the air of the hut is suddenly much thicker, and the look on her face isn’t exactly loosening up.
                
                When you tell her that you need to step outside for a bit, she doesn’t try to stop you.
rows.translation:
……这真的很难向她解释。其中存在语言障碍、文化冲击，还有许多常见的误解。但归根结底，你就是……就是不愿意做出这样的决定。

                你用尽可能温和的肌肉度和简单的语言向凯拉妮解释，你为她所做的那些事并不是为了得到回报；而且，尽管她很想以某种方式奖励你，但她所考虑的那些方式（除了早餐之外）并不是你愿意接受的。 这并不是真正的交配行为，而是被称为“伴侣”的关系。这是一种非常重要的承诺。她对你寄予了很高的期望。但你的生活方式决定了你无法像她所期望的那样，安定下来组建家庭。 你不可能成为她希望你成为的那个人。
                
                她的表情凝固在了当初初次说明自己的意图时那种充满希望、充满期待的笑容上，但她的眉头开始紧锁，瞳孔也逐渐收缩。她的手指在颤抖，依然紧紧握着你的文件。你立刻明白了她的肢体语言：她此刻感受到的不是羞愧，也不是悲伤，更庆幸的是，她并没有生气——而是尴尬。她经历了这一切，只为了听到自己误解了你的意思。
                
                没关系的，”凯拉尼安慰道。但从她声音中的颤抖来看，她的话只有一半是真心的。“你说得对，你并不是这个村庄的人…… [pc.name]我无法强迫你去做那些你根本做不到的事情。”

说完，凯拉妮松开了你的手，重新坐了下来。她并没有要求你离开，相反，她什么也没说，仿佛在邀请你重新坐下，假装这次谈话从未发生过一样。 但是小屋里的空气突然变得浓稠了许多，她脸上的表情也丝毫没有放松的迹象。

当你告诉她你需要出去一会儿时，她并没有试图阻止你。

She looks at you, then at your hand, then towards Kailani's hut off in the distance. "Mmm," she hums as she weighs her options... then, she reaches forward and puts her shiny baubles in your hand. "Ruuglan chrem yulo outi," she says. Which is good progress: she's talking to you! Now you just need to figure out what she said... That aside, you had been watching the kids play the game for a few minutes, and the goal is to get your shiny rocks into the circle as close as you can to the bullseye. Which is a whole lot harder than it looks: it's a game about precision, control, and knowing your own strength. It's exceptionally easy to over- or under-shoot your throws – you thought the kids were struggling because they were kids, but it's actually quite difficult to hone in on the sweetspot you need to even land inside the outer rim of circles, never mind the bullseye.[pc.cunningRange 0 75 | | Although, that said, while it's difficult to master, it's easy to understand. The trick is to throw underhanded and to let the natural sway of your arm do all the movement for you rather than try to put any muscle into it. [pc.isDK |As much as you want to fucking rock the dumb kids at the game and rub your success in their noses |Despite knowing the 'trick,' though, you're still just playing against kids ], and the goal is for Inaya to like you. You want to lose, but you want to make it close. ] You and the kids try a few more times, trading the fistful of shiny baubles back and forth whenever you run out. You and Inaya take turns with the handful of rocks when it comes to you, and every time Inaya gets a rock inside the outer circle, she does a little [silly |pop-off |dance ] in happiness before the game resumes. You[pc.cunningRange 0 75 | | deliberately ] get fewer into the circle than she does, but every time you do, you mimic her little dance... and by the end of it, every time you score a point, she's dancing right alongside you, and you dance with her whenever she gets one, too. You never did learn what sort of scoring metric the game runs on, but, eventually, the kids all spontaneously decide that the game is over, and... you think you lost? Inaya acts a little disappointed that the game is over, like she lost, but she's still happy that the game went the way it did. It's hard to get a read on their body language, and they're speaking so quickly in a foreign language that you couldn't hope to keep up. The kids disperse, and while you expected Inaya to leave with them in whatever direction they're headed, she instead goes to you. Her hands are behind her back and her head is tilted downward, but her eyes are lifted and on yours. "Mmm," she hums as she sways back and forth nervously. You get on one knee, [pc.heightRange 0 55 84 |putting yourself lower than her |bringing yourself to eye-level with her |which, with you being so tall, doesn't bring you to eye-level with her, but it helps her relax a bit ]. Inaya continues to fidget, but she doesn't turn away from you. "Kailani," she says, her head turning to her right and looking to Kailani's hut, near the entrance to the village. Maybe she's asking you to take her to Kailani? You extend your hand for her to take, but she doesn't take it. She stares at you dumbly for a second, her spine stiffening from your motion; you retract your hand, folding it against your left forearm. Instead, once you're still again, she lifts her own right hand, her index finger extended to you. "Kailani?" she asks. Your instinct is to say 'no' and shake your head, but you have no idea if either of those things mean anything in the vulperine culture. What you do instead is point to yourself with your index finger, like she had. "[pc.name]," you say, making sure to enunciate yourself. If Inaya is trying to ask for your name, you want to make sure she gets it right, if not for her self-esteem, then because it'd be really, really hard to teach her that she got it wrong. She pauses. Her nose crinkles upward against her face, as if she's trying to sniff your name out of the air. "[pc.n]," she stutters, her tongue catching behind her lips. She's never said your name before, and it's clearly not a vulperine name that she's used to, but she's determined to try and sound it out. "[pc.name]?" she asks – her accent is a little thicker than most and she puts a bit of weight on your syllables, but, she said it, loud and clear. You smile[pc.isDK | as well as you can. Inaya looks at you with arched eyebrows, like she's watching someone hurt themselves ]. You point to yourself and say your name again, and Inaya repeats it. After that, you point to her and, being a little cheeky, you say "Kailani?" "Laug," she says, her brow furrowing a bit in what you think is mock-frustration. She points to herself, like you had. "Inaya," she says. "Oh!" you say in surprise, leaning backward and raising your eyebrows as if you had made a fantastic discovery. You point to her and say "Inaya!" She smiles. It's a crooked smile, toothy and misaligned, accompanied with a lighthearted giggle that only a child could authentically make. Your theatrics make her laugh – or it's because you and her are finally introduced, even if you two had to overcome a bit of a hurdle to get there. Or maybe it's a combination of both. "Mmm," she hums, closing her mouth and resuming that face-down, eyes-up look from before as she rocks on her feet, but underneath that downward gaze is the smile you had given her, still high enough to make her furry cheeks rise on her face. After a moment, rather than try to say anything more to you, she turns and leaves, making for her friends playing some other game around the village's bonfire. Not bad for a second attempt! |Now that you're spending a little more time with Inaya, she's getting easier and easier to spot among the crowd. Not that it was ever very difficult to find her, but the more you get used to her white fur and scraggly blue tribal markings, the less time it takes you to find her. This time, she's not at by the bonfire in the village's center: rather, she's off to the side, overlooking a meat spit on top of a smaller, more carefully-controlled fire. With her is an elderly vulperine male with orange fur that's graying especially badly at his joints and around his muzzle; he stands with Inaya, instructing her on how to turn the spit so that the meat cooks evenly on all sides, and how to stand next to the fire without getting too close. [pc.isDK |Finally, an activity you give a shit about! |Normally, you wouldn't be so keen on letting a child so close to a fire, but... well, she likes to play games around the bonfire, and the village is small enough that whoever this male is, Kailani probably trusts him to look after her daughter, too. You're a foreigner, a taminyk, and you're already getting defensive and protective over Inaya. You hope you're not moving too quickly for yourself. ] When you approach, the male vulperine initially looks you over with [pc.ra kitsune |venomous disdain |caution ], and from his body language, he's a step away from telling you to get lost – but Inaya sees you approach, too. "[pc.name]!" she says, letting go of the spit's handle completely to run to you. The sight of the little girl abandoning her post to rush to your side catches the male vulperine by surprise, and[pc.ra kitsune |, although his scowl doesn't leave his face, he begrudgingly lets you approach the meat spit |, although his expression is still a bit sour, his body softens enough to let you approach the meat spit ] as Inaya tugs you to it. "Taminyk yol hiyk nim?" The older male asks Inaya. "Gaul," Inaya responds, nodding her head once. "[pc.name] ko [pc.mf |ib |im ]. Kailani nimo [pc.mf |ib |im ] ei kimna!" The older vulperine gives you [pc.ra kitsune |one final stinkeye |one last cautionary look ] before allowing you to grip the spit's handle. From the looks of things, he was in the middle of teaching Inaya how to ensure that the meat was properly prepared and how to tell if it's been cooked all the way through: the meat on the spit still has some pink, raw bits, particularly on the ends. A sign that it hasn't been on the line for too long. You can't tell what sort of meat you're even cooking – or what animal it came from. Maybe it's best you don't know. "Mmm," Inaya hums as she gingerly wraps her fingers around your fist. Her hand is a little over half the size of yours. With a gentle pull, she turns the handle with you, and the meat turns with you both. "Gaul!" she says happily, with her bushy tail swishing side to side behind her as she guides your hand. "Gramm gurd ithk ko tra woo–" You're taken by surprise at how quickly Inaya's opened herself up to you: in two different meetings, she's gone from asking for her mother to chattering excitedly about... well, something about roasting a slab of meat on a spit. Whatever it is she's saying, she's so eager to say it that she's forgotten that you don't understand a word. It takes her a second to realize it, too. When she looks up at you and sees your surprised-and-confused expression, she stops immediately. Suddenly, the language barrier becomes more apparent than ever between you and her, and you can see the struggle in her eyes as she fights to say something you might understand. "Gramm," she says, pointing with her free hand at the meat on the spit – and making sure that you keep spinning it, slowly. "Gr-aaaa-mmm!" she says again, louder, slower, her finger thrusting at the chunk as if you'll understand better if she talks like you're hard of hearing. "Inaya, [pc.mf |ib |im ] leutre adeanim win indunim ko fil matre ou inb ovlechmai yol kel tounim," the older vulperine says with a chuckle. "Taminyk. The word 'gramm' means 'meat.' Inaya, 'Meat' way rimk pralmo 'gramm.'" Inaya looks up at the elder vulperine curiously, then towards you. "Meat," the old fox says again. She pauses, trying to parse the word in her brain. Her lips come together and purse for a moment. The vulperine language seems sort of guttural and throaty, but flexible nonetheless; you wonder what syllable she's having trouble making in her head. "Mmmmeeeet," she manages to sound out after a few seconds. "Meeet. Meat?" She points to the meat on the spit. "Meat?" [pc.isDK |You only offer a nod in response – temporarily forgetting if that even means 'yes' in their culture. But you don't expound any further. |You nod, a smile spreading across your face. You point to the slab of dripping meat on the spit with her. "Meat," you confirm. ] "Now you, taminyk," the old fox says. "The word 'gramm' means 'meat.' Say the word 'gramm' for her." [pc.isDK |You sigh impatiently through your nose. Kailani better have some out-of-this-world pussy for you to learn a new language for it. |While you weren't totally expecting to learn at least a few new words in the vulperine language, you suppose it was inevitable that you'd be taught at least a little bit while you're here. That, and you've picked up that 'taminyk' means 'outsider' through context and osmosis. ] You point to the meat again and say "Gramm." "Gramm, gaul!" Inaya says happily, her little left hand reaching forward to tug on your clothes in excitement. "Gramm gurd ithk ko tra–" she continues in excitement, immediately forgetting the hurdle you two went over just to exchange a single word. "She wants you to turn the meat on the spit so that it is red all over," says the older male. [pc.isDK |Not that you needed the instruction. You can cook your own damn meals. But, with a begrudging sigh, |She's been trying to teach you how to properly cook a steak this entire time. Laughing well-meaningly once, ] you slowly turn the spit above the flame, letting its heat roast the steak evenly throughout until it turns from red to brown. "Yaaay!" Inaya cheers – finally, an expression you can easily understand. She puts her hand on yours and helps you slowly crank it, making sure that no part of the food spends too little or too long in the fire. It's only several minutes later until the meat is cooked all the way through... and Inaya, being a child, losses interest as soon as it's done, and she's off towards the village bonfire with kids more her age. "Hmm," the older vulperine hums as he makes his way to the opposite end of the spit, where it's safe to grip. With a heft, you both pull the cooked meat off the fire and set it down beside it. "Inaya does not... speak with adults as easily as kids. You are having an impact on her." He looks at you with a different eye than when you first approached: [pc.ra kitsune |still with something disdainful and refusing... but with a studious arch in his eyebrows, wondering what it is that she, and apparently Kailani, see in you. |where before he was cautious and wary, he now sees you as something curious: he studies you the way a florist might look over a mushroom they've never seen before ]. "She said that you were a friend of Ibulim Kailani." You confirm that you've been spending some time with Inaya's adoptive mother, yes. He hums again as he turns toward Kailani's hut. "The poor girls. Life has been cruel." He turns back toward you, and his expression softens again, just slightly. "You are... why Kailani and Inaya are... happy, these last few days. Do right by them, and[pc.ra kitsune | even you, wrick kimna-wuute of Keros, will | you will ] be welcome[pc.ra vulperine | | as vulp ] in the village." It's hard to believe that Inaya, the little girl laughing and playing games with children of her age near the village's bonfire, has a hard time being social with adults. These last two times you tried, she really started to warm up to you. Or... maybe it's because you're close to Kailani that Inaya's having an easier time opening up? Although that implies that Kailani's not very popular in the village either, and that's hard to believe. In any case, you have the[pc.ra kitsune | tentative ] respect of at least one of the village elders, thanks to you spending your time with Kailani and Inaya. Things are looking up. |Inaya, as ever, is easy to spot, although she isn't playing with the other kids near the bonfire and she isn't helping with the village chores like she normally does. Instead, she's with Kailani's next-door neighbor, speaking with an adult woman. [first INAYA_BOND4 |The old man from last time said that Inaya was having trouble speaking with adults, but here she is, talking like it's the most normal thing in the world for her. Either he was wrong... or you're being a much better influence for her than you thought. |It's good to see Inaya speaking with the adults of the village as well as she is: the more time you spend with her, the better an influence you're turning out to be. ] As soon as Inaya sees you, she lights up – but before she goes to you, she turns to the adult she's speaking with, says something you can't make out, and bows at the waist slightly, with her hands traveling down her knees. The adult ruffles her hair a bit and then sends her on her way, and she goes straight to you. You've only barely left the doorway to Kailani's hut; when Inaya comes running up to you, saying words in her language that you don't understand, Kailani herself comes over to see what's gotten her daughter so excited. You kneel down onto your right knee, bringing yourself [pc.heightRange 0 72 | |a bit more level ]to her height. After getting your attention, which was easy, Inaya stands in front of you with her hands raised, trying to get you to stay still. She has a big, goofy smile on her face like she's excited to show you a trick that she had just learned, although it takes her a few attempts – and false starts – before she gets up the nerve and mental footing to say something. "[pc.name]," she says as she looks into your eyes. "[var0 |Hauw arr ewe |I missssst ewe |Teudae iz sughnee |Khaan wuee plaeigh ]!" Kailani applauds Inaya's attempt at speaking your language, her hands coming together rapidly. "Yes, good!" she says jovially before getting down on both knees beside you and wrapping her right arm around your shoulders. She rubs her cheek against yours a little more vigorously than usual. "She likes you, [pc.name]! She wants to talk to you in your tongue!" It's a sweet gesture – one you'll have to reciprocate, but you're not especially well-versed in the vulperine language yourself. Still, if Inaya's going to try and cross that gap, then you need to meet her halfway[pc.isDK |, and with Kailani right there watching you both, it'll definitely earn you some points with her ]. You turn your head and whisper in her ear, asking her how to say '[var0 |I am good |I missed you too |It's warm out |Yes we can ]' in her language. She tilts her head so that her muzzle is against your ear, and she whispers back, "[var0 |Ui na amig |Yol ui wrhoin ouin |Ooll wrem |Yolo gaul agr ]." You heard her say the words just fine, but... well, you understand the struggle that Inaya was having when she spoke with you and the old vulperine man at the meat spit. It's a new language: you don't have a grasp on the intricacies of how their mouths make certain sounds, and you're sure your accent is going to sound... apparent. Still, hopefully Inaya knows that you're not an expert in her language either, and you repeat the words Kailani said to you as clearly as you can: "[var0 |Eui nah ahmig |Eyoll eui rhon ooin |Uull rhem |Yulo gawl ahgr ]." Kailani's hand clutches around your shoulder appreciatively, warmly holding you closer to her as the words come out of your mouth. Inaya, though, tries to stifle a laugh: from the way her cheeks raise high enough to nearly hide her eyes, you figure that you... may have said something embarrassing. "Inaya," Kailani says with a chastising tone, "Brhal ki fil. [pc.mf |Ib |Im ] endein [pc.mf |ib |im ] kriff." "Ummal," she says, shyly turning her head down and trying – and failing – to wipe the smirk off her face. Then, in a combination of her skittering off from being scolded and her childish inability to sit still, she's off, dashing towards the village's bonfire once again. With a bit of effort, you pull yourself to your feet, with Kailani beside you. "She is not the same," she sighs as she leans her head on your shoulder. "She would not talk to an adult. She is not the same, and it is you I have to thank." You feel her right hand warmly wrap around your waist, her fingers playing with the waistline of your [pc.lowerGarments]. It's not a sexual touch: she's just holding you closer to her. You're hardly against it: your own fingers come down on hers, gently squeezing down on her fist as she plays with your clothes. You ask her what it is you actually said to Inaya. You figured that you must have botched her language pretty badly to get that sort of reaction. "The words that you said were the words I told you to say," she answers. "You... said them wrong, is all. It was... the way you said them that was wrong." That's... better? You're not sure if that's a good thing or a bad thing. "[pc.name]!" you hear Inaya call from the opposite end of the village's common area, on the other side of the bonfire. She's [rand |standing next to the village's bonfire, and by her foot is the large ball that she was kicking around with her feet that one time several days ago. You don't think she wants to play any specific game; she just wants to pass it back and forth |standing among a number of rocks that she had laid out in circles, one inside of the other; her hands are up and waving at you to join her, and you can see the glint of something shiny wrapped in her fingers |standing next to a meat spit with a gentle flame underneath it, rotating a raw slab of meat with gentle turns of the wrist; her other hand is up with all five fingers extended, waving for you to go and join her ]. Kailani gives a little laugh before moving her hand from your waist to the small of your back, giving you just the tiniest push forward. "Have fun," she says before turning around and entering her hut again. You've made good progress with them both just then. [pc.isDK |Unfortunately, keeping that progress means playing with the kid again. At least her attention span is short. |Every little bit of time you spend with Inaya is having a positive impact on both herself and Kailani – and it's easy to feel like you're benefiting from it, too. ] ]
rows.translation: [flags.INAYA_BOND 1 2 3 4 |伊奈亚很容易被认出来：她拥有凯拉妮的白色毛皮，也带有凯拉妮的蓝色斑纹，只不过这些斑纹的设计要简单得多，而且并没有覆盖她身体的大部分区域，有些地方甚至被弄得模糊不清，破坏了原本应该清晰、整齐的线条。 她和村里的其他几只小动物一起，每只的毛色和毛纹都不同，身上的族纹也各具特色。他们围着篝火踢着一个小球，小心翼翼地防止球靠近火焰。 有个孩子朝伊奈亚扔了过去，但球却偏离了目标，直接朝你飞了过来。你用脚轻松地接住了球，仔细观察后发现：球的外层似乎是由皮革制成的，用一些麻绳随意地缝制在一起；而球的内部看起来很柔软，估计里面可能填充了毛皮或者类似的物质。 Inaya朝球跑去，但当她看清你的样子后便停了下来。她抬头看着你，勇气足以让她没有转身逃跑，却又过于犹豫，不敢靠近你或要求你把球还给她。从她的眼神中你可以看出，她确实认识你——最近你曾去过她家，和她母亲聊过天，但这是你第一次单独遇到她。[pc.isDK | 你暗自咒骂着，努力忍住不让嘴角因厌恶而上扬。你究竟在做什么啊，为什么要这样接近一个孩子？你本来就几乎无法忍受孩子们的存在。但既然这能让你更接近凯拉尼和她的……那些东西，那么，嗯……这已经算是你为达到目的而做出的最大努力了，也算是相当“极端”的举动了。 ] 你向前迈了一步，想要靠近伊奈亚；她却后退了一步，但她的目光依然紧紧地锁定在你身上。你将这视为一个信号，决定继续站在原地。于是，你跪了下来。[pc.heightRange 0 84 | | 模糊地 ] 与她的身高相称。[pc.dcb |嘿， |嗨， |你好！ ]你对她说，试图让自己显得更平易近人：‘我叫…… [pc.name]. [pc.dcb |我，呃……我一直在和你妈妈聊天。 |我最近一直在和你妈妈聊天，所以也很希望能和你谈谈。 |你妈妈和我可是非常好的朋友啊！或者说，我们已经非常接近成为最好的朋友了。我在想，你是不是也想和我们成为好朋友呢？朋友再多总不会嫌多，对吧？ ]Inaya茫然地注视着你。你内心其实希望语言障碍不会太严重，但看来Inaya对这种通用语言掌握得并不好。希望你不必经常让Kailani来进行翻译吧。 你再试一次。你说“我”，同时指着自己的身体。然后，你回头看向凯拉尼的小屋，指了指它，说道“凯拉尼”。接着，你把双手部交叠在一起。你并不知道用那种语言该如何表达“朋友”这个词。朋友？”你这样说道——希望伊奈亚能理解这个意思。 在整个过程中，伊奈亚一直盯着你看，但当你提到她的母亲时，你看到她的身体明显放松了一些。“凯拉尼？”她问道，眼睛瞪得大大的。 她第一次没有与你对视，而是将目光转向了自己的小屋。 你试图利用这一机会，再次指向远处的那间小屋。 凯拉尼，”你说着，然后指了指自己。[pc.name]就是你吧？”你说道，最后将手部指指向了Inaya，同时注意不要把手部臂伸得太远。“你吗？” “嗯……”Inaya低声应道，双手部交叠在身前，身体前后摇晃着，显得有些犹豫不决。她的目光始终紧紧地盯着你。“Kailani？”她问道。 [pc.isDK |这就是你们之所以如此讨厌孩子的原因之一。 |你需要花一些时间来说服自己，但这样做根本不会有什么结果。 ] 你无奈地叹了口气，重新站起身来，轻轻踢了踢那个球，让它越过那片被踩得坚硬结冰的地面，朝着伊奈亚的方向飞去。伊奈亚被球声惊到了，她立刻跳了起来，但当球撞到她的足部踝时，她迅速弯下腰，用双手部把球捡了起来，尽管球有些重，她还是费了些力气才把它拿稳。 嗯……”她又轻声哼了一声，将那个对她来说太大的球紧紧抱在胸前，同时小心翼翼地注视着你。 你转身朝凯拉尼的小屋走去。唯一让你感到些许安慰的是，伊娜雅在看到一个陌生人靠近她时，并没有转身逃跑，也没有吓得哭起来。 一天之内，你能取得的进展也就仅此而已了。 |虽然你上次与伊奈亚的相遇留下的伤痕依然历历在目，但你依然决心再试一次——至少是因为凯拉尼喜欢你这样做。而她能够放心地让你单独和她的女儿相处，这份信任其实比她自己意识到的要重要得多。 由于她那白色毛皮与蓝色斑纹的独特组合，伊奈亚再次变得很容易被认出来。她正在和一些年龄相仿的小幼崽一起玩游戏：地上画有两个大圆圈，两个圆圈之间的距离大概有十步远，每个圆圈里都用石头堆成了一个目标。 She and a number of other kits of the village, each of them with different fur colors and intensities and all of them with different tribal markings, kick a little ball around the bonfire, careful to not let the ball get too close to the blaze. One of the kids makes a pass towards Inaya, but it goes wide – and it heads straight towards you. It's easy enough to intercept with your foot, and when you do, you get a better look at it: the outside looks to be made of leather, stitched together almost haphazardly with some hemp twine, and from how giving the interior is, it feels like it might be stuffed with fur, or hair, or something among those lines. Instead, she's with Kailani's next-door neighbor, speaking with an adult woman. [first INAYA_BOND4 |The old man from last time said that Inaya was having trouble speaking with adults, but here she is, talking like it's the most normal thing in the world for her. Either he was wrong... or you're being a much better influence for her than you thought. |It's good to see Inaya speaking with the adults of the village as well as she is: the more time you spend with her, the better an influence you're turning out to be. ] As soon as Inaya sees you, she lights up – but before she goes to you, she turns to the adult she's speaking with, says something you can't make out, and bows at the waist slightly, with her hands traveling down her knees. The adult ruffles her hair a bit and then sends her on her way, and she goes straight to you. You've only barely left the doorway to Kailani's hut; when Inaya comes running up to you, saying words in her language that you don't understand, Kailani herself comes over to see what's gotten her daughter so excited. You kneel down onto your right knee, bringing yourself [pc.heightRange 0 72 | |a bit more level ]to her height. After getting your attention, which was easy, Inaya stands in front of you with her hands raised, trying to get you to stay still. She has a big, goofy smile on her face like she's excited to show you a trick that she had just learned, although it takes her a few attempts – and false starts – before she gets up the nerve and mental footing to say something. "[pc.name]," she says as she looks into your eyes. "[var0 |Hauw arr ewe |I missssst ewe |Teudae iz sughnee |Khaan wuee plaeigh ]!" Kailani applauds Inaya's attempt at speaking your language, her hands coming together rapidly. "Yes, good!" she says jovially before getting down on both knees beside you and wrapping her right arm around your shoulders. She rubs her cheek against yours a little more vigorously than usual. "She likes you, [pc.name]! She wants to talk to you in your tongue!" It's a sweet gesture – one you'll have to reciprocate, but you're not especially well-versed in the vulperine language yourself. Still, if Inaya's going to try and cross that gap, then you need to meet her halfway[pc.isDK |, and with Kailani right there watching you both, it'll definitely earn you some points with her ]. You turn your head and whisper in her ear, asking her how to say '[var0 |I am good |I missed you too |It's warm out |Yes we can ]' in her language. She tilts her head so that her muzzle is against your ear, and she whispers back, "[var0 |Ui na amig |Yol ui wrhoin ouin |Ooll wrem |Yolo gaul agr ]." You heard her say the words just fine, but... well, you understand the struggle that Inaya was having when she spoke with you and the old vulperine man at the meat spit. It's a new language: you don't have a grasp on the intricacies of how their mouths make certain sounds, and you're sure your accent is going to sound... apparent. Still, hopefully Inaya knows that you're not an expert in her language either, and you repeat the words Kailani said to you as clearly as you can: "[var0 |Eui nah ahmig |Eyoll eui rhon ooin |Uull rhem |Yulo gawl ahgr ]." Kailani's hand clutches around your shoulder appreciatively, warmly holding you closer to her as the words come out of your mouth. Inaya, though, tries to stifle a laugh: from the way her cheeks raise high enough to nearly hide her eyes, you figure that you... may have said something embarrassing. "Inaya," Kailani says with a chastising tone, "Brhal ki fil. [pc.mf |Ib |Im ] endein [pc.mf |ib |im ] kriff." "Ummal," she says, shyly turning her head down and trying – and failing – to wipe the smirk off her face. Then, in a combination of her skittering off from being scolded and her childish inability to sit still, she's off, dashing towards the village's bonfire once again. With a bit of effort, you pull yourself to your feet, with Kailani beside you. "She is not the same," she sighs as she leans her head on your shoulder. "She would not talk to an adult. She is not the same, and it is you I have to thank." You feel her right hand warmly wrap around your waist, her fingers playing with the waistline of your [pc.lowerGarments]. It's not a sexual touch: she's just holding you closer to her. You're hardly against it: your own fingers come down on hers, gently squeezing down on her fist as she plays with your clothes. You ask her what it is you actually said to Inaya. You figured that you must have botched her language pretty badly to get that sort of reaction. "The words that you said were the words I told you to say," she answers. "You... said them wrong, is all. It was... the way you said them that was wrong." That's... better? You're not sure if that's a good thing or a bad thing. "[pc.name]!" you hear Inaya call from the opposite end of the village's common area, on the other side of the bonfire. She's [rand |standing next to the village's bonfire, and by her foot is the large ball that she was kicking around with her feet that one time several days ago. You don't think she wants to play any specific game; she just wants to pass it back and forth |standing among a number of rocks that she had laid out in circles, one inside of the other; her hands are up and waving at you to join her, and you can see the glint of something shiny wrapped in her fingers |standing next to a meat spit with a gentle flame underneath it, rotating a raw slab of meat with gentle turns of the wrist; her other hand is up with all five fingers extended, waving for you to go and join her ]. Kailani gives a little laugh before moving her hand from your waist to the small of your back, giving you just the tiniest push forward. "Have fun," she says before turning around and entering her hut again. You've made good progress with them both just then. [pc.isDK |Unfortunately, keeping that progress means playing with the kid again. At least her attention span is short. |Every little bit of time you spend with Inaya is having a positive impact on both herself and Kailani – and it's easy to feel like you're benefiting from it, too. ] ]"

rows.original: Actually, you tell Kailani that you'd like to spend a bit more time with Inaya, if she'd let you. You and the little kit really seemed to be hitting it off lately; she introduces you to her games and she's been trying to teach herself Belharan to better communicate with you. [pc.isDK |Although you're not about to reciprocate that kind of effort for a child, you can at least appreciate the sort of effort and determination it takes for Inaya to go through with that for your sake. |Although you haven't really been putting in the effort to try and meet her halfway, you nonetheless don't want to diminish her efforts by not spending the time she's obviously craving with her. ] "Yes, of course!" Kailani says gleefully. "She talks much of you, [pc.name]. It is good that you want to be with her. She wants to be with you!" If that's the case – if you're going to be calling yourself Kailani's mate, and Inaya is Kailani's daughter – then why doesn't she come with? The three of you could bond together as a [pc.isDK |unit |family ]. [pc.mascFem |Inaya could use someone akin to a father figure in her life, and the three of you [pc.isDK |acting as a unit |being a family ] together would probably do her well |Inaya's missing a proper, masculine father figure in her life, but that doesn't mean she shouldn't have two parent[pc.isDK |al units |s ], like any kid should ]. The request takes Kailani be surprise... but she's quick to readjust her expression into a warm smile as she steps into your space. Her hands go to your hips, lovingly traveling down the outside of your thighs, as she rubs her cheek against yours. "Yes," she says softly, "I would like that, too. Let us go to Inaya, [pc.name]." Together, with [pc.isDK |her hand wrapped around your waist |your hand in hers ], you leave her hut and make for the village circle, where the bonfire dances.
rows.translation: 其实，你可以告诉凯拉妮，如果你能得到她的允许的话，你很想多花一些时间陪伊娜雅。最近你和那个小家伙似乎相处得非常融洽；她会向你介绍她的游戏，还一直在努力学习贝尔哈兰语，以便能更好地与你交流。 [pc.isDK |虽然你并不打算以同样的方式回报那种付出…… 孩子至少，你应该能够理解，为了你，Inaya付出了多少努力和决心才决定这么做。 |虽然你并没有真正付出努力去尝试与她达成妥协，但你也不想通过不花她所渴望的时间与她相处，从而削弱她的努力。 ] 当然可以！”凯拉尼高兴地回答，“她经常提起你呢。 [pc.name]你想要和她在一起，这真是太好了。她也同样想要和你在一起啊！” 如果真是这样的话——如果你愿意自称是凯拉尼的伴侣，而伊娜雅是凯拉尼的女儿，那么她为什么不一起来呢？你们三个完全可以一起建立深厚的感情联系啊。 [pc.isDK |单位 |家人 ]. [pc.mascFem |Inaya确实需要生活中有这样一个像父亲般存在的人，而你们三个正好符合这个要求。 [pc.isDK |作为一个整体共同行动 |像一家人一样相处 ] 她们一起合作的话，可能会取得不错的成绩。 |在她的生活中，Inaya缺少一位真正意义上的、具有男性魅力的父亲形象，但这并不意味着她不应该拥有两位父母。[pc.isDK |所有单位 |s ]就像任何一个孩子应该做的那样 ]这个请求让凯拉尼感到有些惊讶……但她很快调整了自己的表情，露出温暖的笑容，然后走进了你的身边。她将手部放在你的腰上，轻轻沿着你的大腿外侧向下移动，同时将自己的脸颊贴在你的脸颊上。“是的，”她轻声说道，“我也很愿意。让我们一起去伊奈亚吧。 [pc.name]与……一起 [pc.isDK |她的手环住了你的腰。 |手牵着手 ]你离开她的小屋，朝着村庄的中心地带走去，那里正在举行篝火舞会。

rows.original: Although Inaya's white fur blends in with the snow surrounding the village, she's easy to spot – there aren't a lot of other white-furred vulperine cubs in the village, least of all any with smudged-blue patterns on their fur. Similarly, you stick out like a sore thumb yourself: [pc.ra vulperine |you may be vulperine, but you're still taminyk, and while you've been here enough that everyone recognizes you on sight, you're still not local. |there aren't any other [pc.race]s in the village that have shaggy-furred vulperine women clinging to them (much to the chagrin of some of the males). ] Inaya spots you before you spot her, and she comes running to you and Inaya both. [inaya.kaiIsMom |"Umfracht! Umwricht! |Kailani! [pc.name]! ]" she shouts as she runs as quickly as her small child legs can take her, her arms extended to you both. You and Kailani catch her hands in your own, giving them a squeeze[weightedRand 80 20 | | – and, as if you two had been practicing this exact moment, you and Kailani both heft Inaya up into the air, lifting her clean off the ground and giving her a swing. The childish giggles of a little girl having the time of her life overpower the general ambience of the village ]. Inaya looks up at you both expectantly, eagerly awaiting whatever it is you both had in mind for coming to her. "What... is too day?" she asks, her words heavily obscured by her accent. She looks up at you with wide, expectant eyes; Kailani sees the way she looks at you, and you can see the tension in her shoulders relax so heavily that even her fur starts to slump downward a bit. The at-ease smile of a woman that has everything she's ever wanted spreads across her lips. But that begs the question: What [silly |is too day? |activity did you have in mind for them both today? ]
rows.translation: 虽然伊奈亚的白色毛皮与村庄周围的积雪融为了一体，但她仍然很容易被注意到——在这个村庄里，其他拥有白色毛皮的狐类幼崽并不多见，更何况那些毛皮上还带有蓝色斑纹的幼崽就更少了。同样地，你本身也显得格外显眼。 [pc.ra vulperine |你或许有着狐狸般的狡黠，但终究…… 塔米尼克虽然你在这里待了足够长的时间，以至于大家都能一眼认出你，但你仍然算不上是这里的本地人。 |没有其他的了 [pc.race]村子里有些雄性动物，身上缠着那些毛茸茸的雌性动物……这让一些雄性动物感到非常苦恼。 ] 在你发现她之前，她就已经看到了你，然后她跑过来，朝你和伊奈亚两个人跑了过来。 [inaya.kaiIsMom |"运费！环绕四周! |凯拉妮！ [pc.name]! ]她边跑边喊，用她那双小孩子的腿拼命地奔跑，双臂伸向你们两个人。你和凯拉尼握住了她的手部，轻轻地捏了捏。[weightedRand 80 20 | | – 就像你们俩早就练习过这一刻一样，你和凯拉尼同时将伊奈亚举到空中，让她完全离开地面，然后轻轻一甩。那个小女孩开心地咯咯笑着，她的笑声完全盖过了村庄里的其他氛围。 ]Inaya充满期待地抬头看着你们俩，急切地想知道你们找她来究竟有什么事。“什……么事情？”她问道，她的话语因为浓重的口音而显得有些含糊不清。她用那双充满期待的眼睛望着你们；Kailani看到了她看你们的眼神，而你也注意到她的肩膀上的紧张情绪明显放松了许多，甚至连她的毛发都开始往下耷拉了。 一个拥有自己所渴望的一切的女人，脸上绽放出那种心满意足的微笑。 但这就引出了一个问题： 究竟是什么让她如此满足呢？ [silly |是 今天是什么日子？ |你今天为他们俩安排了什么活动呢？ ]

rows.original: Inaya is a vulperine girl; you've never been told her age, but she can't be older than ten. She's related to Kailani by blood: although Kailani's adopted her as her own daughter, the reality is that Inaya is the daughter of Kailani's aunt's daughter, making her and Inaya cousins, once removed. Although their blood relationship is modestly distant, they nonetheless share a fair amount of physical attributes: Inaya's fur is snow-white, like Kailani's, except her fur hasn't had the chance to grow in as thick and fluffy, and is smooth and short all over her body. Her hair is white, too, although it's kept much shorter than Kailani's, barely reaching down to her neck – and it looks well-maintained and cared for, with each strand straight as a line and without a single knot in sight. It might even have been cut recently, from the looks of it. Likewise, her tail isn't half as full-bodied as her mother's: it extends down to the back of her ankles, the tip just barely grazing the ground, and its fur is kept nice and thin and glossy all throughout. The most striking physical difference between them, however, is their eyes: Inaya's are a deep brown, a far contrast from Kailani's blue. Dotting all over Inaya's fur are blue lines, just like Kailani's body has, denoting her life's story in fantastic symbols and intricate designs... although the lines are all blurred and smudged across her body, badly deforming many of the pictures and turning some of them into illegible messes. Where Kailani's are applied with dyes that had been refined with laborious techniques over time, Inaya's appear to have been applied with less effort: they're more like stains than they are proper tattoos. You wouldn't be surprised if Inaya, being a child, would lick them off whenever Kailani wasn't looking, so her lines are applied with something more palatable, if less stable. Like her mother, Inaya wears a two-piece suit consisting of a top and a bottom, although they cover much more: not just her chest and pelvis, but also her arms and legs down to her elbows and knees, leaving just a small amount of her midriff exposed (and covered in more smudged, blue lines). The tunic is adorned with the Ibulim family colors: yellows, greens, and browns, with red highlights along the trims. The tunic itself appears tight on her body, but that might just be the fur she's wearing pushing out from underneath it. Or maybe she's starting to grow out of it. As far as you can tell, Inaya is a healthy little girl overall. She has a healthily-cautious attitude towards strangers, but once she gets to know an adult – especially a taminyk like yourself – she has a cheerful disposition with a smile that could light up the night.
rows.translation: 伊奈亚是个有着狐狸般外貌的女孩；虽然没人告诉过你她的具体年龄，但她的年纪肯定不超过十岁。她和凯拉妮有着血缘关系：尽管凯拉妮将她当作自己的亲生女儿来抚养，但实际上，伊奈亚是凯拉妮姑姑的女儿，因此她们算是远房表姐妹关系。 虽然他们的血缘关系较为疏远，但他们在外貌特征上却有着不少相似之处：Inaya的毛色如同Kailani一样是雪白的，只不过她的毛发还没有机会长得那么浓密蓬松，因此全身都覆盖着柔软而短小的毛发。 她的头发也是白色的，不过长度比凯拉妮短得多，几乎只到她的脖子而已——而且她的头发看起来保养得非常好，每一根头发都笔直整齐，没有一根打结。 从外观上看，它的尾巴可能是最近才被剪短的。同样，它的尾巴也没有它母亲的尾巴那么浓密：尾巴一直延伸到脚踝的后部，尾巴尖端仅仅略微触地，而且它的毛发一直保持着纤细、有轻型泽的状态。 然而，他们之间最明显的身体差异在于他们的眼睛：Inaya的眼睛是深棕色的，与Kailani的蓝色眼睛形成了鲜明的对比。 伊奈亚的毛皮上布满了蓝色的线条，就像凯拉妮的身体上那样，这些线条用奇妙的神符和复杂的图案记录着她生命中的故事……只不过，这些线条在她的身体上已经变得模糊不清，许多图案因此而变形，有些甚至完全无法辨认了。 凯拉尼身上的纹身是使用经过长期精心加工的染料绘制而成的，而伊奈亚身上的纹身似乎是用了较为简单的工艺：它们更像是污渍，而非真正的纹身。考虑到伊奈亚还是个孩子，她很可能会在凯拉尼不注意的时候把它们舔掉，因此她身上的纹身所使用的材料应该更加温和些，只不过稳定性可能稍差一些。 和她的母亲一样，伊奈亚也穿着一套由上衣和下装组成的连体衣。不过这套衣服覆盖的范围要大得多——它不仅遮住了她的胸部和臀部，还延伸到了她的手臂和腿部，一直覆盖到肘部和膝盖部位，只留下腹部的一小部分裸露在外（而那部分皮肤上也布满了蓝色的线条）。 这件束腰外衣采用了伊布利姆家族的色彩搭配：黄色、绿色和棕色，边缘还点缀着红色装饰。这件外衣看起来紧贴她的身体，但这也可能是因为她里面穿着毛皮，使得外衣的轮廓更加明显。 或者，也许她已经开始逐渐摆脱这种状态了。 从表面上看，Inaya是一个非常健康的小女孩。她对陌生人保持着谨慎的态度，但一旦她认识了某个成年人——尤其是…… 塔米尼克 和她一样——她性格开朗，她的笑容足以照亮整个夜晚。
