"You are a good mate," she says, out-of-turn. "You are not what we had come to think of how a taminyk would act. Most vulps would not do what you do." She stands there, enjoying the feel of your heat against her hand for just a moment... before lowering both of her palms to yours, squeezing her fingers around your hands, and not because she wants to hold them. With an insistent tug, she pulls you back towards the entrance to her hut. "There is much to do," she says, her tail swaying with her gait as she hurriedly pulls you to her home. "I will tell you when there is none to do." You'll probably be waiting a long while. ] Kailani leads you back towards her hut with Inaya in tow. [rand |"Inaya," she says, looking over her shoulder as she lets go of your hands. "Vot grrim. Omtuo yolo nelm kinim yollo." "Igue," Inaya says, making her way towards a small bucket on the left-hand side of the hut, but not before she grips onto your hand the same way Kailani had. Her comparatively tiny fingers wrap around yours, using both palms to squeeze two in each. "Do good, [inaya.kaiIsMom |[pc.mf |daddy |mommy ] |[pc.name] ]," she says with a giggle before setting herself down on her knees, facing towards the center of the hut's common room. Kailani vanishes into her room, but only for a few seconds: when she returns, she's holding a wooden bowl that's been badly stained blue, with a pulverized blue concoction stirring about in its recess. A sudden, intense, fruity smell wafts into your nose as Kailani approaches – it smells intensely of blueberries. She had crushed who knows how many blueberries in that bowl to make some sort of fruity slurry, and from the stains on the outside of the bowl, she's done it multiple times before. It must be very sticky. "[pc.name], we are to do the omtuo on Inaya," she says. Once again, she grips you by the wrist and gives you a gentle pull, guiding you to your knees, with you on one side of Inaya and herself on the other. "You ask on my omtuo ; you say they are 'tattoos,' yes?" She dips two of her fingers into the blueberry slurry and pull them out; the thick, dripping porridge clings to her fingers, sloughing off in long, thick rivulets back into the bowl as she takes her time pulling them out. "Inaya has them, too. But I do them for her. This time, we do them – you as my mate." You eye Inaya's fur. Most of it is as white as the snow surrounding the village, but there are smudged blue lines covering her in haphazard spots that look vaguely like Kailani's own, sharper designs. Inaya, being a ten-year-old girl, spends a lot of her childhood running with her friends and playing in the mud around the village, so the lines get messy and ruined easily – but even still, they don't last as long as you'd expect. After all, Kailani is a hunter and spends most of her time in the snow and what little brush surrounds the mountain, and her designs don't get nearly as ruined. You ask Kailani if the tattoos – if the 'omtuo' on her fur is also applied with crushed blueberries. "No," she says as she dips her fingers into the bowl to moisten them in the sludge once more. Once the blueberry slurry is stuck to her fingers, she gently applies it to Inaya's fur, tracing along the faded lines of the last time they had applied the tattoos. "Fruit is used as dye for our kits; I use soft rock. Kits will try to lick them off, so we use fruit until they grow out of that." Applying the tattoos using something delicious, like crushed blueberries, is maybe not the best approach to teaching a kid to not lick them off, but, well, you're in Kailani's culture; you do as she says. Drawing the markings on Inaya's fur is a slow process, but you wouldn't define it as 'delicate': because of how long her fur is and how drippy the blueberry slurry can be, it takes some effort to worm it underneath her fur and get it properly settled in. Luckily, you don't have to worry about it getting runny on you, but working it underneath all of her fur is still a time-consuming process that requires more than one pass just for a single line. Her markings are faded and blurry, but there's still enough there that you can figure out what the tattoos looked like before, and all you have to do is follow them so they they're good and thick and dark-blue again. Kailani's instructions are sparse: many of them wouldn't be in her native language anyway, so she says as little as she can: whatever instruction Kailani gives you, it's usually on how it's applied, not where. "Like this," she says now and again, dipping her fingers into the slurry and dragging them along where Inaya's fur is already stained blue. "Now you," she continues, gingerly grabbing your wrist with her three dry fingers and guiding you along Inaya's fur, holding you almost like an artist would hold a paintbrush. She's very delicate and patient, and you can feel the years of experience in how she grips your hand and guides you along – although, then again, it's also a delicate and patient process, and one mistake would take a lot of effort to fix. Inaya sits with her back straight and her head facing forward; it sort of reminds you of someone getting their hair done. Which isn't so far from reality. Sometimes you get her somewhere ticklish, and she flinches and giggles before resetting herself. "[pc.name] higlimo yoll gool kamba," she giggles; although you don't understand what she said, the laughter leads you to believe that you're not doing anything wrong. Although maybe you should stop doing whatever it is you're doing to make her laugh, because it makes it harder to work on her tattoos. Maybe she's just ticklish. Time passes quietly between you three. The task isn't especially complex: Kailani once told you that a vulperine's tattoos were stories of their lives written on their bodies, and Inaya, being young, doesn't have many and they aren't very complicated. It's just you, Kailani, and Inaya. You sort of get the impression that the tattoos aren't as important to either of them as it is the time you're all spending together: Kailani's been a single mother without a mate most of her life, and Inaya's only ever had one parent before you came in. You give them both a form of stability they didn't know they had been craving for years, and your presence, and your every stroke of your blueberry-tinged fingers through Inaya's fur, gives them both a sort of peace that had been missing from their lives. The job takes less time than you thought it would, and when it's done, Inaya's lines are just as thick and clean as Kailani's, looking as though they were both applied at the same time with the same material. Everything from the diamond shapes around her eyes to the circles on her arms are reapplied with a pair of steady hands. Kailani leans back, letting her hands rest on her kilt as she admires the handiwork you and her had done applying the art to Inaya's white fur. "Good," she sighs, tilting her head and letting a thin smile spread on her face as she studies Inaya – and then you, and your blue-tinted fingers. Her eyes fall to yours, and they lock there for a long, steady moment. "Um," Inaya says sheepishly, turning on her seat not to face you or Kailani, but to face the bowl in her hand. Kailani can't help but laugh. "This is the best part," she says, lowering her two stained fingers back into the slop and withdrawing a huge dollop of the slurry – and lifting it right to her mouth, sucking them clean. Inaya does the same thing, greedily scooping into it with three fingers instead. You were sort of wondering why there was so much of the stuff in that bowl. Just before you lower your own fingers into the bowl for some of the blueberry treat, Inaya, thinking quickly, sucks two of her fingers clean, but leaves her index finger untouched. She dips it back into the bowl, then taps you on the nose with it, leaving a dark blue stain on the very tip of your nose that you can just barely see with your peripheral vision. With an airy giggle, Kailani does the same thing: she dips her thumb into the bowl, then presses it to your forehead. They'll wash off eventually. |Sitting next to the entrance to her hut is a large, makeshift wooden frame that Kailani probably assembled herself, and inside the frame and hung up with a series of twine strings is a massive, browned patch of leather. Judging just from the size of the pelt, it was something quite large, like a moose buck, or maybe even a young-adult bear. Either way, it's not much more than a lump of skin now – turning an animal hide all the way from a fresh kill to workable leather is a long and arduous process that takes days, and with the pelt just hanging there on the frame, it's nearly finished. You ask Kailani if she lets Inaya help her with any other step of the leather tanning process. You wouldn't call yourself an expert in the field, but you do know that it's messy at the best of times, and it involves handling sharp objects frequently. "Now and then," she shrugs. "Inaya knows how to work a blade. She cut her higlim when she was young." She smiles wryly; it was clearly a long time ago, and Inaya isn't missing any of her body parts, so it must not have been a bad injury. "Then she knew." Kailani reaches behind the standing frame and withdraws two, long, sturdy, blunted sticks. They're both about the same length: just a bit too long for Inaya, and just a bit too short for Kailani. As she hands one of the sticks to Inaya, you ask her if tanning leather is a skill that everyone in the village knows – Kailani is the hunter, and although her bra and kilt are adorned with her family's colors, you wouldn't have thought that she made them herself. "If you are to hunt, then you must know some of hide work, yes," she answers. "Not all. I do not make..." She stutters a few times, trying to get out her words and failing repeatedly. She grips at her leather bra. "Dowrtre. Things to wear. I make the hide, the umlifch. I cut it to strings, then give the rest to the village umlifch torwim." Very suddenly, Inaya rears her stick back, leaning it over her shoulder, and then she thrusts forward, batting it against the strung-up leather on the frame. It's with enough force that the frame rattles in place, but the strings holding it all together remain firm and taut. "Fun!" Inaya says, offering you her stick so that you can have a go – but Kailani pushes it down so she can offer hers instead. "Inaya can tan a hide, from kill to umlifch," she continues, "but this part is easy, safe – and fun." Inaya rears her stick back again and whacks it against the leather, causing the material to creak and groan from the impact. "It is to make the hide soft to work. But not too soft! Too soft, and it is no good." She rests her hand on Inaya's shoulder, wordlessly telling her to take a step back. "You try, [pc.name]." Seems simple enough: just [pc.isDK |beat the shit out of some leather |whack a bit of leather ] until she tells you to stop. She doesn't want the leather to be too tenderized, so you don't give it your all, but all the same, the taut ropes keeping the rack upright and the leather in place strain from the force of the impact, and you can see the indented spot where you beat the end of the stick against the leather slowly form back into place. Soft enough to work with, but tough enough to withstand a blow from a blunted weapon – or, more appropriately, a charging animal. This bit of leather would make a good gambeson. You and Inaya take turns, trying to hit the leather on a different spot each time. She would grunt with her swing; then you would grunt when you swung; then she would grunt louder; than you would grunt louder than that; until, eventually, you and her are making comical, bestial, throaty sounds with your thrusts, each of you beating [silly |the meat |the leather ] a little harder every time. As much fun as you two are having, Kailani nonetheless stops you from getting too carried away and pulverizing the leather too harshly, to keep it from going soft... and to tell you two to start working on the other side so that it tenderizes evenly. It is, at the end of the day, a chore. Something that benefits the whole of the village, but a chore nonetheless. But even the most menial of tasks can be made into something entertaining with a bit of imagination, and doubly so if you have someone to do it with. Inaya, being a child, has a sort of energy that, even with of your adventuring[pc.isDK | and fucking on the side ], you have a hard time keeping up with – but her childish giggles make it all worth it. It reminds you of when you were younger. "Okay, okay, igue," Kailani says, stepping between you both to get you to stop. "It is good, now. We do not want to do too much." Inaya is more reluctant to surrender her stick than you are, but nonetheless, you both do as Kailani says and stop tenderizing the leather. She removes it from the rack and gives it several once-overs with her hands, making sure that it's smooth and sturdy, but still tough enough that it'll last as either clothing, or as a tool. "This is good," she eventually says, unhooking it from the rack. "Good!" "Yay!" Inaya cheers, rushing towards [inaya.kaiIsMom |her mother |Kailani ] with her arms spread out. "Ui agr duul?" Kailani tilts her head curiously for a moment, before hefting the giant sheet of leather in her hands and folding it in half twice. Once it's about large enough for Inaya's spread arm span, she places the leather in her daughter's arms – only for Inaya to almost immediately fall to her knees from the weight of the leather suddenly weighing her down. It's a lot heavier than it looks! With a grunt, she manages to pull herself back up to her feet, but it's clear that she's really struggling to even stay upright. "Igue," she says, straining to get the words out. "Yol agr imbi." Kailani laughs and ruffles Inaya's hair as she takes the leather back from her. |Kailani disappears into her room for just a moment, and when she returns, she's holding a drum under her right arm and a mallet in the other. The drum's body is made from polished wood, and stretched across its top is a thin, battered sheet of leather; the mallet is more or less just a short stick, but wrapped around its tip is a thick knob of cloth, tied at the neck by a string of leather. "Oh!" Inaya says suddenly before dashing into her own room. When she emerges from it, she's holding a similar stick in her own hand, but with a much more bulbous end made of wood. When it moves with her motions, there's a sandy rattling noise coming from inside of it. "Ralm ko beit ou?" "Gaul," Kailani says with a nod, motioning towards the door. "[pc.name]. It is time to dance." [pc.isDK |You think not. You're willing to do a lot of things if it means getting with Kailani, but you're absolutely not the dancing type. The most you'll do is stand there. Maybe tap your foot if Kailani's any good at maintaining a rhythm. |Oh, dancing sounds like fun! You're not much of a dancer yourself – ever since your life's taken a twist, you haven't had a lot of opportunities to try and learn any styles or steps. But, on the other hand, dancing is the language of the body: you don't need to 'know' anything. You just need to let the rhythm guide you. ] Inaya stands to the side of the hut's entrance, giddily waiting for Kailani to start the beat with her drum. Fortunately, there's not much to the 'setup': Kailani just sits herself down on an uprooted stump next to the entrance to her hut, and she's ready. She looks at Inaya, positioning the mallet just above the drum – then feigns striking, watching Inaya jump and overshoot the timing on getting started. With a laugh, Kailani begins in earnest, thumping the mallet against the drum with one hand and tapping on the drum's head with her free palm in between strikes. She gives you a steady one-one-two rhythm, and Inaya is quick to pick up on it, too: after a few measures, she starts shaking the rattle in time to Kailani's drumming. Once [inaya.kaiIsMom |the mother and daughter |Kailani and Inaya ] settle into each other's rhythms, Kailani starts singing. She doesn't sing any words: it's really just loud, open-mouthed humming, but the intonations of her voice shift up and down in pitch like lyrics to a song you're more familiar with would. And once she starts singing, Inaya grabs you by the hand and starts trying to guide you in her dance. [pc.isDK |You allow her to swing your arm around, but you steadfastly refuse to mimic any of her jovial up-and-down prances as she prances circles around you. Your presence is all that you're willing to give for this activity; you're not going to debase yourself by dancing, of all things. You don't even know how to dance; it's an absurd, insipid pastime that you never gave a second thought to, and you don't intend to learn. |Inaya's movements feel more like an aimless prance than anything learned and practiced, but, that said, she's going in time with both Kailani's drumming and her own shaking of her rattler. There's nothing to practice: what's important is that you move, and moving in time with the beat and shaking to the rhythm is all part of the activity, even if it's totally aimless. All you have to do is move like Inaya does, even if she's just a child. Or especially because she's a child. ] [pc.isDK |Y |Perhaps y ]ou're a little out of place: you're an outsider, a taminyk and whatever song Kailani is singing and whatever dance Inaya is trying to get you to do feel like something that's better reserved for the locals. Someone that could better appreciate the music and the singing. Kailani watches you closely and intently, and, under her gaze, you realize the significance of what it is she and [inaya.kaiIsMom |her daughter |Inaya ] are trying to get you to do – if this was something that didn't involve you, as her mate[inaya.kaiIsMom | and Inaya's [pc.mf |father |other mother ] ], then they wouldn't have involved you. Your participation is important to them[pc.isDK |. Ugh, fine, whatever. You awkwardly shift your arms in one direction, then the next, and you twist your hips slightly. There, you're dancing. Although, and much to your chagrin (and a bit to your horror), |, and the smile on Kailani's face as you move with Inaya is... honestly, a bit infectious. Soon, ] you're surrounded by other vulperines of the village, many of them bringing instruments of their own: some of them have more drums; some of them have shakers like Inaya; and some of them bring flutes, or simpler instruments like bells. Many of them don't bring anything, but they're quick to pair up and start dancing to the rhythm. You can tell that none of them have practiced any songs with each other, but music, like dancing, is a language, and one that doesn't need a lot of practice to speak: as long as they all stay on beat, then any kind of noise they make is just music by a different name. If music was a painted picture, then every sound they make is them adding their own brushstroke to the canvas – the end result might be nonsensical and overly busy in some places, but it's nonetheless something everyone made together, as a community. [pc.isDK |And unfortunately for you, you can't really get away with your toe-tapping and your hip-twisting as excuses to dance |And fortunately for you, your inexperience with dancing is just as inconsequential as whether the music was a practiced routine or not ]. Soon, you're pulled away from Inaya to dance with other vulperines, ranging from old to young, with a myriad of different fur colors, and sometimes you're even paired with other [pc.mf | |wo ]men. [pc.isDK |You could follow their lead and try and mimic their actions as they dance, but that feels somehow worse. God, next time, maybe you should keep your damn mouth shut and just tell Kailani that you want to fuck. She's usually pretty willing to fuck when you want to. |Generally, you just try to follow the lead of whoever you're with at the time before they hand you off to someone else, and it's fascinating how many different styles and energies people display as you move with them. It's like you're having whole conversations in the space of a few seconds. ] The trouble with starting a party like this one, though, is that it's hard to know when to stop. The song is improvised, meaning there isn't an 'end' in mind, and you could be trading partners indefinitely the whole time. But the answer is much simpler than that. Throughout it all, Inaya had been shaking her shaker as part of the music. Eventually, she simply stops, and when you look toward her, she's breaking away from the crowd to have a seat. She just got tired of it. And when the song loses one of its instruments, the others quickly follow suit. Kailani and her drum weren't even the last ones still playing by the time everything wrapped up. And just like that, the party is over. You, Kailani, and Inaya had started a whole song and dance party with, near as you could tell, almost everyone in the village, and when one little girl got tired and sat down, it all dispersed. [pc.isDK |And not a moment too soon |That sort of spontaneity is... impressive. You could learn something from being as free-flowing as the vulperine people ]. When it's all said and done, Kailani, with a smile, reaches for you with her hand still grasping the mallet; you put yours in hers, with the stem of the mallet between both of your hands. And Inaya is quick to put her own hand in your other as all three of you head back into the hut[pc.isDK |. At least Kailani's happy. Surely you made some headway with her here. Hopefully it never happens again, though ]. ]"

rows.original: You and Kailani leave her hut to look for Inaya in the village proper. She's easy to spot: there aren't a lot of other rambunctious white-furred vulperine kits running around the village with blue markings in their fur. She spots you both as well, and, as before, she comes running straight to you both. However, somewhat unusually for her, she's a little bashful as she comes closer: her head is low and her arms are tucked behind her back. She drags her feet through the mud with her every step. She's having a hard time maintaining eye-contact with either of you, but with you more than Kailani. It's not a guilty, she-did-something-bad-as-she-knows-it look; it's something shy and reserved, like you're a stranger all over again. "Um," she hesitates. "Kailani... [pc.name] win ui agr vienug?" Kailani furrows her brow and tilts her head at the question. Whatever Inaya just asked, it was something unusual enough to totally catch her off-guard. "Igue," she eventually relents, hanging on the last syllable for a little bit. "Inaya would like to be alone with you, [pc.name]. I will be home if you need me." With that, Inaya grabs you by the hand and leads you a small distance from the hut, while Kailani heads back inside. You're alone with Inaya for the first time since you, her, and Kailani had been bonding with each other as unit. It reminds you of when you first tried approaching the kit. "Um," Inaya stutters, rocking on her feet with her hands behind her back. She keeps glancing towards Kailani's hut, as if checking to make sure you and her are truly alone. "[pc.name]," she says; she looks like she knows what to say, but she doesn't know how to say it. Belharan isn't her first language, after all. [pc.isDK |You grow impatient, but... you know better than to raise your voice against a child, if for no other reason than because that'll only make her more nervous and unable to formulate her thoughts into words. Still, you're also not about to help her. She needs to figure this out herself. And if it's hopeless, you'll just take her back to the hut. |You kneel down in front of her, hoping that bringing you closer to her might put her a little more at ease, even if it means making your knees all muddy. The proximity seems to help her body language, but not her struggle with her words. Still, you keep from helping her formulate her words: her figuring it out on her own will be better for her development. That, and trying to guess your way through her sentences would probably only make it worse. ] "Ewe," she starts, closing her eyes tightly enough to scrunch her nose as she tries to parse together her thoughts in Belharan. "Kailani... hunt?" Maybe she's asking if you and Kailani regularly go hunting? You tentatively answer that, no, that's not something you two do together. You're good at a lot of things, but Kailani is a specialist; you'd probably just get in her way. "No," she says, shaking her head. "Ewe, Kailani... hunt..." She motions with both hands to her left, waving her fingers at nothing. "Then? Um... t-then?" That one's a bit harder to discern. You, and Kailani, hunt, 'then.' And she's motioning to her left... Maybe she's asking if you and Kailani had ever hunted? Because if so, then yes: there was exactly one time when you and Kailani went out on a hunt together. It actually went pretty well. You answer that, yes, you and Kailani went on a hunt once before. "Um, yea," she says with a nod. She looks around, then drags you to the nearest hut, close enough to touch it with her fingers. "Hut," she says, then bends over and puts her hands into the mud, drawing a wide circle before flicking the excess away. "Hole?" A hut, and a hole... that could be anything. You furrow your brow as you try to parse what she wants. Recognizing the posture and expression, she instead points to the cap of the Windy Peaks behind you. "Hut... hole?" she asks again, pointing insistently at the peak. What could the words 'hut,' 'hole,' and the top of the mountain have in common...? [pc.isBimbo |Well, like, there aren't any huts, not like in the village, any higher up the mountain, and none of 'em have holes... caves have holes, though. They have a whole lot of holes! You giggle to yourself, then say the word 'cave,' mostly to yourself. It's just a fun word to say. |You try thinking of synonyms for the words that might work. A 'hut' could be a building, or a hovel, or generally any construct that a person could take shelter in– 'Shelter.' Maybe 'home'? Maybe... a hole, in the mountain, is a home? A cave? It's a bit of a leap, admittedly... but you ask her if she means the word 'cave.' Not that you expect her to know what a cave is. ] "Cave," she repeats. Her eyes close as she considers it. Her nostrils flare and her brow furrows; she's trying really hard to follow along with this conversation. [pc.isDK |You're starting to get a little annoyed, not at her, but your combined inability to communicate. You're supposed to be past this. |It's oddly refreshing, in an annoying way, to bond with Inaya in your mutual frustration over your language barrier. ] "Hunt... in cave." That is what you two did. There was a big, furry monster in a cave on the mountain, and you and Kailani managed to take it down. "Kailani," she says again, looking at Kailani's hut, suddenly getting an idea for a new train of thought. And, once more, just as quickly as it came up, she's frustrated by her inability to articulate where to take it. It's admirable that she doesn't immediately default back to the vulperine language, or to try and get an elder to translate for you two: she wants to say this on her own, with the words she knows. "Kailani... is... is..." She tries and struggles some more, her hands going up to her neck as if she was trying to coax the words out on their own. "Naught... same." Kailani... isn't the same? Since you and her went and hunted that weird, hairy beast in the cave? That is true: shortly after that, you and Kailani [pc.isDK |fucked. You took her virginity and everything. Shit like that's bound to change a woman. |became mates. That whole saga was a big deal for her for a bunch of reasons. ] "Kailani," Inaya continues, "is... naught umfracht. But... Kailani... is umfracht." ... Wow. You've heard that word enough times now to know that it means 'mother.' That's a big thing for Inaya to say, that Kailani is her mom: you don't think she's ever said that to her. Kailani would love to hear her say it, but... you ask Inaya why she's saying that to you. "[pc.name]," she continues, chewing and swallowing nothing as she tries to piece her thoughts together. "Goe too cave. Sea... sea... Kailani naught same." That's true, too: when you and Kailani went into that cave, Kailani found something in the cave's deepest chamber that suddenly changed her whole motivation for being there. She went into that cave to learn what had happened to both of her parents, and to prove something not just to herself, but to everyone in the village: that, one, something dangerous really did live in that cave, and two, she was the greatest hunter in the village (with you as her spotter, anyway). "Goe to cave," Inaya says again, pointing at the peak of the mountain. Wait, she wants you to go back? "Kailani naught same," she repeats. "Hunt... um... watt Kailani naught same." [pc.isDK |You furrow your brow, and then you start to feel yourself getting frustrated. Inaya isn't making herself clear, and you know that she can't, not without asking for a translator, but you're not about to ask for one and she needs to communicate without one if she's going to control her grasp on Belharan. Still, your patience is beginning to wane. If you're not mistaken, this little brat is asking you to go all the way back out to that cave and 'hunt what Kailani not same.' |You furrow your brow as you try to parse what it is that Inaya is asking from you. She said that she wants you to 'go to cave' to 'hunt what Kailani not same.' You're proud that she's communicating as well as she is without the need of a translator, but... you have to admit, it'd be much easier if you did. If she's fighting the urge to find an adult with a better grasp of Belharan than either of you, then you need to fight that urge too. And in the meantime, it sounds a lot like she's asking you to go all the way back out to that cave... ] "Pleese?" she asks, looking up at you with wide eyes. You recognize that look anywhere: she knows exactly what she's asking from you, even if she doesn't think she's communicating it well. It's not like she can pick up and go to that cave herself. [pc.isDK |Ugh. She's lucky her mom is hot. |It's a bit out of the way from the vulperine village, but... if you're in the area, you might as well double check that cave. ]
rows.translation: 你和凯拉尼离开她的小屋，前往村庄里寻找伊奈亚。她很容易被找到：在村庄里，没有其他那些毛发上带有蓝色斑纹、性格活泼的白毛狐狸幼崽会四处跑来跑去。她也注意到了你们，和之前一样，她立刻跑向了你们。 然而，对她来说有点不寻常的是，当她靠近你们时，她显得有些害羞：她低着头，双臂交叉在背后。她每走一步都会让足部在泥泞中拖动。她很难与你们中的任何一个人保持眼神交流，但与你交流的难度似乎比与凯拉尼交流还要大。 那并不是那种“知道自己做了坏事、因此显得内疚”的表情，而是一种害羞、拘谨的神情，就好像你又变成了一个陌生人一样。 “嗯，”她犹豫了一下，“凯拉尼…… [pc.name] win ui agr vienug凯拉尼皱起眉头，歪着头思考着这个问题。无论伊娜亚刚刚问了什么，显然都是些出乎她意料的事情，完全让她措手部不及。伊格好吧，”她最终还是让步了，最后一个音节拖得有点长。“Inaya想和你单独待一会儿。 [pc.name]如果需要我的帮助，我会在家。” 说完，伊奈亚握住你的手部，带着你离开小屋一段距离，而凯拉尼则回到了屋里。这是自从你们三人开始作为一个团队共同协作以来，你第一次与伊奈亚单独相处。这让你想起了当初你第一次尝试接近这个团队时的情景。 “嗯……”伊奈亚支支吾吾地说道，双手部背在身后，站在那里犹豫不决。她不时朝凯拉尼的小屋方向瞥去，似乎在确认你们确实处于单独状态。[pc.name]她是这么说的，”她说，看起来她知道该说什么，但却不知道该如何表达出来。毕竟，贝尔哈兰语并不是她的母语。 [pc.isDK |你开始变得不耐烦，但是……你心里很清楚，不应该对孩子大声呵斥。至少，这样做只会让她更加紧张，更无法将自己的想法用语言表达出来。不过，你也不会去帮助她。她必须自己想办法解决这个问题。如果真的无望了，你也就只能把她带回小屋罢了。 |你跪在她面前，希望这样能让她感到更加安心，哪怕自己的膝盖因此变得泥泞不堪。这种亲近似乎有助于缓解她的肢体语言上的紧张，但却无法帮助她解决语言表达上的困难。不过，你还是没有直接帮她组织语言——你认为让她自己尝试解决这个问题，对她的语言能力发展更有帮助。更何况，如果你试图去猜测她句子中的含义，反而可能会让情况变得更糟。 ] 呃……”她开始说道，紧紧闭上眼睛，甚至把鼻子都皱了起来，努力用贝拉兰语整理自己的思绪。“凯拉尼……一起去打猎吗？” 也许她在问你和凯拉尼是否经常一起打猎？你试探性地回答道，并没有，你们俩并没有这个习惯。 你很多事情都做得不错，但凯拉妮是这方面的专家；你去了只会妨碍她。 “不，”她摇着头说，“呃，凯拉妮……去狩猎吧……”她用双手部朝左边挥了挥，手部指在空中无目的地摆动着。 然后呢？嗯……然后呢？” 这个就有点难判断了。你和凯拉尼在打猎，然后她朝着自己的左边指了指…… 也许她在问你和凯拉尼是否发生了什么。 曾经 被追捕过吗？如果真是这样，那么确实有一次：你和凯拉妮一起出去狩猎过，而且进展得还挺顺利。你得承认，你和凯拉妮确实曾经一起狩猎过一次。 “嗯，是的，”她点头说道。 她环顾四周，然后把你拉到最近的一间小屋旁，那小屋离得如此之近，以至于她的手部指几乎可以碰到它。“小屋，”她说着，然后弯下腰，将双手部伸进泥浆中，画出一个大大的圆圈，随后把多余的泥浆甩掉。“洞穴吗？一间小屋，还有一个洞……那里面可能什么都有。你皱起眉头，试图弄明白她的意思。 看到你的反应，她便指着你身后风之峰的山顶。 小屋……洞穴？”她再次问道，坚持地指向山顶。 “小屋”、“洞穴”这两个词，以及山顶，它们之间究竟有什么联系呢……？ [pc.isBimbo |嗯，实际上山上并没有任何小屋，不像村子里的那样。而且那些地方也没有洞穴……不过洞穴里确实有很多洞啊！你会暗自发笑，然后小声念出“洞穴”这个词，多半也是自言自语。这个词说起来就是觉得挺有趣罢了。 |你可以试着想想这些词的替代词，看看哪些词可以用得通。“小屋”可以指任何一个人可以用来遮风避雨的建筑或简陋的住所…… “遮风避雨的地方”……或许“家”也可以？又或者……山里的洞穴也能算作家吗？诚然，这个联想有点牵强……但你可以问问她，她说的到底是不是“洞穴”这个词。当然，你也不指望她真的知道什么是洞穴。 ] 洞穴，”她重复道。她闭上眼睛，仔细思考着这个词语。她的鼻孔微微张开，眉头也皱了起来——她正在努力理解这段对话的含义。 [pc.isDK |你开始感到有些烦躁了，不是因为她，而是因为你们双方都无法有效地进行沟通。你们本应该已经克服这个问题的。 |在面对语言障碍所带来的共同困扰时，与伊奈亚建立起这种联系，虽然有点让人烦恼，但却有一种奇怪的清新感。 ] 在洞穴里狩猎…… 是 你们两个做的事情真是了不起。山上有个洞穴里住着一只巨大的、毛茸茸的怪物，而你们和凯拉尼成功把它消灭了。 “凯拉尼，”她再次说道，目光投向凯拉尼的小屋，突然想到了一个新的思路。 然而，这种想法刚出现，她又立刻感到沮丧，因为她不知道该如何继续表达自己的想法。值得称赞的是，她并没有立刻重新使用那种隐晦的语言，也没有试图让长辈来为她们两个人翻译——她想要用自己的话，用自己熟悉的词汇来表达这些想法。 凯拉尼……她……她……”她努力着，双手部抱住脖子，仿佛在试图让那些话语自己从口中说出来。“没什么……没什么变化。” 凯拉尼真的没什么变化吗？自从你和她一起去洞穴里捕捉那种奇怪的、长满毛发的野兽之后？ 那个 是 true：就在那之后不久，你和凯拉尼…… [pc.isDK |真他妈的。你夺走了她的贞操，以及她的一切。这种事情肯定会改变一个女人。 |成为了朋友。对于她来说，整个经历之所以如此重要，原因有很多。 ] 凯拉尼，”伊奈亚继续说道，“其实……什么都不是。 运费但是……凯拉妮…… 是 运费…哇，你现在已经听过这个词太多次了，应该知道它的意思是“妈妈”。对伊奈亚来说，说出“凯拉妮是她的妈妈”这样的话意义重大——你认为她以前从来没这么说过吧？凯拉妮肯定很想听到她这么说，但是……你得去问问伊奈亚，为什么她会跟你说这句话。[pc.name]是的，”她继续说道，一边咀嚼着食物，一边努力整理自己的思绪，“你们去了那个洞穴。海……海……凯拉尼变得完全不一样了。” 确实如此：当你们和凯拉尼进入那个洞穴时，她在洞穴的最深处发现了一些东西，那些东西彻底改变了她前往那里的目的。 她走进那个洞穴，想要弄清楚自己的父母究竟发生了什么，同时也想向村里的所有人证明两件事：第一，那个洞穴里确实居住着某种危险的生物；第二，她是村里最出色的猎人（至少有你在她身边担任观察员的话，确实是这样）。 去山洞里吧，”伊奈亚再次说道，同时指向山顶的方向。 等等，她是想让你回去吗？ “凯拉尼已经变了，”她重复道，“狩猎……嗯……凯拉尼已经完全不一样了。 [pc.isDK |你皱起了眉头，渐渐感到烦躁起来。Inaya的表达不够清晰，而你也明白这一点。 不能你当然会要求找一位翻译，但你现在并不会这么做。而如果她想真正掌握对贝尔哈兰的控制权，就必须在没有翻译的帮助下进行沟通。不过，你的耐心已经开始逐渐消逝了。如果我没弄错的话，这个小鬼其实是在要求你再次回到那个洞穴里，去“寻找凯拉尼所没有的东西”。 |你皱起眉头，努力理解伊奈亚到底在要求你做什么。她说她想让你“去洞穴里”，去“捕捉那些凯拉尼不一样的东西”。你为她能够如此自如地与人交流而感到骄傲——她根本不需要翻译的帮助。不过……你得承认，如果你这么做了的话，事情会容易很多。如果她正在努力克制自己，不去去找一个对贝尔哈兰了解得比你们任何一个人都多的成年人帮忙，那么你们也必须克制这种冲动。而与此同时，听起来她其实是希望你们能再次回到那个洞穴里去。.. ] 求你了？”她睁大眼睛看着你问道。你在任何地方都能认出这种眼神：她心里非常清楚自己在向你提出什么要求，尽管她可能觉得自己表达得不够清楚。毕竟，她总不可能自己跑去那个洞穴里去啊。 [pc.isDK |唉，她真幸运，她妈妈这么漂亮。 |那个洞穴距离女狼村有点远，但是……如果你正好在附近，不妨去那里看看。 ]
rows.raw: " You and Kailani leave her hut to look for Inaya in the village proper. She's easy to spot: there aren't a lot of other rambunctious white-furred vulperine kits running around the village with blue markings in their fur. She spots you both as well, and, as before, she comes running straight to you both. However, somewhat unusually for her, she's a little bashful as she comes closer: her head is low and her arms are tucked behind her back. She drags her feet through the mud with her every step. She's having a hard time maintaining eye-contact with either of you, but with you more than Kailani. It's not a guilty, she-did-something-bad-as-she-knows-it look; it's something shy and reserved, like you're a stranger all over again. "Um," she hesitates. "Kailani... [pc.name] win ui agr vienug?" Kailani furrows her brow and tilts her head at the question. Whatever Inaya just asked, it was something unusual enough to totally catch her off-guard. "Igue," she eventually relents, hanging on the last syllable for a little bit. "Inaya would like to be alone with you, [pc.name]. I will be home if you need me." With that, Inaya grabs you by the hand and leads you a small distance from the hut, while Kailani heads back inside. You're alone with Inaya for the first time since you, her, and Kailani had been bonding with each other as unit. It reminds you of when you first tried approaching the kit. "Um," Inaya stutters, rocking on her feet with her hands behind her back. She keeps glancing towards Kailani's hut, as if checking to make sure you and her are truly alone. "[pc.name]," she says; she looks like she knows what to say, but she doesn't know how to say it. Belharan isn't her first language, after all. [pc.isDK |You grow impatient, but... you know better than to raise your voice against a child, if for no other reason than because that'll only make her more nervous and unable to formulate her thoughts into words. Still, you're also not about to help her. She needs to figure this out herself. And if it's hopeless, you'll just take her back to the hut. |You kneel down in front of her, hoping that bringing you closer to her might put her a little more at ease, even if it means making your knees all muddy. The proximity seems to help her body language, but not her struggle with her words. Still, you keep from helping her formulate her words: her figuring it out on her own will be better for her development. That, and trying to guess your way through her sentences would probably only make it worse. ] "Ewe," she starts, closing her eyes tightly enough to scrunch her nose as she tries to parse together her thoughts in Belharan. "Kailani... hunt?" Maybe she's asking if you and Kailani regularly go hunting? You tentatively answer that, no, that's not something you two do together. You're good at a lot of things, but Kailani is a specialist; you'd probably just get in her way. "No," she says, shaking her head. "Ewe, Kailani... hunt..." She motions with both hands to her left, waving her fingers at nothing. "Then? Um... t-then?" That one's a bit harder to discern. You, and Kailani, hunt, 'then.' And she's motioning to her left... Maybe she's asking if you and Kailani had ever hunted? Because if so, then yes: there was exactly one time when you and Kailani went out on a hunt together. It actually went pretty well. You answer that, yes, you and Kailani went on a hunt once before. "Um, yea," she says with a nod. She looks around, then drags you to the nearest hut, close enough to touch it with her fingers. "Hut," she says, then bends over and puts her hands into the mud, drawing a wide circle before flicking the excess away. "Hole?" A hut, and a hole... that could be anything. You furrow your brow as you try to parse what she wants. Recognizing the posture and expression, she instead points to the cap of the Windy Peaks behind you. "Hut... hole?" she asks again, pointing insistently at the peak. What could the words 'hut,' 'hole,' and the top of the mountain have in common...? [pc.isBimbo |Well, like, there aren't any huts, not like in the village, any higher up the mountain, and none of 'em have holes... caves have holes, though. They have a whole lot of holes! You giggle to yourself, then say the word 'cave,' mostly to yourself. It's just a fun word to say. |You try thinking of synonyms for the words that might work. A 'hut' could be a building, or a hovel, or generally any construct that a person could take shelter in– 'Shelter.' Maybe 'home'? Maybe... a hole, in the mountain, is a home? A cave? It's a bit of a leap, admittedly... but you ask her if she means the word 'cave.' Not that you expect her to know what a cave is. ] "Cave," she repeats. Her eyes close as she considers it. Her nostrils flare and her brow furrows; she's trying really hard to follow along with this conversation. [pc.isDK |You're starting to get a little annoyed, not at her, but your combined inability to communicate. You're supposed to be past this. |It's oddly refreshing, in an annoying way, to bond with Inaya in your mutual frustration over your language barrier. ] "Hunt... in cave." That is what you two did. There was a big, furry monster in a cave on the mountain, and you and Kailani managed to take it down. "Kailani," she says again, looking at Kailani's hut, suddenly getting an idea for a new train of thought. And, once more, just as quickly as it came up, she's frustrated by her inability to articulate where to take it. It's admirable that she doesn't immediately default back to the vulperine language, or to try and get an elder to translate for you two: she wants to say this on her own, with the words she knows. "Kailani... is... is..." She tries and struggles some more, her hands going up to her neck as if she was trying to coax the words out on their own. "Naught... same." Kailani... isn't the same? Since you and her went and hunted that weird, hairy beast in the cave? That is true: shortly after that, you and Kailani [pc.isDK |fucked. You took her virginity and everything. Shit like that's bound to change a woman. |became mates. That whole saga was a big deal for her for a bunch of reasons. ] "Kailani," Inaya continues, "is... naught umfracht. But... Kailani... is umfracht." ... Wow. You've heard that word enough times now to know that it means 'mother.' That's a big thing for Inaya to say, that Kailani is her mom: you don't think she's ever said that to her. Kailani would love to hear her say it, but... you ask Inaya why she's saying that to you. "[pc.name]," she continues, chewing and swallowing nothing as she tries to piece her thoughts together. "Goe too cave. Sea... sea... Kailani naught same." That's true, too: when you and Kailani went into that cave, Kailani found something in the cave's deepest chamber that suddenly changed her whole motivation for being there. She went into that cave to learn what had happened to both of her parents, and to prove something not just to herself, but to everyone in the village: that, one, something dangerous really did live in that cave, and two, she was the greatest hunter in the village (with you as her spotter, anyway). "Goe to cave," Inaya says again, pointing at the peak of the mountain. Wait, she wants you to go back? "Kailani naught same," she repeats. "Hunt... um... watt Kailani naught same." [pc.isDK |You furrow your brow, and then you start to feel yourself getting frustrated. Inaya isn't making herself clear, and you know that she can't, not without asking for a translator, but you're not about to ask for one and she needs to communicate without one if she's going to control her grasp on Belharan. Still, your patience is beginning to wane. If you're not mistaken, this little brat is asking you to go all the way back out to that cave and 'hunt what Kailani not same.' |You furrow your brow as you try to parse what it is that Inaya is asking from you. She said that she wants you to 'go to cave' to 'hunt what Kailani not same.' You're proud that she's communicating as well as she is without the need of a translator, but... you have to admit, it'd be much easier if you did. If she's fighting the urge to find an adult with a better grasp of Belharan than either of you, then you need to fight that urge too. And in the meantime, it sounds a lot like she's asking you to go all the way back out to that cave... ] "Pleese?" she asks, looking up at you with wide eyes. You recognize that look anywhere: she knows exactly what she's asking from you, even if she doesn't think she's communicating it well. It's not like she can pick up and go to that cave herself. [pc.isDK |Ugh. She's lucky her mom is hot. |It's a bit out of the way from the vulperine village, but... if you're in the area, you might as well double check that cave. ] "

rows.original: After one final bend in the cave's pathway downward, you come to the final chamber: a large dome, the walls porous with alternate routes throughout the cave's system. While it's still hard to see, one of the holes in the ceiling has a small amount of natural light coming in, giving you just enough visibility to see around the edges of the room. The large, hairy, bipedal creature that you and Kailani had slain together is nowhere to be found. The other vulperines must have cleaned up after you two. Or maybe something or somebody else did. As before, the floor is littered with the miscellaneous bones of creatures that the larger, hairy creature had killed, consumed, and discarded. There's such a large mishmash of bones that it's impossible to tell what any given bone came from what creature, although the piles had been discarded to the sides of the room, leaving the center bare. Though there's clearly been a lot of death here, the dank, moist, mossy smell of the stale air of the cave overpowers whatever decay the offal might be giving off. When you and Kailani dealt the killing blow and you were collecting yourself from the excitement, you distinctly remember Kailani standing off to the side, stoically staring at one particular thing amongst all the boney debris. You remember where she stood, but the light's only gotten worse since that day, and [dayNight |whatever little daylight you're getting isn't going to last forever |the light of the moon and the stars provides very little to work with this deep into the mountain ]. Still, unless anything's moved it, you remember the general location she was standing and where she was facing. And if you're right, then whatever it is should be right... about... Your hands find it before your eyes do: an old, damp piece of wood that's been rotting for many years in the damp darkness of the cave. The end jutting up into the air is jagged and torn, like it's been snapped off, and although it's weathered and mossy, you can feel leather straps encircle the shaft of the wood in some places. It's tough to see, but you can just barely make out the browns, greens, and yellows of the leather, although in this light, it's impossible to make out the red highlights that go along with them. When Kailani saw this, her whole demeanor changed, like a candle blowing out. Her whole motivation to coming into this cave and slaying the monster was gone, and all she wanted was to go home, back to Inaya. After she put Inaya to bed, she hugged you and said something about how the hunt was 'meant to bring her peace,' but it couldn't. Maybe bringing this back to her is the wrong move. When she saw it, it looked like it might have reopened some old wounds. But on the other hand, Inaya said to you that Kailani is her umfracht. As far as you know, she hasn't said that to Kailani. She wanted you to find whatever it was that changed Kailani in this cave and, presumably, bring it back to her. Maybe Inaya has something in mind. It's putting an awful lot of trust in a ten-year-old girl's ability to understand something as serious as grief, but... you've seen what Inaya is capable of, and you know how much Kailani loves her. Maybe it'll mean something more if it comes from Inaya. You pick the old, rotten stick up and stow it away. Hopefully Inaya knows what she's going to do with it.
rows.translation: 在洞穴通道向下延伸的最后一段弯曲之后，你终于来到了最后的房间：一个巨大的圆顶结构，洞壁布满了孔洞，这些孔洞构成了洞穴系统中的其他通道。虽然视线仍然不太清晰，但天花板上的某个洞口让少量的自然轻型透了进来，足以让你勉强看清房间的边缘景象。 你们和凯拉妮一起杀死的那个体型庞大、浑身长满毛发的两足生物已经不见了。其他那些雌性狼人肯定把你们留下的残局清理掉了。或者，也可能是其他什么东西或什么人干的。 和之前一样，地面上散落着那些被那个大型毛茸茸生物杀死、吃掉后又丢弃的各类动物的骨头。 这些骨头杂乱无章地堆在一起，根本无法分辨其中任何一块骨头究竟来自哪种生物。虽然这些骨头被扔在了房间的边缘，留下了中间空荡荡的地方，但显然这里曾经发生过许多死亡事件。洞穴里潮湿阴冷、布满苔藓的空气，掩盖了这些腐烂的骨头散发出来的任何气味。 当你和凯拉尼一起给予那致命一击，正在从激动的情绪中恢复过来时，你清楚地记得凯拉尼站在一旁，静静地注视着那些骨骸碎片中某一样特定的东西。 你还记得她当时站在哪里，但从那天起，情况只会变得更糟…… [dayNight |你所能获得的那一点点时间也不会永远持续下去。 |在这么深的山里，月光和星光所提供的光线实在太微弱了，几乎无法满足任何需求。 ]不过，除非有什么东西把它移动了，否则你应该还记得她当时站立的大致位置以及她面朝的方向。如果你猜对了，那么那个东西应该就在……那个地方。 你的手部在眼睛看到它之前就先找到了它：一块已经在洞穴潮湿的黑暗中腐烂了很多年的旧木头。 末端凸向空中，边缘参差不齐、破损不堪，仿佛是被猛地折断的。尽管表面已经风化、长满了苔藓，但在某些地方，你仍然能隐约看到皮革带子缠绕在木杆上。这些皮革的颜色应该是棕色、绿色和黄色，但在这样的轻型线条件下，根本无法分辨出那些红色的装饰线条。 当凯拉妮看到这一幕时，她的整个人都变了，就像一支蜡烛被熄灭了一样。她当初进入这个洞穴、想要杀死那只怪物的所有动力都消失了，她现在只想回家，回到伊娜雅身边。在把伊娜雅哄上床睡觉后，她抱住了你，还说这次狩猎“本应给她带来平静”，但实际上并没有做到。 也许把这件事再提给她听并不是个好主意。当她看到那个东西时，看起来它可能会重新揭开一些旧伤疤。 但另一方面，Inaya也告诉过你，Kailani其实是她的…… 运费据你所知，她并没有对凯拉妮说过那些话。她其实是希望你能找出在这个洞穴里改变了凯拉妮的那些因素，然后把它们带回来给她。也许伊娜亚心里有什么打算。 这种做法确实把很大的信任寄托在一个十岁女孩理解如此严肃的问题——比如悲伤——的能力上，不过…….. 你们已经见识过伊奈亚的能力了，也知道凯拉妮是多么爱她。如果这是伊奈亚亲手部送来的，或许会更有意义吧。 你把那根旧木棍捡起来，藏好。希望伊奈亚知道自己要用它来做什么。

rows.original: Inaya finds you before you find her when you step into the village proper. She runs right up to you and grips onto the bottom hem of your [pc.upperGarments] with excitement. "Um," she says, her eyes lighting up and her tail wagging behind herself. Her mouth hangs open and idly chews at nothing as she tries to think of what Belharan words she can remember. "Have?" is all she can come up with. You [pc.isDK | |kneel down and ]withdraw the old, tattered, rotten and ratty stick from your belongings. It's been weathered down to just a little longer than your forearm, but the colored leathers are still at least visible. You tell Inaya that, when you and Kailani finished your hunt in that cave, she changed as soon as she saw this. Inaya gasps, her tail standing straight out behind her as she sees it. She handles it gently as she takes it from you: the whole thing is so sodden through that it feels like it could flake apart with a rough squeeze. In particular, she's drawn to the leathers, each of them dyed her family's colors – proof enough that this thing used to belong to the Ibulim family. "Kailani," she says, holding the stick in one hand and twisting it to hide it behind her back. With her free hand, she reaches up to grab onto yours[pc.isDK |; something that you're a bit hesitant to give her. You almost don't. You hate it when someone holds your hand ]. With a tug, she leads you both back to Kailani's hut. It's only a short walk, and you and Inaya hadn't been gone long enough for Kailani to get started on anything productive inside the hut. She tilts her head to one side when you enter with Inaya's hand in yours. "Back so soon?" she asks. [pc.isDK |Whatever Inaya has planned, it's game time, now. You gave her the thing that she wanted. Now, whatever happens next is up to the prerogative of a little girl. |You've been nervously wondering what it is that Inaya's had in mind to do with that lost heirloom ever since she asked you to go get it, and now, it's game time. Whatever it is she has in mind, it's time for her to do it. ] "Um," Inaya says, letting go of your hand and stepping forward. Kailani immediately gets onto one knee as Inaya approaches, lowering herself to the little girl's level. Inaya sways and swishes nervously, but keeps her back straight enough that the stick remains behind her back, where Kailani can't see it. "Kailani," she says, almost apprehensive to say the name. She looks up at Kailani, then at you. She gives you something of a forlorn look, as if in apology – you figure that whatever she's about to say, she's going to say it in the language she actually knows. [pc.isDK |You wave her onward; you don't particularly care if you're involved in this conversation. Besides, you'll pick up enough to get by, surely. |You reassure her that it's alright: whatever she needs to say, she doesn't have to include you if it'd be easier for her. Besides, you'll probably be able to pick up at least enough to get by yourself. ] Recognizing the difficulty Inaya is having, Kailani steps between you and her, placing herself at your side before kneeling back down to bring herself to Inaya's level. Inaya is careful to keep herself facing Kailani at all times – lest she catch a glimpse of the old stick she's hiding behind her back. "Inaya," she says, "yol grool nim ui ou yulo-wulim?" She pauses, considering the question. On the one hand, she looks like she wants to say no, but on the other, she also looks like she really ought to say yes. "Igue," she eventually responds. You recognize that word as meaning "okay," or something else affirmative. She takes another deep breath, in and out of her mouth, before starting again. "Um," she starts, trying to buy time for her own confidence. "Yol, ui, [pc.name] hanneg way wikt beit prav beittre." "Aw," Kailani says, tilting her head to one side and smiling sweetly down at Inaya. "She says that she likes the time we have spent with you and me." Her hand snakes down between your bodies, her hand finding yours and her fingers wrapping gingerly around your digits. "And I do, too." "Falima oo goolo nim yolo oom," Inaya continues. Kailani's body language suddenly shifts: her back straightens, her eyes widen, and her ears perk up, particularly at the word 'falima.' Rather suddenly, Inaya has Kailani's full and undivided attention. [pc.isDK |You tell her to hurry it up: what did the kid say? |You wonder if you should pester Kailani with translations, since what Inaya just said was apparently quite heavy, but... you have a curiosity that needs sating, and you can't help but ask. ] "That word," Kailani says out of the corner of her mouth, twisting her head ever slightly towards you, but her eyes remain locked on Inaya. "Falima. I... do not know the word to say in your tongue. It is a word for a... a self, and a mate, and a child, as one." Kailani's gaze on Inaya breaks to face you, but only for a split second before going straight back to Inaya. "I use the word 'home' to say it, but the real word is... much more. She is using this new word for us." By that description... probably 'family'? Inaya shifts her gaze, looking sideways along the floor of the hut. "Umfracht ui twik hiykin." She hangs on that for probably a little longer than she meant to. "Umfracht ui nah malnah roak wayto yol nahin fil. Kailani yol oom inglam. [pc.name] hup tormin woo yolo wikt luut, Kailani ui twiggimin wayto ui kin fil rawp yol ou. Umfracht ui rawp yol ou." She turns her head and looks up at you – although her eyes are bent into crescents that look like she's unsure of what it is she's saying or doing, her body language is confident and her tone is steady. "[pc.mf |[pc.name] umwricht. |[pc.name], ouin. ]" You're not very well versed in the vulperine language, and not only is she talking way too fast for you to try and piece together the contexts, but Kailani has forwent translating her words for you, so focused on the words Inaya is saying for herself. But based on how tight Kailani is squeezing your hand, it's something that she's wanted to hear for a very, very long time. And you've been with Kailani and Inaya long enough [pc.mf |to recognize the word 'umwricht.' That word means 'father.' And she looked you dead in the eye when she said it. |to piece together that she said something about a 'mother,' and then she looked you in the eye and said something along the lines of 'you, too.' ] The implications are stark – and when you look at Kailani, you see her nostrils are flaring, her teeth are biting into her lower lip, and, most tellingly, her eyes are beginning to water. Inaya could probably stop right there, and Kailani could die a happy woman. But, to sign the deal, Inaya brings her hands out from behind her back. She shows Kailani the old, rotten piece of wood – and Kailani gasps and reels backward, her free hand going to her mouth, instantly recognizing it for what it is. "Ui rawp ou Ibulim," Inaya finishes. Kailani's caught at a total loss for words, and her breath catches in her throat as she stares at the remains of the old family spear in Inaya's hands. She turns to you, her eyes turning bloodshot from the tears welling up in their bottoms. She opens her mouth to try and say something, but the only sound she makes is the sound of her own breath getting caught in her throat, clogging her pipes, and she makes an awkward coughing gurgle instead. "Inaya," she finally manages to squeak out, but the rest of her words break to nothing on her tongue. Unable to respond with words, and on the verge of breaking out in a full-blown [pc.isBimbo |ugly-cry |sob ], she instead lets go of your hand so she can lunge forward and wrap both of her arms around Inaya, hugging her closely. You can see her arms shake all the way from her shoulders to her fingertips, and you can tell that she's consciously fighting to keep from squeezing Inaya too hard. Her eyes close as her tears streak down her cheeks, staining and matting the fur. She has to remember to breathe; her nose is so stuffed up that she has to do it through her mouth, and even then, it comes out somewhat raspy. She's really struggling to keep from breaking down, and Inaya reaching forward and wrapping her own arms around Kailani's body only makes that struggle harder. Kailani opens her eyes. They're so bleary through her tears that you doubt she can see you with much clarity, but she nonetheless looks directly up at you and into yours. She stretches her hand out, palm upward – it shivers in the air between you two, barely able to keep itself straight under its own power. "Please," she begs, her fingers clenching slightly at the air. [pc.isDK |You're not really the hugging type. You place your hand in hers, your thumb crooking around her own. She's too far gone to ask questions or plead any further, and she squeezes your hand tightly as she buries her face into Inaya's neck. |While you may not know the full context of what they had said, you get the basic picture. You step into Kailani's arm and kneel down beside them both, and she immediately snaps it around your shoulders, hugging you closely to her and Inaya as she buries her face into Inaya's neck. ] Kailani squeezes you both like she's drowning and you're the only things keeping her afloat. Her body shivers almost uncontrollably, and she struggles to hold back her tears: her breathing comes out in ragged coughs and deep sniffles as she holds you both close to her. "Ko igue," Inaya says, gently patting Kailani on the shoulders. She's not nearly as affected by what she said and did as Kailani is – maybe she doesn't fully understand the implications of what she said. Not that you're one to think that. Despite Inaya's attempts at making Kailani feel better, she remains on her knees, shivering and struggling to maintain her composure. She's a step away from crying out loudly enough that the whole village would hear her, but she manages to keep herself together... although she's quickly becoming a mess, with her fur all bedraggled and her tears, drool, and her runny nose streaming down her face. [pc.isDK |It's not exactly a dignified look. In fact, you wonder if all the vulperine women are this easy to emotionally compromise. It makes them less attractive. |Despite all that, though, you can tell that these are happy tears. It's attractive to see a woman let her emotions out rather than bottle them up. ] You three stay like that for some time...

]从你的物品中拿出一根破旧、腐烂的棍子。虽然经过风吹日晒，它的长度已经只剩下比你的前臂稍长一点，但那些彩色的皮革仍然依稀可见。你告诉伊奈亚，当你和凯拉尼在那个洞穴里完成狩猎任务后，她一看到这根棍子，立刻做出了改变。 |无论伊奈亚原本有什么计划，现在都是行动的时候了。你给了她她想要的东西。接下来会发生什么，就完全取决于这个小女孩自己了。 |自从伊奈亚让你去取那件失落的传家宝以来，你一直忐忑不安地想知道她究竟打算用它来做什么。现在，行动的时刻到了。无论她有什么计划，是时候付诸实施了。 ] 嗯，”伊奈亚说着，松开了你的手部，向前迈了一步。当伊奈亚靠近时，凯拉尼立刻单膝跪地，将自己调整到与这个小女孩相同的视线高度。伊奈亚紧张地来回摇晃着身体，但尽量保持背部挺直，这样那根棍子就藏在她的背后，凯拉尼看不见它。 凯拉尼，”她说道，似乎有些犹豫才说出这个名字。她先看了看凯拉尼，然后又看向你，眼中带着一丝无奈，仿佛在道歉——你猜想，无论她接下来要说什么，她都会用自己真正熟悉的语言来表达。 [pc.isDK |你示意她继续前进；其实你并不太在意是否要参与这场对话。况且，你肯定能听到足够多的信息来理解整个情况。 |你安慰她，说没关系的：无论她想说什么，如果不把你牵扯进来会让她更轻松的话，她完全可以选择不告诉你。另外，你大概也能理解其中的大部分内容，从而自己解决问题。 ] 看到Inaya遇到的困难，Kailani走到你和她之间，站在你的一边，然后跪下来，使自己的视线与Inaya处于同一水平。Inaya一直小心翼翼地保持着面对Kailani的姿势——生怕让她看到自己藏在背后那根旧棍子。“Inaya，”Kailani说道，yol grool nim ui ou yulo-wulim她停顿了一下，仔细考虑着这个问题。一方面，她看起来像是想拒绝，但另一方面，她又似乎真的应该同意。伊格好吧，”她最终说道。你明白这个词的意思，就是“同意”或者表示肯定的意思。 她又深吸了一口气，然后开始继续说：“嗯，”她这样开口，其实是想给自己一些时间来增强信心。道路、用户界面…… [pc.name] 汉内格的方式才是正确的做法。哎呀，”凯拉妮歪着头，甜美地笑着看着伊奈亚，“她说她很喜欢我们和你一起度过的那些时光。”她的手部从你们中间伸过来，轻轻握住了你的手部，手部指小心翼翼地缠绕在你的手部指上。“我也是啊。法利玛，哦，进球了，我太开心了！伊奈亚继续说道。 凯拉尼的身体语言突然发生了变化：她的背部挺直了，眼睛睁得更大，耳朵也竖了起来，尤其是听到‘法利玛’这个词的时候。转眼间，伊奈亚就完全吸引了凯拉尼的全部注意力。 [pc.isDK |你告诉她快点：那孩子说了什么？ |你在想是否应该去缠着凯拉妮让她帮忙翻译，因为伊娜亚刚才说的话显然相当重要……但是，你的好奇心实在无法抑制，所以还是忍不住想要问出来。 ] 那个词……”凯拉妮微微侧着头对你说，但她的目光仍然紧盯着伊奈亚。法利玛我……不知道用你们的语言该怎么表达这个词。这个词代表着……一个自我，一个伴侣，还有一个孩子，他们共同组成了一个整体。”凯拉尼的目光从伊奈亚身上移开，转向了你，但仅仅一瞬间后又重新回到了伊奈亚身上。“我用‘家’这个词来表达它，但真正的含义……远比‘家’要深刻得多。她正在用这个新的词汇来形容我们。” 根据这个描述……大概应该是“家庭”吧？ 伊奈亚将目光移向别处，顺着小屋的地面望了过去。运输费用及相关事宜她把电话挂断的时间，可能比她原本打算的要长一些。嗯，运费嘛，其实挺贵的。去英格兰的话，费用会更高一些。 [pc.name] 呼喊着托尔明，呜呼，YOLO，维克特·卢特……凯拉妮，你那扭曲的方式，只会让你陷入更深的痛苦。你这种自寻苦路的做法，真的只会带来灾难……她转过头，抬头看着你——虽然她的双眼弯成月牙状，看起来似乎不太确定自己在说些什么或正在做些什么，但她的肢体语言却充满自信，肌肉度也十分稳重。[pc.mf |[pc.name] 嗯，姆维希特。 |[pc.name]嗯，是啊。 ]你对这种语言并不十分熟悉，而且她说话的速度实在太快了，让你根本无法理解她的话的含义。此外，凯拉尼也并没有帮你翻译她所说的话，她完全专注于倾听伊奈亚自己在说什么。不过，从凯拉尼紧握着你手部的方式来看，她显然已经想听这些话很久很久了。 而你和凯拉尼、伊奈亚相处的时间也已经够长了…… [pc.mf |她能够认出“umwricht”这个词。这个词的意思是“父亲”。而且她说这个词的时候，直视着你的眼睛。 |我渐渐明白，她当时提到了“母亲”这个词，然后她直视着你的眼睛，说了类似“你也是”这样的话。 ] 后果十分严重——当你看到凯拉尼时，会发现她的鼻孔正在剧烈收缩，牙齿紧紧咬住下唇，而最能说明问题的，是她的双眼已经开始流泪。伊娜亚或许可以在这个时刻停下来，这样凯拉尼就能幸福地死去。 但是，为了签署这份协议，伊娜亚将双手部从背后抽了出来。她把那块腐烂的旧木头拿给凯拉尼看，凯拉尼顿时倒吸一口凉气，向后退去，空着的那一只手部立刻捂住了嘴，因为她立刻认出了那是什么。Ui rawp ou Ibulim伊奈亚说完后，” 凯拉妮完全不知该说什么好，她盯着伊奈亚手部中的那支旧家族长矛的残骸，呼吸都变得急促起来。她转向你，眼中的泪水已经让她的双眼变得通红。 她张开嘴试图说些什么，但发出的唯一声音，只是自己的呼吸在喉咙里受阻、堵塞了气道，结果只能发出一阵尴尬的咳嗽声。 “伊奈亚……”她终于挤出这几个字，但后面的话却一个字也说不出来。 无言以对，几乎要崩溃了…… [pc.isBimbo |哭哭啼啼 |呜咽 ]相反，她松开了你的手部，然后猛地向前冲去，用双臂紧紧抱住了Inaya。你可以看到她的手部臂从肩膀一直颤抖到指尖，显然她在努力控制自己，不至于把Inaya抱得太紧。 她的双眼渐渐闭上，泪水顺着脸颊流淌下来，弄脏了她的毛发，使它们变得黏腻不堪。她必须记住要呼吸；她的鼻子堵得厉害，只能用嘴巴呼吸，即便如此，呼出的气息也显得有些嘶哑。 她真的在努力克制自己，不让自己崩溃，而伊奈亚伸出手部，将自己的手部臂环绕在凯拉妮的身上，这一举动反而让她的挣扎变得更加艰难。 凯拉妮睁开了眼睛。因为泪水的原因，她的视线十分模糊，你甚至怀疑她是否能够清楚地看到你，但她还是直视着你的眼睛，与你的目光对视着。 她伸出手部，手部掌朝上——那只手部在你们两人之间的空气中微微颤抖，几乎无法依靠自己的力量保持笔直。“求你了，”她恳求道，手部指在空气中微微收紧。 [pc.isDK |你其实并不是那种喜欢拥抱的人。你将手放在她的手上，拇指轻轻绕过她的手指。她已经陷得太深，再也无法提出任何问题或继续恳求什么了，她紧紧握住你的手，然后将脸埋在Inaya的脖子里。 |虽然你可能并不了解他们所说的话的完整背景，但你也大致明白了意思。你走进凯拉妮的怀里，在他们两人旁边跪了下来，她立刻将手臂环在你的肩上，把你紧紧地搂在她和伊奈亚的怀里，然后将脸埋在伊奈亚的脖子上。 ] 凯拉妮紧紧抱着你们两个，仿佛她正在溺水，而你们是唯一能让她保持漂浮的力量。她的身体几乎无法控制地颤抖着，她努力忍住泪水：在将你们紧紧抱在怀中的时候，她的呼吸变成了断断续续的咳嗽声和深深的抽泣声。科伊格这样吧，”伊奈亚轻拍着凯拉尼的肩膀说道。她对自己说过的话和做过的事所受的影响，远没有凯拉尼那么大——也许她并没有完全理解自己那些话所带来的后果。不过，你也不会这么认为吧。 尽管伊奈亚试图让凯拉尼好受一些，但她仍然跪在地上，不停地颤抖，努力保持镇定。她差点就大声哭出来，让整个村庄的人都能听到，但她最终还是控制住了自己。……尽管她现在已经变得一团糟，她的毛发乱糟糟的，泪水、口水以及流鼻涕都顺着她的脸庞往下流。 [pc.isDK |这看起来实在不太体面。事实上，你会不禁怀疑，是不是所有这类女性都这么容易在情感上被轻易影响。这种行为反而让她们显得没那么有吸引力了。 |尽管如此，你还是能看出，这些泪水是幸福的泪水。看到一个女人将自己的情感宣泄出来，而不是将它们压抑在心里，实在是一件令人欣慰的事情。 ] 你们三个就这样待着一会儿吧……
rows.raw: " Inaya finds you before you find her when you step into the village proper. She runs right up to you and grips onto the bottom hem of your [pc.upperGarments] with excitement. "Um," she says, her eyes lighting up and her tail wagging behind herself. Her mouth hangs open and idly chews at nothing as she tries to think of what Belharan words she can remember. "Have?" is all she can come up with. You [pc.isDK | |kneel down and ]withdraw the old, tattered, rotten and ratty stick from your belongings. It's been weathered down to just a little longer than your forearm, but the colored leathers are still at least visible. You tell Inaya that, when you and Kailani finished your hunt in that cave, she changed as soon as she saw this. Inaya gasps, her tail standing straight out behind her as she sees it. She handles it gently as she takes it from you: the whole thing is so sodden through that it feels like it could flake apart with a rough squeeze. In particular, she's drawn to the leathers, each of them dyed her family's colors – proof enough that this thing used to belong to the Ibulim family. "Kailani," she says, holding the stick in one hand and twisting it to hide it behind her back. With her free hand, she reaches up to grab onto yours[pc.isDK |; something that you're a bit hesitant to give her. You almost don't. You hate it when someone holds your hand ]. With a tug, she leads you both back to Kailani's hut. It's only a short walk, and you and Inaya hadn't been gone long enough for Kailani to get started on anything productive inside the hut. She tilts her head to one side when you enter with Inaya's hand in yours. "Back so soon?" she asks. [pc.isDK |Whatever Inaya has planned, it's game time, now. You gave her the thing that she wanted. Now, whatever happens next is up to the prerogative of a little girl. |You've been nervously wondering what it is that Inaya's had in mind to do with that lost heirloom ever since she asked you to go get it, and now, it's game time. Whatever it is she has in mind, it's time for her to do it. ] "Um," Inaya says, letting go of your hand and stepping forward. Kailani immediately gets onto one knee as Inaya approaches, lowering herself to the little girl's level. Inaya sways and swishes nervously, but keeps her back straight enough that the stick remains behind her back, where Kailani can't see it. "Kailani," she says, almost apprehensive to say the name. She looks up at Kailani, then at you. She gives you something of a forlorn look, as if in apology – you figure that whatever she's about to say, she's going to say it in the language she actually knows. [pc.isDK |You wave her onward; you don't particularly care if you're involved in this conversation. Besides, you'll pick up enough to get by, surely. |You reassure her that it's alright: whatever she needs to say, she doesn't have to include you if it'd be easier for her. Besides, you'll probably be able to pick up at least enough to get by yourself. ] Recognizing the difficulty Inaya is having, Kailani steps between you and her, placing herself at your side before kneeling back down to bring herself to Inaya's level. Inaya is careful to keep herself facing Kailani at all times – lest she catch a glimpse of the old stick she's hiding behind her back. "Inaya," she says, "yol grool nim ui ou yulo-wulim?" She pauses, considering the question. On the one hand, she looks like she wants to say no, but on the other, she also looks like she really ought to say yes. "Igue," she eventually responds. You recognize that word as meaning "okay," or something else affirmative. She takes another deep breath, in and out of her mouth, before starting again. "Um," she starts, trying to buy time for her own confidence. "Yol, ui, [pc.name] hanneg way wikt beit prav beittre." "Aw," Kailani says, tilting her head to one side and smiling sweetly down at Inaya. "She says that she likes the time we have spent with you and me." Her hand snakes down between your bodies, her hand finding yours and her fingers wrapping gingerly around your digits. "And I do, too." "Falima oo goolo nim yolo oom," Inaya continues. Kailani's body language suddenly shifts: her back straightens, her eyes widen, and her ears perk up, particularly at the word 'falima.' Rather suddenly, Inaya has Kailani's full and undivided attention. [pc.isDK |You tell her to hurry it up: what did the kid say? |You wonder if you should pester Kailani with translations, since what Inaya just said was apparently quite heavy, but... you have a curiosity that needs sating, and you can't help but ask. ] "That word," Kailani says out of the corner of her mouth, twisting her head ever slightly towards you, but her eyes remain locked on Inaya. "Falima. I... do not know the word to say in your tongue. It is a word for a... a self, and a mate, and a child, as one." Kailani's gaze on Inaya breaks to face you, but only for a split second before going straight back to Inaya. "I use the word 'home' to say it, but the real word is... much more. She is using this new word for us." By that description... probably 'family'? Inaya shifts her gaze, looking sideways along the floor of the hut. "Umfracht ui twik hiykin." She hangs on that for probably a little longer than she meant to. "Umfracht ui nah malnah roak wayto yol nahin fil. Kailani yol oom inglam. [pc.name] hup tormin woo yolo wikt luut, Kailani ui twiggimin wayto ui kin fil rawp yol ou. Umfracht ui rawp yol ou." She turns her head and looks up at you – although her eyes are bent into crescents that look like she's unsure of what it is she's saying or doing, her body language is confident and her tone is steady. "[pc.mf |[pc.name] umwricht. |[pc.name], ouin. ]" You're not very well versed in the vulperine language, and not only is she talking way too fast for you to try and piece together the contexts, but Kailani has forwent translating her words for you, so focused on the words Inaya is saying for herself. But based on how tight Kailani is squeezing your hand, it's something that she's wanted to hear for a very, very long time. And you've been with Kailani and Inaya long enough [pc.mf |to recognize the word 'umwricht.' That word means 'father.' And she looked you dead in the eye when she said it. |to piece together that she said something about a 'mother,' and then she looked you in the eye and said something along the lines of 'you, too.' ] The implications are stark – and when you look at Kailani, you see her nostrils are flaring, her teeth are biting into her lower lip, and, most tellingly, her eyes are beginning to water. Inaya could probably stop right there, and Kailani could die a happy woman. But, to sign the deal, Inaya brings her hands out from behind her back. She shows Kailani the old, rotten piece of wood – and Kailani gasps and reels backward, her free hand going to her mouth, instantly recognizing it for what it is. "Ui rawp ou Ibulim," Inaya finishes. Kailani's caught at a total loss for words, and her breath catches in her throat as she stares at the remains of the old family spear in Inaya's hands. She turns to you, her eyes turning bloodshot from the tears welling up in their bottoms. She opens her mouth to try and say something, but the only sound she makes is the sound of her own breath getting caught in her throat, clogging her pipes, and she makes an awkward coughing gurgle instead. "Inaya," she finally manages to squeak out, but the rest of her words break to nothing on her tongue. Unable to respond with words, and on the verge of breaking out in a full-blown [pc.isBimbo |ugly-cry |sob ], she instead lets go of your hand so she can lunge forward and wrap both of her arms around Inaya, hugging her closely. You can see her arms shake all the way from her shoulders to her fingertips, and you can tell that she's consciously fighting to keep from squeezing Inaya too hard. Her eyes close as her tears streak down her cheeks, staining and matting the fur. She has to remember to breathe; her nose is so stuffed up that she has to do it through her mouth, and even then, it comes out somewhat raspy. She's really struggling to keep from breaking down, and Inaya reaching forward and wrapping her own arms around Kailani's body only makes that struggle harder. Kailani opens her eyes. They're so bleary through her tears that you doubt she can see you with much clarity, but she nonetheless looks directly up at you and into yours. She stretches her hand out, palm upward – it shivers in the air between you two, barely able to keep itself straight under its own power. "Please," she begs, her fingers clenching slightly at the air. [pc.isDK |You're not really the hugging type. You place your hand in hers, your thumb crooking around her own. She's too far gone to ask questions or plead any further, and she squeezes your hand tightly as she buries her face into Inaya's neck. |While you may not know the full context of what they had said, you get the basic picture. You step into Kailani's arm and kneel down beside them both, and she immediately snaps it around your shoulders, hugging you closely to her and Inaya as she buries her face into Inaya's neck. ] Kailani squeezes you both like she's drowning and you're the only things keeping her afloat. Her body shivers almost uncontrollably, and she struggles to hold back her tears: her breathing comes out in ragged coughs and deep sniffles as she holds you both close to her. "Ko igue," Inaya says, gently patting Kailani on the shoulders. She's not nearly as affected by what she said and did as Kailani is – maybe she doesn't fully understand the implications of what she said. Not that you're one to think that. Despite Inaya's attempts at making Kailani feel better, she remains on her knees, shivering and struggling to maintain her composure. She's a step away from crying out loudly enough that the whole village would hear her, but she manages to keep herself together... although she's quickly becoming a mess, with her fur all bedraggled and her tears, drool, and her runny nose streaming down her face. [pc.isDK |It's not exactly a dignified look. In fact, you wonder if all the vulperine women are this easy to emotionally compromise. It makes them less attractive. |Despite all that, though, you can tell that these are happy tears. It's attractive to see a woman let her emotions out rather than bottle them up. ] You three stay like that for some time..."

rows.original: It's nearly half an hour later when Inaya finally manages to wriggle herself free from Kailani's grasp so she can leave the hut and do kid things with her kid friends. You, however, [pc.isDK |aren't so lucky, and a half hour after that, you're still stuck in the hut holding Kailani's hand until she's ready to let you go |stay with Kailani, coming up on a half hour after that: you know her to be a strong woman, but she's in an emotionally precarious situation, and she needs you to be with her ]. At the very least, you manage to get her back to one of the bales of straw that she uses as furniture to give your knees a break. She's stopped crying and sniffling and shivering a while ago. On the contrary to how she was before, her grip on you is weak and exhausted: she could fall asleep [pc.isDK |holding your hand |in your arms ] right now and she'd probably sleep for a full night's rest. But she doesn't, for one reason or another. She stays awake with you the entire time. "I did not mean for you to see me like that," she says. It's the first thing she's said since she said 'please' nearly an hour ago. [pc.isDK |You bite back the first response on your tongue, and you instead say nothing. |You tell her that it's alright. You don't know what Inaya said, exactly, but anything that hits someone as hard as that has every right to let it all out, if they need to. ] Kailani remains silent for a few moments longer. "That was the first time Inaya said I am her umfracht. She had said that we were... that word that you used. Falima. Family." Her fingers lightly stroke your [pc.isDK |hand |arm as she cuddles herself deeper into your embrace on her straw chair ]. She stares off into space, totally lost in her own world as she replays that hour-old conversation in her head again and again. "I had cared for Inaya since she was three," she says. Her voice is crackly and tired, her throat still full of phlegm from earlier. "She tells me that her first thought was of me... but she did not call me umfracht. She knew that her true umfracht was gone, and that I was... I was..." She pauses. She takes a few long, shuddering breaths; she's about to act up again and she's doing everything in her power to keep herself under control. Just thinking about Inaya like this and what had transpired between them is enough to nearly set her off again. "I do... all the things that I can do to be a umfracht to Inaya. She is not mine, but... she is mine." After another brief pause, she rolls her head to one side, glancing towards the old, rotten stick that had started this whole thing. It lies on its side in the center of the room, between the straw chairs, discarded and forgotten in the grand scheme of things. "Inaya did not find that, did she?" she asks you. You answer that, no, she didn't. She said to you that she noticed Kailani started acting differently after you both had slain that hairy creature in the cave, and she wanted you to go find out why. So you went back into that cave on her behest and brought that stick back. She sighs through her nose. "It has the dyes of the Ibulim. It was my hawneio spear. I do not know if it was with my umfracht or my umwricht, but it was one of them." She looks forlornly at the old, tattered, rotten and broken spear, with the dyed leathers barely clinging to its wood. "It is hard to see it like this." You ask her what she'll do with it. She could restore it back to the shape it was when her parents had it. "I could," she admits. "And I might. I had gone past the pain. I know they are gone and can not come back." She sighs again through her nose. An oddly wet sigh that causes her nostrils to whistle as the air moves through them. "But I might not. It might be best to leave the past. I have Inaya, and she has me, now. I am her umfracht, and she is my mufralim. It is time to look on." Her grip suddenly regains its strength on you. Her [pc.isDK |hand squeezes on yours affectionately, pulling you closer to her so she can squeeze her other arm around your forearm |arms and legs pull in against you, squeezing as much of your body as she can with as much of her body as she can ]. "And we have you, [pc.name]. With you, we hunt the omlinaw in the cave. With you, I find where my hawnei go to, as much as it hurts. With you, Inaya calls me umfracht – and she calls us falima. Had you not come, none of this would be." [pc.isDK |She leans her mouth towards the back of your hand and gently presses her lips to it. She knows that you're awkward about displays of affection, so she does it for you. Still, you twist your hand in her grip so that you can cup her cheek, and that little action is enough for her to sigh in contentment and relax more into the straw chair she's sitting on. Her eyes look up at you, moist and somewhat unfocused, but the smile on her face is one of a woman that's finally had the weight of the world taken off her shoulders. A lifetime of wondering if her daughter Inaya would ever call her 'mom' is finally over. You did that for her. No way she won't put out for you now. |She faces you, her eyes wide and totally focused on your own. Her expression drops, like she's about to experience something inevitable – and, without a word between you two, she leans in and presses her lips against yours. It's a chaste, passionate kiss that doesn't last very long, but when she pulls away, she looks at you with arched eyebrows and a gentle smile, looking for all the world like a woman that's finally had the weight of the world lifted off her shoulders. A lifetime of wondering if her daughter Inaya would ever call her 'mom' is finally over. ] "Ui imnu yol," she says under her breath. Almost like you weren't meant to hear it. You ask her what that means. [pc.isDK |She kisses the back of your hand again. |She leans in and presses her nose against yours for a moment before tilting her head and kissing you again. ] "It means 'I love you'." [pc.isDK |You don't respond verbally. Another cup of her cheek is all she needs to be satisfied with you. |Well, then. 'Ui imnu yol' to her, too. ]
rows.translation: 将近半个小时后，伊奈亚终于从凯拉妮的手中挣脱出来，得以离开小屋，去和她的孩子们一起做些孩子该做的事情。然而，你…… [pc.isDK |就没那么幸运了，半个小时后，你仍然会被困在小屋里，紧紧握着凯拉妮的手，直到她愿意放开你为止。 |留在凯拉尼身边吧，半个小时后她就会过来。你知道她是个坚强的女性，但她现在正处于一种情绪上非常脆弱的境地，她需要你陪在她身边。 ]至少，你还是把她弄到了那些她用来当家具的稻草堆上，这样你的膝盖就能得到些休息了。 她已经停止了哭泣、抽噎和发抖。与之前相比，她现在抱住你的力气已经变得虚弱而无力：她甚至可能马上就会睡着。 [pc.isDK |牵着你的手 |在你的怀抱中 ] 此刻，她或许已经能够睡上一个整晚了。但出于种种原因，她并没有睡觉，而是整晚都和你在一起。 “我并不想让你看到我这样的样子，”她说。这是她在将近一个小时前说出“请”之后说的第一句话。 [pc.isDK |你强忍住第一反应，最终选择什么也没说。 |你告诉她，没关系的。你并不清楚伊奈亚具体说了什么，但任何能对别人造成如此巨大伤害的话…… 那个 如果他们需要的话，完全有权利把一切情绪都宣泄出来。 ] 凯拉尼又沉默了好一会儿。“那是伊奈亚第一次称我为她的…… 运费她说过我们就是……就是你用过的那个词。 法利玛家庭。” 她的手指轻轻拂过你的…… [pc.isDK |手 |当她坐在草编椅上，将身体更加紧紧地依偎在你的怀抱中时，她便开始武装自己了。 ]她呆呆地望着前方，完全沉浸在自己的世界里，一遍又一遍地在脑海中回放着那个小时前发生的对话。 “从伊奈亚三岁起，我就一直在照顾她，”她说。她的声音沙哑而疲惫，喉咙里还残留着刚才的痰。“她告诉我，她第一个想到的人就是我……但她并没有给我打电话。 运费她知道，自己的真实身份…… 运费 我做了……所有我能做的事情，只为成为一个…… 运费 送给伊奈亚。她并不属于我，但是……她…… 是 我的。” 又过了片刻的沉默，她将头偏向一侧，瞥了一眼那根引发这一切的旧木棍。它横躺在房间的中央，夹在那些草编椅子之间，在整个事件的背景下，它已经被抛弃，被遗忘了。 伊奈亚并没有发现这一点，对吧？”她问你。 你回答说，没有，她没有发现。她告诉你，她在你们俩在洞穴里杀死那个长满毛发的生物之后，注意到凯拉尼的行为开始发生变化了，她希望你能去弄清楚原因。 于是你按照她的吩咐回到了那个洞穴，把那根棍子带了回来。 她通过鼻子叹了口气：“上面有伊布利姆植物的染料，那是我…… hawneio 长矛……我不知道那是否是我的…… 运费 否则我的…… 嗯……这个名称听起来有点特别吧。但那确实是其中之一。”她黯然地望着那支破旧、腐烂、已经断裂的长矛，那些染色的皮革几乎已经从木头上脱落了。“看到它变成这样的样子，真的让人很难过。” 你问她打算怎么处理这把长矛。 她能够把它恢复到父母拥有它时的样子。 “我能够做到，”她承认道，“而且我可能会这么做。我已经熬过了那种痛苦……我知道他们已经离开了，再也不会回来了。”她再次通过鼻子叹了口气。 她发出一声奇怪而湿润的叹息，空气穿过她的鼻孔时，仿佛引发了轻微的鸣响。“但我也许不会那么做。或许，把过去抛在身后才是最好的选择。现在我有伊奈亚，而她也有我。我属于她…… 运费她就是我的…… 穆夫拉利姆是时候该放下了。” 她的手突然又紧紧握住了你。她的…… [pc.isDK |她深情地握住你的手，将你拉得更近一些，然后用另一只手环抱住你的前臂。 |她用尽全力挤压你的身体，尽可能多地压迫你的各个部位。 ]而我们也有你， [pc.name]有你在，我们就一起狩猎吧。 奥姆利纳夫 在洞穴里。有你在，我就能找到属于我的地方。 hawnei 无论有多痛苦，我都要去。有你在，Inaya才会称呼我…… 运费 – 然后她给我们打了电话。 法利玛如果你没有来，这一切都不会发生。 [pc.isDK |她将嘴唇轻轻贴在你的手背上。她知道你对表达感情这类事情感到有些尴尬，所以她才这样做的。 不过，你还是扭转了手中的动作，这样就能托住她的脸颊了。这个小小的举动足以让她满足地叹了口气，然后更加放松地靠在那把草编椅子上。 她的目光抬起望着你，眼神中带着些许湿润，似乎有些涣散，但脸上的笑容却仿佛是一个终于卸下了世间重担的女性所拥有的。那一生都在疑惑自己的女儿Inaya是否会有那么一天叫她“妈妈”的日子，终于到来了。 你都是为了她才这么做的。 现在她肯定不会再不理你了。 |她面对着你，双眼睁得大大的，全神贯注地注视着你。她的表情突然变得严肃起来，仿佛即将经历一些不可避免的事情——而在你们两人之间没有说出一句话之后，她便倾身向前，将嘴唇贴在了你的嘴唇上。 那是一个纯洁而充满激情的吻，持续的时间并不长。但当她拉开距离时，她会用挑起的眉毛和温柔的微笑看着你，那神情就像是一个终于卸下了世间重担的女性。 多年来，她一直都在疑惑自己的女儿Inaya是否会有那么一天叫她“妈妈”，而如今，这个疑问终于得到了解答。 ] "用户界面免疫系统她小声说道，仿佛那些话不是让你听到的。 你问她这是什么意思。 [pc.isDK |她再次吻了吻你的手背。 |她凑近过来，将鼻子贴在你的鼻子上片刻，然后歪着头再次吻了你。 ] 这意味着‘我爱你’。 [pc.isDK |你没有用言语做出回应。她只需要再轻捏一下你的脸颊，就能确定你对她的心意了。 |那么，也对她说‘Ui imnu yol’吧。 ]
