rows.original: When you approach Kailani’s hut, you see [inaya.introduced |Inaya |the little kit that hangs around her ] loitering about the hut’s entrance, playing in the snow as she normally does... but Kailani is nowhere to be seen, which is unusual. Normally, the two are at least within sight of each other. [inaya.introduced |Inaya |The kit ] looks up at you as she hears your footsteps approaching, and as soon as she realizes that it’s you, her ears perk up and her eyes widen. "[inaya.kaiIsMom |Umfraaa! |Kailani! ]" she shouts, turning her head so that her voice carries into the hut. "[pc.name] ko mola!" From inside the hut, you hear the sound of water splashing, and soon, Kailani emerges from her room, looking haggard and disheveled. Her hair is frazzled, with multiple strands floating out of place in every which direction; her leather top rests on a lopsided angle, threatening to slip right off her left nipple; and her eyes are bloodshot. She looks sick and exhausted, but she moves with an energetic, almost jumpy gait. [flags.KAILANI_HEAT |Oh. She’s... 'ready’, again. You don’t need a particularly strong nose to smell the scent of a horny fox woman emanating from her fur. |[pc.raMulti lupine vulperine |A thick musk wafts from Kailani’s body – one that immediately makes your spine stiffen[pc.hasCock | and your dick stir ]. That’s not just any particular scent. Kailani is– |A thick musk wafts from Kailani’s body – one that immediately makes your spine stiffen[pc.hasCock | and your dick stir ]. That’s not just any particular scent. Kailani is– ] ] Kailani doesn’t waste any time. "Inaya, ma linde chreu im way," she says, her voice dry and crackling in her throat. It’s not a suggestion, it’s a command. [inaya.introduced |Inaya |The little girl ] hesitates. "Yol tou ki yalla kamba?" she asks with all the innocent naivete of a little girl. "Ui bana vanik!" Kailani barks, her volume rising and her tone deepening. You’ve never seen her speak to [inaya.introduced |Inaya |her kit ] like that, and, evidently, neither has she: as soon as the words leave Kailani’s mouth, [inaya.introduced |Inaya |the girl ] is off like a dart, running from the hut towards the bonfire in the center of the village for shelter. [flags.KAILANI_HEAT |All the signs are very familiar – Kailani’s in season once more. Now that she has you, she doesn’t have to suffer any of them any longer.

        You ask her how many days her heat cycle normally lasts. If she isn’t pregnant this time, then her cycle ought to continue until either she is, or it ends on its own.
        
        Her face scrunches up, and you can practically see the wheels turning in her head as she tries to articulate what’s going on in her head. "I do not know the word in the way to talk," she admits. Eventually, she lifts both hands up; her right hand extends all [silly
            |four fingers and her thumb
            |five fingers
        ], while her left extends her middle and index fingers. "The sun will rise these times."
        
        A week, then.
        
        Kailani pulls you back in for one last nuzzle against your jawline, her snout pressing and rubbing against yours much more affectionately than usual. It wouldn’t take any effort at all for another round or two, if you wanted. When she pulls away, her hands fold in front of her abdomen, she stands perfectly upright, and her tail is dusting the floor with how quickly it’s swishing back and forth. "Come home soon!" she says cheerily.'

rows.original: Something is a bit different when you approach Kailani’s hut this time. She’s sitting on flat stump, her elbows on her lap and her hands interlocked at the fingers; standing in front of her is an older vulperine woman wearing ornate, white clothing with blue trims, holding in one hand a stone bowl, and in the other, what appears to be a pestle. The older woman’s developed a hunch in her years, and although most of her fur as retained its orange, her hair and the tips of her ears and fingers have long since gone gray[dayNight |. Unusually, [inaya.introduced |Inaya |the kit that always hangs around Kailani ] is nowhere to be seen ]. The older vulperine is speaking in the village’s language, and although you’re close enough to make out every syllable, you have no idea what she’s saying. Kailani pays rapt attention to what the older woman is saying to her: her eyes are wide and trained fully on the woman’s, with a stern, intense expression, almost reminding you of how she was when you two were on the hunt in that cave. She’s so focused on the woman that she almost doesn’t notice you approach. "Ah, [pc.name]," she says, waving you forward, but her expression only barely softens at the sight of you. "Milona, taminyk muwl ko wayto ui beit tolmin weirg, ui roak yol." The older woman turns to you. You can see the cataracts in her eyes, badly blurring her vision, but she examines you as well as she can: she leans in, her eyes looking at your body, your shoulders, your stomach, then back up to your face. From the way that she dresses, and the things she’s holding, and how closely she’s looking you over, you’d think she’s the village’s medicine woman. "You," she says, her voice creaking like wood that’s about to splinter. She brings up a bent, craggy finger to point at you, then, she points to Kailani. "Mates?" she asks. Although you can’t speak most of Kailani’s language, you’re pretty sure Kailani just told her that you were. Still, you confirm, nodding and saying 'yes,’ but then nothing else. The medicine woman eyes you once more. She hunches further down to bring herself uncomfortably close to your crotch, but then pulls back. She opens up the folds of her cloak, revealing a massive array of hidden inner pockets, each of them holding a different tool related to medicine; she replaces the mortar and pestle, and from a different pocket, she withdraws a long, thin tube made of glimmering stone, perhaps marble. It shines as though it had been recently washed. "Ulpunami outi muwl," she says sternly and succinctly. "She wants you to pee in that," Kailani says. ... Uh, why? Kailani sighs a heavy, frustrated, resigned sigh. Her posture changes, her own back hunching as she stares down at her feet with a mix of shame and exhaustion. "I want a kit, [pc.name]," she says sullenly. "We try hard to have a kit. It is... wugkguntre. I tire – and I am sore. We mate and we mate, but I do not take to a kit. Milona is the village whollim. She can heal a vulp. She will tell us why I can not take to a kit. She must know your health as well." Well, that explains why this jar has been recently washed[var0 |. But you tell her it’s unnecessary: the reason why she hasn’t been able to conceive is because you’ve been taking Blank Powder recently. "What is this thing?" Kailani asks you, furrowing her brow and crooking her head to one side. It’s a powder that’s mixed with drinking water to make you temporarily infertile – so that you can’t sire any children. Kailani continues to stare blankly at you, trying to parse the words that you’re saying in her mind. However, the medicine woman standing beside you seems to have picked up on one or two phrases, and she reaches into one of the many pockets inside of her robe. From it, she withdraws a small pouch made of leather, loosely tied with a single string of twine; she opens it with her shaky fingers, then dips her index and thumb in to withdraw a sample. "This?" she asks, showing you what she’s holding. Both of her digits are caked in a thin, white powder. [silly |It’s either hard drugs, or Blank Powder, and if anyone is just casually carrying that kind of chalk around on them, it’d be the medicine woman. But you doubt that the vulperine are that cool, so it must be |There aren’t a lot of powdery white substances that you’re aware of (that are easily obtained, anyway), so it must be ] Blank Powder. You nod in affirmation. "Ah," the woman says, nodding once. "Kailani, weirg ko bekplidyn osktre. Yol wayto ko tou oom fil beittre ber." Kailani’s entire demeanor changes in an instant, like someone had slapped her across the face. She looks to you with a deep frown, hard enough that the expression reaches her eyes from how hard her mouth is dropping. "You are doing this?" she asks, her tone almost accusatory. "You are we why do not have a kit, and you do this..." She struggles, searching for the right words in your language and having a hard time with it. "On cause?" [pc.isDK |Correct. |It might be callous to just out and say that she’s correct, but... well, the secret’s out now. You confirm that you’re temporarily infertile, and that you’ve been taking Blank – you’ve been taking that white powder stuff that the medicine woman showed her. ] "Why?" she asks, more befuddled and confused than hurt. [pc.isDK |What you want to say is that you’re not interested in having a little ankle-biter running around and getting in the way of enjoying it’s mom whenever you get the chance. But even you recognize that that’s probably a step too far – she’s already looking like she’s ready to either rip you in half or break down in tears. You just tell her that you aren’t ready for a kid yet. |The truth is, you’re just not... ready for a child. Not emotionally. You don’t think that your lifestyle could support raising a kid, and you wouldn’t want to leave that sort of responsibility to Kailani by herself[inaya.introduced |, especially since she’s already looking after Inaya ]. ] She sits patiently, listening to your excuse, although her expression doesn’t change. Even her normally-fluffy, bristly fur seems to deflate on her body as she listens to you. The air between you two is stiff and suffocating, to the point that even the medicine woman realizes that she’s about to get caught in the middle of something and takes her leave. Eventually, Kailani’s shoulders slump, and her eyes drop from yours to the muddy, snowy ground you’re standing on. She lets out a defeated sigh, and her fingers sit folded on her lap as if she’s trying to protect them from the cold. "I can not make you want a kit," she says eventually. Her tone is even, but her volume is low; you almost don’t catch that she’s speaking at all. This is clearly important to her, but she’s also not willing to fight you over it. "You are my mate. I want a mate more than I want a kit." "But," she says, then looks up at you, then back down, then back up, then her eyes drift to her right before refocusing on you, all the while her mouth hangs slightly ajar, as if the words she wants to say is stuffed inside of it and she can’t close it properly. "Please?" she eventually squeaks out. It’s clear that she really, really wants a kid of her own. But she’s not pushing; she’s not fighting; she’s not raising her voice or trying to make this a public thing. This is your choice to make. All you have to do is just not take the Blank Powder for a bit, and it’ll eventually pass through your system. And then you can give Kailani exactly what she wants. That is, if that’s what you want. |. Still, uh... you don’t see the need to pee in a jar and have some old lady look at it. You feel fine; as far as you know, your equipment – and you judge to your crotch for emphasis – is fine. You and Kailani have simply been unlucky so far. That’s really all it comes down to. You two just need to keep trying, and it’ll work out eventually. "Ib sool fil rawp ulpunami Milona," Kailani says with a sigh. The medicine woman’s head jerks downward as you gesture to your pelvis. She stares at your body for a moment, her fingers lightly stroking at the fur of her chin as she considers you and your form. She audibly hums to herself before putting the jar back into the fold of her robes, and, for the third time, she withdraws something else: a leather drinking pouch, this one held shut with twine and a thin wooden cork wrapped tightly around the bag’s mouth. It visibly sloshes with liquid weight sitting inside of it. "Polck muwl," she says, handing it to you. It sits fairly light in your hand: whatever’s inside of it, there’s not much. Maybe good for two mouthfuls. "Yol nelm wree lutt grrutickin." "She wants you to drink it," Kailani translated. You sort of figured: it’s a flask. Although, you suppose, for a tribespeople like the vulperines, it could have been some mystic medicine that you’re meant to pour on some part of you. "She says it will help with... how you do? How you... what is a good word... uhh, how you... act?" You uncork the flask and bring it to your nose – and it distinctly smells of eggs. Eggs, and something else. Something... grassy, or minty. It doesn’t smell like it’d taste bad... Still, it’s either this, or you piss into a jar for an old medicine woman to examine. There are stories of tribespeople like Kailani’s having access to all-natural performance enhancers. Maybe whatever this is really will help. Best case scenario, it gets you ready. [silly |Worst case, it gives you the shits. |Mid case, it does nothing. And you’d prefer not to think about the worst case scenario. ] ]

从她的穿着方式、手部中拿的东西，以及她仔细打量你的神情来看，你会以为她是这个村庄的巫医。“就是你，”她说道，声音如同即将裂开的木头般嘎吱作响。她伸出一根弯曲而粗糙的手部指指着你，然后又指向了凯拉尼。 伙伴们？”她问道。 虽然你几乎听不懂凯拉妮在说些什么，但你应该能猜到她是在问你们是不是她的伙伴们。于是你点了点头，回答“是的”，除此之外什么也没说。 那位女药师又看了你一眼。 她把身体进一步蜷缩起来，让自己尴尬地靠近你的裆部，但随后又退了回去。她拉开斗篷的褶皱，露出了许多隐藏在里面的口袋，每个口袋里都装着不同的医疗工具；她把研钵和杵放了回去，然后从另一个口袋里取出一根由闪闪发轻型的石头制成的细长管子，那可能是大理石制成的。 它闪闪发轻型，仿佛刚刚被清洗过一样。乌尔帕努米，出来吧。她想让你在那个里面小便，”凯拉尼说道。 ……呃，为什么呢？ 凯拉尼重重地叹了口气，充满了沮丧与无奈。她的姿势也发生了变化，自己也弯下了腰，低头盯着自己的足部，脸上带着羞愧与疲惫的神情。“我想要一套装备…… [pc.name]我们真的很努力想要一套装备，”她闷闷不乐地说，“但这…… wugkguntre我感到疲惫，身体也酸痛不已。我们不断交配，但我就是无法适应这种状态。米洛娜，就是那个村庄…… 胡说八道她能够治愈一只狐狸。她会告诉我们为什么我不能使用那个工具包。她肯定也知道你的健康状况。” 嗯，这就解释了为什么这个罐子最近被清洗过了。[var0 |但你要告诉她，这其实没有必要：她之所以无法怀孕，是因为你最近一直在服用那种名为“空白粉末”的药物。 “这是什么东西？”凯拉妮皱着眉头，把头偏向一边，问道。 这是一种粉末，只需将其加入饮用水中，就能让你暂时失去生育能力——这样你就无法生育孩子了。 凯拉尼仍然呆呆地望着你，试图在脑海中理解你所说的话。 然而，站在你身边的那位女巫似乎听懂了一两句话，她伸手进入自己长袍上的众多口袋之一，从中取出了一个用皮革制成的小袋子，袋子用一根细绳松松地系着。她用颤抖的手指打开袋子，然后用食指和拇指取出了其中的一小份样本。 这个？”她问道，同时把你看到的东西指给你看。她的手指上都沾着一层薄薄的白色粉末。 [silly |要么是烈性毒品，要么就是“空白粉末”。如果有人会随意携带这种东西，那肯定就是那位女药师。不过你大概不认为那些女猎人会这么随性，所以……肯定不是别的东西。 |你知道的、容易获取的白色粉末状物质其实并不多，所以这种物质肯定属于其中之一。 ] 空白粉末。”你点头表示同意。 “啊，”女人也点了点头，“凯拉尼…… 我们无法继续下去了。这条路已经走到了尽头。凯拉妮的神情瞬间发生了变化，仿佛有人狠狠地打了她一耳轻型。她皱着眉头看着你，那眉头紧锁到连眼睛都仿佛被挤在一起了。“是你干的吗？”她的肌肉度几乎带着指责。“为什么我们没有装备，而你却有……”她努力寻找合适的词语来表达自己的意思，但显然很困难。“为什么？ [pc.isDK |正确。 |直接说她是对的，或许显得有些冷漠无情，但是……嗯，现在这个秘密已经公开了。你已经确认自己暂时无法生育，并且一直在服用那种白色粉末状的药物——就是那位女巫给你的那种药。 ] 为什么？”她问道，此刻更多的是困惑和迷茫，而非受伤。 [pc.isDK |你究竟想要什么 想要 换句话说，你就是不想让一个小孩子在周围跑来跑去，妨碍你随时享受和妈妈在一起的时光。但就连你自己也知道，这种说法可能有点过分了——她现在看起来简直就像是要把你撕成两半，或者立刻哭出来一样。你只需要告诉她，你目前还不准备要孩子而已。 |事实上，你目前还没有准备好要孩子。在情感上来说，你还没有做好这个准备。你认为自己的生活方式无法承担抚养孩子的责任，也不愿意让凯拉妮独自承担这样的责任。[inaya.introduced |尤其是现在她已经在照顾Inaya了。 ]. ] 她耐心地坐着，听着你的解释，尽管她的表情丝毫没有变化。就连她那原本蓬松浓密的毛发，在听你说话的时候似乎也变得软弱无力。你们之间的气氛紧张而令人窒息，就连那位女巫也意识到自己即将卷入这场纷争之中，于是便离开了。 最终，凯拉妮的双肩耷了下来，她的目轻型也从你的眼睛移到了你们此刻站立的那片泥泞而积满雪地的地面上。她发出一声沮丧的叹息，双手部的指头交叉放在膝盖上，仿佛在试图保护它们免受寒冷的侵袭。 我无法强迫你想要这套装备，”她最终说道。她的肌肉度很平静，但声音很小，几乎让人听不见她在说话。显然，这对她来说很重要，但她也不愿意为此与你争执。 你是我最好的伙伴。对我来说，你比任何装备都重要。 但是，”她说，然后抬头看着你，又低下头，再抬起头，目轻型最终转向右边，又重新回到你身上。整个过程中，她的嘴巴微微张开，仿佛有话想说却无法说出来，因此始终无法完全闭上。“求你了？”她最终轻声说道。 很明显，她真的很想要自己的孩子。但她并没有强行要求，也没有争吵，更没有大声疾呼或试图将这件事公开化。这个决定应该由你来做。你只需要暂时停止服用那种药物，过一段时间它就会从你的体内排出。到那时，你就可以给Kailani她真正想要的东西了。 也就是说，如果真是那样的话…… 你 想要。 |不过，呃……你也没必要非得把尿收集在罐子里，然后让某个老妇人来看吧。你感觉自己没什么问题；据你所知，你的生理机能——我特别强调这一点——也是正常的。你们俩只是运气不太好而已，真的就是这么回事。只要继续努力，最终肯定会有结果的。我独自一人，面对无尽的黑暗…… 米洛娜，”凯拉尼叹息着说道。 那位女巫的头猛地低下，你指了指自己的臀部。她盯着你的身体看了一会儿，手部指轻轻抚摸着自己下巴上的胡须，似乎在仔细观察你和你的身材。 她在把罐子放回长袍的褶皱中之前，明显地自言自语地哼着小曲。第三次，她取出了另一样东西：一个皮革制成的饮水袋，这个袋子用绳子扎紧，袋口还缠着一块细木塞。 里面明显装满了液体，因此会随着液体的重量而晃动。波尔克·穆尔给，”她说着，将它递给你。拿在手部里感觉相当轻：里面装的东西应该不多，大概够吃两口而已。这条路真他妈的难走啊……她想让你喝下它，”凯拉妮解释道。你大概也能猜到：那应该是一个水壶。不过，对于像狐族这样的部落来说，里面装的或许是一些具有神秘功效的药剂，需要涂抹在身体的某个部位上。 她说这会帮助你……怎么做呢？怎么……该用什么词来形容呢……呃，就是怎么……表现出来呢？” 你拧开瓶盖，将瓶子靠近鼻子——里面确实散发着鸡蛋的味道。鸡蛋，还有别的什么气味。 有点像草的味道，又有点像薄荷的味道……闻起来并不像那种会让人觉得难吃的东西…… 不过，要么就选择这个方法，要么就往罐子里尿一点，让那些老巫婆来检查。据说像凯拉尼这样的部落成员，能够获得一些完全天然的增强体力的物品。 也许这个东西真的会起到帮助作用。最好的情况是，它能让你做好相应的准备。 [silly |最糟糕的情况就是，它会让你感到非常难受。 |最理想的情况下，它根本起不了任何作用。而至于最坏的情况，你最好也别去想它。 ] ]

rows.translation: [pc.bg barbarian |该死，那真是你很久以来吃过的最美味的一餐了。没有任何多余的装饰，没有任何繁琐的流程，只有新鲜的肉，刚刚被剥下来，还带着汁水。生活在那些“文明”的世界里，有时候会让人忘记，像野人一样生活其实也能带来如此美妙的体验。 应该 去：离开陆地。唯一能让这种情况变得更好的办法，就是你自己把它抓来并剥下它的皮。 |你任由凯拉妮拉着你去仓库取更多的肉，甚至还为自己留了些……不过你首先是在明火上把肉煮熟的。你毕竟来自一个更为文明的世界。而且，虽然那个狐狸村里的调味料不多，但只要把肉煮得当，吃起来还是会更加美味的。当然，你也不会知道这一点，因为你从来没吃过生兔子肉。你只会认为自己是对的罢了。 ] 凯拉尼向后靠在草椅上，满足地叹了口气，手部轻轻抚摸着自己的肚子——她刚刚吃掉了一整只野兔，甚至还剩下一点。自从你刚才见到她之后，她已经稍微整理了一下自己，不过她的毛皮仍然带着淡淡的红色，尤其是嘴巴和手部指周围。“真好吃，”她说着，向后仰靠，目光漫无目的地望着小屋的天花板。 [pc.bg barbarian |你注视着凯拉尼，看着她放松下来，细细观察她身体的每一个部位：她的腹部圆润饱满，显然刚刚吃饱；她的嘴巴、下巴、大部分胸部，以及双手直至手腕，都还沾着层层血迹。她那满足的神情，分明是在享受一顿美餐后的满足感。而她的头发和毛发也显得杂乱无章，显然已经有一段时间没有好好打理过了。 神明们她很容易被吸引。 |也许事情并不是这样发展的…… 你 她会去吃饭。她那雪白的毛皮上还残留着红色的血迹，这些血迹分布在她的嘴巴、下巴、胸部，以及双手直至手腕处。但是……你不得不承认，凯拉尼此刻的表情和肢体语言中流露出一种平静与安宁。她真的很享受这个过程。此刻，有你在她身边陪伴，她看起来如此惬意。 有时候，生活其实比你想象的要简单得多。 ]
rows.raw: ' [pc.bg barbarian |Goddamn, that was the best meal you’ve had in a hot minute. No bullshit, no mess or frills, just straight meat, freshly stripped and still dripping. Living in 'civilized’ worlds sometimes makes you forget about how good it can be to live like you ought to: off the land. The only thing that could have made it better is if you had killed it and skinned it yourself. |You acquiesced to Kailani dragging you off to the storehouse for some more meat, and you even had something for yourself... but you cooked it, first, over an open fire. You’re from a more civilized world than that. And besides, although the vulperine village is short on seasonings, the meat is more satisfying to eat when it’s cooked properly. Not that you’d know, you’ve never eaten raw rabbit. You’re just going to assume that you’re right. ] Kailani leans back onto her straw chair and sighs in content, her hand running over her stomach as she digests an entire hare, plus a bit extra. She’s cleaned herself up a little bit since you met her a bit ago, although her fur is still tinged red, particularly around her mouth and fingers. "That was good," she says, leaning back and letting her eyes roam aimlessly over the ceiling of her hut. [pc.bg barbarian |You look at Kailani as she relaxes, drinking in every facet of her body. The stomach, rounded and packed with a fresh kill. Her mouth, chin, most of her chest, and her hands down to her wrists, still covered in varying layers of blood. The look of total satisfaction she has from eating a fresh meal. The shaggy condition of her hair and fur, grown out and barely cared for. Gods, she’s fuckable. |It may not have been how you would go about eating a meal. And her snow-white fur is still tinged red with varying layers of blood, all across her mouth, her chin, down her chest, and on her hands down to her wrists. But... you can’t deny the sort of serenity Kailani has in her expression and body language right now. She really enjoyed that. She looks so comfortable right now, in her house with you for her company. Sometimes, life is simpler than you give it credit for. ]'

rows.original: You see Kailani standing at the entrance to her hut, staring out towards the entrance to the village. Her arms and legs are both crossed and she leans against the frame to the hut’s entrance; she rubs at her arms and her tail twitches erratically behind her, back and forth, not comfortable with any position beneath herself. Her hands keep rubbing at her arms as if she’s cold – you’ve never seen her cold before, even when she buries her whole body in the snow as part of her hunting[dayNight |. Near her is [inaya.introduced |Inaya |the kit that she’s always with ], practicing her skills with the leather tanning rack that Kailani’s set up just outside of her hut ]. As soon as she sees you, her ears and her tail all perk straight upward, standing erect[dayNight |. "Inaya," she says quickly, getting [inaya.introduced |[inaya.kaiIsMom |her daughter’s |Inaya’s ] |the kit’s ] attention. "Chreu ma linde im way. [pc.name] ui ooun beit vienug luut." [inaya.introduced |Inaya |The kit ] looks up at Kailani, then at you, then back to Kailani, looking almost as if she had done something wrong and Kailani was trying to banish her. "I-Igue," she says hesitantly, getting up and leaving the tanning rack to head towards the campfire in the village’s center. You give [inaya.introduced |Inaya one last look, and she gives one to you, |the kit one last look ] before heading up to Kailani |. You approach her ], and as soon as you’re in arm’s reach, Kailani lunges forward and grabs onto you by the [pc.upperGarments], fiercely yanking you into the hut. With a twist of her arms, she slams you against the inside wall of her building, pinning you against it and trapping you between it and herself. Her eyes are wide, her pupils are dilated, her nostrils are flared, and her teeth are bared. She looks like a wild animal, pissed that you’re intruding on her turf – if you say or do the wrong thing, she’s just as liable to bite you as she is to do anything else. [pc.heightRange 0 66 |Y |Despite the difference in size between you two, y ]ou’re caught by surprise by the sudden strength and swiftness – all of that time hunting and hauling big game animals has given her quite the strength of arm. "[pc.name]," she growls, her breath hotly washing against your neck and chest as she stands so close to you. "I will say this in your words so that you know what it is I want." She leans upward, her nose dragging across yours, her lips (and teeth) coming less than half an inch from yours. "Fuck. Me." [pc.isDK |On the one hand, you don’t think you like it when she’s so uppity and demanding. But on the other, the cutesy wallflower freshly-de-virginized personality was getting kind of stale. |You hesitate, then – although you recognize this isn’t the time or place to be asking questions – you ask her where she learned that word. "A vulp of the village taught me," she answers. "No more words. Sex now." ] Without another word, she grabs you by both wrists and leads you to her room. You don’t complain. She said it in your words, so you know what it is she wants, after all.

rows.original: There’s a commotion going on in Kailani’s hut. You don’t see her anywhere, but [inaya.introduced |Inaya |the kit that’s always hanging around her ] is sitting outside, in front of the tanning rack, with her hands folded on her lap and her gaze cast towards the ground. Two other vulperine women of the village that you don’t recognize stand guard at the entrance to the hut, each holding a spear in their inside hand, and every now and then, you hear groaning coming from deeper inside. It must be time – Kailani must be giving birth! You approach the hut; the women are probably there to keep others out, but hopefully they know by now that you’re Kailani’s mate, and they’ll let you through. Unfortunately, there’s no such luck. Both of them remain steadfastly in place, and when you approach, their spears cross between each other, blocking your path. "Hierek whollim win weirg laug vie hup tie mola," the woman on your right says. You don’t know enough of the vulperine language to know exactly what she said. You recognize one of the words – 'weirg’ – to mean 'mate’, or something close to it. "Kailani’s mate," you say quickly, pointing to yourself repeatedly. You hope that they get the picture – that’s your mate in there, and you don’t have time to be playing charades with people you can’t speak with. The vulperine woman on your right narrows her eyes in confusion. "Name?" she asks over the sound of Kailani’s pained grunting. You respond with your name, and as soon as you do, the guardswomen uncross their spears, letting you in, just as you hear Kailani let out one longer, deeper, pained moan. It’s only a few wide paces to Kailani’s room. You throw open the hemp curtain. There’s Kailani, lying on her bed with her legs spread underneath a thick, heavy blanket, but between them is an older vulperine woman – and soon, the sound of a baby crying fills the air. The older woman pulls back to reach for a cloth she had set aside earlier, only briefly glancing towards you, before dipping back under the heavy blanket for another moment. When she pulls back once more, there, in her hands, is a vulperine kit, taking its first few breaths. Its eyes are firmly shut and swollen; its fur is moist after having been recently patted down. From the sounds it’s making as it cries, it’s got a healthy set of lungs on it. It has pink, wrinkly skin with no sign of any fur anywhere on its body. And to top it all off, it’s only about the size of your hand[pc.ra human |. If Kailani was having that much difficulty with a baby that size, she’d probably call you a liar if you showed her a human baby ]. You may not have made it for the exact moment, but you were there for its first breath. The mother herself is on her back, her tongue lolling from the side of her mouth, her left arm up and her forearm covering her eyes. She’s panting like she’s run a marathon and her disheveled fur is even more ragged and unkempt than usual. Even the sound of her newly-born baby crying isn’t enough to snap her out of it, but as soon as you say her name, her arm removes itself and she looks at you with bleary eyes. "[pc.name]," she says, huffing through her exhaustion. She tries to smile, and although you do see it in her eyes, her lips barely have the strength to lift. "You came." The elderly woman carefully shuffles to along Kailani’s left, still holding the kit in her hands, while you take your place at Kailani’s right, kneeling down beside her. Kailani turns her head away from you to take the baby into her own hands, and once the little thing is nestled against her chest, it quickly starts to calm down. Not enough to totally stop crying, but it goes from a full-lunged wail to a more muted sob with the occasional sniffle. You lean over Kailani’s shoulder, looking down her neck towards the kit, and she leans her head against yours. She’s still trying to catch her breath after all that. [pc.isDK |All in all, it ain’t much to look at – but you made that. Kailani did the hard part, but you were involved. With your genes mixed with Kailani’s, it’ll be a knockout in twenty year’s time. |The baby is a shivering, naked, blind mess of a thing – but it’s yours. You and Kailani did that. After all this time, of having been an adoptive mother, she finally has a kit of her own, a sibling for [inaya.introduced |Inaya |the kit that keeps hanging around her. ] ] At the risk as coming off as insensitive or ruining the moment, you ask Kailani if it’s a boy or a girl. [pc.ra vulperine |You weren’t born as a vulperine and y |Y ]ou’re not as familiar with vulperine kits as you probably should be... "Girl," she responds simply. Your next question is if she had picked out a name for her. With [inaya.introduced |names like Kailani and Inaya |a name like Kailani ], and given that the kit is a vulperine of the village, you’d think she’d want the baby to have a name more fitting of her people. She sighs as the elderly woman in the heavy robes shows herself out, now that her work is done and the rest is up to the parents. From the look on Kailani’s face, she isn’t caught off-guard, and she always had an idea of what she wanted. "Look at her," she says, diverting the topic a bit. "All of that for one kit." The baby shivers and mewls, defenseless, cold, and just as exhausted as Kailani. [pc.ra vulperine |It’s hard to believe that both you and her looked like that once. |It’s almost hard to believe that you were like that once: a baby that could barely breathe, much less travel the world and fight demons as you do. ][pc.ra vulperine | ... Just one kit? That’s... not normal. |... From the way she phrased it, it sounds like only having one kit is... unusual for vulperine families. ] You don’t say anything; the implication she made says more than enough for you both. "It is," she says, her voice catching in her throat for a moment as she tries to articulate her thoughts. "It is... a gift from Velun that we have a kit at all," she says. Her expression is already tired and somewhat distant from the exhaustion, but it visibly falls further, going from merely 'tired’ to 'defeated’. "One is too few. But it is all we have. Inaya – her umfract only had two, and one... did not make it. I do not know if it is a fault with the Ibulim, or–" You stop her right there by placing your index finger on her lips. Clearly, the fact that she only has one kid is upsetting her, but hanging on the fact is only going to make it worse. Rather than tell her not to worry about it or something equally platitudinous, you tell her that the baby that you two have right now is beautiful. Although her expression doesn’t change that much, the tension in her shoulders evaporate, and she lets out a long, heavy sigh. Your words clearly had some effect on her. "What is this word?" she asks you. "'Beautiful.’ What is this word?" It’s... when a thing looks so good that you can’t take your eyes off it. She smirks, and lets out the tiniest "heh" she can through her pursed lips. "'Beautiful,’" she repeats. "It is a good word." She looks up at you, craning her head for the first time since you came into the room. "Am I beautiful?" You look into her eyes. Her hair, while normally unkempt and wild, is even more frazzled and disheveled than normal. She barely has the energy to smile at you, and the exhaustion is clear in her eyes; she has fur covering her face, but you’re sure she has deep, dark bags underneath them. She looks like she’s been thrown off a cliff and she spent the last day and a half climbing her way back up. [pc.isDK |Honestly? Given that that’s your rugrat against her chest, you don’t think you’ve ever been more attracted to her than you are right now. |You tell her, with all sincerity, that she’s never looked better. That 'freshly-made mom’ aura fits her like a glove. ] For the first time since you came in, she finds the energy to smile. "Opal," she says eventually, looking down at the kit. It’s finally found a decent place to get comfortable against Kailani’s fur, although it keeps fussing and moving, trying to get her bushy fur to warm its colder parts just right. "That is her name. She is 'beautiful,’ and an opal is the most 'beautiful’ thing I can think of. So her name is Opal." The name takes you by surprise. Compared to the name[inaya.introduced |s Inaya and ] Kailani, the name 'Opal’ sounds fairly plain, and hardly native to the village... But you’re not about to argue.
rows.translation: 凯拉尼的小屋里一片嘈杂声。你到处都找不到她…… [inaya.introduced |Inaya |她总是随身携带的那个工具包 ] 她坐在外面，站在晒黑架前，双手部交叠放在膝上，目光凝视着地面。村子里另外两个你并不认识的女性，正站在小屋的入口处站岗，每个人都用一只手部握着长矛。偶尔，你会听到从小屋内部传来的呻吟声。 一定是时候了——凯拉尼应该快要生孩子了！你走向小屋，那些妇女们应该是在阻止其他人进去，但希望她们现在已经知道你是凯拉尼的伴侣，会让你进去的。 可惜，事情并没有那么顺利。 他们两人都坚守在自己的位置上，当你靠近时，他们的长矛会交叉在一起，挡住你的去路。希里克会赢吗？真奇怪，哈哈，加油吧，莫拉！是你右边的那个女人说的。” 你对这种语言了解得还不够多，因此无法完全理解她的话。不过你认出了其中一个词——“weirg”——这个词的意思应该是“伴侣”或者类似的含义。你迅速说道：“那是凯拉尼的伴侣，”一边不停地指着自己。你希望他们能明白意思——那就是你的伴侣，而你没有时间去和那些你无法交流的人玩猜谜游戏。 你右边的那位女子困惑地眯起了眼睛。“名字？”她在凯拉尼痛苦的呻吟声中问道。你报出了自己的名字，就在那一刻，那些守卫们放下了手部中的长矛，让你走了进去——而此时，凯拉尼又发出了一声更长、更凄厉的呻吟声。 距离凯拉尼的房间只有几步之遥。你推开门帘，看到凯拉尼正躺在床上，双腿被厚厚的毯子盖住，但在她的双腿之间，坐着一位年长的女性——不久之后，婴儿的哭声便在空气中回荡起来。那位年长的女性抽身去拿之前准备好的布，只是匆匆瞥了你一眼，然后又重新钻进了厚毯子下面。 当她再次把它拉过来时，她的手部中正握着一只刚刚出生不久的狐狸幼崽。它正微微喘着气，双眼紧闭且有些肿胀；身上的毛皮因为刚刚被抚摸过而显得湿润。从它发出的哭声来看，它的肺部非常健康。它的皮肤呈粉红色，还带着一些褶皱，身体上完全没有毛发的痕迹。最让人惊讶的是，它的体型大概只有你的手部掌那么大而已。[pc.ra human |如果凯拉妮在照顾这么大的婴儿时都会遇到这么多困难，那么当你给她看一个真正的人类婴儿时，她很可能会说你在撒谎。 ]你可能没有恰好出现在那个时刻，但你在它诞生之初就在那里。 那只母兽仰面躺着，舌头从嘴角垂下来，左臂抬起，前臂遮住了它的眼睛。 她喘着粗气，就像跑完了一场马拉松一样，她那凌乱的毛发比平时更加杂乱无章。就连她刚出生的宝宝哭闹的声音也无法将她从这种状态中唤醒，但只要你叫她的名字，她的手部臂就会立刻松开，然后用茫然的眼神看着你。 "[pc.name]你来了，”她说，话语中带着疲惫与辛劳。她努力想要微笑，虽然你能在她的眼中看到那份努力，但她的嘴唇却几乎无力张开。“你来了。” 那位年长的女士小心翼翼地走到凯拉尼的左边，手部中仍然紧握着那套工具；而你则站在凯拉尼的右边，跪在她的身边。 凯拉妮将头转开，把婴儿抱到自己怀里。一旦孩子依偎在她的胸前，很快就开始安静下来。虽然还没有完全停止哭泣，但哭声已经从撕心裂肺的嚎啕变成了轻微的抽泣，偶尔还会发出一声鼻塞声。 你凑近凯拉尼的肩膀，顺着她的脖子向下看去，而她也将头靠在了你的肩上。毕竟，她还在努力恢复呼吸呢。 [pc.isDK |总的来说，这个孩子长得并不特别出众——但这是你和Kailani的共同成果。虽然大部分工作都是Kailani完成的，但你也参与其中了。你们的基因结合在一起，二十年后，这个孩子一定会非常出色。 |这个婴儿浑身发抖，赤裸着身体，还看不见东西，看起来就像一团乱糟糟的东西——但它是你的。这是你和凯拉妮一起创造出来的。经过这么长时间的等待，作为养母的她，终于拥有了自己的孩子，也终于有了一个兄弟姐妹。 [inaya.introduced |Inaya |她总是带着的那个工具包。 ] ] 尽管这样做可能会让人觉得你不够体贴，或者会破坏当时的氛围，但你还是问了凯拉妮，这个孩子是男孩还是女孩。 [pc.ra vulperine |你并非生来就具备狐狸般的特质与能力。 |Y ]你对“狐人族 Kits”这套装备的了解程度，显然应该比现在更深一些…… “女孩，”她简单地回答道。 你接下来的问题应该是，她是否已经为自己选好了名字。 [inaya.introduced |像凯拉尼和伊娜亚这样的名字 |像凯拉尼这样的名字 ]考虑到这个女孩是村里的狐狸后裔，你可能会认为她应该给自己的孩子取一个更符合她族群传统的名字。 当那位穿着厚重长袍的老妇人完成自己的工作后离开时，她叹了口气——剩下的事情就交给孩子的父母去决定了。 从凯拉妮的表情来看，她显然并没有感到意外，因为她从一开始就清楚自己想要什么。“看看她，”她说道，稍微转移了一下话题，“就为了那一套装备，她竟然付出了这么多。”婴儿瑟瑟发抖，发出呜咽声，显得无助而寒冷，和她一样疲惫不堪。 [pc.ra vulperine |很难相信，你和她曾经都有过那样的模样。 |简直难以相信，你曾经也是那样的一只婴儿：连呼吸都显得如此艰难，更别说像现在这样环游世界、与恶魔战斗了。 ][pc.ra vulperine | …只有一套装备？这…不太正常吧。 |从她的说法来看，对于狼人家族来说，只使用一套技能组合似乎确实有些不寻常。 ] 你什么也没说；她那番话已经说明了一切，对你们俩来说都足够了。 “是的，”她说，试图组织自己的语言时，声音有那么一瞬间哽在了喉咙里。“这是……维伦送给我们的礼物，否则我们根本就不会有这些装备。”她的表情已经显得疲惫不堪，甚至带着一丝绝望。“一个太少了。但这就是我们所有的一切了。艾娜雅——她…… umfract 只有两个孩子，其中一个……没能活下来。我不知道这是不是Ibulim的故障，还是……” 你立刻用食指轻轻按住了她的嘴唇。显然，她只有一个孩子这个事实让她非常难过，但一直纠结在这个问题上只会让情况更糟。你没有告诉她不要担心，也没有说一些类似的敷衍话，而是告诉她，你们现在拥有的这个孩子是非常可爱的。 虽然她的表情没有发生太大变化，但肩膀上的紧张情绪已经消失了，她长长地叹了口气。你的话显然对她产生了一定的影响。“这个词是什么意思？”她问你，“‘Beautiful’，这个词是什么意思？” 那就是……当某样东西看起来如此美妙，让你根本无法移开视线的时候。 她露出一丝微笑，然后用紧闭的嘴唇发出了一声极其轻柔的“呵呵”声。“‘漂亮’，”她重复道，“这是个不错的词。”她抬头看着你，这是你进入房间以来她第一次主动抬头看你。“我漂亮吗？你凝视着她的眼睛。她的头发，平时就已经乱蓬蓬的，此刻更是显得更加杂乱无章。她几乎没有力气对你微笑，眼中的疲惫一览无余；她的脸上覆盖着毛发，但你可以肯定，她的双眼下方一定有着深深的黑眼圈。 她看起来就像是从悬崖上被扔了下去，然后花了一天半的时间才爬回来。 [pc.isDK |说真的？ 考虑到那种情况…… 你的 你把那个小家伙紧紧抱在胸前，你会觉得，此刻自己对她产生的吸引力，是前所未有的。 |你一定要真诚地告诉她，她现在看起来比以往任何时候都要漂亮。那种“初为人母”的气质简直和她太相配了。 ] 自从你来到这里之后，她第一次露出了笑容。 “奥帕尔，”她最终说道，目光落在那个小家伙身上。它终于找到了一个舒适的位置，依偎在凯拉妮的毛皮上，虽然还不停地扭动身体，试图让自己的浓密毛皮更好地为那些较冷的部分保暖。“那就是它的名字。它非常‘美丽’，而奥帕尔正是我能想到的最‘美丽’的东西。所以就叫它奥帕尔吧。” 这个名字让你感到有些意外。与之前想到的那些名字相比……[inaya.introduced |沙奈雅和 ] 凯拉尼，这个名字“欧珀尔”听起来实在太过普通，而且也完全不符合这个村庄的传统…… 不过，你大概也不会对此提出异议吧。
rows.raw: ' There’s a commotion going on in Kailani’s hut. You don’t see her anywhere, but [inaya.introduced |Inaya |the kit that’s always hanging around her ] is sitting outside, in front of the tanning rack, with her hands folded on her lap and her gaze cast towards the ground. Two other vulperine women of the village that you don’t recognize stand guard at the entrance to the hut, each holding a spear in their inside hand, and every now and then, you hear groaning coming from deeper inside. It must be time – Kailani must be giving birth! You approach the hut; the women are probably there to keep others out, but hopefully they know by now that you’re Kailani’s mate, and they’ll let you through. Unfortunately, there’s no such luck. Both of them remain steadfastly in place, and when you approach, their spears cross between each other, blocking your path. "Hierek whollim win weirg laug vie hup tie mola," the woman on your right says. You don’t know enough of the vulperine language to know exactly what she said. You recognize one of the words – 'weirg’ – to mean 'mate’, or something close to it. "Kailani’s mate," you say quickly, pointing to yourself repeatedly. You hope that they get the picture – that’s your mate in there, and you don’t have time to be playing charades with people you can’t speak with. The vulperine woman on your right narrows her eyes in confusion. "Name?" she asks over the sound of Kailani’s pained grunting. You respond with your name, and as soon as you do, the guardswomen uncross their spears, letting you in, just as you hear Kailani let out one longer, deeper, pained moan. It’s only a few wide paces to Kailani’s room. You throw open the hemp curtain. There’s Kailani, lying on her bed with her legs spread underneath a thick, heavy blanket, but between them is an older vulperine woman – and soon, the sound of a baby crying fills the air. The older woman pulls back to reach for a cloth she had set aside earlier, only briefly glancing towards you, before dipping back under the heavy blanket for another moment. When she pulls back once more, there, in her hands, is a vulperine kit, taking its first few breaths. Its eyes are firmly shut and swollen; its fur is moist after having been recently patted down. From the sounds it’s making as it cries, it’s got a healthy set of lungs on it. It has pink, wrinkly skin with no sign of any fur anywhere on its body. And to top it all off, it’s only about the size of your hand[pc.ra human |. If Kailani was having that much difficulty with a baby that size, she’d probably call you a liar if you showed her a human baby ]. You may not have made it for the exact moment, but you were there for its first breath. The mother herself is on her back, her tongue lolling from the side of her mouth, her left arm up and her forearm covering her eyes. She’s panting like she’s run a marathon and her disheveled fur is even more ragged and unkempt than usual. Even the sound of her newly-born baby crying isn’t enough to snap her out of it, but as soon as you say her name, her arm removes itself and she looks at you with bleary eyes. "[pc.name]," she says, huffing through her exhaustion. She tries to smile, and although you do see it in her eyes, her lips barely have the strength to lift. "You came." The elderly woman carefully shuffles to along Kailani’s left, still holding the kit in her hands, while you take your place at Kailani’s right, kneeling down beside her. Kailani turns her head away from you to take the baby into her own hands, and once the little thing is nestled against her chest, it quickly starts to calm down. Not enough to totally stop crying, but it goes from a full-lunged wail to a more muted sob with the occasional sniffle. You lean over Kailani’s shoulder, looking down her neck towards the kit, and she leans her head against yours. She’s still trying to catch her breath after all that. [pc.isDK |All in all, it ain’t much to look at – but you made that. Kailani did the hard part, but you were involved. With your genes mixed with Kailani’s, it’ll be a knockout in twenty year’s time. |The baby is a shivering, naked, blind mess of a thing – but it’s yours. You and Kailani did that. After all this time, of having been an adoptive mother, she finally has a kit of her own, a sibling for [inaya.introduced |Inaya |the kit that keeps hanging around her. ] ] At the risk as coming off as insensitive or ruining the moment, you ask Kailani if it’s a boy or a girl. [pc.ra vulperine |You weren’t born as a vulperine and y |Y ]ou’re not as familiar with vulperine kits as you probably should be... "Girl," she responds simply. Your next question is if she had picked out a name for her. With [inaya.introduced |names like Kailani and Inaya |a name like Kailani ], and given that the kit is a vulperine of the village, you’d think she’d want the baby to have a name more fitting of her people. She sighs as the elderly woman in the heavy robes shows herself out, now that her work is done and the rest is up to the parents. From the look on Kailani’s face, she isn’t caught off-guard, and she always had an idea of what she wanted. "Look at her," she says, diverting the topic a bit. "All of that for one kit." The baby shivers and mewls, defenseless, cold, and just as exhausted as Kailani. [pc.ra vulperine |It’s hard to believe that both you and her looked like that once. |It’s almost hard to believe that you were like that once: a baby that could barely breathe, much less travel the world and fight demons as you do. ][pc.ra vulperine | ... Just one kit? That’s... not normal. |... From the way she phrased it, it sounds like only having one kit is... unusual for vulperine families. ] You don’t say anything; the implication she made says more than enough for you both. "It is," she says, her voice catching in her throat for a moment as she tries to articulate her thoughts. "It is... a gift from Velun that we have a kit at all," she says. Her expression is already tired and somewhat distant from the exhaustion, but it visibly falls further, going from merely 'tired’ to 'defeated’. "One is too few. But it is all we have. Inaya – her umfract only had two, and one... did not make it. I do not know if it is a fault with the Ibulim, or–" You stop her right there by placing your index finger on her lips. Clearly, the fact that she only has one kid is upsetting her, but hanging on the fact is only going to make it worse. Rather than tell her not to worry about it or something equally platitudinous, you tell her that the baby that you two have right now is beautiful. Although her expression doesn’t change that much, the tension in her shoulders evaporate, and she lets out a long, heavy sigh. Your words clearly had some effect on her. "What is this word?" she asks you. "'Beautiful.’ What is this word?" It’s... when a thing looks so good that you can’t take your eyes off it. She smirks, and lets out the tiniest "heh" she can through her pursed lips. "'Beautiful,’" she repeats. "It is a good word." She looks up at you, craning her head for the first time since you came into the room. "Am I beautiful?" You look into her eyes. Her hair, while normally unkempt and wild, is even more frazzled and disheveled than normal. She barely has the energy to smile at you, and the exhaustion is clear in her eyes; she has fur covering her face, but you’re sure she has deep, dark bags underneath them. She looks like she’s been thrown off a cliff and she spent the last day and a half climbing her way back up. [pc.isDK |Honestly? Given that that’s your rugrat against her chest, you don’t think you’ve ever been more attracted to her than you are right now. |You tell her, with all sincerity, that she’s never looked better. That 'freshly-made mom’ aura fits her like a glove. ] For the first time since you came in, she finds the energy to smile. "Opal," she says eventually, looking down at the kit. It’s finally found a decent place to get comfortable against Kailani’s fur, although it keeps fussing and moving, trying to get her bushy fur to warm its colder parts just right. "That is her name. She is 'beautiful,’ and an opal is the most 'beautiful’ thing I can think of. So her name is Opal." The name takes you by surprise. Compared to the name[inaya.introduced |s Inaya and ] Kailani, the name 'Opal’ sounds fairly plain, and hardly native to the village... But you’re not about to argue.'

rows.original:
The next few hours are spent you simply bonding with Kailani and Opal. You two made a baby, after all; they both need you here, and you’re not in a rush to go anywhere. Once Opal is good and comfortable against Kailani’s fur, she finally stops sniffling and eventually dozes off – and Kailani is soon to follow, passing out on the bed with the baby still in her arms. That just leaves you alone in the room with them.

        With nothing else for you to do and nobody to talk to, you disengage from Kailani and make your way around her mud-mound of a bed, eventually lying down next to them both, still fully dressed and on top of the thick bearskin covers. You don’t fall asleep – you’re not that tired. You mostly just lie there, staring up at the ceiling, waiting for the time to pass, and listening to the sounds of Kailani and Opal breathing.
        
        After about an hour, to your mild surprise, the hemp curtain to Kailani’s room is flung open – and the midwife that helped deliver Opal is there, still wearing her robes, but hanging off her right arm is a handwoven basket. She stands there for a minute, awaiting permission to come in; rather than give it, you stand and go to her.
        
        In the basket is a thick woven blanket. You had expected it to just be full of other linens – considering kits are born hairless, raising them in this environment must be tricky – but the woman reaches in with her free hand and lifts the blanket away to reveal an assortment of baby-related goods: berries that had been crushed into fine, thin pastes; diapers and other clothing; and leather canteens filled with fresh water.
        
        "For... mate," the woman says, sliding the basket off her arm to you. The basket itself is rather large – perhaps it’s meant to hold Opal while she’s still young. It’s not a very large baby shower gift, but it’s a thoughtful one.
        
        With nothing else to give, the midwife smiles at you, then turns to leave.
rows.translation:
接下来的几个小时，你只是简单地陪伴着凯拉妮和欧珀尔。毕竟，你们俩共同孕育了一个宝宝；她们现在都需要你的陪伴，而你也没有任何急着离开的理由。当欧珀尔在凯拉妮的毛皮上安顿下来，不再抽噎之后，她终于渐渐进入了梦乡——而凯拉妮也很快跟着睡着了，她仍然抱着宝宝躺在床上。这样一来，房间里就只剩下你和她们两个人了。

        由于无事可做，也没有人可以交谈，你离开了凯拉妮，绕过她那堆乱七八糟的睡铺，最终躺在他们俩旁边——依然穿着衣服，就盖在厚厚的熊皮毯子上。你并没有睡着，其实你并不那么累。你只是躺在那里，盯着天花板，等待时间流逝，同时听着凯拉妮和欧珀的呼吸声。
        
        大约一个小时后，令你略感惊讶的是，凯拉尼房间的麻帘被猛地拉开——帮助奥帕尔分娩的助产士站在那里，她仍然穿着那身工作服，但她的右臂上挂着一个手工编织的篮子。她站在那里等待着你的允许才走进房间；而你并没有给她这个许可，反而走到了她跟前。
        
        篮子里有一条厚实的编织毯子。你原本以为里面只会装满其他婴儿用品——毕竟幼崽出生时是没有毛的，在这种环境中抚养它们肯定很麻烦——但那位妇女用空着的手把毯子拿开，露出了里面各式各样的婴儿用品：被碾成细碎糊状的浆果；尿布和其他衣物；还有装满清水的皮制水壶。
        
        给……亲爱的，”那位女士说着，将手中的篮子递给了你。这个篮子其实相当大——大概是为了在奥帕尔还小的时候用来装她吧。虽然这不是一个特别贵重的礼物，但却充满了心意。

助产士没有什么其他东西可以送了，于是对你笑了笑，然后转身离开了。

rows.original: It’s another two hours before Kailani wakes up. [pc.ra vulperine |Knowing how kits can be, that might be the most sleep she’s going to get for some time |You don’t know how vulperine kids can be, but hopefully that’s not the most amount of sleep she’s going to get for a few years ]. Opal, having found herself a warm and cozy spot in Kailani’s fur, hasn’t stirred the entire time. She breathes at a rapid clip, taking three breaths for every one of yours. You lie on your side, watching Kailani and Opal together. Neither of you exchange many words. A part of you wants to ask if she’s good to stand and walk, but she just had a whole other living being pushed through her – she’s going to be bedridden for at least a little while longer. Instead, your presence is all you and Opal really need... even though Opal’s eyes aren’t open to see you yet. [pc.ra vulperine |It’ll be roughly six months before Opal’s eyes are even open, much less her being able to have the motor skills to crawl around. |You do ask Kailani how long it’ll be before they’re open. "Uhh," she stammers, unsure how to answer the question in your language. "The cold will be gone and half way back by the time her eyes are open." ... Oh, about six months. That was a roundabout way to describe it. Six months is a while... ] Again, the hemp curtain shuffles and shimmies out of place, but rather than an adult bearing more baby gifts, a much smaller vulperine peeks their head in from around the laid brick of the room. [inaya.introduced |It’s Inaya, Kailani’s first daughter |It’s the kit that’s normally with Kailani every other hour of the day ], nervously peering into the room to see if it’s alright to come in – she’s been sitting outside of the hut the whole time, anxiously awaiting the news. She’s been just as diligent in being by Kailani’s side as you were. "Um," [inaya.introduced |Inaya |the kit ] asks as she flits in and out of the hemp curtain. She’s trying to make her appearance obvious, and she wants to be given permission to come in, but she doesn’t want to ask for it. "Figg no," Kailani answers. You recognize one of those words, and your mind immediately jumps to Kailani telling the girl to leave, but instead, she comes bounding in excitedly, rushing up to Kailani’s side. Languages can be weird things sometimes. [inaya.introduced |Inaya |The little girl ] comes up a little faster than she ought to beside Kailani, excited to see the baby, though as soon as she sees that Opal is asleep, she tries to temper herself a little bit to stay quiet. Her fingers grip onto the edge of the mud bed as she peers towards the baby. She coos in awe at Opal. "Im ko iyan," she notes, pinching her thumb and index fingers together to try and pantomime that something is really small. Opal is small enough that she could fit into your open hand – the fact that Kailani was that small once is just a part of the miracle of life. "Wayto ko fria?" Kailani hums in ascension, nodding her head once. "Gaul." She turns her head slightly to address you. "This is her... kin. Her..." She sighs through her nose. "I do not know the word in your tongue." If two girls have the same parents, that makes them 'sisters’. So [inaya.introduced |Inaya and Opal are sisters – maybe not by blood, but that doesn’t change anything. |Opal and the kit are sisters. Although... if you’re going to be Opal’s parent, then you really ought to at least try and get to know the little girl that hangs around Kailani a little more. You haven’t even been properly introduced to each other. ] "Sisters," Kailani repeats as she looks down at Opal, still sound asleep in her mother’s chest fur. "Opal and Inaya are 'sisters’. Inaya," she continues, addressing the little girl directly once more, "im tolm ko Opal." She sighs in awe, as though she just watched a star shoot across a night sky. "Opal," she repeats. rows.translation: 又过了两个小时，凯拉妮才醒了过来。 [pc.ra vulperine |考虑到那些小工具的实际情况，她这次可能会睡个好觉了。 |你根本不知道那些调皮捣蛋的小家伙们能做出什么来，不过希望在未来几年里，她睡觉的时间不会因此而减少太多吧。 ]奥帕尔在凯拉尼的毛皮中找到了一个温暖舒适的地方，自那以后就一直一动不动。她的呼吸非常急促，每当你呼吸三次，她才会呼吸一次。 你侧躺着，观察着凯拉尼和奥帕尔在一起的样子。 你们俩几乎没有交流过多少话。你内心有一部分很想问问她现在是否已经能够站立行走了，但事实上，她刚刚经历了一次极其艰难的手术——至少在短时间内，她还是需要卧床休息的。 事实上，你的陪伴才是你和奥帕尔真正需要的……尽管奥帕尔还没有意识到你的存在。 [pc.ra vulperine |大约需要六个月的时间，Opal的双眼才能睁开，更不用说她能够具备爬行所需的运动能力了。 |你 做 问凯拉尼还要过多久它们才会开放。 “呃……”她结结巴巴地回答，不知道该如何用你们的语言来回答这个问题。“等她的眼睛睁开的时候，寒冷应该已经消退了一半。” ……哦，大概需要六个月吧。她的说法确实有点绕弯子。六个月确实是一段不短的时间…… ] 又一次，那块大麻布帘子晃动了几下，从原来的位置移开了。然而，出现的并不是一个带着更多婴儿礼物的成年人，而是一只体型小得多的狐狸从房间里的砖墙后面探出了头来。 [inaya.introduced |这是伊奈亚，凯拉妮的长女。 |这就是通常每两小时就会出现在凯拉妮身边的那套装备。 ]她紧张地往房间里张望，想确认是否可以进去——整个时间里，她都坐在小屋外面，焦急地等待着消息。她和你们一样，也一直悉心陪伴在凯拉尼身边。 “嗯， [inaya.introduced |Inaya |这套装备 ] 她穿梭于麻布帘子之间，一边问道。她想让自己显得更加显眼，也想得到允许进入，却又不想直接开口请求。不知道。是的，”凯拉尼回答道。你听出了其中某个词，脑海中立刻浮现出凯拉尼让那个女孩离开的场景，但事实上，那个女孩却兴奋地跑了过来，急匆匆地来到凯拉尼身边。语言有时候确实是很奇怪的东西。 [inaya.introduced |Inaya |那个小女孩 ] 她在凯拉尼旁边走得有点快，看到婴儿后显得非常兴奋，但一旦发现奥帕尔已经睡着了，她立刻努力让自己保持安静。她的手指紧紧抓住泥床的边缘，凝视着那个婴儿。 她满怀敬畏地轻声呼唤着奥帕尔。我是科伊安。她这样说道，同时把拇指和食指捏在一起，试图用动作来表达某物确实非常小。奥帕尔小到足以放进你的掌心——凯拉尼曾经也有那么小，这一事实本身就是生命奇迹的一部分。前往科弗里亚之路凯拉妮轻声哼着旋律，点了点头。高卢她微微转头对你说道：“这是她的……亲人。她的……”她轻叹着，“我不知道你们语言中该用什么词来表达。” 如果两个女孩有相同的父母，那么她们就被称为‘姐妹’。所以…… [inaya.introduced |Inaya和Opal是姐妹——虽然可能并非亲生姐妹，但这并不会改变什么。 |奥帕尔和那个小工具其实是“姐妹”。不过……如果你打算成为奥帕尔的“家长”的话，那么…… 你真的应该至少试着多了解一下那个经常和凯拉妮在一起的小女孩。你们甚至还没有正式互相介绍过呢。 ] 姐妹们，”凯拉尼重复道，低头看着仍在母亲胸前的毛皮中熟睡的奥帕尔，“奥帕尔和伊奈亚是‘姐妹’。伊奈亚，”她再次直接对小女孩说道，我得去找奥帕尔了。她惊叹地叹了口气，仿佛刚刚看到一颗星星划过夜空。“欧泊尔，”她重复道。她的尾巴比凯拉尼的更细，此刻正快速地来回摆动，她正在仔细打量着这位新妹妹。

Opal, having found herself a warm and cozy spot in Kailani’s fur, hasn’t stirred the entire time. She breathes at a rapid clip, taking three breaths for every one of yours. You lie on your side, watching Kailani and Opal together. Neither of you exchange many words. A part of you wants to ask if she’s good to stand and walk, but she just had a whole other living being pushed through her – she’s going to be bedridden for at least a little while longer. Instead, your presence is all you and Opal really need... even though Opal’s eyes aren’t open to see you yet. rows.original: A few hours pass. Eventually, Kailani complains about stiffness and bed cramps – she’s been lying in the same position for some time. That’s bound to do a number on her back. But there’s not a lot she can do with Opal sleeping on her, and you’re both at the mercy of a creature smaller than a whittling knife. Thankfully, it’s not much longer until the kid starts to wake and squirm in Kailani’s fur. With Opal’s eyes firmly shut for another six whole months, the most that she’s concerned with is kneading through her mother’s fur in search of a teat, and once she finds it, she’s good and set for at least another few minutes. Long enough for both of you to get up and for you to bring Kailani the basket filled with things for the baby that the midwife had left you. Getting together a family plan was modestly simple, considering you have a brand new child to look after now. Where you come from, babies tend to sleep in cribs, but vulperine babies are so small that the basket is more than serviceable until Opal is old and big enough to have her own bed. Opal and the basket don’t leave the hut during the day, and they’re always in the same room as Kailani during the night. Although she’s a new mother, Kailani is still the best hunter in the village (according to her, anyway), and she still has more to support than just Opal. But, taking the old adage literally, there’s no shortage of stay-at-home medicine men and women, or other experienced and elderly vulperines, that are willing and capable of helping one of their own raise a baby during the day. As far as you can tell, everything is accounted for.[silly | Man, raising a baby is easy! ] [pc.isDK |Which works for you. You live a fairly nomadic life, and that’s not going to change whether or not you have the title of 'Kailani’s mate’. You’ll pop in and see the little rugrat every now and again – probably – but Kailani knew what she was getting into when she chose you. |Although... you live a fairly nomadic lifestyle, and by necessity you can’t be staying in the vulperine village forever. And as much as Kailani wants you around, you worry that they’re already going to frown on her mating with a 'taminyk’. You want to be with your daughter, but the longer you stay, who knows how things might turn out – not just here in the village, but elsewhere in Savarra. ] Kailani’s been around you long enough that she’s picked up something of a sense for your thoughts, and [pc.isDK |although she might not agree with your attitude |although she’s confident that the village would see things her way – she’s the best hunter among them, and she commands some respect for it ], she nonetheless understands where your other responsibilities lie. "[pc.name]," she starts, then hesitating immediately. Her eyes drift to the side as she considers how to word her thoughts, and her lips purse and curl into each other as she racks her head for words in your language. "Opal will be fine. She has the village. She has me and Inaya. She is small now..." She pauses, looking down into the hand basket at the tiny kit, wrapped in handwoven blankets. "But she will grow." Finally, Kailani finds her smile. "She is the child of the best two ibulimo in the village, and all." Still, her smile doesn’t last long. Her eyes close and she takes a sigh through her nose. "Just... come back," she says. "The umwricht of Inaya left her. You are the umwricht to Opal, [inaya.kaiIsMom |and Inaya calls you umwricht as well |and Inaya... she does not speak to taminyko, but she wants to know you more. I can tell ]. You have a falima here. And the falima is not whole without you." Kailani’s laying it on thick, but it’s hardly a mystery why: the whole Ibulim family history is filled with parents walking out and leaving their kids for one reason or another. You’re not surprised that she’s practically begging you to at least come back every now and again. [pc.isDK |You tell her that you’ll see what you can do. |You promise that you’ll be back. You won’t let what happened to her and Inaya happen to Opal, too. ] She sighs again, then rests her cheek on your shoulder. [pc.isDK |That’s good enough for her. |That was just what she wanted to hear. ]
rows.translation: 几个小时过去了。最终，凯拉妮开始抱怨身体僵硬以及腿部抽筋——她已经保持同一个姿势躺了很长时间，这样的姿势肯定会对她的背部造成不良影响。不过，由于奥帕尔正趴在她身上，她也没什么办法可以改变这种状况，而你们俩目前都只能任由这个比小刀还小的生物摆布了。 幸运的是，再过不久，那个小家伙就会开始醒来，在凯拉尼的毛发中扭动翻滚了。由于奥帕尔还要再闭着眼睛整整六个月，她现在最关心的就是在妈妈的毛发中摸索，寻找奶嘴；一旦找到了奶嘴，她就能安心地继续睡觉至少几分钟。这段时间足够你们俩起床了，你也就可以把助产士留给你的、装满婴儿用品的篮子拿给凯拉尼了。 考虑到你现在需要照顾一个刚出生的婴儿，制定一个家庭计划其实相当简单。在你们的家乡，婴儿通常会睡在婴儿床里，但狐人族族的婴儿体型太小，因此使用那个篮子来抚养他们完全足够了，直到Opal长大到可以拥有自己的床为止。白天，Opal和那个篮子一直待在小屋里，而晚上它们也会和Kailani待在同一个房间里。 虽然她刚成为母亲，但根据她自己的说法，凯拉妮仍然是村里最出色的猎手。而且，她需要照顾的不仅仅是奥帕尔。不过，按照那句古老的谚语，村里有很多愿意也有能力帮忙照顾婴儿的妇女，以及那些经验丰富、年事已高的女性猎手。看起来，一切都已经安排妥当了。[silly | 天啊，养孩子其实挺容易的！ ] [pc.isDK |这方式对你来说挺合适的。你的生活本来就比较漂泊，无论你是否获得了“凯拉尼的伴侣”这个头衔，这种情况都不会改变。你可能会偶尔去看看那个小家伙吧……但凯拉尼在选择你的时候，就已经清楚自己会面临什么了。 |虽然……你的生活方式确实相当游牧，而且出于种种原因，你也不可能永远留在那个村庄里。尽管凯拉尼非常希望你能留在她身边，但你担心，如果她与一个“塔米尼克”结婚，其他人肯定会反对。你很想陪在女儿身边，但如果你再待下去，谁也不知道事情会发展成什么样子——不仅仅是在这个村庄里，也可能在萨瓦拉的其他地方。 ] 凯拉妮与你相处已久，她已经逐渐能够揣测出你的想法了。 [pc.isDK |尽管她可能不同意你的态度。 |尽管她相信村民们会认同她的观点——毕竟她是村里最出色的猎人，因此也赢得了人们的尊重。 ]尽管如此，她依然明白你的其他责任所在。[pc.name]奥帕尔会没事的，”她开始说道，但立刻又停住了。她的目光转向一旁，思索着该如何用你们的语言表达自己的意思。她的嘴唇微微抿紧，努力寻找合适的词语。“她有整个村子，有我和伊奈亚陪着她。现在她还很小……”她停顿了一下，低头看着那个装在手工编织的毯子里的小小包裹。“但她会慢慢长大的。”最终，凯拉尼露出了微笑，“她可是最优秀的两个父母的孩子啊。 ibulimo 在村子里，就这样。” 然而，她的笑容并没有持续太久。她闭上了眼睛，通过鼻子叹了口气。“只是……回来吧，”她说。“这里…… 嗯……这个名称听起来有点特别吧。 伊奈亚离开了你。你是…… 嗯……这个名称听起来有点特别吧。 致奥帕尔， [inaya.kaiIsMom |而伊奈亚正在呼唤你…… 嗯……这个名称听起来有点特别吧。 也 |还有伊奈亚……她根本不跟任何人说话。 塔米尼科但她想更深入地了解你。我看得出来。 ]你有一个 法利玛 就在这里。还有…… 法利玛 没有你，这一切都不完整。” 凯拉妮的话虽然有些夸张，但原因其实很明显：伊布利姆家族的历史上，父母们因为各种原因离开孩子、抛弃他们的例子比比皆是。所以，她恳求你至少偶尔回来看看，这也并不令人感到意外。 [pc.isDK |你告诉她，你会看看能做些什么。 |你答应过会回来。你不会让发生在她和伊奈亚身上的事情也发生在欧珀尔身上。 ] 她又叹了口气，然后将脸颊靠在你的肩膀上。 [pc.isDK |这对她来说已经足够好了。 |这正是她想听到的话。 ]

rows.original: A short while after you’re finished, you lie on Kailani’s bed, underneath her bearskin covers, totally nude. Kailani lies on top of you, snuggled up against your body; her fingers trace idle, lazy circles on your [pc.chest] and she occasionally hums in satisfaction with herself, content and enjoying the moment she’s having with you. You say that she must have really needed that. "It got my mind off a thing or two," she replies in a sing-song tone. Her heavy fur drapes over your [pc.skinFurScales] as she relaxes on top of you, her body spreading out as she gets good and comfortable. Done with tracing circles, she instead presses her palm gently against your body and lets it slide down, crossing over your stomach and resting her fingers just a few inches shy of your waistline. "It would be nice to get my mind off a third or fourth thing, too." Kailani, naturally, is hot on your heels, bounding with every step, delighted to be spending some time with her family like this. [dayNight |And there she is: [kailani.opalBeforeAfter |still naked, hairless, and blind, but active and moving. [rand |She peeps and hums as she moves, but Kailani recognizes the sounds as her just trying to communicate with the world rather than her trying to find her mother or asking for milk – except when she is. Those peeps and warbles sound distinctly different. |Now and again, you catch her with her hands forward, repeatedly kneading into the blanket that’s on top of. It’s probably good for building her motor skills, too. |The edges of the inside of the basket are slightly worn all around, and it’s easy to see why: Opal’s been rubbing against it repeatedly. Opal’s fur has come in thick enough that you can clearly see its white sheen, spotless all over, just like her mother’s. [rand |In her hands is a hand-made doll, held together with burlap and probably stuffed with fur. Although you can’t see the seams, you can’t see what’s holding it together.
